title: Product Manager – Enterprise AI Operations & Observability
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  
**Product Manager – Enterprise AI Operations & Observability**
Department: Tech@Lilly
  
  
Location: Hyderabad, India
  
  
Position Type: Full-Time
  
  
Level: P4
  
  
**Position Summary**
**Eli Lilly is seeking a highly accomplished and hands on technology lead to drive our Enterprise AI Observability platform fuelling our ARE journey. This pivotal role is responsible for defining, implementing, and optimizing observability platform/s, and processes that ensure the reliability, performance, scalability, and security. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in driving of system of events end to end lifecycle management, self-serve instrumentation using agentic and automation, with a proven track in complex, large-scale environments. They will also partner closely with the ARE Architects and other platform engineers to execute a cohesive strategy that delivers measurable value across the organization, ensuring alignment between architectural vision and operational excellence.**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategic Leadership & Governance**

* Execute and drive forward a comprehensive strategy for enterprise observability
* Establish governance frameworks, standards, and best practices for deployments.
* Ensure compliance with regulatory, security, and operational requirements.

**AIOps**

* Drive the adoption of AIOps practices for proactive issue detection, intelligent alerting, root cause analysis, and automated remediation.
* Establish and scale practices for secure, efficient, and reliable deployment, observability, and lifecycle management of platform.

**Enterprise Observability**

* Enhance and maintain a robust observability strategy across infrastructure, applications, networks, security, and data systems.
* Standardize the collection, correlation, and analysis of metrics, logs, and traces across all technology layers.
* Build predictive capabilities and dashboards to anticipate failures and enable proactive interventions.
* Treat observability as a product, continuously iterating to meet evolving business needs.

**Tooling, Platform Management & Automation**

* Evaluate, implement, and manage advanced observability, and AIOps platforms and tools.
* Optimize and scale observability of infrastructure for high availability and performance.
* Design intuitive, high-value dashboards and alerting systems that clearly visualize system health and performance.
* Champion automation using scripting, orchestration tools, and AI-driven solutions to reduce manual effort and enable self-healing systems.
* Partner with automation teams to develop and implement automation scripts and workflows.

**Operational Resilience**

* Ensure high availability and resilience of mission-critical systems, especially AI/ML workloads.
* Collaborate closely with the Service Management Office and production support teams to drive impactful outcomes and elevate operational success
* Enable methods to reduce mean time recovery (MTTR) and drive continuous operational improvements.

**Performance & Reliability Optimization**

* Utilize observability data to identify performance bottlenecks, capacity issues, and reliability risks.
* Work with relevant teams to implement improvements based on data-driven insights.
* Establish and execute performance strategy benchmarks utilizing baselines and KPIs.

**Team Leadership & Enablement**

* Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing team of engineers and specialists in AIOps
* Provide training and documentation to operational teams on leveraging observability platforms for troubleshooting and performance tuning.
* Foster a culture of innovation, continuous learning, and operational excellence.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Collaborate with engineering, data science, infrastructure, cybersecurity, and business teams to operationalize AI initiatives and ensure comprehensive observability coverage.
* Serve as a subject matter expert to understand and deliver tailored observability solutions across teams.

**Budget & Vendor Management**

* Manage departmental budgets and vendor relationships to deliver cost-effective, scalable solutions.

**Qualifications**
**Required**

* Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Engineering, IT, or a related field.
* 15+ years of progressive technology experience, including 5–7 years in enterprise operations, ARE/SRE and AI operations.
* Deep understanding of the lifecycle, including development, deployment, observability, and retraining.
* Proven experience with enterprise observability across hybrid environments.
* Expertise in AIOps principles and implementation.
* Proficiency with leading observability and MLOps tools and platforms.
* Strong knowledge of cloud platforms, containerization, and microservices.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Demonstrated ability to build and lead high-performing engineering teams.
* Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making skills.

**Monitoring & Observability**
Open Telemetry, Splunk, Datadog, Dynatrace, Prometheus, Grafana - PLGJ stack
  
  
**Infrastructure**
Kubernetes, AWS, Azure, VMware, OpenShift
  
  
**Data & Knowledge**
ServiceNow
  
  
**Agentic & AI**
MCP, REST APIs
  
  
**Automation & Runbooks**
Ansible, Terraform, Python, GitHub
  
  
**Governance**
Jira
  
  
**Preferred**

* Experience in regulated industries (e.g., healthcare, finance).
* Certifications in cloud platforms or operational frameworks (e.g., ITIL).
* Active participation in AIOps or MLOps professional communities.

Lilly is dedicated to helping individuals with disabilities to actively engage in the workforce, ensuring equal opportunities when vying for positions. If you require accommodation to submit a resume for a position at Lilly, please complete the accommodation request form (https://careers.lilly.com/us/en/workplace-accommodation) for further assistance. Please note this is for individuals to request an accommodation as part of the application process and any other correspondence will not receive a response.
  
  
Lilly does not discriminate on the basis of age, race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status.

title: Senior Manager 2, Product Development IT lead Hyd
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.
  
  
At Bristol Myers Squibb, we are inspired by a single vision – transforming patients’ lives through science. In oncology, hematology, immunology and cardiovascular disease – and one of the most diverse and promising pipelines in the industry – each of our passionate colleagues contribute to innovations that drive meaningful change. We bring a human touch to every treatment we pioneer. Join us and make a difference.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
At BMS, digital innovation and Information Technology are central to our vision of transforming patients’ lives through science. To accelerate our ability to serve patients around the world, we must unleash the power of technology. We are committed to being at the forefront of transforming the way medicine is made and delivered by harnessing the power of computer and data science, artificial intelligence, and other technologies to promote scientific discovery, faster decision making, and enhanced patient care.
  
  
If you want an exciting and rewarding career that is meaningful, consider joining our diverse team!
  
  
**Desired Candidate Characteristics**

* Have a strong commitment to a career in technology with a passion for healthcare
* Ability to understand the needs of the business and commitment to deliver the best user experience and adoption
* 10+ years of experience in all phases of SDLC involving Analysis, Design, Development, Deployment, Testing, and Implementation of Web & Client/ Server & cloud applications.
* 10+ years’ experience in IT with demonstrated success in supporting and delivering scientific applications, COTS applications and custom-built solutions.
* Proficient in project management software such as Microsoft Project, JIRA, Asana, or Trello.
* Strong understanding of project management methodologies, including Agile, Scrum, and Waterfall.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and conflict resolution skills across multiple teams.
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and prioritize tasks effectively.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving abilities and communication skills.
* Innovative and inquisitive nature to ask questions, offer bold ideas and challenge the status quo.
* Agility to learn new tools and processes.
* Knowledge of cGXP and 21CFR Part11 standards.

Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Accountable for the controlled production support and life cycle management for multiple applications used by Pharmaceutical Development and Global supplies within PDS.
* Build and develop the project team to ensure maximum performance, by providing purpose, direction, and motivation.
* Lead projects from requirements definition through deployment, identifying schedules, scopes, budget estimations, and implementation plans, including risk mitigation.
* Collaborate with Business and IT Plan functions to develop solutions for business problems including defining business requirements, provide project timelines and budget, develop acceptance criteria, testing, training, and change management plans.
* Contributes heavily towards developing a plan for development activities and translates those into actionable projects. These include releases, required modifications and discretionary enhancements to support the application life cycle.
* Accountable for managing day to day operational support, enabling the business to scale while improving key performance indicators impacting their efficiencies and improving overall customer experience. Defined both long-term strategies and short-term/immediate resource needs.
* Accountable for delivering on project implementations and operational support commitments.
* Collaborate directly with the business clients, IT Business Partners and other IT functions on delivery of digital capabilities.
* Monitor IT service provider resource consumption, review demand and change requests for support work related to custom applications.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Requires advanced knowledge applicable to a wide range of work in own function and thorough knowledge of other functions, typically gained through a university degree and 10+ years of experience.
* May lead initiatives related to continuous improvement or implementation of new technologies. Works independently on most deliverables.
* Responsible for the direct management of a team including results/outcomes, goal setting, performance management, coaching.
* Has significant input into decisions related to hiring, performance reviews, promotions, and compensation actions.
* People manager level with supervisory responsibility for Individual Contributor and People Manager positions
* Responsible for a large sub-function or multiple teams doing similar work.
* Demonstrates ability to build and leverage relationships through diplomacy with a broader focus within the Function.
* Articulates and presents complex information clearly and concisely across all levels. Ability to demonstrate in-depth knowledge and expertise thereby establishing a strong reputation for themselves and the team.
* Participates in decision making and brings a variety of strong views and perspective to achieve team objectives.
* Looks for challenging opportunities and focus on building strong capabilities. Encourages and coach others to do the same.
* Demonstrates a focus on improving processes, structures and knowledge within the team. Leads in analyzing current states, deliver strong recommendations in understanding complexity in the environment, and the ability to execute to bring complex solutions to completion.
* Recognizes the potential impact on internal/external challenges on the future state success. Conveys and takes immediate action to correct any variation in quality, ensures accuracy and completeness of others' work outputs.
* Demonstrates sophisticated analytical thought using various data sources and internal/external environment. Understands the broader implications of actions and perspective. Synthesizes results and links patterns and trends. Considers lessons learned and best practices in conveying to the team's understanding and knowledge.

**Why You Should Apply**
Around the world, we are passionate about making an impact on the lives of patients with serious diseases. Empowered to apply our individual talents and diverse perspectives in an inclusive culture, our shared values of passion, innovation, urgency, accountability, inclusion and integrity bring out the highest potential of each of our colleagues.
  
  
Bristol Myers Squibb recognizes the importance of balance and flexibility in our work environment. We offer a wide variety of competitive benefits, services and programs that provide our employees with the resources to pursue their goals, both at work and in their personal lives.

**How We Work**

title: Technical Manager
description:
**Job Title:**
Technical Manager
  
  
**Company:**
**Sureify**
**Location:**
Hyderabad
  
  
**About Sureify**
Sureify is dedicated to modernizing the life insurance and annuity industry. We provide cutting-edge digital solutions that empower insurers to easily engage with, sell to, and service their customers. Our mission is to drive meaningful digital transformation by offering scalable technology that enhances customer engagement and streamlines carrier operations. Sureify's products deliver the advanced digital experiences that life insurance carriers, agents, employees, and consumers now expect in this rapidly evolving technological landscape. At Sureify, we cultivate a culture that prioritizes innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking an experienced and highly-skilled Technical Manager who is responsible for
**end-to-end delivery of software projects**
while also
**leading, mentoring, and managing engineering teams**
. This role bridges technical execution, delivery management, and people leadership to ensure high-quality, scalable solutions are delivered on time and teams continue to grow and perform at their best.
  
  
**What We Look For**
We are interested in self-motivated individuals who can easily function in a high-demand,
  
  
performance-driven environment. In addition, we are looking for individuals who recognise the team's accomplishments before their own and are sought after as people developers. If you are passionate about problem-solving and helping our customers with some of their most complex issues, this role is for you.
  
  
**Key Requirements & Responsibilities**

* Project & Delivery Management
* Own end-to-end delivery of multiple software projects, from planning through execution and release
* Manage Project scope and milestones effectively
* Project estimations, assessing resource needs and allocation
* Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget
* Identify and mitigate delivery risks, dependencies, and bottlenecks
* Collaborate with Product Managers, Architects, QA, and other stakeholders to align delivery with business goals
* Track and report project progress, metrics, and outcomes to leadership
* Ensure adherence to engineering best practices, SDLC processes, and quality standards
* Technical Leadership
* Provide technical guidance and decision-making across projects
* Review system designs, architecture, and key technical solutions
* Ensure code quality through reviews, standards, and best practices
* Support teams in resolving complex technical challenges
* Drive adoption of modern tools, frameworks, and engineering practices
* Balance short-term delivery needs with long-term technical scalability
* People Management & Team Leadership
* Lead and manage a team of software engineers and/or technical leads
* Conduct regular 1:1s, performance reviews, and career development discussions
* Set clear goals, expectations, and development plans for team members
* Mentor and coach engineers to improve technical and professional skills
* Foster a high-performance, collaborative, and inclusive team culture
* Support hiring, onboarding, and team capacity planning
* Address performance issues constructively and proactively
* Stakeholder & Communication Management
* Act as a primary point of contact for delivery-related communication
* Translate business requirements into actionable technical plans
* Communicate risks, trade-offs, and progress clearly to non-technical stakeholders
* Partner with cross-functional teams (Product, UX, DevOps, QA, Support)

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Overall 12+ years of Industry experience and a minimum of 4+ years of experience as Technical Manager,
* Strong Experience developing production code using TypeScript, Go-Lang, PHP, React, Node JS. Expertise in a few of these technologies is mandatory.
* Experience developing SaaS applications that run on top of AWS (and familiarity with S3, EKS, RDS, EC2)
* Familiarity with Docker
* Experience with CI/CD tooling
* Collaborate on complex customer requirements with internal and external stakeholders
* Contribute towards the design of a specific customer implementation over the development lifecycle, with a particular focus on delivery components
* A desire to work with engineers to develop their test-driven development practice
* A firm understanding of object-oriented design or functional programming, as well as common data structures and algorithms
* Strong communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively with cross cross-functional team
* Experience working with 3rd party software integrations (REST APIs, SOAP APIs, XML, JSON, etc.)
* Experience building secure applications and methodically improving application performance (Profilers, APM tools, Security scanning tools)

**Experience Needed To Qualify**

* Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Computer Science or related field
* Minimum 12+ years of work-related experience
* Experience in developing complex integrated technical solutions involving vendor software across the development lifecycle
* Experience building customer solutions using existing assets and capabilities, including alliances
* Problem-solving skills, costing, and technology-based solutions with deals and offerings
* Industry knowledge across different technologies, especially in Cloud/SaaS/PaaS solutions and the role of IT in digital change
* Experience in Insurance Technology solutions (preferably policy administration systems), in Life & Annuity, will be an added advantage

**Why Join Sureify?**
At Sureify, you’ll be part of a collaborative, innovation-driven culture where your expertise will directly influence the quality and success of products, transforming the life insurance landscape. You’ll work alongside passionate technologists and industry experts, tackling complex challenges with cutting-edge technologies while helping shape the future of digital insurance.
  
  
**Our Guiding Principles**
Our products are for nothing if their creators are not fulfilled in their work. We want our employees to flourish at Sureify. We do not fawn over status or titles; instead, we honour effort and intelligence. The best idea wins, no matter which colleague proposed it. We do not shortcut our mission with overblown claims or false promises. Sticking to the truth is both a strategy and a principle for us.
  
  
Sureify is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to diversity. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, age, disability, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

title: Senior Manager, Agentic AI Engineering
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us in making healthcare work better for everyone through people-led, responsible AI while
**Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Technical Strategy & Solution Leadership

+ Lead the design of scalable, secure, and compliant agentic AI solutions aligned to healthcare industry requirements and enterprise standards
+ Set architectural direction for end-to-end systems integrating LLMs, machine learning models, APIs, data platforms, and enterprise marketing technology ecosystems
+ Guide technical trade-off decisions across model selection, build vs. buy/orchestrate approaches, latency, accuracy, cost, risk, and operational complexity
+ Ensure solutions are designed for production readiness, maintainability, enterprise integration, and long-term supportability across delivery teams

* Engineering Team Leadership & Delivery

+ Lead engineering teams responsible for building and deploying production-grade AI applications, including LLM-based workflows, copilots, and intelligent automation solutions
+ Manage delivery execution across AI agents, automation, platform integrations, and client environments while optimizing for performance, scalability, security, and reliability
+ Create an environment for rapid prototyping, iterative delivery, and continuous learning so teams can validate concepts quickly and accelerate time-to-value
+ Remove delivery blockers, manage technical risks, and guide teams through complex challenges across distributed systems, cloud platforms, data pipelines, and enterprise governance processes
+ Establish engineering practices for AI evaluation datasets, scoring rubrics, agent-performance testing, failure-mode analysis, code quality, documentation, and operational readiness
+ Coach, mentor, and develop engineers and technical leads, supporting career growth, performance management, and strong engineering culture

* Stakeholder Partnership & Cross-Functional Influence

+ Partner with business, product, clinical, compliance, and technical stakeholders to define priorities, translate strategy into execution plans, and align teams around measurable outcomes
+ Coordinate with product, platform, security, architecture, data, and engineering teams to scale reusable AI capabilities across marketing technology deployments
+ Communicate complex technical concepts, delivery risks, investment needs, and business impact clearly for senior leaders and non-technical stakeholders

* Success Measures

+ Leads teams that deliver end-to-end AI-enabled solutions from discovery through production deployment
+ Translates ambiguous business needs into clear technical roadmaps, delivery plans, and scalable outcomes
+ Builds trusted relationships with senior stakeholders and is recognized as a credible technology and delivery leader
+ Drives measurable business outcomes while balancing technical quality, responsible AI practices, delivery speed, cost, and operational risk
+ Creates repeatable engineering patterns, delivery practices, and governance approaches that scale across teams and engagements
+ Develops a high-performing engineering team that can prototype quickly, transition solutions to production effectively, and support enterprise-grade platforms over time

* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or related field
* 7+ years of software engineering experience, including experience delivering distributed systems, cloud-native solutions, or enterprise technology platforms
* 3+ years of people leadership, technical leadership, or engineering management experience, including coaching engineers, managing delivery execution, and influencing technical direction
* Experience leading teams that build and deploy AI/ML solutions, including familiarity with LLMs, prompt engineering, model deployment patterns, and AI evaluation approaches
* Experience structuring ambiguous business and technical problems, aligning stakeholders, and driving teams toward clear, actionable solutions
* Experience guiding cloud architecture, infrastructure as code, and secure deployment practices in enterprise environments, especially Azure
* Experience managing priorities, capacity, delivery commitments, and dependencies across multiple concurrent initiatives
* Advanced knowledge and experience with AI-DLC
* Solid understanding of modern development frameworks, APIs, data integration approaches, engineering delivery practices, and production support models

title: Co-Founder
description:
MDS Pvt. Ltd. is looking for an ambitious Co-Founder who is ready to embark on an exciting startup adventure and join us on an extraordinary journey of innovation, invention, and impact. If you want to help build technologies and products that can transform lives and shape the future of humanity, this is your opportunity to become a co-creator of MDS's grand vision: "Shaping the future through innovation and advanced technology, creating a powerful, intelligent, and human-centered world."

Co-Founder Investment

As a co-founder, we are looking for someone who is willing to invest in MDS as a demonstration of their commitment to the business, its vision, and its long-term success. The amount you choose to invest is entirely at your discretion. Your investment, together with your role, commitment, and contribution, will be reflected in your equity in the company.

About Us

Mahadeva Digital Solutions Private Limited (MDS) is a technology company based in Hyderabad, India. Founded on May 8, 2025, MDS is a Startup India-recognized company. Its primary goal is to build innovative products that create a positive impact on the world.

MDS is currently focused on developing innovative Human-Interactive AI and Affective AI technologies to ensure that AI better serves humanity by enhancing human capabilities, intelligence, and quality of life at scale, rather than becoming a threat to society.

As part of these initiatives, MDS is preparing to launch its flagship product, Noorva Companion MLP, under its broader Noorva Ecosystem vision of building humanized AI solutions around people's daily lives. Noorva Companion is a next-generation application designed to help individuals improve and enrich their everyday lives (additional details will be shared with selected candidates).

MDS has already established a strong team and solid startup foundation and is now looking to further strengthen its leadership by bringing on a committed Co-Founder, who will serve as a co-creator of the company's vision.

MDS is a strongly principle-centered and values-driven organization. Its core purpose is to create meaningful value for the world through its work, innovation, and commitment to human progress. To learn more about MDS, visit MDSIndia.in.

Who We're Looking For

We're not just looking for a co-founder. We're looking for someone who:

* Thinks big and isn't afraid to take bold bets.
* Takes ownership and turns ideas into reality.
* Is ambitious, driven, and passionate about creating meaningful impact.
* Wants to challenge the status quo and help shape the future.
* Sees technology as a force for positive change.
* Wants to build something extraordinary rather than simply work for it.
* Is ready to leave their mark on the world and create a better tomorrow for generations to come.

Responsibilities

Fundraising and Financial Management: You will be co-leading fundraising efforts, pitching to investors, preparing business cases, and managing capital requirements.

* You will monitor budgets, allocate resources responsibly, and ensure financial discipline to support growth and operational scalability.

Product and Operations Oversight: You will oversee product roadmaps, establish operational processes, and ensure alignment between development efforts and market demands.

* You will take on an executive role as COO and will be involved in day-to-day decision-making during the early stages.

Team Building and Leadership: Recruiting, mentoring, and developing a high-performing team is a key responsibility.

* You will assign roles, maintain morale, and foster a collaborative culture that encourages innovation and accountability.
* You will also ensure that each team member's responsibilities are clear and aligned with the company's goals.

Risk Management and Problem Solving: You will assess risks related to product, market, finances, and operations, and implement strategies to mitigate them.

* You will adapt to challenges, pivot when necessary, and make timely decisions based on data, expert input, and market feedback.

Brand Development and External Relations: You will represent the company to investors, partners, customers, and the media.

* You will help build credibility, establish strategic partnerships, and communicate the company's vision effectively to stakeholders.

Cross-Functional Leadership: Acting as a bridge between departments, as COO you will foster collaboration across teams, breaking down silos and ensuring smooth coordination.

* You will oversee multiple departments, including product development, project management, research and development, product design, and administrative functions, ensuring that resources are effectively utilized.

Strategic Partner to the CEO: While the CEO focuses on vision, external relationships, and long-term strategy, the COO translates these high-level plans into actionable initiatives.

* You may lead expansion projects, mergers, acquisitions, or new product rollouts, ensuring that strategic objectives are implemented efficiently.

Compliance and Governance: You will ensure adherence to statutory regulations, corporate policies, and industry standards.

* You may be accountable for labour laws, environmental regulations, taxation, and contractual obligations, coordinating with legal teams to manage operational risks.

Problem Solving and Innovation: You are expected to be a resourceful problem solver, continuously seeking ways to improve operational efficiency, implement innovative solutions, and maintain competitive advantage through operational excellence.

Qualifications

* Anyone can apply. Your educational background is not a deciding factor if you have the skills, mindset, and desire to be part of something big.
* A background in business, finance, entrepreneurship, or related experience will be considered an added advantage.
* MDS Pvt. Ltd. is an inclusive company, and we welcome applications from individuals of all genders, regions, races, nationalities, and economic backgrounds.
* Note: We are also looking for a candidate who is willing to invest in the company as a demonstration of their commitment to the business, its vision, and its long-term success. The amount you choose to invest is entirely at your discretion.
* This opportunity is not for someone who makes promises without following through. Greatness is not built on great words alone, but on consistent action, commitment, and execution.

Compensation

* The selected candidate will receive equity in the company, based on their role, commitment, experience, and overall value contribution to the business.
* Salary and other compensation details will be discussed with shortlisted candidates.

How to Apply

* Apply on our website: https://www.mdsindia.in/careers/co-founder
* We encourage you to write your cover letter in your own words. Tell us about your ideas, ambitions, and why you want to be part of MDS. We'd rather hear your authentic voice than read an AI-generated response.

title: Automation and AI Solutions Lead
description:
Are you passionate about Automation and AI and eager to make a significant impact? We are seeking a highly motivated Automation & AI Solutions Lead with strong organizational and technical skills.You will work closely with architects, developers, and business stakeholders to translate real-world problems into robust AI systems. The role demands deep expertise in LangGraph, LangChain, and AWS-based deployments, with accountability from discovery through production. Success in this role means delivering reliable, scalable AI solutions that create measurable business impact. If you're excited to make real impact, apply now and be part of our innovative journey!
  
  
**About The Role**
In this role as an Automation & AI Solutions Lead, you will
  
  

* Engage internal SMEs to understand current processes and as-is workflows — translate into buildable AI requirements.
* Demo working solutions to internal stakeholders up to business leadership level.
* Support the Architect during feasibility and POC phases — contribute to rapid builds and validate fit.
* Maintain stakeholder communication throughout: progress updates, issue escalation, solution walkthroughs.
* Co-invest with the Architect in upfront solution design — design robustness directly determines build speed and test quality.
* Translate architecture into implementation plans — break down into assignable streams for Developer and Associate.
* Own day-to-day technical decisions during build when the Architect is focused on other projects.
* Identify architectural risks early and escalate before they become build or production problems.
* Build complex solution components end-to-end on AWS AgentCore and LangGraph — hands-on coding role.
* Scale solutions from POC to production: performance, reliability, monitoring, and cost management.
* Debug production failures: hallucination patterns, retrieval degradation, agent loops, latency regressions.
* Use AI coding tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Cline) to accelerate delivery. Own all generated code.
* Build Low Code automations (Copilot Studio, Power Automate) when use case and bandwidth allow.
* Guide Developer and Associate through implementation, code reviews, and debugging.
* Ensure the team uses AI tools effectively — accelerating delivery without sacrificing code understanding.
* Work Mode: Hybrid - 3 days from office.
* Shift Timing: 1pm IST to 10pm IST

**About You**
**You’re a fit for the role of Automation & AI Solutions Lead, if your background includes:**

* Experience — 5–8 years total; 2–4 years production GenAI/LLM; 12–24 months multi-agent LangGraph; 3+ systems owned post-deployment.
* LangGraph — multi-agent state machines, parallel execution, checkpointing, HITL — non-negotiable
* AWS Bedrock — Model deployment, knowledge bases, guardrails.
* Database & AI Data Access — SQL proficiency, NL-to-SQL, LLM-powered query layers. Snowflake a plus.
* Systems Integration — REST API development, MCP awareness, enterprise system connectors.
* Advanced RAG — Hybrid search, re-ranking, query reformulation, retrieval evaluation.
* Evaluation Frameworks — RAGAS / TruLens, golden test sets, automated regression pipelines.
* Observability — LangSmith or LangFuse — agent tracing, production debugging.
* Python — Expert-level — design patterns, async, testing, CI/CD.
* Multi-Model — OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Llama — trade-offs at production scale.
* Pro Code vs Low Code — Working knowledge of Copilot Studio and Power Automate; build when use case fits.
* AI Development Tools — Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or Cline — accelerate delivery; own and fix all generated code.
* Stakeholder Communication — Demo AI solutions to business stakeholders; translate SME knowledge into requirements.
* AWS AgentCore Deep — All services hands-on.
* MCP / A2A — Server/client production implementation.
* Document Intelligence — OCR, layout-aware chunking.
* Fine-Tuning — LoRA / QLoRA for domain adaptation.
* Certifications — AWS ML Specialty, Azure AI Engineer, GCP ML Engineer.

**What’s in it For You?**

* Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment (2-3 days a week in the office depending on the role) for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.
* Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.
* Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.
* Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.
* Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.
* Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.
* Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.

**About Us**
Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news.
  
  
We are powered by the talents of 26,000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? Join us and help shape the industries that move society forward.
  
  
As a global business, we rely on the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all employees to deliver on our business goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. Thomson Reuters is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer providing a drug-free workplace.
  
  
We also make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs in accordance with applicable law. More information on requesting an accommodation here.
  
  
Learn more on how to protect yourself from fraudulent job postings here.
  
  
More information about Thomson Reuters can be found on thomsonreuters.com.

**Job Overview**
The
**AVP, AI/ML Engineering, Tech Lead**

This role guides the engineering of LLM-driven applications, agentic AI systems, autonomous workflows, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and the enterprise Knowledge Graph, all built within a scalable, governed, cloud-native environment. Operating within the AI/ML Engineering organization, this leader sets technical direction for how LPL builds production-quality AI—leveraging AWS Bedrock, generative model ecosystems, and modern ML tooling.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* AI/ML Architecture & Agentic System Design: Architect and lead implementation of agentic AI systems capable of multi-step reasoning, tool use, workflow orchestration, and domain-specific autonomy. Build LLM-based agents that interact with APIs, data products, and enterprise systems to drive intelligent automation and decision support. Design orchestration layers that incorporate memory, context management, and dynamic planning for advanced agent behaviours. Develop RAG architectures that integrate embeddings, vector search, and semantic retrieval into agentic workflows
* AWS Bedrock–Driven AI Platform Engineering: Lead adoption of AWS Bedrock for model selection, orchestration, governance, and enterprise scaling of LLMs and generative AI. Implement Bedrock Features such as: Guardrails, Model evaluation, Provisioned throughput, Custom model fine-tuning. Integrate Bedrock models with downstream systems, including microservices, pipelines, and agent frameworks. Partner with enterprise architecture to define standards for Bedrock usage and model lifecycle governance.
* Knowledge Graph & Semantic Intelligence: Own engineering and operationalization of the Enterprise Knowledge Graph and integrate it with LLM and agent frameworks as a structured reasoning layer, Implement ontology-driven enrichment, entity resolution, and graph-based retrieval for AI capabilities, Connect graph services to agents to support semantic grounding, consistency, and contextual awareness
* ML Engineering & MLOps: Build and maintain automated pipelines for training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring of traditional and generative ML models, Establish rigorous MLOps standards including CI/CD, reproducibility, drift detection, and quality gates, Develop feature stores, vector databases, and real-time inference services optimized for AI workloads.
* Engineering Delivery & Cross-Team Collaboration: Partner deeply with DIME to ensure upstream data pipelines meet enterprise AI-grade requirements for freshness, quality, lineage, and metadata, Work with Lakehouse Engineering and Data Product teams to align models, features, and data availability, Collaborate with governance and security teams to enforce responsible AI practices and regulatory controls

**pursue greatness**
,
**act with integrity**
, and are
**driven to help our clients succeed**
. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we
**win together**
and
**create and share joy**
in our work.

Experience implementing real-time/streaming UIs for LLM chat (e.g., server-sent events / streamed token responses) with responsive state management. Comfortable owning a feature end-to-end: RESTful API design, front-end integration, and deployment of both tiers to AWS (containerized services, ECR/ECS, CloudFront/S3-hosted SPA)

* Implementing and configuring Oracle lead management, sales automation, and marketing automation solutions to optimize client operations

* Utilizing analytical thinking to interpret data and inform insights and recommendations
* Collaborating with teams to deliver quality and strategic objectives in business application consulting
* Embracing change and leveraging digital tooling to enhance client service delivery

What You Must Have
  
  

* Overall experience of 8–12 years, with strong hands-on and leadership experience in Oracle Unity Customer Data Platform (CDP) implementations.
* Experience leading at least 2–3 end-to-end Oracle Unity/CDP implementations.
* Good working experience with Oracle Eloqua Marketing Automation, particularly integrations between Unity, Eloqua, CRM, and other enterprise applications.
* Strong experience in solution architecture, technical design, data modelling, integrations, delivery management, stakeholder management, and team leadership.

* Strong understanding of Customer Data Platforms, Customer 360, CRM, Marketing Automation, Service, Loyalty, Analytics, Data Warehouses, and enterprise integrations.

**Role And Responsibilities**

* Lead the overall solution design, architecture, implementation, and support of Oracle Unity solutions.
* Work closely with business, marketing, sales, service, IT, data, and architecture teams to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable Oracle Unity solutions.
* Own technical design decisions and ensure solutions align with enterprise architecture, security, integration, data governance, and performance standards.
* Lead requirement-gathering and solution-design workshops and provide recommendations based on Oracle Unity capabilities and best practices.
* Review and approve technical requirements, solution design documents, integration specifications, source-to-target mappings, test strategies, deployment plans, and operational documentation.
* Manage multiple Unity workstreams and ensure delivery within agreed scope, timelines, quality standards, and business expectations.
* Provide technical leadership, mentoring, training, feedback, and guidance to developers, consultants, administrators, and end business users.
* Perform solution and design reviews and establish reusable development, integration, and configuration standards.
* Identify technical risks, dependencies, data-quality issues, integration challenges, and performance bottlenecks and drive them to resolution.
* Coordinate with Oracle Support and other vendors for product issues, enhancements, patches, and technical escalations.
* Work with marketing teams to define how customer segments and attributes from Oracle Unity can be activated through Oracle Eloqua campaigns and marketing programs.
* Manage key business and technology stakeholders, align priorities, and communicate scope, risks, dependencies, and delivery status for Oracle Unity initiatives.Build strong relationships across Marketing, Sales, Service, CRM, Data, Analytics, Security, Architecture, and Operations teams.
* Own the overall Oracle Unity solution architecture and define scalable, secure, reusable, and maintainable CDP solution patterns.Design end-to-end data ingestion, identity resolution, segmentation, activation, integration, and Customer 360 architecture across enterprise systems.
* Lead solution demonstrations, proof-of-concepts, and capability showcases for Oracle Unity use cases and platform features.Present Customer 360, identity resolution, segmentation, intelligent attributes, dashboards, integrations, and activation flows to business and technical stakeholders.
* Support pre-sales activities including discovery sessions, solutioning, effort estimation, proposals, RFP/RFI responses, and client presentations.Work with sales and delivery teams to define Unity solution approaches, scope, timelines, assumptions, integrations, and resource requirements.
* Manage resource planning, allocation, capacity, utilization, workload, and delivery commitments across multiple Oracle Unity projects and workstreams.Identify skill gaps, support hiring and onboarding, and drive training, cross-skilling, mentoring, and capability development within the team.

**Oracle Unity / CDP Technical Responsibilities**

* Design the overall Oracle Unity data architecture, including source systems, ingestion strategy, data models, identity resolution, segmentation, activation, and downstream integrations.
* Design and configure data feeds and ingestion jobs to bring customer, transactional, behavioral, engagement, and other enterprise data into Oracle Unity.
* Define and review source-to-target mappings between source systems, data warehouses, Oracle Unity, CRM, Marketing, Service, Loyalty, Analytics, and other downstream platforms.
* Configure and extend Oracle Unity data models based on business, reporting, analytical, and activation requirements.
* Maintain strong understanding of Oracle Unity data objects, relationships, attributes, metadata, and query capabilities.
* Design and configure Identity Resolution rules, including match rules, survivorship rules, master entity identification, and resolution of duplicate or conflicting customer records.
* Review and troubleshoot MCPS queries and optimize queries for performance and scalability.
* Design and create Intelligent Attributes and use them in calculations, segmentation, personalization, analytics, and activation use cases.
* Define and implement customer segmentation strategies using demographic, transactional, behavioral, engagement, and predictive attributes.
* Create, configure, and manage Data Science and Machine Learning models available within Oracle Unity and assess their applicability to business use cases.
* Configure and manage address validation, standardization, enrichment, and data-quality processes.
* Design and develop Customer 360 dashboards using rules, sub-rules, data source views, calculated attributes, and custom widgets.
* Develop dashboards for customer engagement, segmentation, campaign performance, customer behavior, and other business KPIs.
* Design and manage integrations between Oracle Unity and enterprise applications such as Oracle Sales, Salesforce, Oracle Service, Oracle Loyalty, Oracle Eloqua, Oracle Infinity, Data Warehouses, Data Lakes, Analytics platforms, and third-party systems.
* Strong understanding of Oracle Unity REST APIs, batch integrations, outbound activation mechanisms, webhooks, and integration patterns.
* Define and manage Access Control, users, roles, permissions, and security governance within Oracle Unity.
* Establish data-governance standards covering data ingestion, customer identity, data quality, data privacy, retention, consent, security, and downstream data activation.
* Monitor Unity ingestion jobs, data pipelines, identity-resolution processes, segmentation jobs, calculations, data-science processes, and integrations.
* Perform root-cause analysis and drive resolution of data-processing, integration, identity-resolution, API, segmentation, and performance issues.
* Review platform usage and recommend performance, scalability, and operational improvements.
* Define customer-data activation patterns to support Customer 360, personalization, lead generation, cross-sell, up-sell, churn management, customer engagement, and next-best-action use cases.

**Oracle Eloqua Exposure**

* Good understanding of Oracle Eloqua architecture, campaign management, contacts, custom objects, segments, forms, landing pages, and lead-nurturing programs.
* Experience integrating Oracle Unity with Oracle Eloqua for customer segmentation, campaign activation, audience synchronization, and marketing personalization.
* Understand the data flow between Unity, Eloqua, CRM/Salesforce/Oracle Sales, and other downstream marketing systems.
* Support marketing teams in using Unity customer attributes, Intelligent Attributes, and segments within Eloqua campaigns.
* Good understanding of Eloqua integrations, APIs, native connectors, and data synchronization mechanisms.
* Support troubleshooting of data synchronization, campaign activation, contact-management, and integration issues between Unity and Eloqua.
* Understand lead management, lead scoring, campaign responses, and lead hand-off processes between Eloqua and CRM systems.

**Integration And Technical Skills**

* Strong knowledge of Oracle Unity REST APIs and enterprise integration patterns.
* Experience integrating Oracle Unity with:
* Oracle Sales / Fusion CRM
* Salesforce
* Oracle Service
* Oracle Loyalty
* Oracle Eloqua
* Oracle Infinity
* Data Warehouses
* Enterprise Data Lakes
* Analytics platforms
* External marketing and customer-engagement platforms
* Experience with REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, middleware, batch interfaces, scheduled integrations, and event-driven integration patterns.
* Good understanding of SQL/query concepts, data modelling, data transformation, and data-quality principles.
* Ability to troubleshoot complex integration, data-processing, API, identity-resolution, segmentation, and performance issues.
* Understanding of customer-data activation from Oracle Unity into Eloqua and other marketing channels.

**Leadership And Management Responsibilities**

* Lead and manage a team of Oracle Unity developers, consultants, administrators, and data specialists.
* Estimate effort, prepare delivery plans, allocate resources, and monitor project execution.
* Mentor team members and develop Oracle Unity technical capabilities through knowledge-sharing, technical sessions, and hands-on guidance.
* Review deliverables and ensure adherence to technical, documentation, security, integration, and architecture standards.
* Manage stakeholder expectations and communicate project status, risks, dependencies, issues, and key technical decisions.
* Facilitate design workshops and technical discussions with business, enterprise architecture, security, integration, data, analytics, and infrastructure teams.
* Collaborate with marketing and Eloqua teams to define customer activation and campaign integration strategies.
* Support project planning, solution estimation, proposals, technical presentations, demos, and pre-sales activities when required.
* Identify opportunities to create reusable solutions, accelerators, frameworks, automation, and implementation best practices.
* Drive continuous improvement across Oracle Unity implementation, support, data governance, and operational processes.
* Act as the escalation point for complex Oracle Unity technical and functional issues.

**Preferred Skills**

* Strong understanding of Customer 360, Customer Data Platforms, customer identity, data unification, segmentation, personalization, and activation.
* Good understanding of Marketing Automation and Oracle Eloqua concepts.
* Understanding of customer consent, privacy, security, retention, and enterprise data-governance requirements.

* Experience supporting customer-data activation across CDP, CRM, Eloqua, and digital marketing channels.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, presentation, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining delivery quality.
* Experience working with geographically distributed and cross-functional teams.
* Ability to communicate complex Oracle Unity and integration concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

title: Specialist Technical Project Management
description:
**Job Description**
**The Opportunity**
Join a global biopharma company with a 130-year legacy and mission to achieve new milestones in healthcare. Be part of technology driven, data-led organization supporting a diversified portfolio of medicines, vaccines and animal health products. Work alongside passionate teams that use data, analytics and insights to drive decisions, and tackle some of the world’s greatest health threats.
  
  
Our Technology Centers are globally distributed hubs that enable our digital transformation and business outcomes across IT. They bring together diverse teams to collaborate, share best practices, and deliver solutions that save and improve lives.
  
  
This role is based at our Hyderabad Tech Center and follows a hybrid working model (3 days onsite, 2 days remote). Candidates are expected to reside within commuting distance of the Hyderabad office.
  
  
**Role Overview**
Our company's Information Technology (IT) division partners with colleagues across the business to help serve our patients and customers around the world. Ours is a high-energy team of dynamic, innovative individuals dedicated to leveraging information and technology to efficiently drive revenue and productivity, thereby advancing our company's contribution to global medical innovation.
  
  
Enterprise IT (EIT) is an essential component of the current IT division that provides support to the Pharmaceutical Research and Development (R&D), Supply Chain (Manufacturing), Marketing (Human Health) organizations as well as Enabling Functions. The EIT SAP Platform Team is responsible for our company's SAP Global Template asset, delivering enterprise-level capabilities through harmonized business processes and data. The team is responsible for the operation of all our company's SAP and integrated solutions, governance of the associated enterprise assets, and cost-effective delivery of capabilities to support achievement of immediate and future state business objectives.
  
  
Our company is committed to inclusion, ensuring that candidates can engage in a hiring process that exhibits their true capabilities. Please specify to our Talent Acquisition team if you need any support during the application or hiring process. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, disability status, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or national origin.
  
  
We are proud to be a company that embraces the value of bringing diverse, talented, and committed people together. The fastest way to breakthrough innovation is when diverse ideas come together in an inclusive environment. We encourage our colleagues to respectfully challenge one another’s thinking and approach problems collectively.
  
  
In the EIT SAP Platform Team, the SAP Project Manager is responsible for leading the planning, execution, governance, and delivery of SAP initiatives, ensuring alignment with business objectives while managing scope, schedule, risks, resources, stakeholders, and project outcomes.
  
  
**What Should You Have**

* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science or related field
* 3-7 years of hands-on experience working in SAP.

**Primary Skills (must-have)**

* Project management experience delivering medium-to-large IT/SAP projects.
* Basic understanding of SAP systems and business processes, with the ability to translate business requirements into project delivery activities and coordinate effectively across business and technical stakeholders.
* Strong leadership, communication, stakeholder and facilitation skills.
* Experience with planning, risk management, issue resolution and delivery tracking.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and cross-functional teams.
* Working knowledge of Jira, Confluence, MS Project and Microsoft 365 tools.
* Understanding of Agile and Waterfall delivery approaches.

**Secondary Skills (nice To Have)**

* Experience with global SAP implementations.
* Pharmaceutical or regulated industry experience.
* Financial management and budgeting experience.
* Knowledge of Apptio or similar financial planning tools.
* Experience supporting S/4HANA transformation programs.

The role of SAP Project Manager includes (but is not limited to) the following responsibilities
  
  

* Project Planning and Road-mapping Develop and maintain roadmaps, ensuring teams are working towards shared objectives and deadlines.
* Managing project scope and priorities work closely with stakeholders to define project requirements and prioritize tasks, ensuring that the team focuses on delivering the most valuable features first.
* Risk Management Identify potential risks and impediments, assess their impact, and implement mitigation strategies to reduce project risks.
* Stakeholder Communication Act as the primary point of contact for stakeholders, providing updates on program status, risks, and changes while also gathering feedback and requirements.
* Monitoring project progress track team velocity, monitor project metrics, and provide regular updates to stakeholders, enabling transparency and informed decision-making.
* Governance manage project governance, prepare and facilitate steering committee meetings, escalate decisions and risks appropriately.
* Financial Management Manage project budgets and forecasts. Track project financials and resource utilization.
* Resource & Vendor management Coordinate project resources across teams and vendors. Support capacity planning and staffing activities.
* SAP Delivery Coordinate requirements, design, testing, cutover and hypercare activities. Manage cross-functional SAP dependencies.
* Experience within healthcare, life sciences, or other regulated industries.

**Who We Are**
We are known as Merck & Co., Inc., Rahway, New Jersey, USA in the United States and Canada and MSD everywhere else. For more than a century, we have been bringing forward medicines and vaccines for many of the world's most challenging diseases. title: Product Owner Senior Associate
description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**
At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.
  
  
**Job Description:**
The Retain Cloud Product Owner – Senior Associate is the dedicated product and platform owner for Retain Cloud, the firm’s resource planning and scheduling platform, within the Enterprise Applications Support team. Based in Crowe’s Hyderabad office and working closely with US-based stakeholders, this role combines hands-on administration and configuration with day-to-day product ownership: managing the Retain backlog and roadmap, translating business needs into well-defined epics and user stories, coordinating vendor releases, and driving adoption as additional business units move onto the platform.
  
  
This position takes Retain beyond break/fix support. The Product Owner partners with the Retain business owner, business unit resource management teams, the Solutions support team, and the Retain vendor to keep the platform stable, secure, and aligned with firm priorities. As Retain moves into steady-state operations, the role will also be cross-trained on other enterprise applications supported by the team.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Product Ownership and Backlog Management:**

* Own the Retain Cloud product backlog in ServiceNow, capturing, refining, and prioritizing demands, epics, and user stories with clear acceptance criteria.
* Partner with the Retain business owner and business unit leaders to translate business goals into a product roadmap, release plan, and prioritized backlog.
* Lead requirements gathering and backlog refinement sessions, make day-to-day prioritization decisions, and escalate trade-offs that affect scope, timeline, or investment.
* Confirm that delivered changes meet the intended business need and are ready for release, coordinating user acceptance testing (UAT) with business users.
* Track adoption, data quality, and support trends to measure value and guide priorities.
* Platform Administration and Configuration
* Serve as the primary technical administrator for Retain Cloud, configuring security profiles, skills, scheduling units, booking components, dropdown values, and other system settings.
* Manage user access and role assignments through the ServiceNow access request process, and support periodic access reviews with business approvers.
* Prepare, run, and validate mass booking and other data loads in UAT and production.
* Monitor integrations and daily data feeds, including worker and skills data from Workday, and coordinate the resolution of feed and data issues.
* Maintain configuration documentation and follow the firm’s change management process.
* Release and Vendor Management
* Act as the primary liaison with the Retain vendor: log and track support cases, escalate defects, and monitor vendor SLA performance.
* Review vendor release notes, assess the impact of each Retain Cloud release, and plan and execute regression testing.
* Communicate upcoming releases, resolved issues, and new features to support teams and users, and confirm that incidents addressed in a release are closed afterward.
* Business Unit Onboarding and Adoption
* Lead configuration and readiness work for business units onboarding to Retain Cloud, including requirements, data migration and reconciliation, UAT, and cutover planning.
* oordinate the timing of changes and rollouts with business unit operations leaders to avoid busy season and filing-deadline conflicts.
* Develop training materials and job aids, and help resource managers adopt new features.
* Support and Continuous Improvement
* Serve as the Solutions-level (L3) escalation point for Retain incidents: reproduce issues in the test environment, capture diagnostics, manage problem records, and provide workarounds.
* Build and maintain the Retain knowledge base so Services and Troubleshooting teams can resolve common issues quickly and consistently.
* Analyze ticket trends to find recurring issues and drive permanent fixes or enhancements.
* Support Retain reporting needs by producing accurate scheduling and resource data for resource managers and leadership.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 3–5 years of experience in enterprise SaaS application administration, business systems analysis, or product ownership.
* At least 2 years of hands-on experience administering, configuring, or supporting Retain (Retain Cloud strongly preferred); deep experience with a comparable resource management platform will be considered.
* Experience supporting resource management or scheduling teams in a professional services environment (audit, tax, or consulting) preferred.
* Experience managing a backlog and writing epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria in ServiceNow, Azure DevOps, Jira, or a similar tool.
* Working knowledge of ServiceNow ITSM and ITIL practices.
* Experience with Workday or other HR system integrations and data loads is a plus.
* Product Owner certification (such as CSPO or PSPO) preferred.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and working knowledge of Microsoft 365 and SharePoint.

**Requirements**

* This is a hybrid position. The selected candidate must live within commute distance of the Crowe office in Hyderabad, India, and be able to travel to the office as needed.
* Ability to work during US business hours collaborate with US-based stakeholders, with flexibility for releases, go-lives, and critical escalations.
* Estimate an annual average of 10–15% overtime. Overtime will be required to meet critical deadlines and during busy season months.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills for engaging US-based leaders.
* Ability to work independently with broad direction and little supervision while collaborating effectively across a geographically dispersed team.

**Key Positions with Which This Position Interfaces**

* Retain applications for business lead and business unit representatives
* Business unit resource managers and operations leaders
* Enterprise Applications Support Solutions team
* Services and Troubleshooting support teams
* Retain vendor support and product teams
* HR technology and data integration teams (such as Workday)
* ServiceNow platform, project management, and IT leadership teams

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.
