title: Sr Manager, Procurement Platform Excellence
description:
**Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for
*all*
.**
Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.
  
  
**Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.**
Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.
  
  
The Global Procurement team is an integral engine to Micron’s growth, delivering best-in-class total cost and supply chain resiliency through innovative predictive capabilities, risk analysis, and a focus on sustainability and diversity. Our business goals are directly tied to the value we place on our team members, our greatest asset. We invest in our people through a skills-based learning and development model to create clear career pathways for growth. Join us and discover why Micron’s Global Procurement team is the preferred destination to ignite your talent.
  
  
As Senior Manager, Platform Excellence within Global Procurement’s Center of Excellence Digital Transformation & AI organization, you drive the Source-to-Pay (S2P) platform strategy and roadmap and lead end-to-end management of the S2P platform landscape. This is a collaborative role: you shape one coherent S2P platform direction together with your peer Senior Managers for S/4HANA Transformation, AI Transformation, Data & Process Automation, and Data Excellence & Governance. Your portfolio spans sourcing, contract lifecycle management, procure-to-pay, supplier and catalog enablement, and the analytics and reporting platforms used by the data analytics team, and you lead a team based in Hyderabad, India.
  
  
This is not a SAP or ERP configuration role. The SAP S/4HANA and Ariba transformation is driven by a separate team; you partner closely with them so the S2P platform landscape integrates cleanly with the ERP core and enterprise systems, and every platform decision reinforces one coherent, standardized S2P experience. Similarly, new AI transformation products that are still at an early, incubation stage sit with the AI Transformation team — your accountability is the established S2P platform portfolio and how it is run, integrated, and adopted.
  
  
You set direction and priorities and own value realization measured in real business terms — productivity, adoption, cycle time, and decision quality. You bring strong product and user-centered discipline to how the portfolio is run: grounding decisions in user personas, journeys, and end-to-end processes, and owning supplier-supported and third-party products end-to-end, including escalation, supplier performance (reviews, SLAs, demos), licensing, renewals, and end-of-life transitions.
  
  
This is a people-leadership role. A core part of your mandate is to move platform operations from reactive, ticket-driven support to a proactive, agent-embedded model, and to embed product and user-centered discipline across the portfolio. You develop a team of platform and product professionals and partner closely with AI Transformation, Data & Process Automation, Data Excellence & Governance, IT, Enterprise Architecture, Security, and Compliance. GP-centric platform products are owned here end-to-end; enterprise-wide systems and IT infrastructure remain with IT — the role does not perform software development or manage infrastructure.
  
  
**▍**
**Key Responsibilities**
A core expectation is to run Global Procurement’s Source-to-Pay platforms as products — end-to-end, value-driven, well-integrated, and adopted — while moving platform operations toward a proactive, agent-embedded model.
  
  
**Platform Strategy & Value Optimization**

* Own the end-to-end S2P platform portfolio strategy and roadmap — including the analytics and reporting platforms — framing business problems into clear product strategies that maximize outcomes over outputs.
* Prioritize opportunities and make build-versus-buy-versus-partner trade-offs, sequencing platform investment against S2P Reimagined and ERP transformation milestones.
* Track value through real business indicators — productivity, adoption, cycle time, and decision quality — and engage stakeholders on investment decisions and supplier and technology trends.

**End-to-End Platform Leadership & Lifecycle**

* Lead and be accountable for the S2P platform portfolio across its full lifecycle — sourcing, contract lifecycle management, procure-to-pay, supplier and catalog enablement, and analytics platforms — setting clear direction and adapting priorities as needs evolve.
* Own supplier-supported and third-party products for GP-centric solutions, including escalation, supplier performance management (reviews, SLAs, demos), licensing, renewals, and end-of-life transitions.
* Apply product-management fundamentals — budgeting, cost-versus-value trade-offs, and lifecycle planning — to keep platforms fit-for-purpose as scale and complexity grow, while keeping GP-centric solutions PM-owned and enterprise-wide systems with IT.

**Platform Operations, Integration & Health**

* Own platform stability, configuration, release, environment and test, and incident and problem management across the S2P landscape.
* Ensure the S2P platforms integrate cleanly with the SAP S/4HANA and Ariba ERP core and enterprise systems, so data, controls, and processes flow reliably end-to-end.
* Establish platform health KPIs, service levels, and monitoring, and shift from reactive support to proactive, increasingly self-healing platforms — with agents handling detection, triage, routing, and routine configuration and testing.

**Analytics Platforms, Adoption & Product Performance**

* Product-manage the analytics and reporting platforms used by the data analytics team — ensuring the tooling is reliable, well-integrated, and fit-for-purpose, while analytics outputs and insights remain owned by the data analytics team.
* Instrument platforms to measure usage, adoption, and value, and use those signals to refine roadmaps and features.
* Define what “good adoption” means beyond usage — decision confidence, reduced rework, and behavior change.

**User-Centered Solution Design**

* Ground solutions in user personas, journeys, and end-to-end process understanding, balancing usability, feasibility, business value, and enterprise constraints.
* Challenge low-value features and over-customization; advocate scalable, standard-driven design and consistent interaction patterns across S2P tools and AI-enabled capabilities.
* Anticipate adoption risks and continuously improve solutions based on user behavior and usage signals.

**Stakeholder Engagement, Enablement & Change**

* Engage stakeholders, build trust, and bring people along through change; translate needs into clear action plans and resolve issues through influence and partnership.
* Own the platform enablement and support model — training, documentation, self-service, and a responsive support experience across regions.
* Embed change management into the product journey and drive adoption through clear, simple, actionable communication.

**Innovation & Agent-Embedded Ways of Working**

* Reimagine platform operations and enablement with agents embedded — platform support copilot, configuration and testing agents, integration-monitoring agents, and enablement copilot.
* Sponsor rapid experiments, validate impact, and turn the best into reusable building blocks for broader adoption across Source-to-Pay.

**Team Leadership & Enterprise Partnership**

* Lead, coach, and develop a Hyderabad-based team; build depth, ownership, and succession, and coach the team for a product-led, agent-embedded operating model.
* Partner across DTAI pillars, IT, Enterprise Architecture, Security, Compliance, and functional Global Procurement teams, and represent the platform agenda in program reviews and executive readouts.
* Serve as the primary escalation point for platform stability, integration, and adoption risks, translating complex dynamics into clear decisions and tradeoffs for senior stakeholders.

**▍**
**Leadership Expectations**
This leader is expected to embody Micron’s core values and set the tone for the team:
  
  
**People**
Care for each other — build an inclusive, high-trust team; develop talent, grow capability, and plan succession within the team.
  
  
**Innovation**
Shape the future — run platforms as products and champion agent-embedded ways of working; experiment, learn fast, and scale what works.
  
  
**Tenacity**
Nothing shakes our resolve — own platform stability, integration, and adoption outcomes end-to-end through complex, cross-system challenges.
  
  
**Collaboration**
Aligned to win — break silos across DTAI, IT, Enterprise Architecture, Security, and the business; win as one team across time zones.
  
  
**Customer Focus**
Partner and win together — treat procurement stakeholders and end-users as customers; design for their journeys and deliver adopted, high-value platforms.
  
  
**Speed**
Act with purpose and set the pace — make timely, well-reasoned decisions and move prioritized platform work from pilot to scale without losing rigor.
  
  
**▍**
**Leadership Competencies**

* Product & value judgment: Frame problems into value-driven strategy, prioritize outcomes over outputs, and make build-versus-buy-versus-partner calls with clarity.
* User-centered & adoption mindset: Design for real user journeys and adoption, not just delivery, and define value beyond usage.
* Talent & coaching: Develop, coach, and grow a multi-region team; build bench strength and succession within the function.
* Cross-cultural leadership: Work effectively across U.S. and Asia cultures and time zones, partnering with globally distributed stakeholders and peers.
* Influence & partnership: Lead through influence across IT, Enterprise Architecture, Security, and business stakeholders without direct authority.
* Executive communication: Translate complex platform, integration, and product topics into crisp, decision-ready narratives for senior leaders.
* Change leadership: Drive adoption of new platforms and agent-embedded ways of working through enablement and change management.
* Outcome ownership: Set direction, prioritize ruthlessly, and hold the function accountable for measurable stability, adoption, and value.

**▍ Minimum Requirements**

* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Supply Chain, Business, or a related field.
* Experience — depth: 13+ years in enterprise platform, digital product, or Source-to-Pay application management, including 5+ years leading platform or digital product delivery and operations and 3+ years leading teams.
* Experience — scale: At least 5 years in a large, multi-region enterprise (5,000+ employees), including environments running on SAP (ECC and/or S/4HANA).
* Experience — domain: Deep, hands-on ownership of a Source-to-Pay platform landscape (several of sourcing, contract lifecycle management, procure-to-pay, supplier and catalog enablement, and procurement analytics platforms), with close working knowledge of how these integrate with an SAP S/4HANA and Ariba ERP core.
* Product management: Proven end-to-end product ownership — vision, roadmap, prioritization, and value realization — with a track record of driving outcomes over outputs.
* Supplier / third-party product management: Managing supplier-supported products, including escalation, SLAs, performance reviews, licensing, renewals, and end-of-life transitions.
* Analytics & adoption: Working knowledge of analytics and business intelligence (Power BI or Tableau) and of instrumenting products to measure adoption and value.
* Integration: Proven experience integrating SaaS platforms with an ERP core — APIs, middleware, connectors, and cross-system data and controls.
* AI / agentic ways of working: Experience defining requirements for, or embedding, AI agents into platform operations, support, configuration, testing, or enablement.
* Cross-functional leadership: Proven ability to lead through influence across IT, Enterprise Architecture, Security, and business stakeholders without direct authority on enterprise-scale, multi-region initiatives.
* Ways of working: Able to collaborate across U.S. and Asia time zones, including regular overlap with U.S.-based stakeholders and partners.

**▍ Preferred Requirements**

* Product management certification (Pragmatic Institute, SAFe Product Owner / Product Manager, or equivalent).
* Hands-on experience with Source-to-Pay or procurement platforms (SAP Ariba, Coupa, Ivalua, GEP, Icertis, or Ironclad) and procurement analytics platforms.
* Experience reimagining platform operations and enablement with AI or agents embedded.
* Service management (ITIL) and Agile or DevOps ways of working for enterprise applications.
* Depth in Source-to-Pay and Procure-to-Pay processes and the broader procurement platform landscape.

**About Micron Technology, Inc.**
We are an industry leader in innovative memory and storage solutions transforming how the world uses information to enrich life
*for all*
. description:

At AMD, we believe technology can change lives for the better. It can heal us, entertain us, and make us more connected, productive, and understanding of the world around us. Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or creating go-to-market plans, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward.
  
  
THE ROLE
  
  
The Technical Marketing Engineer for AMD-AECG is an adaptable, self-motivated individual who drives the Vivado and next-generation tool product roadmap to best serve customer needs. This role is responsible for feature specification, planning, validation, documentation, early training materials, and key customer support. Technical Marketing works closely with Product Planning, R&D, Applications Engineering, and top-tier customers to improve the FPGA and Adaptive SoC design process and enable next-generation designs and methodologies. The environment is fast-paced, global, and focused on emerging technologies.
  
  
THE PERSON
  
  
The successful Technical Marketing Engineer plays a critical role in defining, planning, and supporting
**Run-Time Reconfiguration (RTR)**
flows in the Vivado Design Suite for AMD FPGA and Adaptive SoC products. This includes maintaining Run-Time Reconfiguration Intellectual Property (IP), enabling advanced use cases that reduce compile time, ensuring compliance with PCI Express standards, and driving the next generation of the Vivado tool roadmap.
  
  
This individual understands customer requirements and pain points across Run-Time Reconfiguration, design partitioning, module reuse, and preservation-based incremental compilation flows, and translates those insights into innovative product capabilities. The ability to manage multiple priorities and collaborate across global teams is essential. We operate with an agentic, AI-first mindset and expect team members to actively incorporate AI into how they work.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Define best-in-class development flows, features, and methodologies for Run-Time Reconfiguration across AMD FPGA, Zynq™, and Adaptive SoC tools and libraries.
* Drive Run-Time Reconfiguration, design partitioning, module-level reuse, and compile-time reduction methodologies from feature specification through validation.
* Maintain and enhance Run-Time Reconfiguration IP and associated tool flows to support advanced customer use cases.
* Collaborate with Engineering, Product Planning, Sales, and customers to define and deliver innovative tool features.
* Provide technical expertise to field teams and customers by developing training materials, tutorials, application notes, and user guides.
* Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to internal stakeholders and customers, including architecture, implementation tradeoffs, and design recommendations.
* Gather and analyze customer and field feedback, identify opportunities for new features and product improvements, and work closely with Planning and Engineering teams to drive implementation.

**Preferred Experience**

* Strong knowledge of the complete FPGA design flow and Vivado tool suite.
* Hands-on experience with Run-Time Reconfiguration or similar modular and reconfigurable design methodologies.
* Understanding of design partitioning, module reuse, incremental compilation, and preservation-based implementation flows.
* Expertise in System-on-Chip (SoC) development.
* Experience applying AI/ML technologies, including AI-assisted design, automation, debug, or agentic engineering workflows.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze and solve complex system-level technical challenges, both independently and in collaboration with strategic customers.
* Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.
* Proven ability to collaborate effectively with geographically distributed, cross-functional teams.

description:
**About Sureify**

Sureify is dedicated to modernizing the life insurance and annuity industry. We provide cutting-edge digital solutions that empower insurers to easily engage with, sell to, and service their customers. Our mission is to drive meaningful digital transformation by offering scalable technology that enhances customer engagement and streamlines carrier operations. Sureify's products deliver the advanced digital experiences that life insurance carriers, agents, employees, and consumers now expect in this rapidly evolving technological landscape. At Sureify, we cultivate a culture that prioritizes innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a
**Senior Technical Release Manager**
to join our Hyderabad office. This role will be responsible for managing all production releases across our enterprise platform and customer-specific solutions. Unlike traditional release roles, this position serves as a
**Technical Release Governor**
in a complex hybrid environment consisting of both
**multi-tenant**
products and
**multi-instance**
siloed environments.

As we scale our
**carrier customer**
base, we are looking to adopt best of the breed release practices. You will be the single point of accountability for replacing high-intensity manual interventions in releases with a systematic, technically rigorous process. You will ensure releases are delivered with quality, predictability, and efficiency while bridging the gap between engineering, QA, product, and client support teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Release Lifecycle Leadership:**
Own and manage the end-to-end release lifecycle for all production deployments, including core platform production updates and customer-specific customizations. Define, document, and enforce
**release management processes and standards**
. Create and maintain the
**release calendar**
, ensuring transparency and alignment across teams.

**Technical Gatekeeping:**
Conduct deep-dive release readiness reviews. You will audit "Release Manifests" by validating steps such as SQL migrations or PDF template migrations, Temporal workflow versioning, Kafka schemas, and AWS resource configurations. A good overall understanding of deployment architecture in AWS is essential for this role.

**Environment Governance:**
Manage "Instance Parity" across our
**AWS**
multi-instance architecture to prevent "Environmental Drift" and ensure customer-specific secrets and variables match our global standards.

**Cross-Functional Orchestration:**
Facilitate formal "Go/No-Go" decisions by tracking a global checklist that includes technical and non-technical readiness.

**Risk Mitigation:**
Identify, document, and mitigate technical sequencing risks (e.g., database locks or stateful workflow conflicts) associated with production releases.

**Continuous Improvement:**
Monitor release performance, generate and provide metrics and reports and drive the transition from manual coordination to
**Automated Production Quality Gates**
within our release pipelines.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* **10+ years of overall technical experience**
  , with a background in software engineering, SRE, or backend operations.
* **5+ years of direct release management experience**
  in a complex, enterprise hybrid SaaS environment (Multi-tenant & Multi-instance).
* **Cloud-Native Expertise:**
  Expert-level knowledge of
  **AWS**
  (EKS, RDS, Secrets Manager, IAM, S3, MSK) and the ability to audit infrastructure-level configurations.
* **Stack Fluency:**
  Demonstrated familiarity with
  **Typescript**
  ,
  **PHP, Go-lang, and Node.js**
  ecosystems. You must understand the deployment nuances of each.
* **Modern Orchestration:**
  Hands-on experience or strong knowledge of
  **Temporal**
  (stateful workflows) and
  **Kafka**
  (event streaming). You understand the risks of deploying to "in-flight" asynchronous processes.
* **Database Proficiency:**
  Strong proficiency in
  **MySQL and Postgres**
  , specifically in auditing complex migration scripts and data sequencing.
* **Containerization Mastery:**

description:

savings at a single enterprise,

, and 15–20% reductions in maintenance costs.

**Frost & Sullivan's**
“Frost Radar 2025 - Augmented Connected Worker Platforms”, with acknowledgments from Gartner and LNS Research, and is backed by
**Vista Equity Partners**
and
**Tiger Global Management**
.

With headquarters in Houston and an engineering center in Hyderabad, we have 300+ employees across the U.S., India, and ANZ and are on a strong trajectory toward $100M ARR.

**The Role**

Innovapptive’s Connected Worker Platform is expanding its AI capability from foundational features into a broad portfolio of product-facing AI agents purpose-built for industrial field operations. These agents span maintenance planning, work order automation, safety compliance, operator rounds, and knowledge assistance, all grounded in customer-specific asset data and SOPs.

This role leads the AI Engineering team responsible for designing, building, and operating that agent portfolio in production. You own the full lifecycle: from architecture and prompt engineering through evaluation, deployment, and reliability. You work closely with Product, Platform, and customer-facing teams to translate industrial use cases into AI capabilities that enterprise customers trust.

**What You Own**

* AI Engineering team across agent development, LLM infrastructure, and model evaluation.
* End-to-end agent lifecycle: requirements through architecture, build, evaluation, deployment, and production monitoring.
* RAG and knowledge infrastructure: document ingestion pipelines, chunking strategies, embedding, vector search, and knowledge graph grounding.
* LLM governance: model selection, prompt versioning, bias testing, audit logs, and human-in-the-loop controls. All inference within Innovapptive’s AWS VPC — no data to external LLM endpoints.
* Agent quality: evaluation frameworks, accuracy benchmarks, hallucination monitoring, and output labelling pipelines.
* Sprint delivery and production reliability. Weekly quality scorecard.
* Hiring, performance management, and coaching.

**You Must Have**

* 7+ years in software engineering with 3+ years managing teams delivering AI/ML or LLM-powered products in enterprise production.
* Hands-on experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangGraph, LangChain, or equivalent) and multi-step agentic workflows.
* Strong grasp of RAG architecture: document pipelines, chunking, embedding, vector databases, re-ranking, and similarity thresholds.
* Experience with managed inference infrastructure: AWS Bedrock, SageMaker, or equivalent.
* Track record shipping AI product features on schedule in a SaaS context — not just prototypes or internal tools.
* Familiarity with AI observability: prompt tracing, hallucination detection, and output evaluation (Langfuse, Ragas, or equivalent).
* Data-driven: model evaluation scores, accuracy/recall metrics, agent success rates, and DORA metrics for the team.
* Strong engineering standards: prompt discipline, eval-driven development, responsible AI controls, and production-grade reliability.

**Nice to Have**

* Knowledge graph architectures (AWS Neptune, Neo4j) for grounding agent outputs in structured asset data.
* Industrial domain knowledge: EAM, ERP integrations (SAP, Maximo), maintenance workflows, or field operations.
* Multi-agent orchestration patterns: tool calling, agent-to-agent delegation, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints.
* Vision models or multimodal AI: image-based defect detection, document OCR, or form digitisation.
* MLOps and LLMOps: model versioning, A/B evaluation, and continuous prompt optimisation pipelines.
* Cloud cost optimisation for LLM workloads: token budgets, model tiering, and caching strategies.
* MongoDB and change stream-based event architectures.

**Tech Stack & Tools**

1. **AI / ML-**
   AWS Bedrock, SageMaker, LiteLLM, LangGraph, Milvus (vector DB), AWS Neptune (knowledge graph), Langfuse
2. **Backend-**
   Node.js / TypeScript, Python, MongoDB
3. **Infrastructure-**
   AWS, Docker, GitLab CI/CD
4. **Observability-**
   Langfuse, Sentry, CloudWatch
5. **Tools-**
   GitLab, Jira, SonarQube

**Compensation & Growth**

Reports to VP PE&A. Path to Sr. EM or platform leadership as integration becomes a core horizontal capability.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive compensation and equity tied to measurable impact on AI accuracy and performance.
* A platform to shape the semantic intelligence layer of a category-defining industrial SaaS company.
* Access to cutting-edge AI, data, and observability toolchains for continuous learning and innovation.

title: Senior Manager, IT Delivery
description:
As a senior technology leader within Vanguard Technology, you will be responsible for defining and executing technology strategies that enable business growth, operational excellence and customer value. You will oversee teams responsible for designing, developing, testing, implementing and supporting enterprise technology solutions across multiple product and engineering domains. This role exists to ensure Vanguard continues to build scalable, resilient and innovative technology capabilities while accelerating delivery and strengthening engineering maturity. You will influence strategic technology direction, drive organisational effectiveness and create an environment where teams are empowered to innovate, collaborate and deliver meaningful outcomes. Success in this role requires strong leadership across technology, people, delivery, finance and stakeholder management. You will be expected to lead through transformation, develop future leaders and establish modern engineering practices that support Vanguard's evolving technology landscape.
  
  
**About Vanguard**
Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe—directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries.
  
  
**Vanguard India**
Vanguard’s office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world-class experience for our clients.
  
  
**Role Summary**
As a senior technology leader within Vanguard Technology, you will be responsible for defining and executing technology strategies that enable business growth, operational excellence and customer value. You will oversee teams responsible for designing, developing, testing, implementing and supporting enterprise technology solutions across multiple product and engineering domains.
  
  
This role exists to ensure Vanguard continues to build scalable, resilient and innovative technology capabilities while accelerating delivery and strengthening engineering maturity. You will influence strategic technology direction, drive organisational effectiveness and create an environment where teams are empowered to innovate, collaborate and deliver meaningful outcomes.
  
  
Success in this role requires strong leadership across technology, people, delivery, finance and stakeholder management. You will be expected to lead through transformation, develop future leaders and establish modern engineering practices that support Vanguard's evolving technology landscape.
  
  
Core Responsibilities
  
  
  

* Provide strategic leadership for technology delivery across multiple engineering, platform and product domains, ensuring alignment with business objectives and long-term technology strategy.
* Lead teams responsible for designing, developing, testing, implementing and supporting enterprise technology products and services.
* Partner with business and technology stakeholders to define priorities, shape technology demand and execute strategic roadmaps that drive business outcomes.
* Develop and implement workforce, operating and organisational growth plans that support business expansion and long-term capability development.
* Hire, coach, mentor and develop technology professionals and leaders while fostering a culture of accountability, innovation and continuous improvement.
* Establish and optimise operating models, governance frameworks and delivery processes that improve organisational effectiveness and execution excellence.
* Oversee planning, prioritisation, resource allocation and execution of complex technology initiatives and portfolios.
* Drive engineering transformation through adoption of modern software development practices, automation, platform engineering and AI-enabled delivery capabilities.
* Monitor delivery performance, service metrics and operational effectiveness using data-driven insights to improve outcomes and decision making.
* Lead the evaluation, selection, implementation and integration of technology solutions, vendor platforms and third-party products.
* Manage departmental budgets, workforce investments and technology expenditures while ensuring efficient use of resources.
* Build and maintain strategic relationships with business leaders, technology partners, vendors and key stakeholders to enable successful business outcomes.
* Identify organisational, operational, technology and delivery risks and implement effective mitigation strategies.
* Embed cybersecurity, resiliency, compliance and risk-management practices into technology solutions and engineering processes.
* Ensure adherence to information technology, cybersecurity and information security standards, policies and regulatory requirements.
* Lead quality and service-improvement initiatives that enhance engineering effectiveness, customer outcomes and operational excellence.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Minimum 12+ years of experience in technology delivery, software engineering, programme management or technology leadership roles.
* Minimum 5 years of experience leading managers, engineering teams or large-scale technology organisations.
* Proven experience leading enterprise software delivery and technology transformation initiatives within complex global or matrixed organisations.
* Strong experience in technology strategy, organisational scaling, workforce planning, stakeholder management and operational leadership.
* Experience managing large technology portfolios, budgets, investment planning and resource allocation.
* Demonstrated experience evaluating technology platforms, managing vendor relationships and leading build-versus-buy decisions.
* Strong understanding of software delivery methodologies, engineering best practices, governance frameworks and operational excellence.
* Experience incorporating cybersecurity, resiliency, compliance and risk management requirements into technology solutions and delivery processes.
* Excellent communication, leadership and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence senior business and technology leaders.
* Proven ability to lead through ambiguity, organisational change and rapid growth while maintaining delivery excellence.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree in Technology, Engineering, Information Systems, Business Administration or a related field.
* Experience leading large-scale engineering organisations within financial services, asset management or other highly regulated industries.
* Experience driving enterprise-wide engineering transformation, cloud modernisation and platform engineering initiatives.
* Experience implementing automation, AI-enabled engineering practices and emerging technology solutions.
* Knowledge of enterprise architecture, cloud technologies, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) and secure software development practices.
* Experience working within global capability centres or globally distributed technology organisations.
* Professional certifications related to cloud technologies, programme management, agile delivery, cybersecurity or enterprise architecture.

**Location**
This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard India. Only qualified external applicants will be considered.
  
  
**Our mission**
Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success.
  
  
**Our commitment to you**
Vanguard takes the same long-term view of your success—at work and in life—with Benefits and Rewards packages that reflect what you care about, throughout all the phases and stages of your life. Our Total Rewards programs provide you and your loved ones with wellness support for key areas in your life:
  
  
**Financial wellness**
We're committed to enabling your financial success and provide competitive offers and programs.
  
  
**Physical wellness**
We're committed to providing benefits that support your physical health and wellness.
  
  
**Personal wellness**
We're committed to providing resources that help support the full scope of your life.
  
  
**How We Work**
Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for most of our employees (crew members), designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

title: Principal Consultant - System Platform
description:
**AVEVA is creating software trusted by over 90% of leading industrial companies.**
**Job Description**
**Job Title:**
Principal Consultant
  
  
**Location:**
Hyderabad
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full Time
  
  
**The job**
We are seeking a highly accomplished and experienced
**Principal Consultant – Unified Operations Center (UOC)**
to lead the architecture, strategy, and delivery of enterprise-scale Industrial Automation and Digital Transformation solutions using the AVEVA portfolio. This role will serve as the technical authority for defining solution architectures, driving technology strategy, and delivering business-critical industrial solutions for global customers.
  
  
The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in
**AVEVA System Platform, Unified Operations Center (UOC), industrial system architectures, SCADA/HMI solutions, enterprise integration, cloud-enabled industrial platforms, and OT-IT convergence**
. The Principal Consultant will be responsible for defining enterprise solution blueprints, establishing architecture and engineering standards, leading technical governance, and ensuring the successful delivery of scalable, secure, resilient, and high-availability solutions across complex industrial environments.
  
  
As a trusted advisor to customers and executive stakeholders, the Principal Consultant will collaborate with business leaders, enterprise architects, project managers, and multidisciplinary engineering teams to shape digital transformation initiatives across industries including
**Oil & Gas, Chemicals, Manufacturing, Mining, Utilities, Water, and Power**
. The role also includes driving pre-sales and solution consulting activities, mentoring senior consultants and engineering teams, establishing technical best practices and reusable frameworks, and influencing the organization's technology roadmap while ensuring successful project execution and long-term customer success.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Solution Design & Architecture**

* Lead the architecture, design, and technical governance of enterprise-scale Unified Operations Center (UOC) and Industrial Automation solutions using the AVEVA portfolio.
* Define enterprise solution blueprints, reference architectures, and technology roadmaps aligned with customer business objectives and digital transformation strategies.
* Own the preparation, review, and approval of High-Level Design (HLD), Low-Level Design (LLD), Solution Design Documents (SDD), and architecture standards.
* Define and govern deployment architectures across the AVEVA ecosystem, including:

+ Galaxy Repository
+ Application Object Servers
+ AVEVA Historian
+ Communication Drivers
+ AVEVA OMI
+ Alarm Servers
+ Application Servers
+ License Manager
+ Identity Manager

* Establish architecture standards, engineering best practices, reusable frameworks, and governance models to ensure consistency across multiple projects and delivery teams.
* Design and review High Availability (HA), Disaster Recovery (DR), redundancy, failover, backup, and business continuity strategies for mission-critical industrial applications.
* Lead infrastructure sizing, capacity planning, scalability assessments, and performance optimization for enterprise and multi-site deployments.
* Define enterprise system architectures encompassing network topology, virtualization, cloud/hybrid deployments, cybersecurity, identity management, and OT-IT integration.
* Provide technical leadership in solution reviews, architecture governance, risk assessments, and design assurance to ensure compliance with customer standards, AVEVA best practices, and industry regulations.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend architecture improvements to enhance system scalability, reliability, maintainability, and operational efficiency.
* Collaborate with customer stakeholders, enterprise architects, and multidisciplinary engineering teams to develop innovative, future-ready solutions that meet both business and operational objectives.
* Serve as the technical authority for complex solution design decisions, architecture escalations, and strategic technology direction across multiple projects and customer engagements.

**Essential Requirements**
**Non-Technical**

* Excellent written, verbal, technical, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to influence customers, executive stakeholders, and cross-functional teams.
* Demonstrated ability to lead customer workshops, solution discussions, architecture reviews, and executive presentations.
* Proven leadership, mentoring, and coaching skills with experience guiding technical teams and driving engineering best practices.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills with the ability to manage complex technical and business challenges.
* Ability and flexibility to travel for customer engagements, solution workshops, architecture reviews, commissioning, and project delivery.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Microsoft Project.

**Technical**

* 12–18 years of experience in Industrial Automation, SCADA, and Digital Transformation, with extensive hands-on experience delivering enterprise-scale solutions using the AVEVA portfolio.
* Recognized subject matter expert in the AVEVA product suite, including System Platform, Operations Control (UOC), OMI, Historian, Communication Drivers, Reports, Application Server, License Manager, and Identity Manager.
* Extensive experience in defining enterprise architecture, solution blueprints, and deployment strategies for large-scale AVEVA System Platform implementations.
* Proven experience leading Unified Operations Center (UOC) / AVEVA Operations Control programs across multiple sites, business units, or geographically distributed facilities.
* Strong expertise in designing highly available, scalable, secure, and resilient industrial automation architectures, including redundancy, disaster recovery (DR), and failover strategies.
* Extensive experience in AVEVA System Platform object modeling, template development, standardization, governance, and reusable engineering frameworks.
* Strong knowledge of AVEVA System Platform scripting, .NET Framework integration, I/O mapping, and device integration.
* Hands-on experience developing high-performance HMI applications, dashboards, and visualizations using AVEVA OMI, ArchestrA Graphics, and InTouch.
* Strong understanding of industrial communication protocols, including OPC DA, OPC UA, MQTT, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Extensive experience integrating AVEVA System Platform with enterprise applications such as SAP, MES, ERP systems, SQL Server, REST APIs, and other business applications.
* Strong knowledge of relational database design, SQL Server, data integration, and industrial data management.
* Experience with SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS) and enterprise reporting solutions is desirable.
* Proven experience in solution sizing, infrastructure planning, system capacity assessment, and performance optimization for enterprise deployments.
* Strong understanding of distributed system architecture, client/server optimization, load balancing, virtualization, redundancy, and high-availability deployments.
* Experience with cloud-enabled industrial solutions, including AVEVA CONNECT, Microsoft Azure, hybrid architectures, and OT-IT convergence is highly desirable.
* Proven experience leading technical governance, architecture reviews, design approvals, and engineering quality assurance across multiple projects.
* Strong experience in defining and executing Factory Acceptance Test (FAT), Site Acceptance Test (SAT), commissioning, and production rollout strategies.
* Demonstrated ability to lead end-to-end project delivery, from requirements gathering and solution architecture through development, testing, commissioning, production deployment, and customer handover.
* Experience contributing to pre-sales activities, including solution proposals, effort estimation, technical presentations, proof-of-concepts (PoCs), and customer demonstrations.
* Working knowledge of industrial cybersecurity principles, secure system design, identity management, and network architecture is highly desirable.
* Experience mentoring senior engineers and consultants, establishing engineering standards, reusable frameworks, and technical best practices across the organization.

**Services at AVEVA**
Our dynamic global team of 700+ engineers, developers, consultants, solution architects and project managers are at the forefront of delivering AVEVA cutting-edge solutions to customers. The work is complex and technical, but immensely rewarding: we empower customers to harness the full transformative potential of AVEVA’s solutions. If you’re analytical, pragmatic, and driven to make a tangible impact on the sustainability of the industrial sector, our team is the perfect place for you.
  
  
Find out more: https://www.aveva.com/en/about/careers/
  
  
**India Benefits include:**
Gratuity, Medical and accidental insurance, very attractive leave entitlement, emergency leave days, childcare support, maternity, paternity and adoption leaves, education assistance program, home office set up support (for hybrid roles), well-being support
  
  
It’s possible we’re hiring for this position in multiple countries, in which case the above benefits apply to the primary location. Specific benefits vary by country, but our packages are similarly comprehensive.
  
  
Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/benefits/

We work in a hybrid way at AVEVA. Most roles are based at a local AVEVA office, with an expectation of being on-site 50% of your working hours to support collaboration and connection. Some positions are fully office-based depending on the nature of the work, and certain roles that support specific customers or markets may be remote. The working arrangement for this position will be confirmed during the hiring process.
  
  
**Hiring process**
Interested? Great! Get started by submitting your cover letter and CV through our application portal. AVEVA is committed to recruiting and retaining people with disabilities. Please let us know in advance if you need reasonable support during your application process.

AVEVA is a global leader in industrial software with more than 6,500 employees in over 40 countries. Our cutting-edge solutions are used by thousands of enterprises to deliver the essentials of life – such as energy, infrastructure, chemicals, and minerals – safely, efficiently, and more sustainably.
  
  
We are committed to embedding sustainability and inclusion into our operations, our culture, and our core business strategy. Learn more about how we are progressing against our ambitious 2030 targets: sustainability-report.aveva.com/

title: Technology Lead – HealthTech & MedTech
description:
The Centre for Technology Innovation & Incubation (CFTII) at LVPEI operates at the convergence of clinical need, translational research, and engineering. We build and scale biomedical devices, diagnostic imaging tools, digital health platforms, and AI-enabled solutions across five core technical domains:
**Optics & Imaging**
,
**Electronics**
,
**Mechanical Engineering**
,
**Software & AI**
, and
**Product Design**
.

**Role Overview**

As Technology Lead, you will bridge clinical needs and engineering execution. You will lead and actively build multidisciplinary healthcare technologies—taking products from problem identification through rapid prototyping, systems integration, clinical validation, regulatory readiness, and technology transfer.

This is a
**hands-on technical leadership role**
requiring bench-level engineering execution, cross-domain system integration, and collaborative problem-solving alongside clinicians, researchers, and external engineering partners.

**Key Responsibilities**

**· Systems Integration & Technical Leadership:**
Architect and integrate multi-domain systems (optics, mechanical hardware, embedded electronics, and software/AI) into functional, clinical-grade medical devices.

**· Hands-on Prototyping:**
Directly contribute to CAD/3D printing, circuit/embedded hardware reviews, optical assembly, or AI model integration to advance concepts from bench to prototype.

**· Clinical Translation:**
Partner directly with ophthalmologists, surgeons, and researchers to convert clinical protocols and user workflows into measurable technical specifications.

**· Engineering Lifecycle Management:**
Manage product timelines, conduct cross-disciplinary design reviews, establish build standards, and oversee internal engineers and external fabrication partners.

**· Regulatory, IP & Tech Transfer:**
Ensure technical documentation meets medical device quality standards (e.g., ISO 13485), document IP, and support technology transfer toward commercialization.

**Candidate Profile**

**Must-Haves (Ranked by Priority)**

**1. Hands-on MedTech Development & Rapid Prototyping:**
Demonstrated experience building, physically assembling, and testing Biomedical or MedTech devices—not just managing schedules.

**2. Multidisciplinary Systems Engineering:**
Proven ability to lead and integrate cross-functional hardware and software projects spanning mechanical engineering, electronics, optics, software, or design.

**3. Clinical Need Translation & Regulatory Awareness:**
Experience collaborating with medical professionals to translate clinical workflows into product specifications, with a basic working knowledge of medical device regulatory pathways and IP documentation.

**Good-to-Haves**

**1. Optics, Medical Imaging, or Ophthalmic Experience:**
Direct work with optical systems, cameras, sensors, illumination, or healthcare computer vision/AI models.

**2. Commercialization & Tech Transfer:**
Exposure to taking prototypes through pilot manufacturing, licensing, GTM, or startup spin-offs.

**3. Intellectual Output:**
Granted/pending patents or peer-reviewed publications in biomedical/tech domains.

**4. Immediate Availability:**
Ability to join within
**30 days**
.

title: Portfolio Lead
description:
****Company Description****
There's nothing like a career at Entain India. We're the technology powerhouse helping Entain – a world leader in sports and gaming – create products and experiences used by millions of customers across the globe. Whether you're an engineer, product owner or customer care professional, unlock a world of new possibilities – for you and the future of sports and gaming.
  
  
****Job Description****
The Portfolio Lead is accountable for delivery performance across a sub-domain of 4-6 pods (Engineering, Quality, Product). They lead the flow of value from idea to production, ensuring pods deliver with pace, predictability and understanding to outcomes.
  
  
They combine hands-on delivery leadership with AI-augmented ways of working and data-driven decision-making. They do not prescribe a single framework - instead they adapt approaches that best serve each pod's context.
  
  
They partner with Engineering and Product leadership to reduce waste, improve throughput and help pods achieve Autonomy, Accountability and Agreement to value outcomes.
  
  
****What You Will Do****
**Pod Performance & Accountability**
You are responsible for pod delivery performance across the sub-domain.
  
  
You will lead and communicate delivery health, risks and performance to leadership
  
  
Ensure pods operate as, self-organising units delivering value outcomes
  
  
Support pod leads with coaching, facilitation and conflict resolution
  
  
Ensure cross-pod agreement on priorities, dependencies and shared goals
  
  
Facilitate communication and collaboration between pods to promote knowledge sharing
  
  
**Problem Solving**
You will be an expert; deploy root cause analysis, systems thinking and structured techniques to analyse and guide out resolutions.
  
  
Be an escalation point for cross-pod blockers and systemic impediments
  
  
Identify patterns across pods that indicate deeper organisational or process issues
  
  
**AI-Augmented Delivery**
Champion AI agent adoption across pods - including coding agents, test generation, story creation, board health and deployment automation
  
  
Identify opportunities where AI can reduce toil, accelerate delivery or improve decision-making
  
  
Apply AI to improve delivery effectiveness, including workflow insights, risk prediction, and automation of reporting
  
  
Track and demonstrate the impact of AI on delivery performance
  
  
**Flow & Efficiency**
Monitor and improve delivery flow (lead time, cycle time, WIP, throughput) using Kanban and lean principles
  
  
Ensure WIP limits are respected and surface ageing items through Board Walks
  
  
Identify bottlenecks, ageing work and sources of delay across pods.
  
  
Improve through regular assessment and experimentation.
  
  
Support teams in breaking down work into deliverable, value-driven increments
  
  
**Agile Ways of Working**
Support and evolve the agile operating model for a pod-based environment focused on pace, not ceremony.
  
  
Adapt delivery approaches (Kanban, flow-based, lean) appropriate to each pod's needs
  
  
Ensure consistency of practice across pods without being prescriptive
  
  
Promote outcome-driven delivery vs output-driven activity
  
  
Guide teams to operate with autonomy and accountability
  
  
**Metrics & Reporting**
Define and maintain delivery metrics: cycle time, flow efficiency, lead time of initiative, PDLC compression, dependency reduction, rework rate, team satisfaction, and AI effectiveness
  
  
Build dashboards (cumulative flow diagrams, throughput charts, WIP ageing) that provide leadership visibility and lead informed decision-making
  
  
Analyse performance data to identify trends, patterns and areas for improvement
  
  
Use data to facilitate conversations and coach pods — not just track output
  
  
**Stakeholder Management**
Partner with Engineering and Product leadership at sub-domain level
  
  
Represent delivery health and risks in leadership forums
  
  
Build trusted relationships that allow fast decision-making
  
  
Communicate delivery performance to both technical and non-technical audiences
  
  
**Commercial Awareness**
Understand the commercial context of the sub-domain
  
  
Connect delivery decisions to revenue, cost, and customer impact
  
  
Support prioritisation trade-offs with a business lens
  
  
**Capacity Planning**
Forecast capacity across pods based on team composition, skills mix and upcoming demand
  
  
Identify resourcing gaps and support hiring/allocation decisions
  
  
Balance workload across pods to prevent burnout and underutilisation
  
  
Support realistic planning by ensuring pods have clear understanding of available capacity
  
  
**Risk & Dependency Management**
Manage risks through regular assessment and execution of controls
  
  
Ensure cross-pod dependencies are visible, tracked and managed
  
  
Track dependency cost (time blocked, items affected) and lead mitigations such as contract-first development and feature flags
  
  
Support issue escalations, ensuring intervention by the dependency escalation protocol
  
  
**Coach & Capability Development**
Provide hands-on coaching at pod level
  
  
Build capability in workflow management, flow thinking, estimation, planning, and data-led decision-making
  
  
Support teams in understanding and improving their own performance
  
  
Strengthen a culture of continuous improvement and learning
  
  
**Outcome & Value Focus**
Align delivery to always ensure outcomes and value.
  
  
Help teams understand the why behind their work and how their outputs contribute to value
  
  
Challenge work that does not link to outcomes
  
  
Support measurement of delivery against OKRs and value indicators
  
  
**Centre of Excellence (CoE) Contribution**
Be an active contributor to the CoE
  
  
Share best practices, delivery insights and improvement opportunities from pods
  
  
Support adoption of standards, playbooks and tools
  
  
Help evolve delivery practices based on experience
  
  
****Qualifications****
**Specialist Experience**
You will have 7+ years in delivery/agile roles, with at least 3 years operating across multiple teams simultaneously in a technology environment
  
  
Expert in flow-based delivery approaches (Kanban, lean, continuous delivery) — not limited to Scrum
  
  
Experience enabling multiple teams/pods simultaneously at scale
  
  
Strong understanding of AI tooling and its application to software delivery (coding assistants, automation, intelligent analytics)
  
  
Experienced in capacity planning, demand forecasting and resource optimisation across multiple teams
  
  
Use data to solve complex problems; can interpret and communicate complex data sets clearly
  
  
Previous experience of organisational transformation and change management
  
  
Good knowledge of Objectives and Key Results (OKR) strategy
  
  
Experience in a regulated industry (gaming, fintech, or similar) desirable
  
  
**Competencies & Behaviours**
You will embody the Maker Dimensions - selecting for capability, not just competence. We are looking for people who are versatile, curious, and able to operate with autonomy in a high-trust environment.
  
  
**AI Fluency**
uses AI tooling; experiments; iterate with AI as a collaborator
  
  
**Agency & Accountability**
Owns outcomes, not just tasks; directs itself.
  
  
**Systems Thinking**
Sees patterns across pods and addresses causes, not symptoms
  
  
**Stakeholder Engagement**
Builds working relationships across pods and leadership
  
  
**Improve Performance**
Raises the bar through data and experimentation
  
  
**Cross-functional Versatility**
Comfortable operating beyond their primary discipline
  
  
**Product Sense**
Connects their work to customer and outcomes
  
  
**Build Capability**
Invests in developing pods, individuals and self
  
  
****Benefits****
**Additional Information**
At Entain India, We Offer a Package And The Support People Need To Make An Impact. Join Us, And a Great Compensation Package Is Just The Beginning. You Can Expect To Receive Benefits Like:
  
  

* Safe home pickup and home drop.
* A regular bonus and great pension.
* 24 days annual leave.
* Extra paid leave, including wellbeing and development days.
* Life assurance and Income Protection.
* Private healthcare and wellbeing support.
* INR 3,000 per month Communication allowance.
* Up to INR 16,000 per year in Crèche expenses (children under 3).

**Equal Opportunities**
.
  
  
If you need any
**reasonable adjustments**
at any stage of the recruitment process, please contact us and we'll support you.
  
  
We're committed to creating a diverse, equitable and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, respected and able to be themselves.
  
  
We're an
**equal opportunities employer**
. We welcome applications from everyone and we do not discriminate based on age, disability, gender or gender reassignment, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sexual orientation, marriage/civil partnership, or any other basis.
  
  
We comply with all applicable recruitment regulations and employment laws in the jurisdictions where we operate, ensuring ethical and compliant hiring practices globally.

title: Events Platform Manager
description:
**Job Title: Events Platform Manager**

* Location: Hyderabad

**About Sanofi**
We are an innovative global healthcare company, committed to transforming the lives of people with immune challenges, rare diseases and blood disorders, cancers, and neurological disorders. From R&D to sales, our talented teams work together, revolutionizing treatment, continually improving products, understanding unmet needs, and connecting communities. We chase the miracles of science every single day, pursuing Progress to make a real impact on millions of patients around the world.
  
  
Sanofi has currently the best and most robust pipeline of R&D and consequent new launches in our history. The Go-to-Market Capabilities Team was organized to consolidate business operations efforts globally across all business units with an eye to create efficiencies that fund our pipeline and prepare us to drive multiple new product launches as we strive to materialize the miracles of science to improve people's lives.
  
  
**About The Job**
The Events Platform - Manager role is a part of the Go-to-Market Capabilities (GTMC), Customer Facing Capabilities (CFC), CRM & Enablers team. The GTMC organization drives best-in-class capabilities and brings value and excellence in commercial operations. The GTMC organization is a key part of the modernization of Sanofi and allows all business operations efforts to be focused on Sanofi "Take the Lead" priorities across products, markets, and pipelines. It accomplishes these goals through realizing the efficiencies of removing silos that exist between our business units, avoiding the duplication and overlapping of resources, standardizing our processes and tools, operating with a One Sanofi approach to accelerate our key capabilities development, and fostering the entrepreneurial spirit by speeding up the decision-making process.
  
  
This role serves as the technical authority for Events and Congresses platform operations within OneCRM US, supporting the strategic vision for event platform capabilities, data governance, and system evolution. This leader ensures system enhancements operate as intended and advises on scalable event platform solutions that support multi-brand, multi-market launch requirements, ensuring enterprise-wide compliance, data integrity, and continuous platform transformation across all Promotional and Non-Promotional event types (Speaker Meetings, Displays, Product Theaters, Scientific Education Programs, and Speaker Trainings etc.).
  
  
This position will work closely with CRM & Enablers Team members in the US, US-based stakeholders, Hyderabad HUB resources, contracted system enhancement resources, Sales, Marketing, Medical, Field Engagement Management, Business Operations, Compliance, other GTMC pillars, Veeva, and Sanofi Digital to support the end-to-end design, governance, and evolution of the Events and Congresses platform across the OneCRM US ecosystem. This leader serves as a strategic partner across the enterprise, supporting platform direction, data governance standards, User Acceptance testing and operational frameworks that underpin compliant, high-performing event execution at scale.
  
  
Main Responsibilities
  
  

* Support the strategic vision and roadmap for Events Management platform capabilities across OneCRM US, ensuring alignment with enterprise Events & Congress standards and business priorities
* Serve as the technical lead for Veeva Events and Congresses enhancement user acceptance testing and issue investigation/resolution, overseeing service ticket process and driving associated improvements to the process
* Identify and recommend scalable event platform solutions supporting multi-brand Speaker Meetings, Displays, Product Theaters, Scientific Education Programs, and Speaker Trainings across multiple markets and business units
* Drive enterprise-wide data discrepancy investigation and correction for Compliance and Transparency events data, establishing data quality standards and reconciliation frameworks for transparency, compliance, and data integrity across all event types and downstream systems
* Ensure accurate end-to-end event platform frameworks and processes — including topic management, speaker profiles, budgets, and nomination and content submission tools — that scale with organizational growth and platform evolution
* Mentor the events platform operations team, providing technical guidance, knowledge transfer, and career development support that elevates individual and team capability
* Influence technical decisions across requirements gathering, system enhancements, and UAT for major platform initiatives, ensuring solutions are scalable, compliant, and fit for enterprise purposes
* Contribute toshape of the long-term roadmap for Events and Congresses platform evolution and integration with downstream systems, including iCare, transparency, FMV, GRF, and contracting
* Lead change management efforts for Service Ticket (ESM) enhancements and evolution, driving adoption and alignment across field teams, Field Engagement Management, and business stakeholders including the creation of knowledge based articles.
* Drive capability building across the broader CRM community through structured knowledge sharing, best practice development, and train-the-trainer programs
* Partner with Field Engagement Management, Sales, Marketing, Medical, Compliance, and Business Operations to influence event platform strategy and ensure the platform meets evolving business requirements
* Oversight of service/incident ticket process for events , establishing performance measurement frameworks and continuous improvement approaches that drive platform excellence
* Investigate and remediate escalated inquiries, applying technical expertise to resolve complex issues and prevent recurrence through systemic process improvements
* Drive cross-functional collaboration across partner GTMC US teams, ensuring event platform strategies are integrated with broader CRM and Global Events and Congress initiatives and enterprise data standards
* Partner with internal and external vendor technical teams to ensure platform readiness

**About Our Team**
The CRM & Enablers Team is a part of the GTMC organization in the US. The CRM & Enablers Team strives to support our business customer facing teams by delivering innovative CRM capabilities that are timely, reliable, accurate, and constantly improving. We focus on our customers — both brand teams and customer facing teams — to adapt our CRM platform and operational systems to meet their needs. Our efforts to streamline and maintain OneCRM US bring value and impact to the organization by reducing the manual workload on our customer facing teams, by providing accurate activity data back to reporting systems, and acting as the nexus of data flow to and from Sanofi data systems. This team operates as a strategic partner to the business, driving platform excellence and enabling compliant, high-impact field engagement at enterprise scale.
  
  
**About The Candidate**
This candidate has a demonstrated track record of leading technical teams, influencing enterprise platform strategy, and designing scalable event platform solutions across multiple business units and product launches. They bring deep expertise in Veeva Events and Congresses, data governance, and compliance requirements — including PhRMA guidelines and transparency reporting — combined with the ability to translate complex technical platform requirements into enterprise-wide operational frameworks. This leader has experience architecting event management solutions, driving process transformation, and building organizational capability at scale. They are skilled at influencing senior stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Medical, Compliance, and Field Engagement Management, navigating complex matrix environments, and shaping platform strategy across concurrent launch programs. Strong English communication skills and availability to engage with US stakeholders with significant operational hour overlap are essential.
  
  
Ideal Experience
  
  

* Bachelor's degree from an accredited four-year college or university (Project Management Masters or MBA preferred)
* 7+ years of progressive events platform and CRM operations experience with demonstrated leadership
* 7+ years of experience in Biotechnology or Pharmaceuticals
* Proven track record of leading technical teams and driving strategic platform initiatives across enterprise-scale programs
* Experience in solution architecture for event management platforms and CRM systems
* Advanced expertise in data governance, compliance requirements (PhRMA guidelines), and data integrity across events and transparency reporting
* Strong knowledge and experience with Veeva Events and Congresses, Agile processes, and event management systems
* Deep understanding of the events ecosystem including transparency, FMV, GRF, contracting, and field engagement integration
* A keen eye for improvement opportunities and the demonstrated ability to deliver on these opportunities
* Clear communication skills with the ability to explain not only the requirements and the "ask", but also the "why" with credibility
* Motivated, energetic, and a respected contributor who engages and elevates others
* Ability to change behaviors to evolve to the company's strategies and initiatives
* Experience working and thriving in a matrix environment
* Strong English communication skills with the ability to engage and align diverse stakeholders across geographies and functions

description:

Arcesium is a global financial technology firm that solves complex data-driven challenges faced by some of the world’s most sophisticated financial institutions. We constantly innovate our platform and capabilities to meet tomorrow’s challenges, anticipate the risks our clients encounter, and design advanced solutions to help our clients achieve transformational business outcomes.
  
  
Financial technology is a high-growth industry as change and innovation continue to disrupt the status-quo and prompt major transformation. Arcesium is at a particularly interesting time in our own growth as we look to leverage our successfully established market position and expand operations in pursuit of strategic new business opportunities. We value intellectual curiosity, proactive ownership, and collaboration with colleagues, and we empower you to meaningfully contribute from day one and accelerate your professional development.
  
  
Arcesium is looking for a hands-on Product Manager to own and drive the evolution of our Tax Product for the Alternative Investment industry. This is a builder’s role for someone who can work closely with Engineering to translate complex tax workflows into scalable technology solutions—from requirements definition through production delivery.
  
  
We are looking for someone who has personally built and shipped technology solutions for hedge fund tax operations. The ideal candidate will have demonstrated experience taking products or platform capabilities from concept and requirements through design, development, testing, and production, working closely with engineering teams throughout the process.
  
  
The role requires a strong combination of tax domain expertise, product thinking, and technology execution. You should be comfortable understanding complex hedge fund tax workflows, identifying opportunities to solve them through technology, defining clear product requirements, and partnering hands-on with Engineering to deliver solutions that are scalable, reliable, and user focused.

* Support the roadmap: Contribute to and eventually own the vision and roadmap for the Tax Product that is informed by market trends and the needs of Alternative Investment clients.
* Grow with the role: This role starts as an individual contributor. Candidates who demonstrate strong independent delivery and domain command will have a path to leading the Tax Product team, earned through performance.

**What You'll Need**

* 8–12 years of experience in US Taxation, with hands-on domain expertise in US Tax Compliance and Planning for Hedge Funds.
* Working knowledge of wash sales, tax lot classification (including Section 1256 treatment), K-1 and investor allocation processing, and regulatory filings such as FBAR, FATCA, and FIN48.
* Direct, verifiable experience building or delivering technology solutions for tax operations like platform features, workflow automation, or systems you helped design and ship with an engineering team.
* Ability to work independently and produce accurate output that holds up on subsequent reviews.
* Strong communication skills, with a track record of meeting client and internal commitments on time.
* An outstanding academic background and genuine interest in working in a high-tech software development environment.

title: Market Development Manager - Biopharma
description:
**Job Description**
**Shape the Future of Biopharma Innovation in India**
Agilent Technologies is seeking a strategic, customer-focused, and results-driven
**Market Development Manager, Biopharma**
to accelerate growth across one of the world's fastest-growing biopharmaceutical markets.
  
  
India is rapidly emerging as a global hub for biosimilars, biologics, CDMOs, advanced therapeutics, and pharmaceutical innovation. This role provides a unique opportunity to influence industry direction, shape market strategy, build strategic partnerships, and drive business transformation initiatives that create long-term competitive advantage.
  
  
This position sits at the intersection of science, business, and strategy, working closely with customers, industry leaders, academia, government agencies, and cross-functional Agilent teams to identify growth opportunities, execute strategic initiatives, and accelerate market adoption of Agilent's solutions.
  
  
This is a
**single contributor role**
with significant cross-functional influence and accountability for driving outcomes through strong stakeholder engagement, project leadership, and execution discipline.
  
  
**Most importantly, this is an execution-focused role. Success will be measured not by opportunities identified, but by business outcomes delivered. The ideal candidate combines strategic thinking with strong execution discipline, data-driven decision-making, and relentless project follow-through to ensure initiatives translate into measurable impact.**
**Job Description:**
**Drive Market Growth & Strategic Development**

* Identify emerging opportunities across biologics, biosimilars, peptides, oligonucleotides, ADCs, cell and gene therapy, and other advanced therapeutic modalities.
* Develop and execute market development strategies that accelerate revenue growth and expand Agilent's presence across India's biopharma ecosystem.
* Conduct continuous market intelligence gathering, including customer feedback, competitive assessments, market trends, regulatory developments, investment activities, and emerging technologies.
* Develop robust market monitoring processes, dashboards, and reporting mechanisms that enable data-driven decision making.
* Translate market insights into actionable growth initiatives, investment recommendations, and commercial strategies.
* Serve as the voice of the market by identifying unmet customer needs and emerging opportunities before competitors.

**Lead Strategic Collaborations & Partnership Programs**

* Establish and manage strategic collaborations with leading biopharma companies, CDMOs, CROs, research institutions, universities, industry associations, government agencies, and innovation ecosystems.
* Lead collaboration projects from concept through execution, ensuring alignment of objectives, stakeholders, timelines, resources, and expected outcomes.
* Develop collaboration roadmaps and governance structures to maximize business impact.
* Build and maintain relationships with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), scientific leaders, and senior industry decision-makers.
* Convert strategic collaborations into scalable commercial opportunities, customer references, workflow adoption programs, and long-term partnerships.

**Drive Business Transformation & Commercial Innovation**

* Lead strategic business transformation initiatives that improve customer engagement, organizational effectiveness, and growth.
* Evaluate and recommend innovative Go-to-Market (GTM) models that improve customer coverage, workflow adoption, market penetration, and business performance.
* Develop channel strategies, customer segmentation frameworks, territory coverage models, and resource allocation recommendations to maximize growth opportunities.
* Build data-driven investment cases and business proposals that support new growth opportunities, organizational changes, and capability development.
* Partner with leadership teams to design and implement transformative initiatives such as dedicated biopharma channels, workflow-led selling models, partnership ecosystems, and new commercial structures.
* Shape future business strategies by identifying structural gaps and recommending scalable solutions that enhance customer experience and commercial effectiveness.

**Lead Execution & Deliver Results**
This role requires exceptional execution capability and project leadership.
  
  

* Establish clear project objectives, KPIs, milestones, governance mechanisms, and success metrics for strategic initiatives.
* Own project tracking and performance monitoring to ensure initiatives remain on schedule and deliver intended outcomes.
* Drive cross-functional alignment across commercial, marketing, applications, business units, and leadership teams.
* Proactively identify risks, remove obstacles, escalate issues when necessary, and maintain momentum across complex initiatives.
* Hold stakeholders accountable and ensure commitments are translated into action.
* Develop executive updates and progress reviews to provide visibility into project performance and business impact.
* Foster a culture of execution excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement.

**The successful candidate will be known for making things happen. They will relentlessly push initiatives forward, connect strategy to execution, and ensure that projects move beyond discussion and planning into measurable results.**
**Enable Commercial Success**

* Support strategic account planning and opportunity development across key biopharma customers.
* Partner with sales, applications, and marketing teams to accelerate pipeline growth and market adoption.
* Provide market expertise and workflow insights to strengthen customer engagement strategies.
* Champion a One Agilent approach across strategic customer accounts and growth initiatives.

**Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Biochemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemistry, Engineering, Business, or a related discipline.
* 8+ years of experience in biopharma, biotechnology, life sciences, healthcare technology, business development, market development, strategic marketing, consulting, or related fields.
* Strong understanding of India's biopharma ecosystem, including biologics, biosimilars, CDMOs, CROs, and emerging therapeutic modalities.

This role will be a part of the Payments Technology Team which is responsible for delivering the next generation of payments capabilities, including digital wallets, tokenization, and modern payment experiences. The team partners closely with Product Managers, Architects, and Engineering teams to translate product strategy into scalable technical solutions, while also collaborating with Client, Strategy, and Partnership teams to identify new opportunities, shape concepts, and drive strategic integrations that expand Synchrony’s payments ecosystem and drive business growth.
