The release train engineer will also be responsible for driving process improvements for the train with the goal of increased speed to market of new features and capabilities.
  
  
The release train engineer will work across multiple agile teams with the goal of leading innovative payments and banking solutions to production. This role is responsible for collaborating with scrum masters, product owners, Product managers, program manager and business leaders in setting the agile roadmap for this train, driving new innovations, and leading the agile teams to deliver technical capabilities in partnership with other teams within the company.
  
  
The Emerging Payments Agile Release Train is a key part of the digital organization and this role will be responsible for cross train collaboration in planning and managing dependencies across various teams and trains within the company, ensuring that resources are properly aligned and dependencies prioritized across the stakeholder group.
  
  
**You are the right candidate if you…**

* Have strong knowledge of The Scaled Agile Framework and have been on or led an Agile Release Train
* Have a proven track record of leading and executing critical business initiatives
* Are passionate about working with large cross functional teams to deliver cutting edge features to clients
* Have creativity, enthusiasm, and energy with a strong "can do" attitude and are result oriented
* Have superior oral and written communication skills, as well as the ability to manage expectations of the business, clients, team members, management, and external groups

* Have a curiosity driven mindset—ask meaningful questions, challenge ambiguity, and pursue solutions until issues are fully resolved

* Track execution of features and capabilities
* Plan and communicate with business, Technology leadership, and other key stakeholders regarding agile program status, milestones, issue resolution and escalation.
* Manage risks, dependencies and priority or scope changes that are introduced to the ART
* Manage multimillion dollar budget
* Coach leaders and teams in lean agile practices and mindset
* Develop effective communication strategy across projects and constituencies

**Additional Responsibilities: Tech Product Lead (As Needed):**

* Act as Tech Product Lead (as needed) in addition to core RTE responsibilities
* Ensure teams have clarity on outcomes, requirements, and operational readiness for Emerging Payments delivery
* Demonstrate a curiosity driven mindset .ask meaningful questions, validate assumptions with data, remove ambiguity
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Architecture, Risk/Compliance, and Operations to clarify outcomes and drive execution
* Work closely with the Product Manager to translate Emerging Payments problems into technical epics/features

* Bachelor's Degree and 10 years of Technology experience or equivalent leadership program experience or in lieu of degree High School Diploma/GED and 12 years of IT experience, experience in developing and implementing information systems and project management experience

* Excellent organizational skills and ability to collaborate with other team members to achieve cooperative global results
* Self motivated and ability to work independently with minimal direction
* Ability to shepherd multiple concurrent priorities to completion without significant guidance.

This is not a support function. Every person in this pod owns outcomes — revenue, margin, platform health, or market intelligence. If you are commercially driven, data-fluent, and thrive in a fast-moving execution environment, this team is built for you.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Revenue & P&L
* Own and deliver revenue and gross margin targets for an assigned geography or function within the pod
* Track P&L on a weekly and monthly basis — identify gaps early and course-correct with data
* Drive revenue growth through a mix of new user acquisition, base reactivation, and improved margin per transaction
* Identify and unlock new revenue opportunities — brand partnerships, channel monetisation, and promotional levers
* Marketing, Growth & Campaigns
* Plan and execute user acquisition campaigns to drive installs and first-order conversions at efficient CAC
* Own reactivation marketing for lapsed and install-not-transacted user cohorts
* Design and run CRM, push notification, and in-app messaging campaigns to improve repeat purchase frequency
* Execute on-app promotions, deal constructs, offer panels, and sale events — end-to-end, accurately and on time
* Build and manage hyperlocal BTL activation plans tied to regional events, festivals, and seasonal demand peaks
* Promote high-margin SKUs and categories to improve the overall GM profile of the geography
* Market Intelligence & Consumer Insights
* Build and maintain a revenue intelligence framework covering consumer spending patterns, competitive pricing, and category growth
* Lead quantitative research: cohort analysis, pricing elasticity studies, and transactional data mining
* Conduct qualitative research: consumer focus groups, in-depth interviews, and retailer feedback sessions
* Produce competitive intelligence reports — share of wallet, competitor activity, and whitespace opportunities
* Generate data-backed demand signals for new SKUs and assortment decisions
* Platform Health & Fulfilment
* Own platform revenue health KPIs: availability rate, catalogue fill, listing quality, order completion, and RTO
* Identify and plug revenue leakage — stock-outs during campaign periods, broken listings, and fulfilment failures
* Coordinate with Supply Chain and Inventory teams to ensure stock availability ahead of activations
* Escalate platform issues — broken listings, payment failures, checkout drop-offs — with revenue-impact quantification
* Own fulfilment SLAs; work with logistics partners to reduce TAT, RTO, and delivery failures
* Analytics & Reporting
* Maintain a real-time revenue dashboard and weekly health scorecard accessible to the entire pod
* Run weekly sales trend and insights analysis to identify performance gaps and activation opportunities
* Report on key metrics: installs, CAC, reactivation rate, traffic, GM impact, and channel revenue contribution
* Translate complex data into clear, commercially actionable narratives for business decisions

**Who We Are Looking For**
Must Have
  
  

* Engineering degree from a Tier 1/2 institution [IIT (Bombay/ Delhi/ Madras/ Kanpur/ Kharagpur/ Roorkee/ Guwahati/ Hyderabad/ Indore/ Gandhinagar/ Bhubaneswar/ Ropar), BITS Pilani (Pilani/ Goa/ Hyderabad), NIT (Trichy/ Warangal/ Surathkal/ Calicut/ Rourkela), DTU, VIT, NSIT, IIIT (Hyderabad/ Bangalore)]
* 1–3 years of experience in one or more of: revenue management, performance marketing, trade sales, consumer insights, e-commerce operations, or P&L-owning commercial roles
* Strong commercial acumen — ability to connect marketing and operational actions directly to revenue and margin outcomes
* Data fluency: comfortable with Excel, SQL, BI tools (Tableau, Looker, or equivalent), and building dashboards or revenue models
* Experience working cross-functionally across Brand, Supply Chain, Product, and Marketing teams
* Proven track record of execution in a fast-paced, high-accountability environment

Good to Have
  
  

* Prior experience in a geography or zonal business role in e-commerce, Q-commerce, FMCG, or consumer tech
* Exposure to CRM platforms, push notification tools, or on-app promotion management dashboards
* Experience with qualitative research methodologies: FGDs, in-depth interviews, ethnographic observation
* Knowledge of trade economics: margins, sell-through rates, distributor ROI, and channel profitability
* Basic knowledge of Python or R for data processing and analysis
* Proficiency in regional language(s) of the assigned state — advantage for primary research and on-ground activation

**What We Offer**

* Competitive compensation — reviewed based on role level, experience, and fitment
* Direct ownership of business outcomes from Day 1 — revenue, margin, or market intelligence
* Mentorship from senior P&L leaders and a clear pathway to leadership roles
* High-velocity, commercially focused culture built on ownership, experimentation, and speed
* Work at the intersection of marketing, technology, and commerce — in a category with significant growth headroom

title: Senior Product Manager, AI
description:
**Our Company**
At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
In this role, you will serve as a Senior Product Manager for Teradata's vector search and unstructured data capabilities, driving product vision, strategy, roadmap, execution, and adoption. You will define how enterprises turn documents, images, audio, and other unstructured content into searchable, trusted context that AI applications and agents can retrieve at scale, alongside the structured data they already manage in Teradata.
  
  
On the retrieval side, you will own the product direction for vector and hybrid search: indexing and approximate nearest neighbor techniques, filtering, ranking and re-ranking, and the balance between recall, latency, freshness, and cost. You will work with engineering to make vector search a first-class, SQL-native capability that performs at enterprise scale and concurrency, and you will define how relevance and quality are measured, not only how fast queries run.
  
  
On the ingestion side, you will own how unstructured data gets into the platform: connectors to object stores and enterprise content sources, document parsing, OCR, chunking, metadata extraction, embedding generation, and incremental refresh. You will shape pipelines that are reliable, governed, and cost-efficient, with access controls, lineage, and sensitive-data handling that carry through from source to retrieved result.
  
  
Your impact will be measured by customers moving from retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) prototypes to production AI applications and agents that run on trusted enterprise data, with measurable gains in answer quality, time to value, and cost per query.
  
  
**Who You Will Work With**
You will collaborate with customers, engineering, the database engine and SQL teams, AI platform and data science teams, cloud infrastructure, UX, governance and security, product marketing, and field teams to bring next-generation retrieval capabilities into Teradata's enterprise ecosystem. You will be responsible for ensuring our products meet business objectives.
  
  
**What Makes You a Qualified Candidate**

* Bachelor's in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field from a recognized institution. MBA or advanced degree is a plus.
* 6+ years of experience in software product development companies, including 3+ years in product management working with AI/ML, search, or data platform products.
* Strong knowledge of embeddings and vector search, including index types (such as HNSW and IVF), quantization, filtered and hybrid search (keyword plus vector), and re-ranking.
* Working understanding of RAG, LLMs, and AI agents, and how retrieval quality drives answer quality. Experience defining evaluation metrics such as recall, precision, and relevance.
* Understanding of unstructured data ingestion: document parsing, OCR, chunking strategies, multimodal content, metadata extraction, and embedding pipelines, including GPU considerations.
* Experience with data pipelines and connectors on cloud object storage, including batch and incremental or streaming ingestion.
* Experience with APIs, SDKs, and integrations for enterprise and developer adoption, including open ecosystems such as Python, Jupyter, and agent frameworks.
* Familiarity with the competitive landscape, such as Pinecone, Elasticsearch and OpenSearch, pgvector, Snowflake, Databricks, and MongoDB, and the ability to benchmark against it.
* Excellent communication skills, with a strong track record of customer engagement, product KPIs, and prioritization.
* Experience with AI productivity tools, and the ability to work independently and deliver high quality outcomes in fast-paced environments.

**What You Will Bring**

* Experience building search, retrieval, or data ingestion products at scale, with a clear view of the trade-offs between recall, latency, freshness, and cost.
* Hands-on exposure to building RAG applications or agents on structured and unstructured enterprise data.
* A quality mindset: the discipline to build benchmarks and evaluation sets, and to let data decide between approaches.
* A strong understanding of responsible AI, including explainability, auditability, and protection of sensitive data in retrieval.
* Vision to anticipate how agents will use retrieval, and to position Teradata's offerings as differentiated and enterprise-ready.
* Passion for intuitive developer and user experiences, such as natural language search and simple, SQL-friendly interfaces.
* Ability to influence engineering and go-to-market teams without direct authority, and to mentor others.

**Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata**
We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. title: Director, Product Management — Core Database Engine & AI
description:
**Our Company**
At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
In this role, you will lead product strategy and execution for Teradata's core database engine: the massively parallel query engine behind every workload on the platform. You will shape the roadmap across the optimizer, execution runtime, workload management, and Global Planner, and own how the engine performs on native storage, cloud object storage, and open table formats such as Apache Iceberg and Delta Lake.
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of the database engine and AI. AI agents are becoming the dominant consumers of enterprise data, issuing high volumes of exploratory, speculative queries, while GenAI and machine learning can improve the engine from the inside. Every core component needs to be rethought in this light, and you will lead that rethink and turn it into a roadmap engineering can build.
  
  
Two things anchor the role. Performance: you will spend significant time inside real workloads, query plans, and benchmarks, working with engineering to deliver measurable gains release after release. SQL: you will be the steward of Teradata SQL, the surface customers live in, making its syntax, semantics, and ergonomics simpler, more expressive, and safer for developers, analysts, and AI agents.
  
  

* Strategy: Own the engine vision and multi-year roadmap, co-owning architecture direction with senior engineering leaders and making principled trade-offs across performance, cost, and complexity.
* AI and agents: Lead the rethink of every core engine component for AI agents as the new dominant workload, and apply GenAI and ML inside the engine to make it faster and more autonomous.
* Optimizer, execution, and workload management: Agents send many redundant queries. Explore optimizing across queries, sharing intermediate results, and returning early or approximate answers. Apply learned cardinality and cost models and LLM-assisted rewrite, with guardrails that protect plan stability. Define how workload management absorbs bursty machine traffic through agent identity, priorities, and budgets.
* Performance: Work hands-on with engineering on query plans, regressions, and bottlenecks. Own the benchmark suite and KPIs (latency, concurrency, plan stability, price-performance), including agentic workloads, and build regression gates into releases.
* Open Table formats: Own the engine side of Iceberg and Delta Lake (scan planning, pruning, pushdown, write paths) so customers never trade performance for openness. Automate statistics, clustering, and compaction with AI.
* SQL language and query interface: Design features that turn complex problems into simple, readable queries, reduce footguns while keeping power and backward compatibility, and stay aligned with ANSI SQL. Make the dialect something agents can safely generate and execute, and let agents steer with cost estimates, plan explanations, and hints.

**Who You'll Work With**
You will work with senior database engineering leaders, performance engineering, AI platform teams, the open table format product team, sales engineering, and executive leadership across the US, Europe, and India. This role starts as an individual contributor, leading through technical depth and influence and mentoring Staff-level PMs. It may grow into managing a team of product managers.
  
  
What Makes You a Qualified Candidate
  
  

* 15+ years in databases, query engines, or distributed data systems, including senior product management or equivalent principal or staff engineering experience
* Expert understanding of database internals: query planning, cost-based optimization, execution models, and MPP trade-offs
* Deep SQL expertise: a heavy SQL user (data engineer, analyst, or DBA) with strong opinions on language design, ergonomics, and compatibility
* A hands-on performance mindset: reading query plans, designing benchmarks, and finding root causes with senior engineers
* A strong working understanding of LLMs and AI agents, and an informed view on how they change database design and how ML can improve database internals
* Architecture-level knowledge of Snowflake, Databricks, and ClickHouse, and fluency in lakehouse architecture and open table formats
* Degree in Computer Science or a related field; an MS or PhD in databases, distributed systems, or ML for systems is a plus

**What You'll Bring**

* First-principles thinking and good taste: willingness to question long-standing database assumptions, a preference for elegance over verbosity, customer obsession, daily use of GenAI tools, and the credibility to earn the trust of senior engineers
* The ability to read research critically, separate promise from hype, and design experiments to prove value, with a track record of setting multi-year platform strategy
* A plus: experience designing SQL features or language extensions, hands-on work with optimizers or learned database components, open-source contributions, or publications at SIGMOD, VLDB, or CIDR

title: Clinical Informatics Lead
description:
**Clinical Informatics Lead (Physician): EMR Strategy & Clinical Systems**

**Apollo Home Healthcare | Hyderabad | Full-time or part-time / fractional**

**About the role**

Apollo Home Healthcare is building a modern, technology-led home care platform. We need a physician who understands both clinical practice and health technology to shape our EMR: defining what clinical data we capture, how care is documented and escalated, and which EMR platform and architecture will serve us today and as we scale. You will be the clinical authority in our technology decisions, working directly with senior leadership, product, and engineering.

**Engagement options**

We are open to either, depending on the right person:

• Full-time: a permanent leadership role owning clinical informatics across the product suite.

• Part-time / fractional: a retainer of about 10-15 hours a week for an initial 3-6 months, with the option to extend or convert.

Remote, hybrid, or Hyderabad-based arrangements can be discussed.

What you will do

• Define the clinical data model for home care: visits, vitals and device data, medication reconciliation, assessments, care plans, handovers, and consent.

• Evaluate and select the EMR: lead build-vs-buy analysis, assessing FHIR-native and open-source platforms against commercial options for fit, extensibility, and long-term scalability.

• Write clinical requirements and safety rules: alert thresholds, red-flag escalation pathways, documentation standards, and order/protocol templates.

• Be the clinical voice in product and engineering: review designs and workflows and prioritise what is clinically essential versus noise.

• Validate with the field: run user testing with nurses, doctors, and caregivers, and turn feedback into product changes.

• Own clinical governance: safety sign-off, audit trails, data privacy (DPDP), ABDM alignment, and relevant NMC and telemedicine compliance.

• Build clinical content and train teams on documentation standards and system use.

**What we are looking for**

Must have

• MBBS (or higher) with an active medical registration in India.

• Clinical experience in internal medicine, family medicine, geriatrics, palliative care, critical care, or a related field. Home care exposure is a strong plus.

• Hands-on experience implementing, configuring, or building an EMR/EHR as a clinical owner, not only as an end user.

• Working knowledge of health data standards: FHIR/HL7, ICD-10, SNOMED CT, LOINC.

• Ability to work with engineers and product managers and translate clinical needs into clear requirements.

• Strong judgement and communication with both clinicians and senior leadership.

Good to have

• Formal training in clinical or health informatics (e.g. AMIA, MSc, or fellowship).

• Familiarity with ABDM (ABHA, HIP/HIU, consent manager).

• Experience with remote patient monitoring, device integration, or telehealth.

• Experience at a health-tech startup or a hospital digital team.

• Exposure to open-source EMRs (Medplum, OpenMRS, Bahmni) or commercial platforms.

How you will be measured

• First 30 days: clinical requirements and home care data model drafted and reviewed.

• First 60 days: shortlist of EMR options evaluated against clear criteria, with a recommendation.

• First 90 days: platform decision made, clinical workflows validated with frontline staff, and safety/governance framework in place.

What we offer

• A senior, high-impact role shaping clinical technology from the ground up.

• Direct access to leadership and real influence on product direction.

Please write to hr@apollohomecare.com, with your CV attached.

title: Agentic AI Transformations
description:
**About The Role**
This is a high-impact, hybrid role designed for a "technical operator." You aren't just strategizing about AI; you are building it and ensuring it sticks. Reporting directly to the
**Head of Agentic Transformation**
, you will bridge the gap between business strategy and production-ready automation.
  
  
As the
**Lead Agentic AI Solutions Manager**
, you will own the entire lifecycle of transformation: from mapping messy human processes and scoping automation briefs to writing the code, connecting the APIs, and training teams to adopt their new "AI colleagues." If you are a builder who loves seeing your work run in production and a strategist who cares about the human impact of technology, this role is for you.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Architecture, Build & Deployment
* Design & Ship Agents: Build production-ready agentic workflows using tools like LangChain, LangGraph, n8n, or Make across Finance, HR, and AdOps.
* LLM Engineering: Develop natural language query interfaces, intelligent routing agents, and RAG-powered document processing pipelines.
* Technical Integration: Own the API layer (REST, webhooks, JSON, OAuth) between business systems like CRMs, HR platforms, and Ad Servers.
* Prototyping: Rapidly move from a "whiteboard concept" to a "minimum viable agent," testing with real users and iterating based on performance.
* Process Discovery & Scoping
* Process Mapping: Audit current workflows to identify bottlenecks, manual data entry points, and high-value automation opportunities.
* Strategic Prioritization: Maintain and sequence a backlog of transformation initiatives based on ROI, time-savings, and technical feasibility.
* Briefing: Translate complex business pain points into clear technical specifications with defined edge cases and success criteria.
* Change Management & Adoption
* Make it Stick: Own the "human side" of deployment—conducting training sessions, writing user guides, and providing hands-on support during transitions.
* Relationship Building: Work closely with team leads to handle resistance and ensure that automated tools are actually utilized by the workforce.
* Governance & Reliability: Set up observability (logging, alerting) and write runbooks so that automations are maintainable and compliant (GDPR/Data Privacy).
* Specialized AdOps Automation
* Campaign Lifecycle: Automate pacing alerts, budget tracking, and delivery discrepancy resolution to reduce manual overhead in media operations.
* Reporting Sync: Build automated data pipelines between DSPs/SSPs and internal reporting tools to eliminate manual data reconciliation.

**What You’ll Need**
**Must-Have Experience**

* 4–7 years in technical automation, AI engineering, or business transformation delivery.
* Hands-on AI Delivery: Proven experience building and deploying LLM-powered tools or agents in a production environment (not just toy projects).
* Technical Stack: Proficiency in Python or JavaScript for custom scripting and mastery of at least one automation platform (n8n, Make, LangChain).
* The Integration Mindset: Comfortable connecting systems that "aren't designed to talk to each other" using APIs and webhooks.
* Operational Excellence: Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to move a project forward independently from spec to live status.

**Information Security & ISO 27001 Compliance**
Security is at the heart of everything we do. In this role, you will be strictly required to uphold our Information Security Management System (ISMS) policies in alignment with
**ISO/IEC 27001**
standards. Responsibilities include safeguarding sensitive asset data, completing mandatory security awareness training, reporting potential security incidents or vulnerabilities immediately, and ensuring that daily operations comply with our rigorous data protection protocols.

description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Specialist Manager, Technical Project and Program Management**
As a program manager in the Deloitte Technology-US (DT-US) Office of the CIO (OCIO) PMO team, you will play a key role in leveraging leading program and project management practices and methodologies to enable world-class delivery of our major internal technology programs.
  
  
The DT-US PMO team is part of the Office of CIO (OCIO) and reports to the US OCIO Leader. The OCIO leads the development and implementation for technology strategy at Deloitte and drives the strategic initiatives to build market leading technology capabilities. DT-US powers IT for Deloitte’s 175K+ professionals while supporting business priorities and transformational initiatives in areas such as AI, Cloud, and Cyber.
  
  
**Work you’ll do**
As a DT-US Manager, you will work directly with the DT-US PMO FSS or Enterprise Solutions Leads to leverage leading practices used within the Deloitte Businesses and/or industry to drive successful technology implementations. Specifically, you will proactively incorporate those leading practices into our evolving methodologies, tools, templates, processes, and organizational thinking for how we should manage and lead strategic technology implementations for continuous improvements. Additionally, you will support efforts to drive consistency throughout our DT-US organization in how we implement and deliver our technology programs and projects.
  
  
You will also manage the end-to-end project lifecycle for large and complex projects/programs in one or more of the DT-US project portfolios. You will lead and coordinate project/program team resources to ensure project/program milestones are met and the project/program is delivered on schedule and on budget with the highest standard of quality. You will also manage project/program risk identification and resolution to keep projects/programs on track and able to deliver planned outcomes. As the DT-US PMO Manager, you will be expected to build and demonstrate a strong competency and business knowledge of assigned initiatives. You may have responsibility for managing day-to-day activities of other PMO team members as well as providing coaching and performance feedback.
  
  
**Responsibilities include:**

* Drives cross-functional teams in the delivery of high-risk, complex programs/projects
* Leads program/project issue/risk management, remediation plans, and escalations across channels, studios/service areas for projects within assigned programs - responsible for providing management direction in these areas and ensuring clear communication, consideration of all factors, generation of solution alternatives, and defined actionable plans.
* Lead and manage a diverse range of IT projects including software development, infrastructure upgrades, cloud migrations, system integrations, and data migrations while ensuring timely delivery, budget adherence, and high-quality outcomes.
* Develops and demonstrates strong business knowledge of the assigned business units/portfolios/products
* Works with all stakeholders to identify and confirm necessary project and program resources throughout the project lifecycle and resolves resource availability conflicts across the program
* Builds detailed program/project master schedules and promotes collaboration through identified team sites
* Oversee the activities of other PMO junior resources and offshore teams to ensure delivery of timely solutions.
* Conducts ongoing examination of projects within the program for compliance with established processes, project plans/schedules and budgets, influencing decisions on resource utilization and allocation at key project lifecycle decision points.
* Maintains oversight and accountability for program performance including creation/review of key project delivery metrics across projects within the program.
* Prepares and delivers regular, audience-specific communications/reports/dashboards to ensure that program sponsors, key stakeholders, CIO advisors and leadership are adequately apprised of program and project statuses, successes, risks and issues.
* Manages and tracks project/program budget/variance and takes corrective actions.
* Proposes changes to project methodologies, frameworks, and promotes best practices for continuous process improvement.
* Motivates and leads teams and fosters a mindset of collaboration and continuous process improvement.
* Accountable for all applicable PMO related processes and methodologies and their proper and consistent execution on all projects

**Required Qualifications:**

* 10+ years of relevant experience in Project/Program Management working on large, complex, cross-functional IT initiatives utilizing a structured project management methodology and formal tools/approaches (PMBOK, Prince2, etc)
* 3+ years of experience managing full lifecycle Agile projects including overseeing the strategy / business case development, developing the implementation plan to support the business case, and driving the implementation of the plan to deliver the final program objectives
* 1+ year of people management experience overseeing and mentoring numerous other PMs, Project Coordinators, etc.
* 3+ years of project / program financial management (e.g., Planning, Forecasting, Budgeting, Business Case Development, etc.) in addition to experience in planning, estimation, resource management, project tracking, scope control, risk and issues management as well as stakeholder relationship management.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Business Administration or equivalent educational
* This role would require professional to work from Deloitte Office – Hyderabad office as per business policy.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* MBA or equivalent graduate degree preferred
* Hands on experience with Azure DevOps (ADO)
* Minimum 2 years of experience managing projects/programs in ServiceNow
* Minimum of 1 year of experience in a matrixed professional services firm OR consulting
* Strategic and critical thinker with the ability to make connections across workstreams and Deloitte’s matrixed organizations
* Excellent written and verbal communications skills and strong executive presence. Must be able to analyze, understand, and communicate complex ideas across varied audiences, including senior Deloitte Partners, Principals, and Managing Director leaders
* Experience with strategy / business case development, then developing the implementation plan to support the business case, and driving the implementation of the plan to deliver the final program objectives
* Strong commitment to professional client service excellence
* Empowered self-starter comfortable to take the lead and managing multiple initiatives with an ability to effectively collaborate across teams
* Proven success at mentoring and leading teams that are focused on exceptional client service and can manage risk remotely/virtually
* Excellent interpersonal relations and demonstrated ability to work with others effectively in teams
* Prior experience in or working for Executive Leaders and their respective offices/leadership teams
* Prior experience with IT Financial management methodologies and disciplines
* Comfort with ambiguity and the ability to logically structure issues and determine recommended resolutions
* Detail-oriented with ability to plan, prioritize, and make decisions on multiple time-sensitive projects
* Strong commitment to integrity
* Strong knowledge of leading-edge project management methodologies
* Understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)
* Strong MS PowerPoint skills with proven record to create high impact audience-specific presentations.
* Proficient in MS Project / MS Project Server (or similar applications)

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

title: Manager - Transformation & Innovation
description:
**General Position Information**
Reports directly to (Title): Sr. Manager of HR Transformation & Analytics
  
  
Matrix reports to (Title): AVP of HR Transformation
  
  
Direct Reports: People manager; Product analysts, business analysts, software engineers
  
  
Created / Last Revised: -
  
  
Job Code: -
  
  
**Position Summary**
The Manager - Transformations & Innovation leads a team focused on designing and delivering digital HR products, intelligent workflows, and innovation solutions that reduce administrative work and improve the way HR services are delivered. Reporting to the Senior Manager of HR Transformation & Analytics, with dotted-line alignment to the AVP of HR Transformation, this role partners across HR, HRG business teams, technology, operations, analytics, and delivery partners to translate transformation priorities into scalable products and practical workflow improvements.
  
  
This role is accountable for value creation, not simply project execution. The manager helps identify high-friction HR processes, define future-state experiences, shape product and automation roadmaps, and guide implementation of AI-enabled tools and digital capabilities that improve speed, quality, consistency, and employee experience. Success requires strong transformation leadership, product orientation, process design discipline, stakeholder management, and the ability to turn ambiguous business needs into measurable outcomes.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Digital Product & Innovation Delivery**

* Lead the design and delivery of HR digital products, workflow solutions, and innovation capabilities that simplify HR work and improve user experience.
* Partner with HR Transformation leadership to translate strategic priorities into product roadmaps, use cases, delivery plans, success measures, and adoption plans.
* Guide teams through product discovery, requirements shaping, solution design, implementation support, testing, launch readiness, and post-launch improvement.
* Ensure digital products are built around clear business problems, defined users, measurable outcomes, and sustainable operating models.

**Intelligent Workflow & Process Transformation**

* Assess HR processes to identify administrative burden, manual handoffs, rework, cycle-time delays, control gaps, and opportunities for standardization or automation.
* Design future-state workflows that combine people, process, technology, automation, analytics, and AI tools in a practical and governed way.
* Partner with business analysts, product analysts, process engineers, software developers, data teams, and operations leaders to convert workflow designs into implementable solutions.
* Establish reusable design patterns, intake methods, process maps, decision flows, and documentation standards for transformation initiatives.

**AI Tools, Automation & Productivity Improvement**

* Identify opportunities to use AI tools, automation, digital assistants, workflow orchestration, and self-service capabilities to reduce administrative work and improve service delivery.
* Ensure AI-enabled and automated solutions are human-reviewed, explainable, secure, and aligned to HR data privacy, compliance, and responsible AI expectations.
* Partner with technology and analytics teams to evaluate, pilot, implement, and scale AI-enabled products that improve HR productivity and decision support.
* Measure productivity gains, time saved, quality improvements, adoption, and user satisfaction associated with digital and AI-enabled solutions.

**Stakeholder Partnership & Change Enablement**

* Partner with HRG business teams, HR centers of excellence, HR operations, technology, analytics, and delivery teams to clarify needs, align priorities, and manage dependencies.
* Communicate transformation goals, product value, risks, tradeoffs, and decisions clearly to operational leaders and senior stakeholders.
* Support change readiness through stakeholder engagement, communication input, training support, adoption tracking, and feedback loops.
* Build trust with partners by balancing innovation with operational feasibility, governance, user experience, and measurable business value.

**Team Leadership, Governance & Continuous Improvement**

* Manage, coach, and develop HR Transformation & Innovation Partners or related contributors responsible for discovery, process design, product coordination, documentation, and implementation support.
* Set expectations for quality, documentation, stakeholder management, delivery discipline, and value realization across assigned transformation work.
* Maintain portfolio visibility across initiatives, including status, dependencies, risks, issues, outcomes, and benefits realization.
* Promote a culture of innovation, simplification, responsible experimentation, customer focus, and continuous improvement.

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, Information Systems, Analytics, Operations, Organizational Development, Industrial Engineering, or a related field; equivalent experience may be considered.
* Typically 8+ years of experience in HR transformation, digital product delivery, HR operations, HR technology, process improvement, business analysis, product management, or a related environment.
* Experience leading teams or matrixed contributors through complex transformation, workflow redesign, automation, or digital enablement initiatives.
* Experience partnering with HR, technology, operations, analytics, and business stakeholders to define requirements, implement solutions, and measure adoption or value realization.
* Experience using AI tools, automation, digital workflow tools, or analytics-enabled products to improve productivity, service delivery, or user experience.

**Must Have Skills**

* Strong HR transformation and product delivery mindset, with the ability to connect business problems to digital products, workflows, and measurable outcomes.
* Strong process design skills, including current-state assessment, future-state workflow design, business rules, handoffs, controls, and exception paths.
* Demonstrated ability to reduce administrative work through simplification, automation, self-service, AI-enabled tools, workflow redesign, or digital product adoption.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to align HR, business, technology, analytics, and operations partners in a matrixed environment.
* Strong communication and facilitation skills, including the ability to translate complex transformation concepts into clear decisions, plans, and actions.
* Ability to manage multiple initiatives, prioritize competing work, track risks and dependencies, and drive follow-through with quality and accountability.
* Working knowledge of HR systems, workflow tools, analytics products, AI tools, and digital enablement approaches sufficient to guide product and process decisions.

**Nice To Have Skills**

* Experience implementing or supporting ERP, HRIS, or enterprise workflow products such as Workday, Oracle, SAP SuccessFactors, PeopleSoft, ServiceNow, or similar platforms.
* Experience with product management, agile delivery, design thinking, Lean/Six Sigma, human-centered design, or transformation operating models.
* Experience in healthcare, shared services, global capability centers, or highly regulated environments.
* Experience with AI-enabled productivity tools, digital assistants, process mining, robotic process automation, workflow orchestration, or self-service portals.
* Certifications in project management, agile, product management, process improvement, change management, HR technology, or related disciplines.

**Licenses, Certifications & Training**
Not separately specified in the source job description.
  
  
**Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, Behaviors**

* Demonstrates curiosity, innovation orientation, sound judgment, and business ownership when assessing transformation opportunities.
* Operates as a value creator, not only a project coordinator; focuses teams on business outcomes, adoption, productivity improvement, and measurable impact.
* Challenges complexity and seeks opportunities to simplify work, reduce manual effort, and improve the employee and HR user experience.
* Builds trust across HR, business, technology, analytics, and operations partners while navigating ambiguity and competing priorities.
* Communicates with clarity and executive presence, including status, risks, tradeoffs, recommendations, and outcomes.
* Promotes responsible use of AI and automation, including human review, documentation, privacy, security, and appropriate governance.
* Develops talent by coaching team members in product thinking, process design, AI-forward skills, stakeholder management, and transformation delivery discipline.
* Handles confidential HR information appropriately and upholds ethical standards in day-to-day work.

title: Senior. Specialist, Data Enablement Lead (Supply Chain, Manufacturing focus
description:
**Job Description**
***Senior. Specialist***
***, Data Enablement Lead (Supply Chain, Manufacturing focus)***
***The Opportunity***

* Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130-year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.
* Be part of an organisation driven by digital technology and data-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products.
* Drive innovation and execution excellence. Join a team that is passionate about using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision-making and create custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the world's greatest health threats.

Our Technology Centres focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our company's IT operating model, Tech Centres are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
  
  
A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in the growth, success, and well-being of our people to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging, to managing critical emergencies. Together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centres
*.*
**Role Overview**
The Senior Specialist – Data Enablement Lead is accountable for enabling trusted, governed, reusable, and AI‑ready data products across Animal Health by providing standards, methods, platforms, guardrails, and enablement — while data ownership remains with Value Teams.
  
  
Operating within the Architecture, Integration, Data Engineering & Data Enablement (AIDE) organization, this role partners closely with Value Teams, platform teams, analytics and AI teams, and enterprise governance bodies to embed data enablement capabilities into business domains.
  
  
Working in a matrixed, domain‑centric environment, the Data Enablement Lead acts as a product manager for data enablement, translating governance and platform capabilities into scalable, consumable outcomes that accelerate business value, analytics, and AI adoption.
  
  
**What Will You Do**

* Define and drive the Data Enablement strategy for assigned data domains, aligned with Value Teams, Animal Health Data Platform and One Data Program objectives.
* Establish and enforce data enablement standards, guardrails, and design principles covering data quality, metadata, lineage, access, privacy, and AI readiness.
* Act as the AIDE liaison to Value Teams, co‑designing domain data products while maintaining clear separation between enablement and ownership.
* Enable self‑service data capabilities with guardrails, in collaboration with platforms, engineering, and security teams.
* Own and evolve data enablement roadmaps, prioritizing capabilities based on domain needs, adoption, and business value.
* Ensure data products are discoverable, trusted, reusable, and fit for advanced analytics and GenAI use cases.
* Partner with analytics, AI, and data science teams to ensure data enablement supports current and future AI needs.
* Define and track product‑style metrics (adoption, data quality, time‑to‑delivery, consumer satisfaction).
* Support domain governance councils, escalation paths, and cross‑domain alignment.

**Your Daily Activities include, but are not limited to**

* Management Lead the design and implementation of scalable, compliant data enablement capabilities aligned with business priorities. Support leadership vision and strategy for a federated, domain‑centric data operating model.
* Process and Insight Translate governance and platform capabilities into repeatable enablement processes. Promote data‑driven decision‑making using metrics and insights from enablement outcomes.
* Product & Delivery Operate with a data‑as‑a‑product mindset, managing enablement backlogs, roadmaps, and lifecycle evolution. Deliver incrementally using agile ways of working.
* Relationships Build trusted partnerships with Value Teams, platform teams, analytics teams, and enterprise governance stakeholders. Influence without assuming data ownership.
* Organizational Change Management Drive behavioral and cultural change toward reuse, self‑service, and product thinking. Act as a role model for modern data enablement and product leadership practices.
* Global & Enterprise Alignment Ensure enablement approaches align with enterprise standards, platforms, and governance frameworks. Coordinate with central data and analytics organizations to avoid duplication and misalignment.
* Diversity & Inclusion Respect and value diverse perspectives, fostering an inclusive and collaborative team environment

**What Should You Have**

* 5+ years of experience in data enablement, data governance, data management, analytics, or related data domains.
* Proven experience working in domain‑centric or product‑oriented data models.
* Strong background in data governance, data quality, metadata management, lineage, access control, and compliance.
* 2-3 years of proficiency in using Collibra Data Catalog for data governance activities.
* Expertise in metadata management and implementing metadata cataloging processes.
* Proven experience in supporting the design and implementation of data governance frameworks, policies, and procedures.
* Experience partnering with business/value teams without owning data assets.
* Demonstrated ability to define and operate data products or enablement capabilities using product management principles.
* Exposure to advanced analytics, AI, or GenAI use cases, with understanding of what makes data AI‑ready.
* Experience working in complex, global, matrixed organizations.

**Additional Skills**

* Experience working with Supply Chain, Manufacturing and Shopfloor data domains, such as

+ Supply Chain (Planning, Inventory, Logistics & Distribution)
+ Manufacturing (Production Execution, Maintenance)
+ Quality (Compliance, Quality Control)

* Familiarity with supply chain & manufacturing business processes (e.g., Production Execution, Demand Planning, Inventory Management, Manufacturing Intelligence) and how data enables decision‑making in these areas.
* Experience with Data Quality and EDAC solutions like Collibra Data Quality and Immuta.
* Experience partnering with Manufacturing or Supply Chain Value Teams to enable data products while maintaining clear separation between data ownership and enablement.
* Strong product mindset roadmapping, prioritization, consumer focus, outcome measurement.
* Agile delivery experience (Product Owner, Scrum, or equivalent).
* Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills.
* Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, actionable guidance.
* Proven self‑starter with high standards of excellence and continuous improvement mindset.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to engage at all organizational levels.
* Ability to navigate cross‑domain and cross‑functional dependencies.

Team‑oriented leader who values collaboration, inclusion, and collective success.
  
  
***Primary Skills***

*Supply chain Management, Manufacturing Management, Data Governance, Data Management, Metadata Management, Colibra data catalog.*
***Secondary Skills***
*Product Management, Stakeholder Management, Agile, GxP*
**What We Look For**
*Imagine getting up in the morning for a job as important as helping to save and improve lives around the world. Here, you have that opportunity. You can put your empathy, creativity, digital mastery, or scientific genius to work in collaboration with a diverse group of colleagues who pursue and bring hope to countless people who are battling some of the most challenging diseases of our time. Our team is constantly evolving, so if you are among the intellectually curious, join us—and start making your impact today.*
**Required Skills**
Data Management, Governance Management, Privacy Compliance, Quality Management, Technical Advice, Waterfall Model

Works with business leaders to define scope and requirements, and plans and executes the development of various systems. Acts as liaison with business sponsors and principals.
  
  
**About Vanguard**
Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe—directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries.
  
  
**Vanguard India**
Vanguard’s office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world-class experience for our clients.
  
  
**Role Summary**
The Manager, IT Delivery role manages and leads a team of technical support staff who design, develop, test, implement, and monitor software and tools; works with business leaders to define scope and requirements, and plans and executes the development of various systems; and acts as liaison with business sponsors and principals, while leading cross-functional teams, managing project risks and resources, and integrating cybersecurity best practices to ensure secure and successful project delivery.
  
  
**Responsibilites**

* Hires, evaluates, and supervises crew. Provides guidance and training as necessary to develop crew. Sets performance standards, reviews performance, and makes informed compensation decisions in accordance with all applicable Human Resources policies and procedures.
* Responsible for delivering software releases relating to the product for the business units. Works with business clients to determine scope, and develops environmental requirements for each project.
* Works closely with management to develop and implement staffing and operational plans. Participates in the development of short and long term department goals. Monitors and reports on service delivery metrics and overall performance.
* Develops and implements changes to department policies and procedures to meet changing business needs and to achieve department objectives. Identifies opportunities for continuous improvement.
* Leads quality initiatives to improve the delivery of service levels. Works with senior management in the planning, development, and execution of short and long range goals.
* Presents status, metrics, and department initiatives at meetings with management and project peers. Maintains relationships with technical teams, IT, and business partners.
* Participates in the development of the department budget. Reviews expenses and ensures department operates within budgetary guidelines.
* Ensures staff complies with information technology and information security policies and procedures, and verifies that deliverables meet requirements.
* Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned.
* Lead cross-functional teams, fostering collaboration and effectively communicating project progress and updates to stakeholders.
* Identify potential risks throughout the project lifecycle and implement strategies to mitigate them, ensuring smooth project delivery.
* Develop comprehensive project plans, set timelines, allocate resources efficiently, and manage budgets to ensure successful project delivery.
* Enhance cybersecurity frameworks by integrating advanced security measures and best practices into IT projects to safeguard company data and assets.

**Qualifications And Skills**

* Minimum 8 years of experience in IT project management, software development, or IT service delivery. Previous leadership experience required.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field. PMP, ITIL, or Agile certifications preferred.
* Mid-Level Developer understanding and hand-ons experience with Java/Python, AWS Services, CI/CD Pipelines (Github, Bitbucket, Bamboo) TDD/BDD practices
* User level understanding of Splunk, Honeycomb, Cloud Watch, Open Telemetry; Understands observability concepts
* Well versed in Confluence, JIRA
* Ability to leverage AI-assisted engineering Tools (Claude Code, Github CoPilot) effectively to improve the software development process. Ability to mentor/coach others on the team on the effective use of AI Tools
* High Level understanding of automated testing concepts
* Previous people leadership experience. Ability to lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers. Ability to set clear performance expectations, provides ongoing feedback, and supports career growth.
* Demonstrated ability to drive delivery outcomes and implement strategic platform initiatives.
* Strong expertise in IT project management, Agile methodologies, and SDLC best practices with experience in software development and enterprise IT solutions.
* Strong problem-solving skills and experience working with cross-functional teams and managing stakeholders.
* Strong expertise in IT project management, Agile methodologies, and SDLC best practices with experience in IT infrastructure, software development, and enterprise IT solutions.
* Must have skills: Node.js, TypeScript, ECS, Kubernetes,Kore.AI, Android, iOS development
* Proficiency in risk management, budgeting, and IT governance. Understanding of cybersecurity frameworks and IT compliance standards.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

**Location**
This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard India. Only qualified external applicants will be considered.
  
  
**Our mission**
Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success.
  
  
**Our commitment to you**
Vanguard takes the same long-term view of your success—at work and in life—with Benefits and Rewards packages that reflect what you care about, throughout all the phases and stages of your life. Our Total Rewards programs provide you and your loved ones with wellness support for key areas in your life:
  
  
**Financial wellness**
We're committed to enabling your financial success and provide competitive offers and programs.
  
  
**Physical wellness**
We're committed to providing benefits that support your physical health and wellness.
  
  
**Personal wellness**
We're committed to providing resources that help support the full scope of your life.
  
  
**How We Work**
Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for most of our employees (crew members), designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

title: Assistant Manager – Revenue (Hyderabad)
description:
**About The Team**
We are building a high-performance Revenue & Marketing pod — a geography-focused business unit that owns end-to-end top-line and bottom-line delivery for an assigned state or cluster. The pod operates like an autonomous business unit: defining local strategy, executing marketing and growth plans, running platform operations, and generating the consumer insights that drive every commercial decision.
  
  
This is not a support function. Every person in this pod owns outcomes — revenue, margin, platform health, or market intelligence. If you are commercially driven, data-fluent, and thrive in a fast-moving execution environment, this team is built for you.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Revenue & P&L
* Own and deliver revenue and gross margin targets for an assigned geography or function within the pod
* Track P&L on a weekly and monthly basis — identify gaps early and course-correct with data
* Drive revenue growth through a mix of new user acquisition, base reactivation, and improved margin per transaction
* Identify and unlock new revenue opportunities — brand partnerships, channel monetisation, and promotional levers
* Marketing, Growth & Campaigns
* Plan and execute user acquisition campaigns to drive installs and first-order conversions at efficient CAC
* Own reactivation marketing for lapsed and install-not-transacted user cohorts
* Design and run CRM, push notification, and in-app messaging campaigns to improve repeat purchase frequency
* Execute on-app promotions, deal constructs, offer panels, and sale events — end-to-end, accurately and on time
* Build and manage hyperlocal BTL activation plans tied to regional events, festivals, and seasonal demand peaks
* Promote high-margin SKUs and categories to improve the overall GM profile of the geography
* Market Intelligence & Consumer Insights
* Build and maintain a revenue intelligence framework covering consumer spending patterns, competitive pricing, and category growth
* Lead quantitative research: cohort analysis, pricing elasticity studies, and transactional data mining
* Conduct qualitative research: consumer focus groups, in-depth interviews, and retailer feedback sessions
* Produce competitive intelligence reports — share of wallet, competitor activity, and whitespace opportunities
* Generate data-backed demand signals for new SKUs and assortment decisions
* Platform Health & Fulfilment
* Own platform revenue health KPIs: availability rate, catalogue fill, listing quality, order completion, and RTO
* Identify and plug revenue leakage — stock-outs during campaign periods, broken listings, and fulfilment failures
* Coordinate with Supply Chain and Inventory teams to ensure stock availability ahead of activations
* Escalate platform issues — broken listings, payment failures, checkout drop-offs — with revenue-impact quantification
* Own fulfilment SLAs; work with logistics partners to reduce TAT, RTO, and delivery failures
* Analytics & Reporting
* Maintain a real-time revenue dashboard and weekly health scorecard accessible to the entire pod
* Run weekly sales trend and insights analysis to identify performance gaps and activation opportunities
* Report on key metrics: installs, CAC, reactivation rate, traffic, GM impact, and channel revenue contribution
* Translate complex data into clear, commercially actionable narratives for business decisions

**Who We Are Looking For**
Must Have
  
  

* Engineering degree from a Tier 1/2 institution [IIT (Bombay/ Delhi/ Madras/ Kanpur/ Kharagpur/ Roorkee/ Guwahati/ Hyderabad/ Indore/ Gandhinagar/ Bhubaneswar/ Ropar), BITS Pilani (Pilani/ Goa/ Hyderabad), NIT (Trichy/ Warangal/ Surathkal/ Calicut/ Rourkela), DTU, VIT, NSIT, IIIT (Hyderabad/ Bangalore)]
* 2–6 years of experience in one or more of: revenue management, performance marketing, trade sales, consumer insights, e-commerce operations, or P&L-owning commercial roles
* Strong commercial acumen — ability to connect marketing and operational actions directly to revenue and margin outcomes
* Data fluency: comfortable with Excel, SQL, BI tools (Tableau, Looker, or equivalent), and building dashboards or revenue models
* Experience working cross-functionally across Brand, Supply Chain, Product, and Marketing teams
* Proven track record of execution in a fast-paced, high-accountability environment

Good to Have
  
  

* Prior experience in a geography or zonal business role in e-commerce, Q-commerce, FMCG, or consumer tech
* Exposure to CRM platforms, push notification tools, or on-app promotion management dashboards
* Experience with qualitative research methodologies: FGDs, in-depth interviews, ethnographic observation
* Knowledge of trade economics: margins, sell-through rates, distributor ROI, and channel profitability
* Basic knowledge of Python or R for data processing and analysis
* Proficiency in regional language(s) of the assigned state — advantage for primary research and on-ground activation

**What We Offer**

* Competitive compensation — reviewed based on role level, experience, and fitment
* Direct ownership of business outcomes from Day 1 — revenue, margin, or market intelligence
* Mentorship from senior P&L leaders and a clear pathway to leadership roles
* High-velocity, commercially focused culture built on ownership, experimentation, and speed
* Work at the intersection of marketing, technology, and commerce — in a category with significant growth headroom

title: Director, Software Engineering & Site Leader
description:
**Overview**
This is a dual-mandate leadership role at one of Quest Software's most strategic engineering locations. You will have full engineering leadership responsibility for a product within Quest's data management portfolio while serving as Site Leader for our Hyderabad development center of approximately 150 employees.
  
  
**The Priorities Are Clear**

* Development Management : Deliver exceptional product outcomes through high-quality engineering execution.
* Site Leadership : Grow Hyderabad's capability, culture, and strategic importance within Quest.
* A third, critical responsibility cuts across both mandates: leading the Hyderabad organization toward an AI-first software delivery model , transforming how engineering teams design, build, test, and deliver software.

**Responsibilities**
**Priority 1: Development Management**
You will lead a Hyderabad-based engineering organization responsible for a product within Quest's data management portfolio.
  
  
**Delivery & Execution**

* Own end-to-end product delivery, including roadmap execution, release commitments, quality, security, performance, and supportability.
* Translate product strategy into achievable engineering plans and ensure predictable execution.
* Partner with architects and senior engineers on key technical and architectural decisions.
* Balance innovation with operational excellence, including technical debt, supportability, and customer-reported issues.
* Communicate delivery status, risks, and dependencies effectively to senior leadership.

**Customer & Business Partnership**

* Partner closely with Product Management and go-to-market teams on customer engagements, evaluations, and proofs of concept.
* Bring customer insights into product planning and prioritization.
* Support Sales, Professional Services, and Customer Support on strategic customer opportunities.

**Team Leadership**

* Lead through engineering managers and senior technical leaders.
* Hire, develop, and retain high-performing teams.
* Build leadership depth, succession plans, and future engineering leaders.
* Foster a culture of accountability, growth, and continuous improvement.

**Data Management Expertise**
Experience in the data management domain is strongly preferred, including areas such as:
  
  

* Data architecture and modeling
* Data lineage, metadata management, and governance
* Data quality, integration, and intelligence solutions
* Enterprise data platforms, cloud data warehouses, lakehouses , relational and NoSQL technologies

**Priority 2: Hyderabad Site Leadership**
As Site Leader, you will be accountable for the growth, culture, and reputation of the Hyderabad engineering organization.
  
  
**Site Growth & Capability**

* Drive Hyderabad's growth strategy in partnership with HR, Talent Acquisition, Finance, Facilities, and IT.
* Expand engineering capability and increase strategic product ownership within the site.
* Develop career paths, technical communities, and learning opportunities that strengthen engagement and retention.

**Culture & Communication**

* Lead regular town halls and site-wide communications.
* Promote a high-performance culture focused on customer value, engineering excellence, accountability, and collaboration.
* Serve as the primary bridge between Hyderabad and Quest's global engineering and business teams.

**External Leadership**

* Represent Quest within the Hyderabad technology ecosystem.
* Build relationships with universities and academic institutions to strengthen graduate hiring and talent pipelines.
* Participate in industry forums, technology communities, and employer-branding initiatives.

**AI-First Software Delivery**
A core expectation of this role is to lead Hyderabad's transition to AI-first engineering.
  
  
**You Will**

* Define and implement an AI-first software delivery strategy.
* Embed AI-assisted practices across development, testing, code review, documentation, and support.
* Establish governance for quality, security, intellectual property, and responsible AI usage.
* Measure outcomes through productivity, quality, delivery, and employee experience metrics.
* Lead the organizational change required to drive adoption.
* Share best practices across Quest and position Hyderabad as a center of excellence for AI-enabled engineering.

**Qualifications**
**Essential**

* 5+ years of second-line engineering leadership experience managing organizations of 30-50+ engineers through managers.
* Proven record of delivering enterprise software products to market.
* Experience partnering with customer-facing and go-to-market teams.
* Demonstrated success building high-performing engineering organizations.
* Strong technical credibility and ability to influence architecture and engineering decisions.
* Excellent communication skills with experience engaging executives, large employee audiences, and external stakeholders.
* Experience operating in global organizations across multiple time zones.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science , Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

**Preferred**

* Experience in data management, governance, metadata, lineage, or related enterprise software markets.
* Experience leading AI-assisted engineering transformation initiatives.
* Site leadership experience in India.
* SaaS and cloud platform experience.
* Expertise in modern engineering practices, including cloud-native architectures, DevOps, CI/CD, quality engineering, and secure software development.
* Experience scaling engineering organizations.
* Strong network within the Hyderabad technology community.
* Advanced degree in engineering, technology, or business.

**What Success Looks Li Ke**
Within your first 12 months:
  
  

* Deliver product commitments with high quality and clear customer value.
* Build a strong leadership team with healthy engagement, retention, and succession plans.
* Establish measurable adoption of AI-assisted software delivery.
* Successfully scale the Hyderabad site while strengthening culture and communication.
* Increase Quest's visibility and reputation within the Hyderabad technology ecosystem.

**Leadership Attribut es**
**We Are Looking For a Leader Who**

* Maintains a strong bias for delivery and results.
* Builds leaders and develops talent.
* Can effectively balance multiple strategic responsibilities.
* Communicates with clarity, candor , and consistency.
* Remains focused on customer outcomes.
* Embraces change and innovation, particularly AI-driven transformation.

**Why Quest Software**
Quest Software helps organizations manage, secure, and maximize the value of their data and IT environments. This role offers a unique opportunity to own product delivery, lead a 150-person engineering organization, and shape how software is built through AI-first practices at one of Quest's most strategic engineering locations.

title: AVP, Sr Product Engineer, APEX (L10)
description:
**Role Title :**
AVP, Sr Product Engineer, APEX (L10)
  
  
**Company Overview:**
Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a premier consumer financial services company delivering one of the industry’s most complete digitally enabled product suites. Our experience, expertise and scale encompass a broad spectrum of industries including digital, health and wellness, retail, telecommunications, home, auto, outdoors, pet and more.
  
  

* We have recently been ranked #2 among India’s Best Companies to Work for by Great Place to Work. We were among the Top 50 India’s Best Workplaces in Building a Culture of Innovation by All by GPTW and Top 25 among Best Workplaces in BFSI by GPTW. We have also been recognized by AmbitionBox Employee Choice Awards among the Top 20 Mid-Sized Companies, ranked #3 among Top Rated Companies for Women, and Top-Rated Financial Services Companies.
* We provide best-in-class employee benefits and programs that cater to work-life integration and overall well-being.
* We provide career advancement and upskilling opportunities, for all to take up leadership role

**Organizational Overview**
Synchrony's Engineering Team is a dynamic and innovative team dedicated to driving technological excellence. As a member of this Team, you'll play a pivotal role in designing and developing cutting-edge tech stack and solutions that redefine industry standards.
  
  
The Credit Card that we use every day to purchase our essentials and later settle the bills - A simple process that we all are used to on a day to day basis. Now, consider the vast complexity hidden behind this seemingly simple process, operating tirelessly for millions of cardholders. The sheer volume of data processed is mind-boggling. Fortunately, advanced technology stands ready to automate and manage this constant torrent of information, ensuring smooth transactions around the clock, 365 days a year.
  
  
Our collaborative environment encourages creative problem-solving and fosters career growth. Join us to work on diverse projects, from fintech to data analytics, and contribute to shaping the future of technology. If you're passionate about engineering and innovation, Synchrony's Engineering Team is the place to be
