title: PM II, SPIV Vendor Mgmt, Verifications & Risk Management Ops - VRMO
description:
**Description**
Are you passionate about driving vendor performance and operational excellence? Do you thrive in environments where data-driven insights shape strategic decisions and cross-functional collaboration is key to success?
  
  
The Selling Partner Identity Verification Vendor Management (SPIV VM) team is responsible for end-to-end vendor governance, managing vendor relationships, performance oversight, and operational excellence across seller-facing service vendors. SPIV VM partners with VS Tech, VS Product, Legal, TPSA (Third Party Security Assessment), SPS VM, Finance, and Global Corporate Procurement (GCP) to ensure vendor compliance, cost efficiency, and service quality throughout the vendor lifecycle — from shortlisting and selection through contract management and performance governance.
  
  
A Vendor Manager in SPIV VM owns vendor performance management, drives operational improvements, and ensures vendors meet contractual SLAs and quality benchmarks. They validate vendor data through internal dashboards, manage invoicing accuracy, collaborate with Finance on cost savings initiatives, coordinate with VS Tech, VS Product, Legal, and TPSA on vendor assessments and compliance, and support governance framework implementation. This role requires strong analytical skills, stakeholder management across multiple teams, and the ability to navigate ambiguity in vendor operations.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Manage day-to-day vendor relationships and performance against SLAs and KPIs
* Validate vendor-reported volumes against internal dashboard data to ensure invoicing accuracy
* Partner with Finance to track cost savings and budget adherence
* Collaborate with SPS VM and GCP during vendor shortlisting and selection processes
* Support governance framework implementation and ensure vendor compliance
* Conduct root cause analysis on vendor performance misses and drive corrective actions
* Develop and maintain vendor performance reporting (weekly, monthly)
* Lead risk assessments and vendor governance processes within SPIV VM
* Identify process improvement opportunities using data-driven insights
* Manage stakeholder communication across VS Tech, VS Product, Legal, TPSA, Finance, and Leadership teams
* Ensure contract scope, timelines, and deliverables align with business objectives
* Support change management initiatives related to vendor operations

A day in the life
  
  
You will start your day reviewing operational dashboards to identify anomalies in vendor performance metrics. You may then dive deep into a variance analysis to understand why a particular metric is trending below target, presenting your findings to your manager. In the afternoon, you might work on building an automated report that consolidates inputs from multiple teams, or partner with Data Engineering to refine data pipelines for reporting needs. Your work directly influences decisions on operational strategy and process improvements.
  
  
**About The Team**
The SPIV Vendor Management team operates a Dual-Face Model — an Operations Face covering onboarding, contracts, tech integration, and performance management, and a Cost Face covering budgets, invoices, accruals, POs, and spend management. The team manages processes across four pillars: Onboarding, Spend Management, Vendor Performance, and Vendor Strategy & Data Analytics. The VM role sits within the Operations & Performance function, serving as the bridge between business stakeholders, vendors, and cross-functional teams (VS Tech, VS Product, Legal, TPSA) — owning vendor governance, performance monitoring, and operational decisions. The structure is designed for interchangeability and continuity across the vendor management function.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of program or project management experience
* 3+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
* 3+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Bachelor's degree
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* 3+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

title: Product Manager - Enterprise Processes
description:
**Company Description**
**Dr. Reddy’s Laboratories Ltd.**
is a leading multinational pharmaceutical company based across global locations. Each of our 24,000 plus employees comes to work every day for one collective purpose: to accelerate access to affordable and innovative medicines because
**Good Health Can’t Wait.**
We started in 1984 with a modest investment, 20 employees and a bold vision. Today, we have research and development centres, manufacturing facilities or a commercial presence in 66 countries.
  
  
For nearly four decades, we have stood for access, affordability and innovation based on the bedrock of deep science, progressive people practices and robust corporate governance. As the pharmaceutical industry evolves and undergoes disruption, we see an opportunity – to strengthen our core further (the next steps) and to build the future (the new bets).
  
  
‘The Next and the New’ is how we aim to continue to be the partner of choice – purpose-driven, future-ready and sustainable. Our aim is to reach over 1.5 Bn+ patients across the world by 2030 by growing our core businesses and building for the future with sustainability at the core of our purpose and strategy. Sustainability for us means operating in a manner that respects people, planet and purpose – helping us conserve precious resources, serve our patients, create value for stakeholders, give back to society, fulfil our potential and maintain our integrity and transparency
  
  
Dr Reddy’s maintains a work environment, free from discrimination and is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to employ & nurture all qualified diverse workforce without regard to race, colour religion, nationality, sex, age, disability status, genetics, sexual orientation, gender expression, citizenship or any other characteristic or classification protected by applicable law(s) of the country we operate in. We treasure every talent, and recognize merit and diversity in our organization.
  
  
"
  
  
**Job Description**
**Job Summary**
We are looking for a Product Manager – Enterprise Processes to own product-led transformation across the end-to-end Order-to-Cash (O2C) and Record-to-Report (R2R) processes. The Product Manager will own the roadmaps for selected enterprise products and initiatives, and the data tracks for commercial planning, long-term capacity planning, and revenue planning. The Product Manager will also use AI-assisted product development to replace legacy workflow solutions with secure, scalable, and supportable enterprise-grade products.
  
  
Also, manage enterprise processes as products defining value, the needs of customers, and business owners, define the Northstar metrics, prioritize the highest-value problems, and mobilize Business and Digital teams to improve measurable business outcomes.
  
  
The Product manager will create and maintain end-to-end process visibility using process mining tools to establish leading and lagging performance measures, identify root causes and improvement opportunities, and provide senior leaders with a clear, evidence-based pulse of process health, risks, outcomes and required interventions.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Enterprise Data Products and Planning
* Own the vision, roadmap, lifecycle, and value realization of data products, ensuring trusted and reusable data for management reporting, operational decisions, analytics, and AI.
* Lead data tracks of commercial planning, long-term capacity and revenue planning.
* Own Product data management platform with various functions, ensuring Product Master is first time right and enable product movement with adequate controls through the value chain without delays while playing a major role in important initiatives across functions and markets.
* Use AI to prototype and build (vibe code Enterprise grade) applications to sunset legacy applications, spreadsheets, and manual touchpoints affecting master data quality and process effectiveness
* Product-led O2C and R2R Transformation
* Define the product vision, strategy, roadmap and success measures for assigned O2C and R2R journeys; discover and prioritize user and business problems based on value, experience, risk, controls and delivery complexity.
* Map and maintain L1-L4 end-to-end process architecture in a process mining tool across business units, geographies, roles, systems, controls and key data objects; establish trusted current-state and future-state process views.
* Use process mining, and Lean methods to identify variants, bottlenecks, rework, exceptions, manual interventions, control gaps and non-value-added activities.
* Partner with Business and Digital teams to deliver process, policy, data, automation, integration and operating-model improvements that address root causes and improve business outcomes.
* Process Performance and Executive Pulse
* Establish a balanced measurement framework covering leading indicators, lagging outcomes, activity, controls, adoption and user experience, with clear definitions, baselines, targets, ownership and review cadence.
* Create an integrated enterprise-process pulse highlighting performance trends, root causes, risks, value leakage and priority interventions; translate complex insights into concise executive narratives and decisions.
* Track outcomes such as OTIF, Perfect Order Rate, Fill Rate, Revenue Growth, Customer Retention, Day 1 Month Closure, Working Capital, and Profitability.

**Qualifications**
**Educational qualification:**
Master’s in Business Administration, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field
  
  
**Minimum work experience**
: 5 to 8 years of experience
  
  
**Skills & attributes:
  
  
Technical Skills**

* Proficiency in project management methodologies such as Agile, Scrum, or Kanban.
* Strong understanding of enterprise application architecture, databases, and integration technologies.
* Familiarity with software development lifecycle (SDLC) processes, including requirements analysis, design, development, testing, and deployment.
* Experience with enterprise software platforms such as ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning), Finance, and SCM (Supply Chain Management) systems.
* Knowledge of cloud computing platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and their application in enterprise environments.
* Good understanding about analytics platforms like Power BI, tableau, etc.
* Good understanding about Robotic Process Automation and Artificial Intelligence.

**Behavioural Skills**

* Ability to perform tasks independently with minimal supervision, showcasing self-reliance and autonomy.
* Teamwork and collaboration skills to work effectively in a multidisciplinary environment.
* Good time management and organizational skills.
* Team player with good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Attention to detail and commitment to quality of work.

**Additional Information**
Benefits Offered
  
  
At Dr. Reddy’s we actively help to catalyse your career growth and professional development through personalised learning programs.
  
  
The benefits you will enjoy at Dr. Reddy’s are on par with the best industry standards. They include, among other things and other essential equipment, joining & relocation support, family support (Maternity & Paternity benefits), learning and development opportunities, medical coverage for yourself and your family, life coverage for yourself.
  
  
" Our Work Culture
  
  
Ask any employee at Dr. Reddy’s why they come to work every day and they’ll say, because Good Health Can’t Wait. This is our credo as well as the guiding principle behind all our actions. We see healthcare solutions not only as scientific formulations, but as a means to help patients lead healthier lives, and we’re always attuned to the new and the next to empower people to stay fit. And to do this, we foster a culture of empathy and dynamism. People are at the core of our journey over the last few decades. They have been supported by an enabling environment that buoys individual ability while fostering teamwork and shared success. We believe that when people with diverse skills are bound together by a common purpose and value system, they can make magic.
  
  
For more details, please visit our career website at https://careers.drreddys.com/#!/"

title: Chief Product Officer
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Chief Product Officer — Enterprise AI Products**

**Role Overview**

is seeking a Chief Product Officer (CPO) to own the strategy, innovation, market relevance, and product

credibility of its enterprise AI product portfolio. The CPO defines what the company builds, why it matters to customers,

how it is differentiated, and how product investment translates into adoption, intellectual property, and long-term

enterprise value.

This is a hands-on product leadership role for an AI product company — not a services delivery role. The CPO is

expected to have personally built and commercialized enterprise technology or AI products before, and to bring that

credibility directly into the company's product decisions, market positioning, and investor narrative.

The CPO works closely with the CEO and leadership team on portfolio priorities, and partners with a separate Chief

Revenue Officer (CRO) function on go-to-market execution. The CPO equips Sales and Business Development with

product truth, evidence, and narrative — but does not own a sales quota or revenue target. Revenue accountability sits

with the CRO organization.

*Note: This role is deliberately scoped without quota or revenue ownership. Product credibility and commercial enablement*

*are the mandate; carrying a number belongs to the CRO role, hired separately.*

**Role Allocation & Primary Outcomes**

**A. Product Strategy, Innovation & Portfolio Leadership — 50%**

• Own the enterprise AI product vision, portfolio strategy, product roadmap, and investment priorities in alignment

with company strategy and target markets.

• Define clear product theses: which enterprise problems Cortexa will solve, for whom, why the problems matter,

and where the company can establish sustainable differentiation.

• Continuously assess developments in GenAI, agentic AI, LLMs/SLMs, domain models, RAG, enterprise AI

platforms, AI governance, evaluation, observability, and orchestration; determine their relevance to the portfolio.

• Maintain a structured view of competitors, substitutes, cloud/platform capabilities, customer build-vs-buy

decisions, and market white spaces; translate these insights into roadmap choices.

• Establish a continuous product-discovery process using customer interviews, market evidence, competitive

intelligence, and experiments — rather than feature development in isolation.

• Sponsor rapid prototypes, technical spikes, and proofs of concept to test product hypotheses quickly; define

explicit go, pivot, partner, or stop criteria before larger investments.

• Drive product architecture and capability principles with Principal Architects/Engineering leadership to keep the

portfolio scalable, reusable, and technically differentiated.

• Build and govern an IP pipeline: identify patentable ideas, sponsor invention disclosures, support patent

development, and connect the IP portfolio to product differentiation and investor narrative.

• Establish product metrics covering adoption, usage, customer value, quality, time-to-value, and differentiation;

use evidence to guide roadmap decisions.

• Own product lifecycle decisions, including incubation, launch, scale, repositioning, partnership, consolidation,

and retirement.

**B. Market Insight & Commercial Enablement — 30%**

• Act as the executive bridge between Product and the market — maintaining direct engagement with customers,

prospects, partners, analysts, and industry stakeholders to understand evolving enterprise AI requirements.

• Partner closely with the CRO, Business Development, Sales, and Marketing to convert market signals, pipeline

patterns, objections, and competitive wins/losses into actionable product strategy.• Participate in strategic customer discovery and executive conversations to understand business priorities, AI

maturity, buying criteria, and expected value — in support of Sales-led opportunities, not as the deal owner.

• Shape product positioning, packaging, solution propositions, target customer profiles, and differentiated sales

narratives for each product or product family.

• Assess strategic opportunities for product fit, roadmap implications, customization risk, and technical feasibility,

at the CRO's or Sales leadership's request.

• Support priority pre-sales engagements as a product expert — customer workshops, product demonstrations,

technical/product Q&A, and proof-of-value definition — without personally owning deal outcomes or quota.

• Ensure Sales and Business Development have strong product assets: solution briefs, competitive battlecards,

demos, architecture narratives, FAQs, and ROI/value narratives.

• Work with Marketing to develop technically credible product marketing, thought leadership, white papers, and

research-led content.

• Represent Cortexa externally through conferences, customer forums, and industry publications to build market

and investor credibility around the product.

• Identify strategic partnerships, OEM opportunities, and ecosystem integrations that can accelerate product reach.

• Create a closed feedback loop from CRO/pipeline insight to roadmap, and from roadmap/releases back to Sales

and Marketing.

**C. Product Execution & Delivery Governance — 20%**

• Translate portfolio strategy into clear product priorities, roadmaps, and release objectives for Product,

AI/Research, Engineering, and Delivery teams.

• Establish product governance across discovery, prototype, MVP, productization, launch, and scale — while

avoiding unnecessary process overhead.

• Review major architecture and technology decisions with technical leadership for alignment with product

strategy, scalability, security, and enterprise readiness.

• Ensure customer-specific work does not unnecessarily fragment the core product; identify what should become

reusable product capability versus one-off configuration.

• Guide strategic PoCs and early customer implementations to validate product-market fit and reduce risk before

wider commercialization.

• Track product execution risks, dependencies, and release readiness; intervene when strategic product outcomes

are at risk.

• Ensure product feedback, telemetry, and delivery learning are incorporated into subsequent roadmap and

investment decisions.

**Executive Accountabilities / Measures of Success**

• Clarity and quality of the AI product portfolio strategy and roadmap.

• Evidence that roadmap priorities are driven by market need, customer value, and differentiation.

• Speed from market insight or research hypothesis to prototype, validation, and product decision.

• Creation of differentiated capabilities, research outputs, and defensible intellectual property.

• Demonstrated product contribution to pipeline quality and win rates — measured jointly with the CRO, not

owned as a revenue target by this role.

• Product adoption, active usage, customer value realization, and time-to-value.

• Reduction in one-off customer customization through reusable product capabilities.

• Quality of product positioning, sales enablement, and market/investor-facing thought leadership.

• Effective alignment across Product, AI/Research, Engineering, CRO/Sales, Marketing, and Delivery.

• Disciplined product investment decisions, including willingness to stop or redirect initiatives that don't

demonstrate sufficient value.

LPL Financial is seeking a Data Product Analyst to support our Strategic Data Platforms, with a strong focus on how data is produced, shaped, governed, and delivered to downstream consumers across the firm.
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of Product Management, Data Product Ownership, and Advanced Analysis, and is designed for a senior individual contributor who can bring rigor and clarity to complex, data‑centric platform initiatives.
  
  
The Data Product Analyst focuses on data as a product—helping define data contracts, validate quality, assess downstream impact, and support data product and platform decisions.
  
  
The ideal candidate is comfortable working across upstream systems of record, platform services, and downstream consumers, and excels at turning complex data flows into actionable insights and decisions.

Product Discovery & Capability Support
  
  

* Support product discovery by helping translate business and platform needs into clear data‑centric problem statements.
* Contribute to roadmap planning by evaluating value, risk, and complexity across data initiatives.

Advanced Data Analysis & Problem Solving
  
  

* Perform hands‑on exploratory and diagnostic analysis across distributed data sources and platforms.
* Investigate data quality issues, lineage gaps, and semantic inconsistencies that affect downstream consumers.
* Conduct impact analysis for schema changes, new feeds, platform migrations, or system decommissions.

Data Product Ownership (Supporting / Platform‑Level)
  
  

* Support Data Product Owners by helping define:
* Data contracts, schemas, and semantic definitions
* Data quality rules, validation logic, and controls
* Usage expectations and downstream dependencies
* Maintain traceability between business intent, data products, and technical implementation.

Stakeholder Communication & Influence

* Communicate complex data flow and platform concepts in clear, decision‑ready narratives.
* Help align stakeholders across domains by grounding conversations in data realities and trade‑offs.

,
**act with integrity**
, and are
**driven to help our clients succeed**
. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we
**win together**
and
**create and share joy**
in our work.

* 4+ years of experience in Product Analytics, Data Analysis, Data Product Ownership, or Platform‑oriented Product roles.

* Experience working with data platforms, distributed data systems, or integration layers.
* Experience adopting emerging AI‑enabled capabilities to improve the speed, depth, and effectiveness of data analysis
* Experience operating in Agile/Scrum environments with cross‑functional product and engineering teams.

**Location:**
Hyderabad
  
  
**Skills Screening Summary**
**Key Skills — Must Have**
**Nice to Have**

* 7+ years Release Management, Delivery, or Agile Scrum experience
* Hands-on Scrum Master — primary facilitator (not a supporting role)
* Active Scrum certification: CSM, PSM I/II, or SAFe Scrum Master
* Advanced Azure DevOps: boards, release pipelines, test plans, dashboards
* Release Manager on a complex, multi-component enterprise application
* Multi-environment release coordination (Dev / Test / Prod / Prod-like)
* Geo-dispersed / distributed team experience
* Financial services, insurance, or regulated domain background
* Strong cross-timezone stakeholder communication (written and verbal)
* ITIL Foundation or equivalent change/release management certification
* Cloud platform exposure: Azure or AWS
* Insurance or actuarial domain knowledge
* ITSM tooling experience (ServiceNow, Jira Service Management)
* SAFe Agilist, RTE, or scaled agile certification
* Large-scale cloud migration programme experience
* AI-assisted productivity tools (Copilot, automation tooling)

**Who are we?**
Actuary IT Solutions is Zurich’s global capability within Finance, Investment & Treasury (FIT), responsible for running, stabilising, and evolving shared actuarial platforms that support IFRS and Group Reporting across business units.
  
  
We provide a unified and scalable operating model covering service management, platform operations, governance, compliance, and modernisation—so actuarial teams can focus on business outcomes with confidence in platform reliability and control.
  
  
Our portfolio includes Zurich’s core actuarial platforms such as Actuarial Solutions (ACE, GNLA, GRAND, and GLAD), operated as shared services with clear ownership, measurable KPIs, and standardised processes. We are actively modernising this landscape—including a major migration to AWS (targeted Go-Live Q1 2027)—to improve resilience, speed, cost efficiency, and long-term sustainability.
  
  
India delivery is an integral part of our global model, serving as a fully embedded delivery and capability hub. Teams work alongside global partners to support run operations, change, and transformation initiatives, contributing to scalability, resilience, and cost efficiency across the actuarial ecosystem.
  
  
**Why you’ll love working here**

* Enterprise-critical impact – Work on platforms that underpin IFRS and Group Reporting across Zurich
* Complex, meaningful delivery – Coordinate releases across a sophisticated, multi-component actuarial platform used globally
* Transformation at pace – Play a central role in Zurich’s AWS migration programme for actuarial systems
* AI-enabled ways of working – AI-first engineering, testing, operations, and knowledge management
* Clear ownership and accountability – Well-defined service models, KPIs, and decision rights
* Global collaboration – Work with diverse, highly skilled teams across Hyderabad, Barcelona, and multiple global locations
* Ownership culture – Trusted to make decisions, solve real problems, and deliver tangible outcomes

*If you want to operate at the intersection of release excellence and agile delivery leadership—working on platforms that truly matter to Zurich’s financial reporting and regulatory outcomes—Actuary IT Solutions is the place to do it.*
**Role Purpose**
The Release Manager & Scrum Master is responsible for orchestrating the end-to-end release lifecycle for the ACE actuarial platform while simultaneously leading agile ceremonies and delivery rhythm for a geo-dispersed team. The role is dual-purpose: ensuring that every release is controlled, traceable, and production-ready, while also embedding a high-performing agile culture through effective Scrum facilitation. The role operates as a critical bridge between Hyderabad and global stakeholders, requiring strong ownership, proactive communication, and the ability to manage complexity under pressure.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**
**Release Management**

* Own the end-to-end release process for the ACE platform: planning, scheduling, coordination, and deployment across complex, multi-environment, multi-component releases.
* Define and maintain the release calendar, change windows, and release trains in alignment with business and regulatory timelines.
* Coordinate release readiness across Engineering, Testing, and Business stakeholders—ensuring sign-off gates, test evidence, and change management processes are completed before every deployment.
* Manage hotfixes, emergency releases, and production incidents with structured communication and minimal disruption.
* Maintain a clear audit trail of all releases through Azure DevOps, ensuring traceability from work item to deployment.
* Act as the single point of accountability for release quality, risk, and go/no-go decisions.
* Produce and maintain a complete release artefact pack for every deployment — including release notes, test evidence sign-off, go/no-go decision record, change request documentation, and deployment confirmations — structured to satisfy internal audit and Group Reporting governance requirements.

**Scrum Master & Agile Delivery**

* Facilitate all Scrum ceremonies: sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and backlog refinement sessions.
* Remove impediments, protect the team from scope creep, and ensure sprint commitments are realistic and delivered.
* Track and report on velocity, sprint health, and delivery metrics—escalating risks proactively to stakeholders.
* Coach the team on agile principles and continuously improve delivery processes and team dynamics.
* Partner with Product Owners to maintain a healthy, well-ordered backlog with clear acceptance criteria.
* Enforce Definition of Ready and Definition of Done standards — ensuring every User Story carries complete acceptance criteria, linked test cases, and post-sprint artefacts (test evidence, business sign-off) before closure. This is a compliance requirement, not a best-practice aspiration.
* Foster a culture of transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement in a distributed team environment.

**Azure DevOps (ADO) Ownership**

* Own and optimise the Azure DevOps environment: boards, pipelines, repositories, release pipelines, and test plans.
* Configure and maintain ADO work item hierarchies, sprint boards, and reporting dashboards for senior stakeholder visibility.
* Ensure end-to-end traceability from requirements to test evidence to deployment through ADO.
* Drive adoption of ADO best practices across the team and onboard new team members to ADO workflows.

**Stakeholder Communication & Governance**

* Provide regular, clear release and delivery status updates to global stakeholders across Hyderabad, Barcelona, and Switzerland.
* Prepare release notes, deployment plans, and post-release reports.
* Represent delivery status in governance forums and steer committees, highlighting risks, decisions needed, and upcoming milestones.
* Serve as the Hyderabad focal point for all release and sprint-related queries from global team members.

**AI-First & Continuous Improvement**

* Apply an AI-first mindset to release and delivery processes: use AI tools to improve sprint reporting, release documentation, risk identification, and status communications.
* Continuously identify and drive process improvements to reduce release cycle time, increase predictability, and improve sprint delivery rates.
* Act as a critical thinker: validate AI outputs and apply professional judgement before adoption.

**Skills & Experience**
**Required Experience**

* Minimum 7 years of experience in Release Management, Delivery Management, or Agile Scrum roles.
* Proven experience managing releases for large, complex enterprise applications with multiple integrated components.
* Strong hands-on experience as a Scrum Master on a delivery team—not just a supporting role, but as the primary facilitator and impediment remover.
* Experience working in financial services, insurance, banking, or other regulated/complex domain is strongly preferred.

**Technical Skills**

* Advanced, hands-on experience with Azure DevOps (ADO): boards, pipelines, release management, test plans, and dashboards. This is a non-negotiable requirement—basic ADO exposure is not sufficient.
* Experience with release tooling and deployment coordination (CI/CD pipelines, change management processes, ITSM tools).
* Familiarity with cloud deployments (Azure or AWS) and how infrastructure changes interact with release planning.
* Competent in tracking and reporting using ADO or equivalent tooling (Jira, ServiceNow).

**Certifications — Required**

* Active Scrum certification: Certified Scrum Master (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM I or II), or equivalent (SAFe Scrum Master acceptable).
* ITIL Foundation or equivalent release/change management certification is required.

**AI & Mindset**

* Practical exposure to AI-assisted productivity tools (e.g. Copilot, AI writing assistants, automation tools) is an advantage.
* Demonstrates a learning mindset and openness to evolving ways of working.

**Professional Skills**

* Excellent communication skills—clear, proactive, and confident across technical and non-technical audiences.
* Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent releases and sprint streams.
* Structured approach to risk management, escalation, and decision-making under pressure.
* Proven ability to work independently in a geo-dispersed team—self-directing when requirements are ambiguous and proactively communicating status without being prompted.

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

title: Principal Outcome Manager
description:
Tezo is a new generation Digital & AI solutions provider, with a history of creating remarkable outcomes for our customers. We bring exceptional experiences using cutting-edge analytics, data proficiency, technology, and digital excellence.

**About the Role**

The Principal Outcome Manager owns business outcomes for our clients — not just projects. This is a senior consulting role that combines deep technology fluency, strong business judgment and disciplined delivery leadership.

It is not a traditional project manager role. The Outcome Manager agrees with the client up-front on what success looks like in measurable terms, leads the team that delivers it, tracks the outcome continuously, and stands behind the realized result.

In one line: agree the outcome, deliver the outcome, and make sure both the client and Tezo win
**.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Discovery and outcome definition**

* Run discovery workshops with client business and technology leaders to uncover the real problem.
* Translate the client's ambition into 2– 4 measurable KPIs with clear baselines and targets.
* Document and sign off the outcome, the measurement method and the review cadence with the client.

**2. Shaping the engagement**

* Partner with sales and pricing to structure a fair, outcome-linked commercial that protects margin and gives the client real upside.
* Identify risks early and decide — with leadership — whether to pursue, reshape or decline the deal.
* Co-own the Statement of Work, ensuring every outcome term is unambiguous and measurable.

**3. Execution and delivery**

* Build the right cross-functional pod (architects, engineering leads, data scientists, analysts) and set the operating cadence.
* Drive day-to-day delivery through the leads. You do not write code, but you always know whether the work is on track to the outcome — and intervene early when it is not.
* Manage scope, risks, dependencies and change with discipline.

**4. Outcome tracking and realization**

* Stand up a simple outcome dashboard for each engagement: live KPI values against baseline and target, with leading indicators.
* Run a weekly internal review and a regular client-facing outcome review. Convert lagging KPIs into corrective actions with owners and dates.
* Close each engagement with a short outcome memo: what was committed, what was delivered, what the business impact was, what to repeat next time.

**5. Stakeholder consulting and communication**

* Act as a trusted advisor to client business and technology sponsors — bring point of view, not just status updates.
* Translate fluently between the CIO/CTO conversation (architecture, data, AI, technical risk) and the CXO conversation (revenue, cost, customer experience, time-to-market).
* Manage escalations and disagreements directly; protect the relationship and the outcome at the same time.
* Identify the next outcome and help grow the account.

**6. People and team leadership**

* Lead the engagement pod with clarity on outcome and decision rights.
* Coach engineering and consulting leads to think in outcomes rather than tasks.
* Mentor junior consultants and outcome managers; help build the bench.

**Experience :**

* 10 –15 years of overall experience, currently working in a senior consulting role.
* Proven track record of personally owning business outcomes — not just managing projects.
* Strong hands-on engineering background. You should be able to ask the right second-order technical questions, even if you no longer build day-to-day.
* Experience with US enterprise clients from an offshore-anchored base; comfort across India and US time zones.
* Experience leading multi-disciplinary teams of 15– 40 people across geographies.
* Exposure to non-T&M commercial constructs (outcome-based, milestone-linked, gain-share, managed-service) is a strong plus.

**Technical Background**

This role requires a real engineering foundation. The Outcome Manager must be credible with client CTOs, enterprise architects and engineering leads, and must be able to challenge technical choices that put the business outcome at risk.

**Programming and engineering (must have at least one)**

* Strong hands-on background in .NET (C#) (Microsoft Stack), React/Angular— at least 5 years building production systems, ideally as a lead developer or technical lead.
* Comfortable reviewing code, design documents and architecture artefacts critically.
* Application, platform and product engineering
* Experience across one or more of: enterprise application development, platform engineering (internal developer platforms, shared services), product engineering (SaaS / multi-tenant products).
* Familiarity with modern engineering practices: API-first design, microservices, event-driven architectures, CI/CD, test automation, observability, DevSecOps.

**Cloud (must have at least one)**

* Working knowledge of AWS, Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud Platform — including compute, storage, networking, identity, managed databases and the platform's primary AI/data services.
* Solid Understanding of cloud-native development — containers (Docker / Kubernetes), serverless, managed services, infrastructure-as-code (Terraform / CloudFormation / Bicep), 12-factor app principles.
* Awareness of cloud cost, security and resilience trade-offs at enterprise scale.

**Architecture**

* Hands-on solution architecture experience — able to shape the end-to-end design of a non-trivial system covering data, services, integration and front-end.
* Working understanding of enterprise architecture — domain decomposition, integration patterns, reference architectures, ESB / API gateway, identity, master data, security and compliance.
* Familiarity with one or more architecture frameworks (TOGAF, C4, Well-Architected Frameworks for AWS / Azure / GCP) is a plus.

**Data and AI (good to have)**

* Working understanding of modern data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, Synapse, BigQuery), data engineering pipelines, and analytics use cases.
* Familiarity with AI/ML solution patterns — classical ML, GenAI, RAG, agents, MLOps — at a level credible to client data and AI leadership.

**Behavioral Skills and Competencies**

* Business and consulting judgment — strong commercial instincts, hypothesis-driven thinking, comfort with trade-offs.
* Stakeholder management — executive presence; credible with CXO audiences in writing, on a call and in a room.
* Communication — clear writing, active listening, ability to translate between technical and business audiences.
* Delivery discipline — uses KPIs and leading indicators, not status colors and percent-complete.
* People leadership — coach teams, gives feedback directly and kindly, holds the line on quality.

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science or a related technical discipline (required).
* MBA or equivalent post-graduate qualification (preferred, not required).

title: Senior Manager– Technology, Learning Futures Lab
description:
**Senior Manager– Technology, Learning Futures Lab, CLTE**

**Function:**
Leading the technology and AI-enabled tool development for CLTE's Learning Futures Lab pillar

**Location:**
Hyderabad

**Reports to:**
Director, CLTE

**Band:**
A2

**Reportees to Position:**
Developers / Technical Associates (internal and contracted)

**Job Outline**

The Senior Manager – Technology, Learning Futures Lab is responsible for leading the hands-on design, architecture, and delivery of AI-enabled and other technology tools that support CLTE's mandate to pioneer the future of learning at ISB. Working closely with the Teaching & Learning Design pillar, which engages directly with faculty to surface needs and define requirements, the incumbent translates these requirements into technical specifications, rapidly prototypes and validates solutions, and leads internal developers and external consultants through build, pilot, and scaled deployment. The role combines strong individual technical execution with the ability to architect, direct, and quality-control the work of a small technical team, while partnering with CLTE's other pillars — particularly Learning Analytics & Insights — on data, privacy, and compliance considerations.

**Job Specification**

**Knowledge / Education**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Strong, demonstrable technical foundation across modern software engineering and AI/ML systems.
* Exposure to education, ed-tech, or learning environments is desirable but not required — the Teaching & Learning Design pillar leads on pedagogical requirement-gathering.

**Specific Skills**

* Systems architecture & integration: REST/GraphQL APIs, microservices, enterprise databases and legacy systems.
* AI/LLM engineering: prompt design, RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, model and vendor evaluation.
* Data engineering: ETL design, data warehousing, stream processing.
* Cloud & deployment: Docker, Kubernetes, AWS/GCP/Azure, CI/CD, security and compliance (e.g., SOC2, data privacy).
* Full-stack development: Python, Java, TypeScript/Go/C++.
* Rapid prototyping, including fast feasibility-testing of AI/LLM approaches before committing to a full build.
* Root-cause debugging across unfamiliar, third-party, and integrated systems.
* Translating ambiguous requirements into precise technical specifications and milestones.
* Clear communication of technical trade-offs to faculty, engineers, and leadership.
* Pragmatic judgment on build-vs-buy and “80% solution” vs. long-term architecture decisions.
* Composure and ownership under pressure, including live pilots and production issues.

**Desirable Experience**

* 7–10 years of experience in software engineering, solutions architecture, or technical leadership roles.
* Proven experience leading a team of engineers and/or managing external consultants or vendors.
* Hands-on experience building and shipping AI/LLM-based products or features.
* Prior exposure to ed-tech, e-learning platforms, or academic/research environments is a plus, not a prerequisite.

**Job Interface & Relationships**

**Internal**

* Director, CLTE
* Teaching & Learning Design pillar
* Learning Analytics & Insights pillar
* Faculty (periodic, during pilots and reviews)
* Internal developers / technical associates

**External**

* AI and ed-tech vendors / platform providers
* Technical consultants and contracted developers
* Cloud and infrastructure providers

**Key Result Areas**

**1. AI & Technology Development**
— Weightage: 30%

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Lead design, prototyping, and delivery of AI-enabled and other technology tools across CLTE's curriculum and faculty initiatives.
* Translate requirements developed with the Teaching & Learning Design pillar into technical architecture and working solutions.
* Rapidly validate AI/LLM approaches through proofs-of-concept before committing to full builds.

**Measures**

* Number and quality of tools/features delivered
* Time from requirement handoff to working prototype
* Faculty/stakeholder satisfaction with delivered tools

**2. Pilot-to-Scale Execution**
— Weightage: 20%

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Run structured pilots for new AI/technology tools with clear success criteria.
* Own the transition of successful pilots into scaled, production-grade deployments.
* Ensure sustainable architecture that avoids unsustainable technical debt.

**Measures**

* Number of pilots successfully scaled
* Post-scale system reliability/uptime
* Incidence of rework due to technical debt

**3. Team & Vendor Management**
— Weightage: 20%

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Lead and mentor internal developers; manage external consultants and contractors engaged for development work.
* Establish clear technical workflows, milestones, and accountability across the build pipeline.
* Make sound build-vs-buy decisions, evaluating vendor and platform options against internal capacity.

**Measures**

* On-time, on-quality delivery across team- and consultant-led workstreams
* Quality and rigor of vendor evaluations

**4. Cross-Pillar & Stakeholder Collaboration**
— Weightage: 15%

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Partner closely with the Teaching & Learning Design pillar to ensure technical builds reflect faculty and pedagogical intent.
* Coordinate with the Learning Analytics & Insights pillar on data architecture, privacy, and compliance considerations.
* Communicate technical trade-offs clearly to faculty, CLTE leadership, and other non-technical stakeholders.

**Measures**

* Stakeholder feedback on collaboration and clarity
* Smoothness of cross-pillar handoffs; rework/escalations due to miscommunication

**5. Technical Governance & Compliance**
— Weightage: 15%

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Ensure deployed systems meet data security, privacy, and compliance requirements (e.g., student data protection).
* Maintain up-to-date documentation of architecture, systems, and integrations for institutional continuity.
* Track emerging AI/ed-tech developments relevant to CLTE's mandate and flag adoption opportunities.

**Measures**

* Compliance/audit outcomes
* Documentation completeness
* Relevant new capabilities identified and evaluated

In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.
  
  
One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.
  
  
Customer Engagement (CE) is a team within Ads focused on providing tools and products to enable Google to intelligently engage customers and help them succeed at scale. Our solutions cover marketing, business, and support for the Ads business and also customer support for Google’s consumer ecosystem with many of those products serving more than 1B monthly users like YouTube, Play, Hardware, Photos, Maps, Search, and Gmail to name a few. The team drives the design and development of agentic Artificial Intelligence (AI) systems that transform how support practitioners engage with customers through automated, intelligent conversations. Our tools manage contextualized diagnosis, multi-step troubleshooting, resolution, and communication with human agents in the loop.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Define and advocate the product goal, strategy, and roadmap for features and quality of the Cases AI Agentic system.
* Prioritize the product backlog, make trade-off decisions, and manage the product lifecycle from concept to launch and iteration. Translate user needs and business requirements into detailed Product Requirements Documents (PRDs), user stories, and specifications.
* Collaborate deeply with Engineering, User Experience (UX) Designers, UX Researchers, and Technical Program Managers to ideate, design, and deliver innovative solutions.
* Engage with key stakeholders and users including Sellers, Analysts, and Global Business Organization (GBO) partners to understand their needs, pain points, and opportunities.
* Communicate product plans, progress, and results to stakeholders, leadership, and cross-functional partners across CE and its ecosystem.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. title: Senior PMT
description:
**Description**
Our mission is to ensure customers trust Amazon to deliver a perfect order experience on every order. The Order Performance team within Perfect Order Experience (POE) is responsible for setting performance standards and ensuring that every purchase in our stores meets or exceeds Amazon's high bar for fulfillment quality and customer service quality — regardless of seller or channel. For our external selling partners, we set minimum performance expectations and enforce those expectations by limiting selling privileges if needed, while incentivizing sellers to improve performance and address customer pain points.
  
  
As a Senior Product Manager-Tech for Enforcement Decisioning, you will own the logic that determines when enforcement triggers — the threshold framework that translates seller performance metrics into enforcement decisions across all Order Performance policies and all global marketplaces. You will build intelligent, data-driven decisioning that calibrates enforcement to the tradeoff between customer harm prevented and seller value lost. You will also own the criteria for exemptions, leniency, and permanent enforcement, determining which sellers deserve differentiated treatment. You will partner with data scientists, software engineers, policy teams, and operations stakeholders to define the vision, design experiments, and ship decisioning systems that reduce order defects for hundreds of millions of customers while preserving the seller value that drives Amazon's flywheel.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Own the product vision and multi-year roadmap for enforcement decisioning, including data-driven threshold models, exemption frameworks, permanent enforcement pathways, and graduated enforcement calibration across multiple fulfillment quality policies
* Make trade-off decisions across enforcement model design (segmentation, economic tradeoff curves, marketplace-specific vs. global calibration)
* Design and launch enforcement decisioning systems that maximize defect prevention while minimizing unnecessary enforcement of valuable selection
* Design exemption and leniency logic — including thresholds for high-value listings, enforcement leniency for sellers with sustained clean performance, and graduated protection mechanisms
* Run A/B and holdout experiments to measure the causal impact of threshold changes on customer experience and business metrics— translating experimental results into production rollout decisions
* Author the long-term enforcement strategy and present to senior leadership, contributing to annual planning cycles and writing strategy documents that align cross-functional stakeholders

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
* Experience managing technical products or online services
* Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning
* 5+ years of technical product or program management experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in using analytical tools, such as Tableau, Qlikview, QuickSight

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Staff Product Manager, AI Control Plane
description:
Fanatics Commerce is the global leader in licensed sports merchandise, operating a vertically integrated platform that designs, manufactures, and delivers officially licensed apparel, jerseys, headwear, and collectibles for major leagues, teams, and events worldwide. With more than 900 e-commerce sites and a global omnichannel presence across digital, in-venue, and retail, Fanatics Commerce reaches fans in over 180 countries and powers official fan experiences for many of the world's most iconic sports properties.
  
  
At Fanatics, we bring our BOLD Leadership Principles to life every day - building championship teams, obsessing over fans, acting with entrepreneurial speed, and delivering with a determined and relentless mindset.
  
  
As we continue to scale our global platform, the Staff Product Manager, AI Platform Control Plane will play a critical role in defining the strategy, governance, and scalable foundation for AI agents, tools, and applications across Fanatics Commerce.
  
  
**Role Overview**
Fanatics Commerce is building an AI platform to make it easier for teams to build, deploy, and scale AI-powered agents and tools across the organization, and the Staff Product Manager, AI Platform Control Plane owns the common capabilities that make this possible — registration, configuration, deployment, lifecycle management, security, governance, monitoring, and operation at scale. This role sits at the intersection of product, engineering, AI, security, and business needs, working as part of a globally distributed AI platform PM team alongside the AI Platform Adoption PM and the Business Solutions PM to create a continuous feedback loop between customer needs, business solutions, and platform evolution. The Staff Product Manager, AI Platform Control Plane delivers business and fan impact through BOLD leadership and execution excellence, leveraging data, automation, and AI-enabled insights.
  
  
**How Will You Drive Impact**
Success is measured by the ability to deliver results through BOLD capabilities and measurable outcomes.
  
  
Team & Leadership Impact (Build Championship Teams)
  
  
**Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Partner with engineering, security, governance, legal and business stakeholders to translate organizational requirements into scalable platform capabilities, creating clarity and alignment without relying on formal authority.
* Operate as a tightly connected system with the AI Platform Adoption PM and Business Solutions PM, ensuring clear ownership and strong collaboration across the platform PM team so that customer needs, solution patterns, and platform evolution continuously.
* Establish the principles, product standards, and architectural guardrails that guide the evolution of the Control Plane in partnership with engineering leadership.

**People Leadership**

* Create alignment across a broad range of technical and business stakeholders — product, engineering, security, governance — driving decisions through ambiguity and making difficult trade-offs with confidence and transparency.
* Mentor and model platform product thinking by demonstrating how to turn complex infrastructure capabilities into coherent products that solve real customer problems.

Fan & Customer Impact (Obsessed with Fans)
  
  

* Build a deep understanding of the developers and teams using the AI platform, distinguishing between individual feature requests and underlying needs that should shape reusable platform capabilities.
* Own the experience for developers and technical teams interacting with the Control Plane, reducing complexity in configuring, deploying, operating, and troubleshooting AI applications.
* Establish clear workflows, tooling, documentation, and self-service capabilities that enable teams to move AI solutions from experimentation into secure, governed, reliable production environments with decreasing effort and friction.
* Use developer feedback and platform usage data to continuously improve the Control Plane experience, ensuring teams view it as an enabler rather than a constraint.

Innovation & Problem Solving (Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit)
  
  

* Stay deeply informed about emerging AI infrastructure and agentic patterns — including agent runtimes, orchestration, tool calling, MCP-style systems, model gateways, evaluation, and observability — and translate that knowledge into practical platform capabilities and product strategy.
* Identify common technical and product patterns that should become platform primitives rather than being implemented repeatedly by individual teams, building once and enabling reuse across multiple AI solutions.
* Balance developer velocity with platform reliability, security, safety, and governance, making pragmatic architectural and product trade-offs as the platform evolves.
* Build safety and governance capabilities directly into the platform rather than relying primarily on manual processes, defining requirements for guardrails, policy enforcement, auditability, monitoring, evaluation, and responsible AI controls.

Ownership & Execution (Determined & Relentless Mindset)
  
  

* Define and own the product strategy and roadmap for the AI platform Control Plane, establishing platform abstractions and standards that allow teams to build AI solutions consistently without reinventing underlying capabilities for every use case.
* Define how users, teams, agents, tools, models, and other AI resources are identified, owned, authenticated, authorized, and managed throughout their lifecycle, establishing clear ownership and accountability at scale.
* Provide visibility into AI usage, behavior, performance, risks, and policy compliance, enabling appropriate human oversight and intervention for AI applications where required.
* Track and drive success metrics including developer velocity, time to production, platform leverage, management and control maturity, safety and governance consistency, observability and reliability, and overall developer experience quality.

AI & DIGITAL CAPABILITY
  
  
We are building a future-ready organization. This role is expected to:
  
  

* Apply AI and technology to improve efficiency, quality, and outcomes
* Use data and digital tools to inform decisions and enhance performance
* Demonstrate curiosity and adaptability in adopting new technologies and ways of working
* Contribute to a culture of innovation and continuous improvement

**Required Qualifications**
CAPABILITIES & EXPERIENCE YOU BRING
  
  

* Proven experience as a Staff-level or senior product manager owning platform, infrastructure, or developer tooling products, with a track record of defining strategy and delivering roadmaps in ambiguous, rapidly evolving environments.
* Strong technical fluency in AI infrastructure, distributed systems, security, and platform architecture — credible enough to engage deeply with engineering on trade-offs, challenge assumptions, and make sound product decisions without needing to be the architect.
* Demonstrated understanding of AI and agentic systems, including agent runtimes, orchestration, tool calling, model gateways, evaluation frameworks, and observability patterns relevant to production AI platforms.
* Experience defining and building identity, access control, lifecycle management, and governance capabilities for complex technical platforms, with the ability to translate organizational security and compliance requirements into scalable product solutions.
* Systems thinking ability — can design for the broader platform ecosystem (agents, models, tools, data, infrastructure, identity, security, governance, developer experience) rather than optimizing individual components in isolation.
* Strong track record of influencing and aligning engineering, product, security, governance, and business stakeholders without formal authority, driving decisions through ambiguity and complexity.
* Experience using customer and developer feedback, platform usage data, and solution patterns to continuously evolve platform strategy and prioritize a roadmap for maximum leverage and reuse.

WORK LOCATION
  
  
Hybrid: The primary place of performance of this role is the Fanatics office located in Hyderabad, Telangana subject to the Company's current hybrid work policy. This role currently requires in-office presence.
  
  
*At Fanatics, we operate with a BOLD mindset - We Build Championship Teams, we’re Obsessed with Fans, we embrace a Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit, and we approach every challenge with a Determined and Relentless Mindset. If you’re ready to contribute to a dynamic, fast-paced environment that thrives on collaboration and growth, we want you to be part of our team.*
**About Us**
*Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.*
**About The Team**

title: Principal PM Manager
description:
****Overview****
The Defender for Office 365 product group owns the protection experience for email and collaboration across Microsoft 365. The product management team drives end-to-end ownership across the product lifecycle, partnering with groups and stakeholders across the organization and directly with customers and partners. As part of Microsoft XDR, the product spans real-time detection, post-delivery response and recovery, investigation and hunting, and pre-breach capabilities. The team owns one of the largest security solutions in the XDR portfolio and helps shape how communication and productivity security will work in an era of AI-powered social engineering, using AI to strengthen detection and making MDO the trusted entry point into the broader Defender suite. The group works at the intersection of protection efficacy, explainability and everyday usability, serving SOC analysts, email administrators and end users alike.
  
  
****Responsibilities****
Are you a product leader who wants to own a product line that protects organizations every single day, and to build the team that delivers it Come work with us at the largest security company in the world, on one of its most broadly deployed security products.
  
  
Microsoft Defender for Office 365 protects email and collaboration across Microsoft 365. Attackers are shifting from recognizable malicious artifacts toward adaptive, multi-step social engineering, and generative AI is lowering the cost of personalizing those attacks at scale. Staying ahead of that shift — while keeping protection fast, explainable and operable at enterprise scale, is the challenge this role leads.
  
  
You will oversee a portfolio of complex engagements while developing high-performing teams and shaping a sustainable security product. You will own the overall health, quality and success of a product line and its features within the MDO portfolio.
  
  
****Responsibilities****
**Enable teams and build talent**

* Lead and develop product managers through coaching, clear expectations and accountability.
* Model Microsoft's Model, Coach, Care leadership culture — creating an environment where people grow and perform at their best.
* Partner with capacity and resource teams to align the right skills to the right work at the right time.
* Own the professional development of the people in your area, including onboarding, ongoing feedback and career growth, and provide managers with in-depth insight into their performance.

**Own the product line**

* Own the overall health, quality and success of a product line and its features in the MDO portfolio, strategy, roadmap, delivery and the outcomes customers actually experience.
* Set direction and priorities for your area, make the hard trade-offs, and hold the line on scope, sequencing and quality.
* Ensure consistent delivery excellence through Microsoft methodologies, quality standards and governance.

**Drive results with customers and partners**

* Engage directly with customer executives and steering committees to remove blockers, build trust and drive results.
* Partner closely with product and engineering leaders from other groups, and with business planning, marketing, sales, customer success, support and finance, acting as the point of contact for your area across disciplines.
* Manage existing relationsionship with 3rd parth companies and Identify opportunities to expand existing engagements and partnerships with our ecosystem and potential partners

**Shape product strategy**

* Define and own the multi-year strategy for your product line, what it wins on, and what it deliberately does not do, and keep it coherent with MDO's overall direction and the broader Defender suite.
* Translate the threat landscape, customer signals, telemetry and competitive movement into a clear point of view on where the product must go next, and refresh it as the landscape shifts.
* Turn that strategy into a sequenced, fundable roadmap: name the bets, the trade-offs behind them, and the OKRs.
* Build the business case for investment, size the opportunity, define the success metrics, and defend the plan in leadership, planning and review forums.
* Influence adjacent product strategies across XDR, identity, endpoint and data to help strengthens the platform.

****Qualifications****

* 10+ years of product management experience, including 4+ years in security.
* Experience leading product managers as a manager, area lead or equivalent with a track record of growing people.
* Proven track record of owning a product line or major product area end to end, from strategy through shipping to measured business outcomes.
* Demonstrated success engaging senior customer stakeholders and executives, and turning those conversations into product direction and resolved blockers.
* Strong cross-group influence: able to align engineering, design, research, marketing, sales, support and finance around a shared plan without direct authority.
* Exceptional analytical, problem-solving and decision-making skills; data-driven by default.
* Excellent communication, writing and presentation skills.
* Demonstrated use and adoption of AI in real-life product practices, applying AI agents and tools to research, analysis, specification, prototyping and decision-making, and raising that bar across the team.
* Advantage: hands-on background in email and collaboration security, threat detection, SOC workflows or XDR.

title: AI-Native Systems Builder
description:
We're looking for builders.
  
  
Not product managers. Not software engineers. Not AI researchers. People who happen to do all three when the problem demands it — because they care more about solving the problem than about which lane it falls in.
  
  
****What this role is****
Darwinbox is an enterprise HCM platform used by hundreds of large organizations across multiple countries. We're in the middle of a fundamental shift — rearchitecting the product and the company to be AI-native. Not adding AI features to an existing system. Rebuilding how the system thinks, operates, and delivers value.
  
  
This role exists because the most important work in that transformation doesn't fit traditional job boundaries. It sits at the intersection of product thinking, systems engineering, enterprise domain knowledge, and AI — and it requires people who can hold all of that in their head while shipping something that actually works.
  
  
You will take ambiguous, high-stakes enterprise problems and turn them into working systems. Some will be customer-facing product capabilities. Some will be internal operational systems. All of them will require you to think deeply about the realities of enterprise software — permissions, auditability, multi-tenancy, scale, configurability, edge cases — because that's where most "AI-powered" systems quietly break.
  
  
****What the work looks like****
You won't get a detailed spec. You'll get a problem.
  
  
It might sound like: "Our customers can't tell whether their employees are actually using the platform — and neither can we." Or: "Implementation consultants spend 40% of their time on work that should be systematized." Or: "This workflow was designed for humans filling forms — redesign it for a world where AI handles 80% of the steps."
  
  
Your job is to go from that problem statement to a production system. You'll need to understand the business context, design the solution, build it (using AI-native development workflows extensively), validate it against real enterprise complexity, and iterate until it works — not in a demo, but at scale, with real customers, in production.
  
  
****Who thrives here****
People who build things outside of work — not because someone asked, but because they saw a problem and couldn't leave it unsolved.
  
  
People who use AI tools daily and have strong opinions about where they're transformative and where they're dangerous.
  
  
People who think in systems — who instinctively ask "what breaks downstream?" and "what happens at 100x scale?" and "what's the edge case no one mentioned?"
  
  
People who've shipped things. Not prototyped. Shipped. In environments where the user didn't forgive rough edges.
  
  
You might come from engineering, product, consulting, design, operations, or a path that doesn't have a clean label. We genuinely don't care about the label. We care about how you think, how you simplify, and what you've built.
  
  
****What we explicitly don't optimize for****

* Resume pedigree as a proxy for capability
* Interview performance on problems you'd never encounter here
* AI enthusiasm without AI execution
* Coordination-heavy profiles that produce slides instead of systems
* Prototype thinking without production realism

****Why this role exists****
Most companies hire PMs to write specs, engineers to execute them, and analysts to measure the outcome. Three roles, three handoffs, three points of context loss.
  
  
We're building a company where one person can hold the full arc — problem to system to outcome — because we believe that's how the best enterprise software gets built in the AI era.
  
  
If that sounds like how you already think, we should talk.
  
  
**Location:**
Hyderabad

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
  
  
The Position
  
  
**Job Description**
The Delivery Management Professional (SE6) leads moderately complex deliveries, proactively identifies improvements, manages diverse stakeholders, and contributes to strategic implementation. In this role, you will independently define and control the scope of medium to large initiatives, involving multiple multidisciplinary teams, utilizing effective facilitation and analytical skills to drive value delivery. While navigating intricate stakeholder environments, you will connect team development with broader business objectives. Depending on the organization's needs, you may operate within role archetypes such as Project Manager, Service (Delivery) Manager, ITSM Process SME, Scrum Master, Release Train Engineer (RTE), or Agile Coach.
  
  
Description of the area
  
  
This team plays a critical role in drug development, integrating clinical study data, real-world evidence, and enabling cross-ecosystem collaboration to drive operational excellence and scientific innovation. They also deliver real-time operational insights from clinical trials, enabling proactive management of study execution, improving enrollment strategies, and streamlining workflows for maximum efficiency. By fostering collaboration across registries and federated open science networks, they leverage shared data ethically to uncover new scientific insights and study long-term treatment outcomes. Additionally, the team harnesses RWE and secondary use of clinical trial data to understand real-world treatment effectiveness, utilization patterns, and patient health trends. This holistic approach ensures trials are efficient, evidence generation is robust, and therapies are aligned with real-world patient needs, accelerating development timelines and improving outcomes at every stage.
  
  
A key focus of the area will also be building AI-ready data foundations that support advanced analytics, machine learning, and emerging agentic AI capabilities. This includes engineering trusted, well-governed, and semantically rich datasets; enabling metadata-driven access; and providing reusable data products that allow autonomous and human-in-the-loop AI systems to safely explore, reason over, and act on complex clinical and real-world data.
  
  
****Job Responsibilities****

* Scope / (Content Leadership): Independently defines, manages, and controls the scope of medium to large initiatives involving multiple multidisciplinary teams, or significant workstreams with moderate complexity. Leads and facilitates the scope definition process, aligning with strategic objectives, stakeholder expectations, and team dependencies. * Accountability/Problem Solving: Independently leads the analysis of moderate to complex delivery problems, driving root cause analysis and eliciting complex stakeholder needs. * Stakeholder Management: Identifies a diverse range of stakeholders across functional areas and develops comprehensive stakeholder communication plans. Effectively manages relationships to act as a trusted advisor, proactively shapes stakeholder perspectives, and navigates intricate stakeholder environments by resolving conflicts to ensure alignment
* Impact/Strategy: Demonstrates consistent performance with an impact that typically extends to a specific product, initiative, or cluster. Contributes to achieving product or domain goals by ensuring value delivery, takes a proactive role in shaping team processes, and contributes to the implementation of strategic objectives for Informatics, the Chapter, and/or Domains
* Complexity / (Product Size): Manages moderately complex initiatives or workstreams extending across a product or service. Manages the delivery of complex features, services, or projects (e.g., a service transition, a product release, or an Agile Release Train (ART) increment). Selects and tailors delivery methodologies while managing dependencies between activities
* Business/Technical ability: Demonstrates strong business acumen by analyzing business needs and translating them into effective delivery strategies.
