title: Deployment Lead
description:
**Job Requirements**
We are looking for a curious, high-agency
**Deployment Lead**
to join our Global Professional Services team and help build our new
**Customer Transformation capability**
. You will work directly with enterprise customers and partner closely with Applied AI, Solution Architecture, Product, Engineering, and Professional Services teams to turn customer problems into practical solutions, adoption, and measurable business value.
  
  
This is
**not a traditional project management role**
. You will operate in a forward-deployed model, working close to customers, navigating ambiguity, bringing the right people together, and helping drive transformation across
**AI, Agents, enterprise technology, and customer workflows**
.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Work directly with customers to understand their business objectives, challenges, workflows, and operating environment.
* Participate in customer conversations, ask the right questions, and identify the problem behind the request.
* Help customers explore AI-powered Talent experiences, AI Agents, and emerging Phenom capabilities.
* Identify where AI can solve a meaningful customer problem and where it may not be the right solution.
* Partner with Solution Architecture, Product, Engineering, Applied AI, and Professional Services teams to turn ideas into practical customer outcomes.
* Help customers move from experimentation → validation → adoption → value.
* Translate real-world customer problems into clear internal decisions, actions, and priorities.
* Bring structure to ambiguous situations by defining problem statements, actions, owners, dependencies, risks, and next steps.
* Bring the right Phenom expertise into customer situations at the right time.
* Drive progress across teams and influence stakeholders without formal authority.
* Identify blockers, escalate with context and recommendations, and follow through until meaningful progress is achieved.
* Build an understanding of how customer workflows, systems, constraints, and business processes connect to Phenom's platform.
* Capture customer patterns and learnings to improve the broader Customer Transformation and deployment approach.
* Develop a strong understanding of Applied AI, Agentic workflows, enterprise technology, and customer transformation.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 3–6 years of experience in consulting, enterprise technology, SaaS, business analysis, customer success, operations, implementation, professional services, or a similar environment.
* Strong customer-facing communication and stakeholder management skills.
* High agency and ownership — someone who takes initiative rather than waiting for detailed instructions.
* Ability to bring structure and clarity to ambiguous problems.
* Strong problem-solving skills with a natural tendency to ask “why?” before jumping to solutions.
* Ability to influence and collaborate across teams without formal authority.
* Strong follow-through and the ability to drive actions to completion.
* Curiosity about technology, AI, Agents, and how enterprise systems actually work.
* Ability to learn quickly, go deep when required, and operate comfortably outside your existing expertise.
* Comfortable saying “I don't know yet — I'll find out” and taking ownership of finding the answer.
* A customer-outcome mindset, with a focus on business value rather than simply completing activities.
* Prior experience with AI, Talent technology, enterprise transformation, or SaaS implementations is a plus, but not required.

**Why Join This Team**
This role offers the opportunity to help build a
**new Customer Transformation capability from the ground up**
. You will work directly with enterprise customers on real-world problems involving
**AI, Agents, enterprise technology, and business transformation**
, while partnering closely with Phenom's Product, Engineering, Solution Architecture, and Professional Services teams.
  
  
You won't have a playbook for everything —
**part of the job is helping us build the playbook**
. This is an opportunity for someone who wants to learn quickly, take significant ownership, and grow into a role where they can directly influence customer outcomes and the future of how Phenom delivers transformation.

description:
**Role & responsibilities**

**If interested send me cv on 6304776536 or bommakanti.sai.vaidehi@pwc.com**

**Preferred candidate profile**

We are looking for a Senior Business Analyst who can sit between US healthcare payer and provider business stakeholders and an offshore ETL engineering pod, and turn ambiguous business asks into precise, buildable specifications. The role spans requirement elicitation, source-to-target mapping, business validation logic, UAT ownership, and stakeholder-facing reporting across an enterprise data warehouse an enterprise Operational Data Store, and the downstream extract and BI layers.

This is a hands-on analyst role, not a coordination role. You will profile data yourself in SQL, read ETL job logic, and defend your specifications in front of both the business and the development team.

**Key Responsibilities**

Requirement to specification. Elicit requirements from business and clinical stakeholders and convert them into BRDs, functional specifications, source-to-target mapping (STTM) documents, and testable acceptance criteria that developers can build from without re-interpretation.

Source-to-target mapping and impact analysis. Produce and maintain mapping and business-requirement documentation for data extracts, including impact analysis for schema, entity, and source-system changes.

Business validation (BV) logic. Define the Landing Zone to Persistent Layers reconciliation and business validation rules executed by the ETL BV framework, and investigate count and value mismatches jointly with the development team.

Data analysis and profiling. Write and tune complex SQL to profile source data, validate transformation logic, quantify defect impact, and answer stakeholder data questions independently.

Reporting and visualization. Partner with BI developers on Tableau / Power BI dashboard requirements, wireframes, and metric definitions; validate published outputs against the agreed source of truth.

Release and UAT ownership. Drive UAT planning, test-scenario definition, defect triage, and business sign-off across Dev / QA / UAT / Production cycles, including regulatory submission windows.

Stakeholder management. Run requirement workshops and status reviews with US-based business owners across time zones; surface risks, dependencies, and scope ambiguity early rather than at test time.

Documentation and governance. Maintain runbooks, known-issue articles, data dictionaries, and end-to-end traceability from requirement through to the deployed object.

Required Qualifications

8 10 years of total experience, including a minimum of 4 5 years as a Business Analyst or Data Analyst in the US healthcare domain payer side (claims, enrollment, membership, provider, benefits, capitation, pharmacy) and/or provider side (EMR / clinical data).

Demonstrated ability to convert client requirements into formal business documents BRD / FSD, STTM, use cases, process flows, and requirement traceability matrices.

Strong data warehousing fundamentals — dimensional modelling, slowly changing dimensions, CDC / delta processing, landing–staging–persistent layering, data lineage, reconciliation, and data quality management.

Excellent written and verbal English and the confidence to lead a workshop with senior US stakeholders.

title: IT Delivery Lead - Technology IT
description:
**About Signant Health**
At Signant Health, we help bring life-changing treatments to patients faster. We are a global evidence generation company that supports clinical trials with smart technology, scientific expertise, and hands-on operational support — so better data leads to better decisions in healthcare. We embrace AI and advanced technologies to enhance every aspect of what we do, from data analysis to operational efficiency.
  
  
Our teams work at the intersection of science, technology, and patient experience, delivering digital solutions powered by AI innovation that make clinical trials more efficient, more accurate, and more accessible around the world. Trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and CROs, our platforms and services support studies across more than 90 countries and have contributed to hundreds of new drug approvals.
  
  
If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health — including the opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI technologies — you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health.
  
  
**About The Role**
Signant Health is recruiting an IT Delivery Lead to give every significant IT delivery a single, accountable owner from approval through to a compliant go-live. Working within IT’s lean, high-tempo delivery model, the IT Delivery Lead takes end-to-end ownership of automation and Ai delivery — with particular accountability for the cross-boundary work (dependencies, compliance sequencing, decisions, escalation and continuity) that keeps a delivery on track in a regulated, GxP environment.
  
  
This is a delivery and coordination role, not a build role: engineering owns the technical work and the initiative roadmap sits with the Sponsor. The IT Delivery Lead owns whether a delivery is genuinely ready to ship — sequencing compliance so it never becomes the bottleneck, confirming dependencies before dates are committed, driving decisions and approvals to closure, and keeping the audit trail complete. It will suit a delivery professional energised by making complex, cross-functional work land in a controlled environment, who is also fluent in how AI and automation are governed and delivered responsibly.
  
  
**Location: Hyderabad/Bangalore/Noida**
**Work mode: Remote**
**Years of experience: 3-6 Years**
**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES - Function**

* Delivery ownership — hold a single delivery accountable end to end through the IT SDLC; run its gates (day-one AI-vs-automation classification, Team Confirmation, Go/No-Go, release and closure); confirm the delivery is genuinely ready to go live.
* Boundary & dependency management — maintain the dependency and change-freeze register; confirm feasibility with dependency owners before dates are committed; drive decisions, approvals and escalations to closure; ensure a named deputy for every gate approver.
* Compliance & validation orchestration — sequence GxP compliance so it is never the bottleneck; own the tier-appropriate deliverable set (GxP risk determination, Validation Plan, Process Risk Assessment/FMEA, test evidence, release notification, validation summary) to completion and approval; protect the audit trail.
* Release management — own the release runbook; route production change through the change-management process, including CAB review for high-impact change; sequence sign-offs; confirm hypercare and monitoring ownership before go-live.
* Team cadence — facilitate the daily standup; uphold Jira hygiene and a shared Definition of Done; coordinate UAT and demos.
* Risk & continuous improvement — maintain the project risk register; run delivery retrospectives; maintain shared templates and the delivery playbook so learning is retained in the model.

**Knowledge, Skills & Attributes**
Essential:
  
  

* Degree-level education or equivalent professional experience.
* Delivery, project or agile certification (e.g. Scrum, PRINCE2, PMP, ITIL) desirable.
* Excellent stakeholder management and the ability to influence, coordinate and drive work to closure without direct authority.
* Confident facilitation of agile ceremonies and disciplined use of Jira and delivery tooling.
* Working knowledge of AI and automation governance — and comfort working with AI-enabled delivery tooling.
* Highly organised and detail-oriented, with a habit of surfacing risks and dependencies early.

**Desirable:**

* Proven delivery or project-management track record taking technology change to production in a regulated (preferably GxP / life-sciences) environment.
* Strong compliance-sequencing and validation awareness (CSA / GAMP 5, change management) with audit-grade documentation discipline.
* Experience delivering automation / RPA and AI-enabled solutions.
* Familiarity with GxP computerised system validation and quality frameworks (21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, ICH E6(R3)).
* Data literacy and experience resolving cross-system data-readiness issues.

**Why Signant Health?**
At Signant Health, your work has real impact. Everything we build, support, and deliver helps advance clinical research and bring new treatments to patients faster — improving lives around the world. Our teams combine science, technology, and operational expertise to solve complex clinical trial challenges, and every role contributes to that mission.
  
  
We offer a collaborative, global environment where you can grow your career while working alongside experts across clinical, technology, data, and operations, with opportunities to learn, take ownership, and drive meaningful innovation — not just maintain the status quo.
  
  
If you are looking for purpose-driven work, smart colleagues, and the opportunity to help shape the future of clinical research and digital health, Signant Health is the place to do it.
  
  
At Signant Health, accepting difference isn't enough — we celebrate it, we support it, and we nurture it for the benefit of our team members, our clients, and our community. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer, committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status. Prior to their start date, all new hires are required to be verified through a thorough background check and identity verification to confirm eligibility for employment.
  
  
Unsolicited resumes submitted by agencies or third-party recruiters directly to hiring managers or any Signant Health employee will not be considered and will not obligate Signant Health to any fees or terms associated with the submission.

title: Associate, Founder's Office -Technology & Operations
description:
**Company Description:**

**Role:**
The Associate, Founder's Office (Technology & Operations) will work directly with the Co-founder and CTO across programme management, supply chain, manufacturing coordination, regulatory tracking and product support. The mandate is deliberately broad and is set by the priorities of the technology organisation. Direct CTO and senior leadership exposure; a clear path to a programme management or manufacturing operations leadership role. Makers Hive is the company that invented KalArm, India's first fully functional bionic hand, designed and manufactured in India under an ISO 13485:2016 quality system. The company runs four hardware programmes in parallel across bionic prosthetics, assistive devices and dexterous robotics, manufactured in-house in Hyderabad.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Programme management**

Maintain a single integrated view of all product programmes covering milestones, dependencies and critical path; run the weekly programme review; surface and escalate slippage in the week in which it occurs.

**Supply chain coordination**

Track long-lead items and bill-of-material changes; follow up with vendors on open commitments; coordinate inward, quality and import escalations. Commercial negotiation remains with the operations function.

**Regulatory and certification tracking**

Maintain the regulatory and certification calendar as a live document with named owners and dates; coordinate documentation across engineering, quality and external consultants.

**Manufacturing and delivery coordination**

Maintain the production plan against the order book; coordinate between the commercial and operations functions on delivery commitments, capacity and dispatch.

**Product and engineering support**

Prepare the analysis behind product, sourcing and make-versus-buy decisions; maintain technical documentation and decision records; support hiring and onboarding across the engineering organisation.

**Special projects**

Execute cross-functional initiatives sponsored by the CTO, from problem definition through to closure.

**STRATEGIC PRIORITIES**

01.
**Establish the programme management function:**


Stand up the integrated plan, the weekly review cadence and the escalation mechanism; none of these exists in structured form today.

02.
**Eliminate late discovery:**
Ensure that no milestone, approval dependency or long-lead item is identified after the point at which it can still be managed.

03.
**Instrument the supply chain:**


Build the long-lead watch list and the vendor follow-up cadence to a standard that prevents production stoppages.

04.
**Connect commercial commitments to manufacturing capacity:**
 Establish a monthly interface between what the commercial organisation has sold and what the plant can ship.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

**Background**

Experience in programme management, new product development, supply chain, planning and purchase, or plant operations at a hardware, medical device, automotive or manufacturing company.

**Education**

Bachelor's degree in engineering (mechanical, production, electronics or equivalent). Graduate engineer trainees and management trainees from manufacturing organisations are encouraged to apply.

**Cross-functional execution**

Demonstrated ability to drive cross-functional execution without formal authority, across teams that do not report into the role.

**Ways of working**

Structured problem solving; fluency in Excel and programme tracking tools; clear and concise written communication.

**On the ground**

Willingness to work on the shop floor and at vendor premises, and the capacity to manage four programmes in parallel.

**AI fluency**

Comfortable using AI tools to track programmes, analyse data and document decisions, with the judgement to check their output before acting on it.

**Preferred edge**

Medical device or regulated manufacturing exposure; experience with BOM management, ERP or PLM systems; MBA in operations or supply chain management.

**HOW TO APPLY**

01 · Send

Your CV and a short note (under 300 words) to
**hr@makershive.io.**
Tell us one thing you noticed about Makers Hive and what you would do about it.

02 · Assignment

Shortlisted candidates take a short assignment.

03 · Meet the founder

Walk the CTO through your assignment, followed by a round of interviews.

Subject line: "Associate, Founders Office - Technology & Operations". A link to something you have built or written is welcome but optional.

title: Lead Product Owner
description:
The Lead Product Owner (LPO) within Kroll’s Chief Data Office (CDO) is responsible for
**end‑to‑end ownership, consistency, and execution excellence across multiple data, analytics, and reporting products or domains**
. This role ensures alignment between business priorities, product strategy, and delivery execution.
  
  
The Lead Product Owner acts as the
**central accountability point across a portfolio of related products**
, coaching and guiding Product Owners, establishing standards, and partnering closely with Program Management, Data Engineering, and Governance to deliver predictable, high‑quality outcomes.
  
  
This role is critical to enabling
**product‑led execution at scale**
within the CDO.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Portfolio‑Level Product Ownership**

* Own the overall product vision and execution strategy across a defined product portfolio or domain (e.g., Reporting, Self‑Service Analytics, Finance Analytics, Data Platforms).
* Ensure each product has:

+ A clear purpose and roadmap
+ Defined success metrics
+ Consistent experience and standards

* Act as the final decision authority on prioritization, scope tradeoffs, and acceptance across related products.

**Leadership & Coaching**

* Lead, mentor, and coach Product Owners to ensure consistent product ownership practices and decision quality.
* Set and enforce standards for backlog quality, roadmap clarity, and stakeholder communication.
* Serve as the escalation point for complex prioritization, dependency, or scope conflicts.
* Raise the overall product ownership maturity across CDO.

**Stakeholder Alignment & Business Partnership**

* Serve as an interface between CDO and business, finance, and functional leaders for assigned domains.
* Translate enterprise priorities into sequenced, realistic roadmaps.
* Manage competing stakeholder demands by making transparent, value‑based trade‑offs.
* Ensure stakeholders have confidence in what will be delivered, when, and why.

**Roadmap, Backlog & Delivery Governance**

* Maintain a portfolio‑level roadmap, aligned with capacity, dependencies, and strategic priorities.
* Ensure Product Owners maintain well‑defined, ready backlogs that support predictable delivery.
* Partner with Program Managers and Scrum Masters to:

+ Align sprint and release plans
+ Surface risks and constraints early
+ Manage cross‑team dependencies

* Ensure delivery adheres to CDO governance, readiness, and release standards.

**Quality, Governance & Trust**

* Partner with Data Governance, Architecture, and Platform teams to:

+ Enforce consistent KPI definitions and semantic standards
+ Uphold data quality, lineage, and trust expectations
+ Ensure security and compliance requirements are met

* Ensure products are operationally ready and supported post‑release.

**Value Realization & Continuous Improvement**

* Define and track adoption, usage, and value metrics across the product portfolio.
* Ensure products deliver measurable business impact, not just functionality.
* Identify opportunities to:

+ Simplify or consolidate products
+ Reduce technical or vendor dependency
+ Improve scalability and user experience

* Continuously refine product direction based on feedback and performance insights.

**Required**
**Qualifications & Experience**

* 7+ years of experience in Product Ownership, Product Management, Business Analysis, or Analytics/Data‑centric leadership roles.
* Proven experience owning multiple products or domains in a complex enterprise environment.
* Strong understanding of enterprise data, analytics, reporting, and BI platforms.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively with senior business stakeholders and technical delivery teams.
* Experience leading or mentoring other Product Owners or equivalent roles.

**Preferred**

* Experience within a Chief Data Office, Analytics COE, or Enterprise Reporting organization.
* Familiarity with platforms such as Databricks, Power BI, semantic models, and self‑service analytics.
* Experience modernizing legacy reporting or analytics platforms.
* Background in professional services or financial services environments.

**Leadership Behaviors & Expectations**

* Thinks and acts portfolio‑first, not story‑by‑story.
* Brings clarity, structure, and discipline to ambiguity.
* Comfortable making—and defending—trade‑off decisions.
* Focused on outcomes, adoption, and trust, not just delivery.
* Acts as a role model for product ownership maturity.

**Role Relationships (Clarity of Accountability)**

* Lead Product Owner: Defines long‑term strategy, investment priorities, and value realization. Owns execution alignment, product standards, and delivery outcomes across a portfolio.
* Product Owners: Own day‑to‑day product execution and backlogs within specific domains.
* Program Managers: Own delivery coordination, milestones, and dependency management.

**Why This Role Matters**
The Lead Product Owner ensures CDO can
**scale product‑led execution without chaos**
, reducing reliance on individual heroics while increasing predictability, trust, and impact across enterprise data and analytics investments.

title: TC-CS-IAM-Tech BA-Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-Cyber Security-IAM- Tech BA- Senior**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We’re looking for consultants in the cyber security team to work on various Identity and Access Management projects for our customers across the globe. Also, the professional shall need to report any identified risks within engagements and share any issues and updates with the leadership/management on a timely basis
  
  
In line with EY’s commitment to quality, you’ll confirm that work is of the highest quality as per EY’s quality standards and is reviewed by the next-level reviewer. As an influential member of the team, you’ll help to create a positive learning culture, coach and counsel junior team members and help them to develop.
  
  
As a member of the Identity and Access Management (IAM) team this position will contribute towards execution of an IAM roadmap that meets security requirements, implementation and adoption of secrets management, management of machine identities and definition of access policies that meet their needs and are in line with overall IAM Program.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* 3-5 Years of expertise and strong understanding of end-to-end Identity Governance & Administration (IGA) capabilities and its processes, including Identity Lifecycle Management, Access Requests, Approvals, Access Reviews, RBAC, SoD, and Application Onboarding.
* Proven ability to gather, analyse, and document business and technical requirements, translating stakeholder needs into functional specifications, user stories, process flows, and implementation-ready requirements.
* Hands-on experience in application onboarding, RBAC, SoD, compliance, and governance initiatives, ensuring alignment with security policies, audit requirements, and regulatory standards.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, and documentation skills, with the ability to independently lead workshops and discussions with application owners, business stakeholders, and technical teams for assessments, discovery, and requirements elicitation.
* Experience conducting IGA maturity assessments, current-state and future-state analysis, gap assessments, and providing strategic recommendations to improve governance, automation, and compliance.
* Ability to drive testing, user acceptance, deployment readiness, and adoption activities, ensuring successful implementation and business adoption of IGA solutions

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment**
: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture:**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits**
: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply:**
If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Product Manager (AI & Software Delivery)
description:
**Who We Are**
At Techdome, we turn hard business problems into well-built software. Our engineers, designers, and domain specialists work side by side with clients across industries to ship products that set them apart, and AI is now part of almost everything we build.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We need a Product Manager who is as comfortable in an architecture review as in a client steering meeting. You will own projects from the first scoping conversation through to launch, keeping them on schedule, within budget, and tied to real business outcomes. You'll work with teams building traditional software as well as LLM-powered products, chatbots, AI agents, and automation.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Shape the plan: Work with stakeholders to set scope, goals, timelines, milestones, and budgets that are technically realistic and aligned with business priorities.
* Keep teams moving together: Coordinate UI/UX, frontend, backend, mobile, QA, DevOps, and business analysis so handoffs are clean and nobody is blocked.
* Deliver AI/ML projects: Guide LLM integrations, chatbots, AI agents, and automation initiatives from idea to production, partnering closely with engineers, data scientists, and ML specialists.
* Learn each client's world fast: Absorb a client's industry and turn its domain rules and compliance needs into clear, buildable requirements.
* Manage people and partners: Allocate internal resources, and handle third-party vendors, including contracts, expectations, and performance.
* Control change and risk: Run disciplined change control over scope, schedule, and cost, and spot technical, delivery, and AI-specific risks early enough to act on them.
* Report with clarity: Track progress in JIRA or Azure DevOps and give management and clients honest, regular status updates.
* Be a trusted partner to clients: Build lasting relationships through open, proactive communication.
* Document and automate: Keep project records complete and easy to find, and use AI tools to speed up planning and reporting.

**What You Bring**

* 3+ years as a Product Manager on software or technology projects, with a track record of delivering complex work on time and on budget.
* Solid experience leading cross-functional teams (design, development, QA, DevOps) and a real understanding of how each function operates.
* Working knowledge of Agile (Scrum/Kanban) and Waterfall, plus tools like JIRA, Azure DevOps, Trello, or Asana.
* Strong technical grounding in the SDLC, system architecture (APIs, microservices, databases), cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP), and CI/CD, enough to join technical debates and challenge estimates with confidence.
* Hands-on exposure to AI/ML or Generative AI projects, including the AI lifecycle (data, model evaluation, deployment, monitoring) and its risks: privacy, bias, hallucinations, and cost.
* Experience in more than one domain, such as FinTech, Healthcare, E-commerce, EdTech, Logistics, or SaaS, and the ability to pick up new domains and their compliance standards quickly.
* Strong risk management, change management, vendor management, and stakeholder communication skills.

**Nice to Have**

* Certifications such as PMP, PRINCE2, CSM, CSPO, or an AI or cloud credential.
* Deep expertise in at least one industry domain.

**Why Techdome?**

* Own AI-driven, technically demanding projects across a variety of industries.
* Work with experienced designers, engineers, QA specialists, and AI experts, with real say in how your projects are run.

title: Technical Product Manager
description:
TransUnion's Job Applicant Privacy Notice
  
  
**Team Overview**
What: we drive credit risk solution delivery as technical product managers
  
  
How: we deliver new products to market, enhance existing products, modernize our platforms and products, and innovate new technical solutions for customers
  
  
Who: Technical product mangement leader will be Carla Leatherman This is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in-person at an assigned TU office location for a minimum of two days a week.
  
  
**Overview**
**Role Overview And Core Responsibilities**
We are seeking a Technical Product Manager, Advisor to own technical delivery and application outcomes for a major product area or program workstream. You will translate strategy into a feasible 2–3 PI roadmap and lead multiple teams through design, build, testing, release, adoption, and continuous improvement.
  
  
This role may support real-time products and partners with Solutions, Data Science, Analytics, Compliance, Engineering, and Operations to deliver scalable credit risk solutions.
  
  
Success requires technical fluency, concise communication, independent judgment, and influence across a complex matrix. The TPM Advisor aligns partners, manages dependencies, and escalates issues with clear options and trade-offs.
  
  
**Why the role exists:**
Turn product strategy into coordinated technical delivery for complex, multi-team initiatives, specifically for our online credit risk products.
  
  
**Outcomes it drives:**
Predictable delivery, scalable and compliant solutions, stronger adoption, reliability, customer value, and growth.
  
  
**What the person owns:**
The roadmap, priorities, dependencies, risks, cross-functional decisions, release readiness, launch, and continuous improvement for online credit risk products.
  
  
**Core Responsibilities**
**Required Knowledge And Experiences**
**Workstream Strategy & Delivery Leadership**

* Translate strategy into a feasible, KPI-aligned roadmap for a major workstream across multiple teams and 2–3 PIs.
* Own priorities, sequencing, capacity assumptions, delivery waterlines, dependencies, and readiness criteria.
* Lead strategic Alternative Credit initiatives, including Alternative Data, Blended Scores, integrations, compliance, modernization, and customer onboarding.
* Resolve competing priorities using customer value, impact, risk, feasibility, urgency, and opportunity cost.
* Maintain predictable delivery by surfacing trade-offs and driving timely corrective action.

**Cross Functional Program Leadership**

* Lead complex delivery across Solutions, Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, Compliance, Operations, Architecture, Customer Success, and support teams.
* Turn roadmap commitments into outcome-based plans with clear milestones, owners, forecasts, dependencies, and success measures.
* Manage cross-team risks, impediments, and decisions; escalate with clear options, impacts, and recommendations.
* Establish planning, forecasting, risk-review, and KPI cadences that improve transparency and accountability.
* Provide stakeholders clear visibility into delivery health, changes, and corrective actions.

**Product Development Lifecycle Ownership**

* Own delivery from discovery and commitment through launch, adoption, and iteration.
* Maintain traceability across outcomes, roadmap commitments, requirements, delivery plans, releases, and results.
* Re-plan using customer feedback, KPIs, regulatory changes, risk, capacity, and readiness.
* Lead discovery, requirements, and solution trade-offs for complex, high-visibility initiatives.
* Ensure regulatory, model-governance, audit, data-quality, operational, and customer requirements are met.

**Quality, Risk & Operational Readiness**

* Lead workstream-level delivery, technical, operational, security, compliance, regulatory, and customer risk management.
* Maintain mitigation plans, escalation paths, release gates, readiness reviews, and clear accountability across teams.
* Balance timeline, scope, quality, technical debt, and operational risk in delivery recommendations.
* Partner with engineering to monitor reliability, defects, stability, and post-launch outcomes.
* Use root-cause analysis and lessons learned to reduce recurring issues and rework.

**Technical Expectations**
The Technical Product Manager understands application architecture, data flows, integration patterns, cloud constraints, and operational considerations well enough to guide delivery decisions with engineering.
  
  

* Partner with engineering and architecture on application design, implementation, testing, documentation, and operational readiness.
* Guide data-processing and integration decisions involving data movement, performance, resilience, debugging, and environment readiness.
* Partner with Data Science and Analytics to productionize models, features, score workflows, monitoring, and performance measures.
* Balance customer value, compliance, reliability, scalability, time to value, and technical debt.
* Communicate requirements, decisions, risks, trade-offs, and status clearly to technical teams and leaders.

**Leadership Expectations**
Lead through influence and ambiguity, align teams on priorities and trade-offs, and operate independently while strengthening delivery practices and outcomes.
  
  

* Set clear workstream priorities and delivery guardrails while empowering teams to execute.
* Build commitment through evidence, transparency, and clear trade-offs.
* Influence stakeholders without direct authority and maintain alignment through change.
* Coach junior TPMs and partner teams on planning, execution, risk, and accountability.

**Qualifications**

* Typically 8+ years in technical product management, application development, engineering, systems analysis, or data-processing delivery, including ownership of a major workstream across multiple teams.
* Bachelor’s degree required; financial services, insurance, or banking experience preferred.
* Experience with Agile/Scrum or SAFe delivery from requirements through post-launch adoption.
* Proven ability to translate strategy into a KPI-aligned 2–3 PI roadmap with priorities, capacity, waterlines, dependencies, and trade-offs.
* Demonstrated ownership of multi-team execution, credible forecasts, cross-functional decisions, and corrective action.
* Experience leading risk, quality, release, and operational readiness, including evidence-based escalation and post-launch improvement.
* Strong technical partnership skills across application design, data processing, integrations, cloud platforms, performance, resiliency, and operational readiness.
* Clear written and verbal communication for business, technical, and senior leadership audiences.
* Ability to influence without authority and strengthen the practices of junior TPMs and partner teams.
* Preferred: Experience with credit risk, consumer reporting, FCRA, model governance, alternative data, scores or predictive models, cloud modernization, and GCP or AWS in an online environment; SAFe PO/PM or related certification.

**Expectations in the First 90 Days**

* Learn the product strategy, application ecosystem, delivery model, FactorTrust platform, Alternative Data products, Blended Scores, customer use cases, and regulatory context.
* Build strong partnerships across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, Compliance, Operations, Legal, Marketing, and Customer Success.
* Assess the roadmap, delivery health, dependencies, quality controls, and operational risks; recommend an initial 2–3 PI plan.
* Establish a multi-team cadence for planning, forecasting, risk review, decisions, KPI reporting, ownership, and escalation.

**What You’ll Accomplish Beyond 90 Days**

* Independently lead discovery, solution design, delivery, testing, release, and adoption for complex initiatives.
* Own a feasible, KPI-aligned roadmap and delivery waterline across multiple teams and 2–3 PIs.
* Drive Alternative Credit and FactorTrust initiatives from concept through production, including compliance and modernization work.
* Lead quality, risk, release, and operational readiness; identify exposure early and drive mitigation.
* Deliver measurable improvements in customer value, adoption, reliability, compliance, efficiency, and growth.
* Introduce reusable planning, forecasting, governance, and readiness practices

At TransUnion, we encourage and are committed to creating a real, positive impact and shared sense of purpose within our
**Workforce for Good**
, which empowers our people to grow, innovate and contribute to a better future for our communities and customers. We strive to build an environment where our associates are in the driver’s seat of their professional development— while having access to help along the way. We recognize that success comes when our associates thrive both professionally and personally; that’s why we prioritize work/life flexibility and offer resources for our teams across the globe to collaborate and drive excellence.
  
  
Be a part of our
**Workforce for Good**
– you’ll work with great people, pioneering products and cutting-edge technology.

Advisor, Product Management

title: Digital Product Mgr-AI&D
description:
**Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients**
At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.
  
  
Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.
  
  
Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.
  
  
**Digital Product Manager (AI)**
The Digital Product Manager at Amgen oversees the lifecycle of digital products, working closely with various teams to define the product vision, roadmap, and growth opportunities.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a Digital Product Manager, to join the AI & Data Innovation Lab Product Management Team. This role is focused on rapidly validating high-potential AI and data-driven business opportunities before major investment, helping Amgen determine which AI initiatives should be scaled, refined, paused, or redirected.
  
  
Operating at the intersection of business strategy, AI product innovation, data, technology, and enterprise transformation, this role will provide strategic product leadership across ambiguous, cross-functional opportunities and influence senior business and technology stakeholders on product direction, prioritization, investment, and scale.
  
  
This role requires a strong product mindset, sufficient technical depth to evaluate whether AI and data opportunities are practical, scalable, measurable, and aligned to Amgen’s enterprise technology direction. The successful candidate will understand how AI products are built, validated, deployed, monitored, and scaled in complex enterprise environments.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Design and execute rapid discovery sprints, prototypes, pilots, user research, and experiments to assess desirability, feasibility, viability, value, and risk. Use evidence to determine whether opportunities should advance, pivot, pause, or scale.
* Identify, frame, and validate AI-enabled business opportunities across Amgen. Translate broad transformation themes into clear problem statements, testable hypotheses, user needs, data requirements, success metrics, and validation plans.
* Assess how LLMs, AI agents, machine learning models, NLP, automation, knowledge retrieval, analytics, and intelligent workflow tools can improve productivity, decision quality, scientific discovery, operational efficiency, and workforce effectiveness.
* Evaluate whether proposed AI opportunities have the right data foundations, system integrations, architecture patterns, model capabilities, security controls, and operational support needed to move from concept to scalable solution.
* Partner with engineering, data science, and technical teams to align on scope, tradeoffs, and execution path.
* Conduct landscape assessments across different industries to learn how AI is leveraged to solve shared problem spaces at the macro level.
* Develop product requirements that account for user experience, data availability, model performance, output quality, explainability, reliability, latency, integration needs, governance, and ongoing measurement.
* Synthesize findings from validation work into clear product recommendations, opportunity briefs, technical feasibility assessments, business cases, and executive-ready narratives. Help leaders make informed decisions about where to invest, scale, or stop.
* Ensure validation efforts consider responsible AI, data privacy, model risk, cybersecurity, compliance, regulatory considerations, human oversight, change management, and enterprise scalability from the earliest stages of discovery.
* Facilitate workshops, discovery sessions, prioritization discussions, technical feasibility reviews, user experience design, process mapping, and decision forums. Communicate complex AI and data concepts in a clear, business-oriented way for senior leaders and non-technical stakeholders.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* 8-13 years of work experience in the related field
* Doctorate; or Master’s degree and 2 years of Information Systems, Technology, Product, Digital, AI, Data, Business Transformation, or related experience; or
* Bachelor’s degree and 4 years of Information Systems, Technology, Product, Digital, AI, Data, Business Transformation, or related experience; or
* Associate’s degree and 8 years of Information Systems, Technology, Product, Digital, AI, Data, Business Transformation, or related experience; or
* High School Diploma or GED and 10 years of Information Systems, Technology, Product, Digital, AI, Data, Business Transformation, or related experience.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 4+ years of product management, product strategy, innovation, consulting, digital transformation, or related experience.
* 2+ years of experience with AI, machine learning, data products, automation, LLMs, agents, NLP, analytics, or enterprise AI solutions.
* Working knowledge of AI product development, including discovery, prototyping, model evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and iteration.
* Familiarity with generative AI, LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation, AI agents, prompt engineering, model orchestration, NLP, predictive analytics, or intelligent automation.
* Design thinking experience
* Ability to evaluate AI opportunities across desirability, feasibility, viability, value, risk, scalability, and data readiness.
* Experience with AI platforms, MLOps, or enterprise AI architecture.
* Familiarity with AI (e.g., LLMs, agents, NLP) and ML productization at scale.
* Strong presentation and public speaking skills with experience communicating to executives
* Familiarity with biotech workflows (e.g., lab automation, computational biology, clinical data, etc).
* Hands-on ability to analyze product usage, model output quality, or design A/B experiments.
* Comfort working in fast-paced, cross-functional environments where priorities evolve quickly.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, including the ability to build relationships and collaborate effectively across functions and levels.
* Consulting experience, with demonstrated ability to structure and solve complex business problems.
* Experience conducting cross-industry landscape assessments to identify how AI is being leveraged to address shared problem spaces and uncover macro-level trends and opportunities

title: Founder's Office Associate
description:
**About The Role**
Great ideas often die in the gap between a leadership discussion and actual execution. This role exists to close that gap. As a right hand to Techdome's CEO and CTO, you'll take rough, unfinished thoughts from strategy conversations and shape them into clear plans with timelines and named owners, then follow each one through to completion.
  
  
You'll work across Engineering, Marketing, BD, and Ops, pushing priorities from "we should do this" to "it's live." You'll also keep hunting for ways AI and automation can take over the manual, repetitive work that slows the business down.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Turn CEO/CTO discussions into structured action plans with clear owners, deadlines, and next steps
* Lead cross-functional initiatives across Engineering, Marketing, BD, and Ops through to real completion, not just progress reports
* Spot operational bottlenecks early and clear them before they become fire drills
* Build sharp, client-ready pitch decks, proposals, and briefing documents for founder-led meetings
* Join client and BD conversations and own the follow-up as if the deal were your own
* Run market, competitor, and customer research and turn it into recommendations the team can act on
* Identify recurring manual work (research, reporting, documentation) and build AI-powered or automated replacements
* Pick up ad hoc, cross-cutting projects that don't belong to any one team

**Who You Are**

* 6+ months in a Founder's Office, BizOps, Strategy, BD, or early-stage startup role
* Someone who has delivered results without a ready-made playbook
* Highly self-driven: you see what's missing and fix it before anyone asks
* Comfortable with ambiguity and with priorities that change within a single week
* Skilled at building compelling PowerPoint decks and Excel/Google Sheets models
* Someone who uses AI tools as a core part of your daily workflow, not an afterthought
* Trustworthy with confidential information, and able to juggle many threads without dropping details

**Bonus Points**

* Experience in a fast-paced, high-pressure startup or founder's office
* Exposure to client-facing work or business development
* Hands-on familiarity with Notion, Asana, or Trello
* Understanding of how AI, SaaS, Healthcare, Fintech, or Enterprise Tech businesses work
* An MBA is welcome, but a proven bias for execution counts for far more

**Why Techdome?**

* Real ownership: You'll be part of strategy, technology, AI, BD, client relationships, and operations, as a driver rather than an observer
* Proximity to leadership: Regular, direct access to the CEO and CTO, and a seat where key decisions are made
* Wide scope: You'll work across the whole business, with no pre-packaged tasks and no room to coast
* Growth path: A clear route into a broader leadership or strategy role as your impact grows

**What Success Looks Like**
Ideas raised in leadership discussions keep turning into finished results on your watch. The right people are aligned, blockers are removed quickly, and nothing important falls through the cracks.

Amgen helped establish the biotechnology industry more than 40 years ago and remains at the forefront of innovation, using technology, data, AI, and human genetic insights to push beyond what is known today.

The Associate Director, Product Development (PD) Technology will serve as a senior site and capability leader responsible for scaling and leading PD Tech teams at Amgen in support of global Product Development priorities. This role operates within a global capability model and will partner closely with OPS PD Tech Leads in the U.S. and other global stakeholders to understand strategic priorities, translate them into actionable execution plans, and ensure delivery across India-based teams. The role requires leadership across a flexible reporting model. Some product teams may report directly to U.S.-based leaders, while others may report through India-based leadership. Regardless of reporting structure, this leader will be accountable for creating alignment, enabling strong execution, advancing consistent standards, and fostering a high-performance culture.
  
  
The ideal candidate will have a proven record of leading managers and technology/product teams in a global matrixed environment, with experience driving portfolio execution, maturing operating models, establishing KPIs, improving productivity through AI-enabled ways of working, and building strong partnerships with senior stakeholders.

That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Join us to put AI to work for people.
  
  
**Job Description**
ServiceNow is changing the way people work. With a service-orientation toward the activities, tasks and processes that make up day-to-day work life, we help the modern enterprise operate faster and be more scalable than ever before.
  
  
We are looking for a Staff Product Manager who can help lead the effort to build a consumer-grade user experience for ServiceNow’s products. **Company Overview**
Lilly, a leading innovation-driven corporation is developing a growing portfolio of pharmaceutical products by applying the latest research from its own worldwide laboratories and from collaborations with eminent scientific organizations. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, Lilly makes life better – through medicines and information – for some of the world’s most urgent medical needs. Founded over 150 years ago, the company has sustained a culture that values excellence, integrity and respect for people. This has resulted in Lilly frequently being ranked as one of the best companies in the world at which to work. Lilly knows its business has prospered because of its employees – people with a talent for innovation and a passion for making a difference by finding treatments for the most stubborn diseases; people whose talent is matched by their generosity, and people with strong values and a determination to prevail, regardless of the challenges. Join our team – and make a difference in improving health for people all over the world!
  
  
**Manufacturing and Quality Technical Hub Hyderabad**
Lilly has made a strategic investment of more than $1B dollars to establish a Manufacturing and Quality technical hub. This hub will oversee the significant investment in contract manufacturing of starting materials and intermediates for API manufacturing in India and the technical services responsible for managing the scientific agenda for manufacturing and quality. The hub will be recruiting top talent in the areas of process engineering, chemistry, analytical and data sciences to build a cutting-edge scientific organization supporting the exciting manufacturing portfolio of Lilly.
  
  
**About This Role**
Lilly’s product commercialization spans a growing global manufacturing network, dozens of specialized functions, and an expanding portfolio of transformative medicines. The gap: no single leader owns the full picture.
  
  
This role fills that gap. You are the single point of accountability for a product’s entire commercialization lifecycle—from post-Phase 2 through launch and beyond. You own the manufacturing CMC strategy, lead the Product Core Team, collaborate with development, and serve as the go-to interface for senior executives who need clarity, not noise.
  
  
This is a strategic leadership role, not a coordination role. It demands deep pharma development and/or manufacturing knowledge, executive presence, and the ability to drive alignment across a powerful, matrixed organization — without direct authority.
  
  
**What Success Looks Like In Year One**
Lilly’s commercialization process involves deep, specialized functions — Development, Engineering, Analytical Quality, TS/MS, Supply Chain, Manufacturing Sites, and CMC Regulatory. Each brings critical expertise. The winning Manufacturing CMC Project Manager orchestrates them: knowing when to convene the full team, and when to engage only who’s needed — protecting expert time and driving efficient progress. In year one, you will have demonstrated:
  
  

* Stakeholder orchestration credibility — functional leaders trust that when you call them in, it matters; when you don’t, it’s handled.
* A Mfg technical agenda that serves as the true single source of truth — every relevant function’s input synthesized into one coherent product strategy.
* At least one major bottleneck resolved through smart, targeted convening — the right people in the room, no one else.
* Senior leaders who say you “always know where the product stands” — earned through disciplined intelligence-gathering, not reporting overhead.
* A product team operating with more speed and purpose than before — siloed expertise channeled into coordinated, forward momentum.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Manufacturing CMC Strategy & Commercialization Ownership**

* Own the Manufacturing CMC Commercialization Strategy across Development, Manufacturing, and Business Units.
* Lead the Product Core Team and oversee its technical execution, ensuring clear ownership, milestone accountability, and proactive risk management.
* Drive alignment of launch presentation and commercial image strategy across relevant functional and affiliate stakeholders.
* Ensure gate deliverables are clearly defined, plans are in place, and execution is on track; proactively identifying and resolving gaps.

**Governance & Executive Visibility**

* Serve as the accountable representative for the product at all Governance and Oversight Forums, providing clear, confident updates on progress, risks, and decisions required.
* Act as the primary interface for senior executives seeking visibility into commercialization status — translating technical complexity into concise, actionable insight.
* Ensure escalations are surfaced proactively and resolved with appropriate speed and rigor.
* Demonstrates proficiency in using enterprise project management, collaboration, and reporting tools to drive transparency and execution excellence.

**Cross-Functional Alignment & Stakeholder Leadership**

* Ensure sustained alignment across Development, Manufacturing, and Business Unit stakeholders throughout the product’s lifecycle, including global manufacturing site teams and CMC Regulatory.
* Influence without authority across a complex, matrixed organization — building trust, resolving conflict, and driving decisions through collaboration rather than directive.
* Partner closely with Development and CMC Regulatory on submission strategy, ensuring the manufacturing program supports regulatory timelines and requirements.

**Post-Launch Technical Agenda**

* Lead Post-Launch Technical Agenda (PLTA) strategy for assigned products, influencing pre-submission deliverables and lifecycle management planning.
* Ensure the product’s long-term commercial and technical sustainability by driving proactive planning for process improvements, line extensions, and continuous manufacturing optimization.

**Required Qualifications**
**Education**

* Advanced engineering, scientific degree (M.S., Ph.D., or MBA with strong technical foundation). Advanced degrees are preferred although a Bachelor with equivalent industry experience may also be considered.

**Experience**

* Minimum 8 years of progressive pharmaceutical industry experience, with meaningful exposure to development, manufacturing, commercialization, and/or technical program leadership.
* Experience with both drug substance and drug product. Small or large molecule experience.
* Demonstrated experience leading or significantly contributing to cross-functional programs through key development and commercialization milestones (e.g., tech transfer, process validation, regulatory submission readiness, product launch).
* Ability to evaluate manufacturing network strategies and their impact on launch readiness, supply continuity, cost, and lifecycle management.
* Proven ability to influence and lead without direct authority across complex, matrixed organizations.
* Track record of operating effectively at the senior leadership level — communicating with confidence, handling ambiguity, and making high-quality decisions under pressure.

**Functional Background (one Or More Areas Preferred)**

* TS/MS, CMC development, Operations, Supply Chain, or Mfg.

**Key Skills & Competencies**

* Strategic Leadership: Shapes long-range manufacturing CMC commercialization strategy; translates vision into execution.
* Influence Without Authority: Drives alignment and decisions across powerful, matrixed stakeholders without formal reporting relationships.
* Change Leadership: Leads teams through organizational, technical, and strategic change while maintaining stakeholder engagement and execution momentum
* Executive Communication: Distills complex technical and operational information into clear, confident narratives for senior audiences.
* Negotiation & Conflict Resolution: Balances competing functional and affiliate priorities with fairness, speed, and strategic judgment.
* Commercial Acumen: Understands the business implications of manufacturing decisions — including supply risk, launch readiness, and lifecycle value.
* Risk Management: Proactively identifies, surfaces, and resolves program risks before they become schedule or quality issues.
* Cross-Cultural & Global Collaboration: Effective working across global manufacturing sites, development organizations, and business units with varying priorities.
* Entrepreneurial Mindset: Comfortable operating in an evolving role structure; builds credibility and process from the ground up.

**Schedule**

* Flexible in supporting critical business discussions outside standard local working hours to meet global business needs.

**Location**
Lilly Manufacturing India -Hyderabad

title: Lead Business Process Engineer (Process Automation) - Officer
description:
**Who We Are Looking For**
We are seeking a hands-on process and knowledge engineer to join Alpha Intelligence, State Street’s AI & Automation Center of Excellence for Alpha Implementations. You will help transform complex processes end to end — understanding how work is done today, designing simpler future-state processes, and enabling automation and AI solutions that improve speed, control and client outcomes.
  
  
The ideal candidate is analytical, structured and delivery-focused, comfortable working directly with subject-matter experts, and able to own a workstream of process discovery and documentation end to end with limited supervision.
  
  
**Why this role is important to us**
Alpha Intelligence goes beyond documenting processes — we redesign how Alpha implementations are delivered. This role connects process discovery, future-state design, automation and AI, implementation and continuous improvement.
  
  
**About The Team — Alpha Intelligence**
Alpha Intelligence is State Street’s AI & Automation Center of Excellence for Alpha Implementations — the team rewiring how the industry’s first front-to-back platform gets delivered. We turn the deep expertise locked inside our implementation teams into engineered processes, governed knowledge and intelligent agents that cut manual effort, compress client go-live timelines and make every implementation faster and more predictable than the last.
  
  
We operate as one global team across the US, UK, Europe, India and APAC, combining process engineering, automation delivery, AI platform engineering and responsible-AI governance under a single roof. We work on real client implementations, not pilots that sit on a shelf — what we build is adopted, measured and scaled. If you want to shape how AI is applied to one of the most complex delivery landscapes in financial services, this is the team to do it in.
  
  
**What You Will Be Responsible For**

* Conduct process discovery through interviews, shadowing, walkthroughs and system observation with implementation and operations subject-matter experts.
* Own end-to-end process transformation for assigned workstreams, from discovery and future-state design through implementation, adoption and continuous improvement.
* Map and assess current-state processes, including handoffs, systems, data, controls and exceptions, to identify root causes, effort, risk and friction.
* Design simpler, standardized future-state processes that improve controls and use the right mix of people, process, data, automation and AI.
* Structure and tag content for search, RAG and agent use, ensuring knowledge assets are discoverable, accurate and maintainable.
* Validate process and knowledge assets with subject-matter experts, manage signoffs and maintain version control.
* Prioritize redesign, automation and AI opportunities, and define the expected benefits and success measures.
* Turn approved future-state designs into clear requirements and implementation plans, working with automation, AI, technology, operations and change teams.
* Support rollout and adoption, track results, and use feedback to improve the process over time.
* Maintain accurate status, progress and delivery reporting for your assigned workstream, escalating risks and blockers early.
* Coordinate across regional teams and time zones to enable seamless handoffs and effective dependency management.

**What We Value**

* Strong structured thinking and attention to detail — precision matters in process and knowledge engineering.
* Curiosity and persistence in getting to the real process, not just the documented one.
* Self-driven delivery with the ability to produce quality outcomes with minimal follow-up.
* Clear, concise written and verbal communication, especially in documentation.
* A collaborative mindset and comfort working with senior subject-matter experts and global stakeholders.

**Experience And Capabilities That Will Help You Succeed**

* 10 to 15 years of relevant experience in business process analysis, process documentation, operations, transformation or automation delivery within financial services.
* Working knowledge of investment management or capital markets operations across front, middle and back office and the trade lifecycle.
* Hands-on experience with process mapping and documentation methods and tools, exposure to BPMN, Visio, UiPath Task Capture, ARIS or comparable platforms is beneficial.
* Familiarity with automation platforms such as UiPath and an understanding of what makes a process automatable.
* Good understanding of AI and GenAI concepts, including how structured knowledge and content quality drive RAG and agent performance.
* Strong analytical and documentation skills, with proficiency in relevant collaboration, data and presentation tools such as JIRA, Confluence, SQL, Excel or PowerPoint; equivalent tools and transferable experience are welcome.
* Ability to plan, prioritize and deliver milestones in a fast-moving programme environment.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with regional teams, occasional participation outside local working hours may be required for planned handoffs or critical discussions.

**Education & Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Technology, Engineering, Finance, Management or Information Systems, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
* Process excellence or automation certifications (e.g., Lean Six Sigma, BPM, UiPath) are an advantage.

**Interested but do not meet every qualification?**
If your experience and transferable skills align with the overall role, we encourage you to apply. We value different paths to building relevant expertise and will consider the full picture of what you can bring to the team.
  
  
**About State Street**
Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.
  
  
We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

**General Summary**
The CHS (Central Hardware System) Operations team is looking for a Staff Project Analyst, based in India, with a drive to self-succeed and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment. This person will lead operations and resource planning across the chipset programs we engage on out of the region, providing program and operations support to hardware engineering and design teams while working closely with global cross-geo teams across US time zones. They will lead the development and management of processes, procedures, and tools that increase productivity and improve existing flows, and recommend alternate system management tools to satisfy core business objectives

* Bachelor's degree and 2+ years of relevant work experience.

OR
  
  
Associate's degree and 4+ years of relevant work experience.
  
  
OR
  
  
High School Diploma or equivalent and 6+ years of relevant work experience.
  
  

* Completed advanced degrees in a relevant field may be substituted for up to two years (Master’s = one year, Doctorate = two years) of work experience.

Principal Duties and Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead operations, resource, and capacity planning across the region's chipset programs — spanning CAD, Mechanical, and PCB design activities — in partnership with hardware platform program managers.
* Own and continuously enhance CHS Operations systems, SharePoint lists, and Power Automate flows that support program execution; drive enhancement requests from intake through release.
* Own end-to-end hardware R&D program management — project-manage from design through tape-out, fab, builds, bring-up, testing, and release.

* Drive the fiscal year budget intake and consolidation process; build and operate budget dashboards that give leadership a real-time view of plan vs. actuals and forecast risk.
* Design, build, and maintain executive dashboards using Power BI (and Tableau where applicable) that turn operational data into decisions; define KPIs, data models, and refresh cadence.
* Provide operations leadership and consultation to functional teams across the program; serve as the connective tissue between program management, engineering, finance, and supplier-facing teams.
* Lead resource planning, capacity modeling, and gap analysis across active and pipeline projects; surface staffing and bandwidth risks early.
* Drive product reviews across core program meetings — own agendas, capture decisions and action items, and hold owners accountable to closure with documented evidence.
* Own end-to-end management of program milestones, change requests, and risks.
* Coordinate material ordering for Mechanical teardowns and prototype builds, and support substrate prototype ordering.
* Establish and roll out new program management processes, methods, and tools (tracking systems, schedules, databases, documentation management) — and retire those that no longer deliver value.
* Lead project planning activities including integrated schedules, work breakdown structures, dependency maps, and critical-path analysis.
* Architect Power Automate workflows on top of new and existing SharePoint lists to eliminate manual operational toil and improve data quality.
* Mentor junior project analysts and program coordinators; codify reusable templates, playbooks, and operating standards.
* Represent CHS Operations to senior leadership (Director / VP audience) — produce executive briefings, gate review packages, and quarterly business reviews.

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, Industrial Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.

* Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel (complex formulas, pivots, Power Query), SharePoint Online (lists and document libraries), Power Automate, Power BI, PowerPoint, and Visio.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with proven ability to organize and articulate complex information for both engineering and executive audiences.
* Strong presentation skills, sharp analytical judgment, and rigorous attention to detail.
* Working understanding of the semiconductor product lifecycle, from concept through high-volume manufacturing.
* Demonstrated ability to operate across multiple time zones and cultures with global teams and external suppliers, including regular collaboration with US-based teams.

* Experience with SQL, Python, or other scripting languages to automate data pipelines and reporting.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft 365 Copilot, AI-assisted analytics, or other modern automation platforms applied to operations workflows.

* Experience standing up new operational processes from scratch and scaling them across a global organization.

title: Sr. Product Manager, Operations Evaluation, Worldwide Returns and Recommerce
description:
**Description**
In the Worldwide Returns & ReCommerce (WW R&R) group at Amazon, we are dedicated to ‘making zero happen’ – zero cost of returns, zero waste, and zero defects – to benefit our customers, company, and environment. We are an agile and inclusive organization that constantly innovates to create long-term value by investing in our people and our planet, not simply focusing on the bottom line.
  
  
WW R&R includes business, product, operations, data, and software engineering teams, who together manage the lifecycle of returned and damaged products. In WW R&R, you will partner across these teams to help customers get the most value out of Amazon’s products; improve the customer returns experience; and reduce defects, waste, and cost in reverse logistics processes. You will be a leader, a builder, and an owner, collaborating cross-functionally with technical, operations, and business teams to design scalable and automated solutions to customer problems.
  
  
Evaluation Automation charter is dedicated to grading every returned item with machine-learned precision instead of static rules, by building the science based scalable solutions that replace heuristic rules for sellability and recovery disposition thereby maximizing sellable yield, reducing associate subjectivity, and protecting the customer experience across Amazon's reverse logistics network.
  
  
We're looking for someone who has a passion for working in cross functional environment, strong communication skills (verbal & written) in addition to proven product management experience. Join us if you want the opportunity to make a big impact in a quickly growing team that can make a big difference in the customers' journey with Amazon.
  
  
Amazon is Earth’s most customer-centric company and in WW R&R, the Earth is our customer too. Come join us and innovate with the Amazon Worldwide Returns & ReCommerce.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**
Create vision, product strategy, roadmap, and execution across a suite of return products to improve customer trust
  
  
Develop worldwide features with huge customer-facing and financial impact
  
  
Work with technology, customer service, returns operations, retail etc. to develop a comprehensive solution to fulfil the returns CX.

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with end to end product delivery
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product

* Experience owning technology products

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights
