title: Digital Product Manager, Product Operations - Measurement & Reporting
description:
**What You Will Do**
The Digital Product Manager, Product Operations - Measurement & Reporting will help Amgen measure, understand, and improve adoption of the Digital Product Operating Model (DPOM) by supporting the measurement, analysis, and reporting capabilities used to assess product management maturity, team health, and quality of core product practices and artifacts.
  
  
Reporting to the Senior Director, Product Management - Product Operations, this individual contributor role will independently own defined measurement and reporting capabilities within the broader Product Operations strategy. The Digital Product Manager will work with Product Operations, Product Management Catalysts, digital product teams, analytics and technology partners to maintain meaningful measures, improve dashboards and reporting, conduct product maturity assessments, and translate quantitative and qualitative data into actionable insights.
  
  
This role will help distinguish activity and compliance measures from meaningful indicators of adoption, maturity, quality, and impact. The Digital Product Manager will use data, stakeholder feedback, and learning from product teams to improve measurement approaches over time and help the Product Management Hub identify where teams are progressing, where barriers remain, and where additional support or enablement may be needed.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**DPOM Measurement and Metrics**

* Manage and improve defined measures for DPOM adoption, product management maturity, team health, product artifact quality, and related Product Management Hub priorities.
* Apply established measurement frameworks and maturity dimensions across product teams, product groups, and business functions.
* Use quantitative and qualitative evidence to evaluate whether measures provide meaningful signals of adoption, maturity, quality, and impact rather than simply tracking activity or completion.
* Identify gaps in metrics, data, instrumentation, or measurement approaches and recommend practical improvements.
* Define and document data, instrumentation, and KPI requirements for assigned measurement capabilities in partnership with analytics, technology, and reporting teams.

**Dashboards, Reporting, and Insights**

* Build, maintain, and improve dashboards, scorecards, reports, and related measurement tools directly and/or in partnership with analytics, technology, and reporting teams.
* Gather, organize, analyze, and interpret DPOM-related data using platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, Jira Align, Jira, Confluence, SharePoint, ChatGPT, or similar tools.
* Prepare recurring reporting and analyses that support MBRs, QBRs, Product Management Hub reviews, and other operating rhythms.
* Translate data, trends, qualitative feedback, and product-team observations into clear findings, risks, and recommendations.
* Monitor data quality, reporting consistency, and usability of measurement outputs and work with appropriate partners to resolve issues.

**Product Management Maturity and Artifact Quality**

* Conduct and support product management maturity assessments using established DPOM frameworks and assessment approaches.
* Evaluate product management practices and artifacts such as roadmaps, OKRs, product charters, product strategies, discovery practices, prioritization approaches, and value measures.
* Identify recurring maturity gaps, adoption barriers, product management anti-patterns, and areas where teams may need additional guidance or support.
* Partner with Product Management Catalysts to incorporate field-based insights and observations from product-team engagements.
* Synthesize assessment findings so they can inform Product Operations priorities, playbook improvements, training, accelerator workshops, coaching, and other enablement activities.

**Reporting Operations and Continuous Improvement**

* Support integration of DPOM measurement and reporting into established Product Management Hub and enterprise operating rhythms.
* Independently manage assigned reporting processes, analyses, or measurement capabilities and continuously improve their quality, usefulness, and efficiency.
* Partner with Product Operations colleagues to connect measurement insights with improvements to DPOM standards, playbooks, tools, training, and adoption approaches.
* Gather feedback from product teams, leaders, and reporting users to identify opportunities to improve measurement methods, dashboards, reporting experiences, and decision support.
* Identify appropriate opportunities to use AI, automation, and reusable workflows to improve data analysis, artifact assessment, reporting, and insight generation.

**Cross-Functional Partnership and Product Community Contribution**

* Build trusted relationships with Product Operations, Product Management Catalysts, Digital Product Managers, technology leaders, business partners, analytics and reporting teams, and other cross-functional stakeholders.
* Influence product-team partners and leaders through clear communication, preparation, data, and evidence-based recommendations.
* Facilitate productive discussions about measurement findings, maturity gaps, reporting needs, data limitations, and improvement opportunities.
* Partner with data, analytics, technology, privacy, security, regulatory, and governance specialists when measurement or reporting needs require additional expertise.
* Share reusable insights, examples, and feedback that help improve DPOM measurement practices and strengthen the broader product management community.

**What We Expect Of You**
We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The Digital Product Manager, Product Operations we seek is a product-minded, analytical problem solver who can independently manage defined measurement and reporting capabilities and turn evidence into practical improvements.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of experience in Digital Product, Product Management, Product Ownership, Product Operations, Product Analytics, Business Reporting, Digital Transformation, Technology Strategy, or comparable customer- and outcome-focused work.
* Demonstrated ownership of a defined product area, capability, or comparable problem space, including the ability to make independent decisions within an established strategy and lead cross-functional delivery and iteration.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in product operations, digital product management, product analytics, business reporting, measurement, digital transformation, or related disciplines.
* Experience defining, maintaining, or improving adoption, maturity, performance, effectiveness, or quality measures for product teams, operating models, or transformation efforts.
* Understanding of product management practices including product strategy, roadmaps, OKRs, product charters, discovery, prioritization, user and business problem definition, and value measurement.
* Experience building or maintaining dashboards, scorecards, reporting mechanisms, or recurring business reporting using Power BI, Tableau, Jira Align, Jira, Confluence, SharePoint, ChatGPT, or similar platforms.
* Ability to combine quantitative data, qualitative feedback, and stakeholder perspectives into clear findings and actionable recommendations.
* Strong analytical judgment, including the ability to distinguish activity or compliance metrics from meaningful indicators of adoption, maturity, quality, and impact.
* Experience defining data, instrumentation, and KPI needs and partnering with analytics or technology specialists to improve measurement capabilities.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain data, findings, limitations, and recommendations clearly to cross-functional audiences.
* Ability to work independently within an established strategy, manage assigned priorities, navigate ambiguity, and adapt approaches based on evidence and outcomes.
* Experience partnering across product, technology, business, analytics, reporting, or enablement teams in a complex enterprise environment.
* Experience in healthcare, biotechnology, or other regulated industries preferred; candidates from high-tech, digital, consulting, or product-led organizations are also encouraged to apply.
* Familiarity with AI-native workflows, generative AI, responsible AI principles, and opportunities to use AI and automation to improve product measurement, analysis, and reporting preferred.

title: Digital Product Mgr-AI&D
description:
**Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients**
At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.
  
  
Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.
  
  
Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.
  
  
**Digital Product Manager (AI)**
The Digital Product Manager at Amgen oversees the lifecycle of digital products, working closely with various teams to define the product vision, roadmap, and growth opportunities.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a Digital Product Manager, to join the AI & Data Innovation Lab Product Management Team. This role is focused on rapidly validating high-potential AI and data-driven business opportunities before major investment, helping Amgen determine which AI initiatives should be scaled, refined, paused, or redirected.
  
  
Operating at the intersection of business strategy, AI product innovation, data, technology, and enterprise transformation, this role will provide strategic product leadership across ambiguous, cross-functional opportunities and influence senior business and technology stakeholders on product direction, prioritization, investment, and scale.
  
  
This role requires a strong product mindset, sufficient technical depth to evaluate whether AI and data opportunities are practical, scalable, measurable, and aligned to Amgen’s enterprise technology direction. The successful candidate will understand how AI products are built, validated, deployed, monitored, and scaled in complex enterprise environments.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Design and execute rapid discovery sprints, prototypes, pilots, user research, and experiments to assess desirability, feasibility, viability, value, and risk. Use evidence to determine whether opportunities should advance, pivot, pause, or scale.
* Identify, frame, and validate AI-enabled business opportunities across Amgen. Translate broad transformation themes into clear problem statements, testable hypotheses, user needs, data requirements, success metrics, and validation plans.
* Assess how LLMs, AI agents, machine learning models, NLP, automation, knowledge retrieval, analytics, and intelligent workflow tools can improve productivity, decision quality, scientific discovery, operational efficiency, and workforce effectiveness.
* Evaluate whether proposed AI opportunities have the right data foundations, system integrations, architecture patterns, model capabilities, security controls, and operational support needed to move from concept to scalable solution.
* Partner with engineering, data science, and technical teams to align on scope, tradeoffs, and execution path.
* Conduct landscape assessments across different industries to learn how AI is leveraged to solve shared problem spaces at the macro level.
* Develop product requirements that account for user experience, data availability, model performance, output quality, explainability, reliability, latency, integration needs, governance, and ongoing measurement.
* Synthesize findings from validation work into clear product recommendations, opportunity briefs, technical feasibility assessments, business cases, and executive-ready narratives. Help leaders make informed decisions about where to invest, scale, or stop.
* Ensure validation efforts consider responsible AI, data privacy, model risk, cybersecurity, compliance, regulatory considerations, human oversight, change management, and enterprise scalability from the earliest stages of discovery.
* Facilitate workshops, discovery sessions, prioritization discussions, technical feasibility reviews, user experience design, process mapping, and decision forums. Communicate complex AI and data concepts in a clear, business-oriented way for senior leaders and non-technical stakeholders.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 8-13 years of work experience in the related field
* Doctorate; or Master’s degree and 2 years of Information Systems, Technology, Product, Digital, AI, Data, Business Transformation, or related experience; or
* Bachelor’s degree and 4 years of Information Systems, Technology, Product, Digital, AI, Data, Business Transformation, or related experience; or
* Associate’s degree and 8 years of Information Systems, Technology, Product, Digital, AI, Data, Business Transformation, or related experience; or
* High School Diploma or GED and 10 years of Information Systems, Technology, Product, Digital, AI, Data, Business Transformation, or related experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 4+ years of product management, product strategy, innovation, consulting, digital transformation, or related experience.
* 2+ years of experience with AI, machine learning, data products, automation, LLMs, agents, NLP, analytics, or enterprise AI solutions.
* Working knowledge of AI product development, including discovery, prototyping, model evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and iteration.
* Familiarity with generative AI, LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation, AI agents, prompt engineering, model orchestration, NLP, predictive analytics, or intelligent automation.
* Design thinking experience
* Ability to evaluate AI opportunities across desirability, feasibility, viability, value, risk, scalability, and data readiness.
* Experience with AI platforms, MLOps, or enterprise AI architecture.
* Familiarity with AI (e.g., LLMs, agents, NLP) and ML productization at scale.
* Strong presentation and public speaking skills with experience communicating to executives
* Familiarity with biotech workflows (e.g., lab automation, computational biology, clinical data, etc).
* Hands-on ability to analyze product usage, model output quality, or design A/B experiments.
* Comfort working in fast-paced, cross-functional environments where priorities evolve quickly.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, including the ability to build relationships and collaborate effectively across functions and levels.
* Consulting experience, with demonstrated ability to structure and solve complex business problems.
* Experience conducting cross-industry landscape assessments to identify how AI is being leveraged to address shared problem spaces and uncover macro-level trends and opportunities

**nights**
a week in for cross over time with PST leadership)
  
  
**Role Description**
The Senior Business Systems Analystrole offers an exciting opportunity to join a small, high-performing technology team supporting the Results Delivery Office (RDO).

This role will be responsible for both helping build and launch new products and enhancements, as well as maintaining, supporting, and continuously improving existing AI, SharePoint, Microsoft 365, and automation products after go-live.
  
  
This is a versatile, hands-on role suited for someone who can wear many hats across business analysis, product support, roadmap planning, low-code/no-code automation, AI solution enablement, documentation, testing, release support, and operational maintenance. The role is especially well suited for a technically minded analyst or engineer who enjoys client-facing work, thrives in ambiguity, takes initiative, and wants to help a small team deliver high-value technology outcomes.

* Contribute to continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to simplify processes, reduce manual effort, increase adoption, and improve user experience.
* Operate effectively in Agile delivery models while adapting to other frameworks and ways of working as needed for the business group.

**Basic Qualifications And Experience**

* 4+ years of relevant experience in business analysis, technology analysis, product analysis, digital solutions, information systems, engineering, or a related technology delivery role.

**Functional Skills**

The DSP program is the backbone of Amazon's last-mile delivery network, operating in 22 countries with over 4,400 DSPs and 390,000+ Delivery Associates.
  
  
This role is responsible for customer experiences with considerable complexity, managing a unified data platform that serves as the single source of truth for associate information. This includes ownership of multiple concurrent product workstreams — DSP DA onboarding/off-boarding workflow, DSP onboarding/off-boarding experience, employment classification models, qualifications management, and DA data/metadata services — each requiring distinct technical approaches and stakeholder alignment. The Sr. Product Manager-Tech is responsible for driving strategic goals that span multi-million dollar cost savings, DSP satisfaction (CSAT), and DA sentiment — influencing the DA experience from the very first interaction with Amazon's systems. You will own the financial entitlement for your product area and be accountable for measurable improvements in onboarding speed, compliance automation, and operational efficiency for DSPs worldwide.
  
  
We are in the early stages of a multi-year initiative to overhaul much of the DA lifecycle experience from the ground up. This is a rare opportunity to invent and simplify at scale — redesigning foundational systems and workflows that touch hundreds of thousands of drivers globally. The role comes with significant investment backing and outsized influence in shaping what the next-generation experience looks like.
  
  
This is a global role requiring cross-regional coordination across all regions where the DSP program is established or will be established, each with distinct compliance requirements, legal frameworks, hiring models, and payment structures. The role requires distinguishing between one-way and two-way door decisions to drive rapid experimentation where possible while ensuring appropriate rigor for irreversible choices. The Sr. Product Manager-Tech serves as Voice of the Customer by generalizing requirements from diverse DSP DA personas across regions and use cases — working backward from their needs to reduce friction and time spent in onboarding and offboarding phases. Through direct engagement with DSPs, analysis of support tickets, and monitoring of operational health post-launch, the Sr. Product Manager-Tech gains insight that distinguishes between surface-level requests and underlying problems that truly matter. The Sr. Product Manager-Tech regularly drives product discussions with senior managers and Directors, producing clear documentation and contributing to OP1/OP2 planning cycles.
  
  
We are seeking a PM with expertise and high judgment to determine the right goals, design long-term solutions, and take the lead on initiatives independently while seeking direction when needed. This role operates in a space where problems, opportunities, and strategy are not always clearly defined, and the right candidate will thrive in that ambiguity.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Leading the build-out of new external facing applications, products, features and tools.
* Owning the translation of business intent, customer needs, and/or technical direction into clear, concise, well-documented business requirements or product backlog for one or more complex applications (or a product family) spanning one or more technical domains.
* Developing longer-term (12 months or more) product roadmap, ensuring product development plans align with and support stakeholder business and application objectives.
* Communicate and collaborate cross-functionally across multiple teams in operations, technology and planning to define strategic roadmaps while keeping the impact of the solution to all stakeholders in mind
* Creating and implementing data driven improvements to Amazon's transportation network
* Monitoring KPI’s to analyze their drivers and determine the level of investment needed

**About The Team**
The team consists of engineers, product managers, and program managers. These functions roll up into a shared VP with a shared goal of delivering the most efficient experience for our transportation partners.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
* 5+ years of end to end product delivery experience
* Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience bridging technical and business teams to collect and refine requirements, prioritize incoming work requests, and ensure all committed work is delivered on time
* Experience in using analytical tools, such as Tableau, Qlikview, QuickSight

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Associate Product Manager/Product Manager (Reference Standards)
description:
**Description**
**Who is USP?**
The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high-quality medicines worldwide.
  
  
At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.
  
  
USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.
  
  
**Brief Job Overview**
As part of the USP Programs, Regions, Operations, and Strategy (PROpS) Division, the Reference Standards Product Manager leads the development and management of the Small Molecules, Complex Generics, and General Chapters portfolio of reference standards. The Product Management function is responsible for overseeing the full product lifecycle (development to discontinuation), understanding key industry trends, applying data-driven and analytic decision making and making customer-focused recommendations that drive product portfolio growth. This role is an individual contributor who will be responsible for implementation of projects and processes that enable decisions about new and existing products. Core activities will also include the development of prioritization, forecasting, and financial models that enhance product mix, optimization and overall performance. This is a highly collaborative role that will be expected to work globally across the organization including Science, Operations, Sales, Regions, Pricing, Trade Compliance, and Marketing. As a product manager, this role will drive product strategy, lead cross-functional teams in planning product roadmaps, discount and promotion strategies and ensure the successful launch and growth of innovative, high-quality standards and solutions to drive USP’s mission and vision of improving global health.
  
  
**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**
As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence-based decision-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.
  
  
Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results-driven work environments.
  
  
**The Reference Standards Product Manager Has The Following Responsibilities**

* Item forecasting, pricing, and margin analysis
* Develop and present business case and supporting rationale for new and existing items
* Stays abreast of industry and market trends and key competitive intelligence to drive product strategies.
* Lead pipeline prioritization efforts, aligning pipeline to segment value and organizational strategies/prioritization
* Work with Industry Programs, Science and Operations, and others to facilitate new product launches
* Support Industry Programs, Regional and Sales staff in new product training and related customer solutions
* Support continuous improvement of forecasting and product performance against key success metrics
* Manage product mix and optimization for selection and discontinuation of products that enhance profitability
* Identify new product opportunities based on customer needs, feedback, and strategic insights
* Work collaboratively with Marketing, Sales, and Regions to launch and monitor feedback and uptake of items
* Maintain and update product roadmaps to meet targeted product pipeline and growth goals.

**Who is USP Looking For?**
The Successful Candidate Will Have a Demonstrated Understanding Of Our Mission, Commitment To Excellence Through Inclusive And Equitable Behaviors And Practices, Ability To Quickly Build Credibility With Stakeholders, Along With The Following Competencies And Experience
  
  

* Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in business, Marketing or Science fields with a MBA Degree.
* Minimum three (3) to seven (7) years of professional experience in Pharmaceutical industry or related field
* At least one (1) to two (2) years managing large product portfolios across B2B and/or B2C companies and managing high performance cross-functional teams.
* Experience with financial analysis, forecasting, data and analytical tools
* Strong quantitative and critical thinking skills with ability to handle complexity and drive data-driven solutions.
* Ability to develop and present dashboards, templates and business cases supported by strong rationale, customer insights and business growth goals.
* Self-starter and highly self-motivated, assumes personal accountability for results and performance.
* Working knowledge of syndicated data and analysis, such as IQVIA, Cortellis, Dailymed, etc
* Knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint
* Strong written and verbal communication and cross-functional collaboration skills

**Supervisory Responsibilities**
None, this is an individual contributor role.
  
  
**Benefits**
USP provides the benefits to protect yourself and your family today and tomorrow. From company-paid time off and comprehensive healthcare options to retirement savings, you can have peace of mind that your personal and financial well-being is protected.
  
  
Note: USP does not accept unsolicited resumes from 3rd party recruitment agencies and is not responsible for fees from recruiters or other agencies except under specific written agreement with USP.

description:

title: Manager, Product Management — Sourcing & Procurement
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Manager, Product Management — Sourcing & Procurement**
**Zora AI™ by Deloitte | Deloitte Consulting Products (USI)**
**About The Role**
Zora AI™ by Deloitte is Deloitte's agentic AI platform, delivering role- and function-specific products — including Finance, Procurement, Supply Chain, Customer, and Human Capital — built on the NVIDIA AI stack and underpinned by Deloitte's Trustworthy AI™ framework.
  
  
Deloitte is looking for a hands-on Product Manager to own the
**Sourcing & Procurement product area**
within Zora AI end-to-end. Based in US-India (USI Office), you'll own the roadmap, the team, and the outcomes for a defined slice of the procurement portfolio — spanning requisitioning, sourcing and RFx, contract management, supplier onboarding and collaboration, and purchase-to-pay — turning real practitioner pain points into digital workers that deliver measurable value. You'll set direction in partnership with the Product Lead, run discovery and delivery across multiple workstreams, and bring deep procurement domain expertise to every decision, all while ensuring trust, adoption, and business impact for enterprise users.
  
  
This is a builder's role with real ownership: you're accountable not just for what your team ships, but for the vision, prioritization, and people behind it. You'll work closely with US-based product owners, sponsors, and offering leaders, and you'll mentor and grow the Consultants and Analysts around you.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Own Your Product**

* Own the roadmap, backlog, and outcomes for the Sourcing & Procurement product area, and take a lead role — alongside the Product Lead — in shaping the 12–18 month vision and strategy
* Make prioritization and trade-off calls across multiple workstreams (requisition, sourcing/RFx, contract management, supplier onboarding, purchase-to-pay), sequencing by value, effort, and readiness
* Define and own the KPIs that prove impact: adoption, efficiency gains, cost reduction, supplier performance, and workflow completion
* Know when something isn't working — flag it early, make the case to change course, and retire low-value work fast

**Discover & Validate**

* Lead discovery to understand procurement practitioners, category managers, and finance stakeholders, and translate what you hear into prioritized, high-value use cases
* Frame and test hypotheses through user research, prototypes, and competitive analysis of procurement platforms before committing to build at scale
* Use generative and evaluative research to continuously answer "are we building the right thing?" and "are we building it right?"

**Ship as One Team**

* Take features and agent capabilities from concept through define, shape, build, and scale
* Own PRDs, epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, and workflow diagrams for agent behaviors, tool use, human-in-the-loop patterns, and exception handling across your product area
* Run sprint planning, reviews, and the daily cadence that keeps delivery moving with engineering, data science, and design
* Own launch, adoption, and iteration — instrument the product and act on what the telemetry and voice-of-customer data show
* Work in an AI-native way, using AI and agentic workflows across discovery, build, and delivery

**Trust & Governance**

* Partner with risk, compliance, and cybersecurity teams to define evaluation approach, monitoring plans, auditability, and governance requirements aligned to the Trustworthy AI™ framework
* Own trust and audit-readiness outcomes for your product area, including policy adherence and reduction of high-severity model risks

**Clients & Go-to-Market**

* Stay close to clients — lead demos, discovery sessions, and feedback conversations with procurement leaders and category managers, and turn what you hear into roadmap decisions
* Own go-to-market inputs for your area: positioning, pricing/packaging input, demos, and enablement, partnering with sales, alliances, and delivery on pursuits, pilots, and launches
* Stay fluent in the market realities shaping procurement products: data privacy, ERP/CRM ecosystems, connector marketplaces, and SaaS vs. on-prem considerations

**Work Across the Network & Lead the Team**

* Partner with Deloitte Consulting Delivery and Practice teams across India to align the product area with delivery capacity and real client needs
* Mentor and develop the Consultants and Analysts on your team, raising the bar on product craft, and act as the go-to escalation point for your product area
* Collaborate with Sourcing & Procurement SMEs to collect product feedback and establish an advisory council

**Key Deliverables**

* Owned roadmap and delivery for the Sourcing & Procurement product area, with direct input into broader portfolio strategy
* PRDs, epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria across all agent capabilities in your area
* Use-case catalog and prioritization framework (value, feasibility, risk, readiness)
* MVP/pilot plans with success metrics, rollout phases, and scale criteria
* Trust & governance artifacts: evaluation approach, monitoring plan, audit/logging requirements
* Release plans and launch-readiness inputs (docs, training, demo scripts, enablement)
* Customer feedback loop: telemetry dashboards, voice-of-customer insights, iteration plan
* Development plans and coaching cadence for direct reports/mentees

**How Success Will Be Measured**

* Adoption: active users, repeat usage, workflow completion rates, feature utilization
* Business impact: cycle-time reduction, cost-to-serve/spend reduction, supplier performance and exception-resolution improvements
* Quality & reliability: task success rate, low rework/rollback rates, latency/uptime, healthy incident trends
* Trust & compliance: audit readiness, policy adherence, governance review outcomes
* Delivery excellence: roadmap predictability, on-time releases, stakeholder satisfaction
* Team leadership: growth and performance of mentees/direct reports, delivery quality across the product area
* Customer outcomes: pilot-to-scale conversion, referenceable wins in procurement engagements

**Reporting Relationships**
Reports to a Senior Manager / AVP of Product Management. Works as one team with engineering, data science, and design; partners with US-based product owners, sponsors, and offering leaders; collaborates with GTM, account, risk/compliance, and Deloitte Consulting Delivery and Practice teams across India. May mentor or informally guide Consultants and Analysts on the team.
  
  
**Working Model & Stakeholders**
Remote + hybrid model (typically 2–3 days onsite), with flexibility based on team and client needs, operating in agile product teams on a regular release cadence.
  
  
Core stakeholders: Engineering (platform + product squads), Data Science/Applied AI, Design/Research, Cybersecurity & Privacy, Risk/Legal/Compliance, Domain SMEs (procurement, sourcing, supply chain, finance), Sales/Alliances/Delivery, and client-side procurement leaders, category managers, process owners, IT, and operations.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Required**

* 8–12 years in product management or product ownership, including owning a product area end-to-end with measurable business outcomes
* Track record of shipping products or major features from discovery to launch, and leading through ambiguity across multiple concurrent workstreams
* Strong hands-on product craft: backlog, PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and day-to-day partnership with engineering and design in an agile setup
* Fluent in discovery and validation — user research, hypothesis testing, experimentation — not just delivery
* Experience delivering products involving AI/ML (GenAI preferred), including evaluation, monitoring, and iteration loops
* Exposure to procurement, sourcing, or supply chain — either as a product focus or through direct stakeholder work — with demonstrated ability to build domain depth quickly
* Comfortable client-facing, including product demos and discovery with senior stakeholders
* Experience mentoring or informally leading other product managers, owners, or analysts
* Working knowledge of enterprise integration patterns (APIs, identity/SSO, RBAC, data pipelines)
* Based in India, able to work virtually with US stakeholders on US-market direction and nuances

**Preferred**

* Domain depth in procurement/sourcing (direct/indirect sourcing, RFx, spend analytics, supplier management, purchase-to-pay)
* Experience with agentic architectures (tool calling, RAG, workflow orchestration, multi-agent patterns)
* Familiarity with LLM evaluation (quality metrics, red-teaming, grounding, hallucination mitigation) and observability
* Zero-to-one product or feature launch experience
* Consulting, enterprise transformation, or platform product experience (shared services, reusable components, governance)
* Experience with OCI/SAP/ERP/CRM ecosystems, S2P/ procurement suites, and connector marketplaces
* Products, professional services, or enterprise-technology background

**Core Competencies**

* Owns outcomes and team performance, not just outputs
* Problem-obsessed and customer-centric
* Strong product craft paired with delivery and governance discipline
* Bias to action — ships, learns, iterates, and adjusts course early
* Clear communicator across engineering, design, risk, and senior stakeholders
* Data-driven, with sound judgment under ambiguity
* Develops others — mentors and raises the craft of the team around them

**Why This Role Matters**
Great products are built by people who stay close to the user and close to the craft — and great product organizations are built by people who can also lead others to do the same. This role owns a strategically important slice of the procurement portfolio in Zora AI, from vision through delivery through governance, while growing the next generation of product talent in USI. It's where strong product managers step into broader ownership and prove they're ready for a portfolio.
  
  
**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
  
  
**Recruiting tips**
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

title: Staff Inbound Product Manager
description:
**Company Description**
It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
  
  
Join us to put AI to work for people.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Role summary:**
This is an inbound technical product manager role. You'll own the design and delivery of ServiceNow's ITSM and ITOM products — Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Knowledge, Service Catalog, Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management, and CMDB — in a live production environment, measure how they actually perform, and use that evidence to influence what the products should become.
  
  
Three things make this role distinct from a standard implementation specialist:
  
  

* You own the outcome, not the deployment. Go-live is the midpoint. You instrument the solution, track adoption and performance in production, and iterate when the data says the design didn't land.
* You're the voice of the customer, from inside. You'll partner directly with ServiceNow Product Management for ITSM and ITOM — evaluating new and pre-GA capability under real operational load, documenting gaps with evidence, and tracking them to closure.
* You can carry the story upward. You'll represent this work in executive forums, translating implementation detail into the impact language leadership needs to make decisions.

You'll spend part of your week across the table from business stakeholders shaping requirements, part with engineering getting it built, and part with Product shaping the roadmap. If you only want one of those three, this isn't the role.
  
  
**What You Get To Do**
**Shape the solution**

* Run discovery sessions with business stakeholders and process owners to understand current-state pain, process gaps, and desired outcomes
* Translate business requirements into a recommended ServiceNow solution design, and pitch it credibly — including where out-of-box beats customization and where scope should be cut
* Drive alignment across competing stakeholders, secure sign-off on scope and design decisions, and document the agreed solution

**Deliver it with engineering**

* Translate approved designs into deployable epics and stories with clear acceptance criteria, dependencies, and definition of done — well-formed enough that engineering can build without guessing
* Walk engineering through design intent, defend the "why" behind decisions, and work through technical trade-offs and constraints collaboratively as build progresses
* Act as the single point of translation between engineering and the business. When engineering needs clarification, you go get it — you own the round trip back to the business stakeholder rather than pulling engineers into stakeholder meetings to ask directly
* Manage scope, sequencing, and backlog priority with engineering through the build, and unblock decisions rather than escalating them
* Own UAT coordination, go-live readiness, and hypercare
* Advise on platform best practices, upgrade-safe design, and technical debt avoidance

**Measure it**

* Instrument every implementation for measurability from day one — define success metrics and baselines before build starts, not after go-live
* Personally build and maintain the reports and dashboards that show whether the solution is actually delivering: adoption, deflection, cycle time, process compliance, data quality, and where the process is leaking
* Use the data to drive iteration — surface underperformance to stakeholders proactively, recommend fixes, and close the loop rather than declaring victory at deployment

**Accelerate it**

* Use AI tooling to compress delivery cycles — apply general-purpose AI assistants (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) to accelerate requirements synthesis, data analysis, rapid prototyping of solution concepts for stakeholder validation, test case generation, and documentation — and bring a point of view on where AI genuinely speeds delivery versus where it adds noise

**Influence the product**

* Represent your work in executive forums like monthly product reviews: what you delivered, why that approach, and what measurable impact it created. Distill technical detail into outcome language a VP can act on
* Partner with ServiceNow Product Management for ITSM and ITOM — build durable working relationships with the teams building these products, evaluate new and pre-GA capabilities in a real production environment, and provide grounded, constructive feedback based on actual adoption experience
* Own the product gap loop — document capability gaps that block or slow adoption, translate them into clear, evidence-backed asks with business impact attached, and track them through to closure with Product and Engineering rather than logging them and moving on

**Qualifications**
**To be successful in this role you have:**

* Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
* 8+ years delivering ServiceNow solutions, with at least 3 full lifecycle ITSM and ITOM deployments owned end to end
* Prior product management experience, formal or informal
* Experience operating in an internal IT / Customer Zero model, deploying capability before general availability
* Exposure to enterprise CMDB remediation at scale
* Experience with AI-driven service operations — AI Agents, Now Assist, predictive intelligence, or AIOps
* ITIL v4 Foundation or higher

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Familiarity with Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, REST/SOAP integrations, and CMDB/CSDM structure — enough to write buildable stories and hold a credible technical conversation
* Working knowledge of ITIL practices and how they map to platform capability
* Demonstrated ability to lead requirements and design conversations with directors and above, without a program manager in the room
* Strong executive communication — able to build and deliver concise, metric-driven narratives for senior leadership, and to hold a credible technical conversation with product managers in the same week
* Demonstrated fluency with AI assistants (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, or equivalent) as part of day-to-day delivery — analyzing data, prototyping, drafting artifacts, and reducing time-to-first-draft on design and requirements work

**Position Summary**
Level: Manager or equivalent
  
  
We are seeking a Sales Operations Technologist Manager to lead the design and implementation of scalable Sales Operations solutions across CRM, CPQ, ERP, data, analytics, and AI platforms. This role combines deep Sales Operations domain expertise with solution architecture, systems integration, automation, delivery leadership, and practical application of Agentic AI.
  
  
The successful candidate will help life sciences organizations improve commercial effectiveness across pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, diagnostics, and healthcare businesses. The Manager will lead client engagements, shape solution strategies, develop high-performing teams, and contribute to the growth of our Sales Operations and commercial technology capabilities.
  
  
**Work you’ll do:**
As a Manager, you will lead multidisciplinary teams and work directly with client executives, commercial leaders, business stakeholders, IT organizations, data teams, and technology partners to deliver measurable business outcomes. You will be responsible for shaping solutions from strategy and discovery through design, implementation, adoption, and value realization.
  
  
You will lead and oversee work across the following areas:
  
  

* Translate Sales Operations requirements into scalable solutions supporting territory and account alignment, segmentation and targeting, quota and incentive planning, sales forecasting, pipeline and opportunity management, account planning, field productivity, pricing and quoting, approvals, and commercial performance reporting.
* Define enterprise solution architectures and delivery approaches integrating CRM, CPQ, ERP, data, analytics, workflow, and AI platforms.
* Lead implementations and solution delivery across platforms such as Salesforce, Veeva, Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle, SAP, and other enterprise applications.
* Establish reusable integration patterns, APIs, data models, workflows, accelerators, and delivery standards that can be deployed across client environments.
* Identify, prioritize, and oversee practical Agentic AI use cases, including sales planning assistants, forecasting and pipeline analysis agents, next-best-action recommendations, account and territory intelligence, automated opportunity and CRM hygiene, quoting and approval support, and sales performance insights.
* Define and oversee human-in-the-loop controls, access controls, auditability, evaluation criteria, monitoring, and escalation paths for AI-enabled solutions.
* Lead discovery workshops, process assessments, design sessions, demonstrations, executive discussions, testing, deployment planning, and adoption activities.
* Build trusted relationships with client executives and key stakeholders, facilitate difficult decisions, manage expectations, and communicate risks, dependencies, and trade-offs clearly.
* Manage delivery quality, scope, schedule, resources, risks, issues, dependencies, and financial performance across workstreams or engagements.
* Coach and develop consultants and senior consultants through structured feedback, hands-on leadership, and opportunities to expand their domain and technology expertise.
* Establish solution roadmaps, implementation plans, operating models, adoption strategies, governance approaches, and measurable value cases.
* Support and lead pre-sales activities, including account planning, proposals, statements of work, solution demonstrations, estimates, client presentations, and pursuit strategy.
* Contribute to market eminence, intellectual capital, reusable assets, accelerators, and offerings that strengthen our Sales Operations and commercial technology portfolio.
* Ensure solutions reflect life sciences-specific requirements related to HCP/HCO data, field force structures, regulatory expectations, data privacy, commercial compliance, and data governance.

**The team:**
Step into our
**Sales & Service**
team, where technology powers business impact and innovation drives everything we do. As a global, dynamic group, we deliver seamless, end-to-end solutions—advising on strategy, implementing advanced CRM or back-office platforms, and enabling continuous business improvement. Here, you’ll collaborate with passionate, creative minds to transform sales models, elevate service excellence, and optimize customer operations. If you’re ready to grow your expertise, make bold ideas real, and help redefine the customer experience for leading organizations, this is your next big move. Join us and shape the future of sales and service!
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**

* 8+ years of consulting or industry experience, including significant experience leading Sales Operations, Commercial Operations, CRM, CPQ, business transformation, or technology implementation initiatives.
* Experience leading end-to-end client engagements or major workstreams, including delivery planning, team leadership, quality management, risk management, and executive communication.
* Strong understanding of Sales Operations processes and performance drivers, including territory and account alignment, segmentation, targeting, quota and incentive planning, forecasting, pipeline management, account planning, pricing, quoting, approvals, and performance reporting.
* Experience implementing or integrating two or more CRM, CPQ, ERP, data, or analytics platforms.
* Experience with APIs, middleware, data integration, workflow automation, enterprise solution architecture, and delivery governance.
* Practical knowledge of Agentic AI, generative AI, large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, tool calling, AI orchestration, or related enterprise AI patterns.
* Ability to convert business requirements into solution strategies, functional designs, technical specifications, implementation plans, roadmaps, and value cases.
* Demonstrated ability to lead workshops, influence senior stakeholders, manage ambiguity, resolve issues, and make sound delivery decisions.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, presentation, relationship management, and problem-solving skills.
* Experience leading, coaching, and developing consulting or technology delivery teams

**Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**

* Experience with Salesforce, Veeva CRM, Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle CPQ, Salesforce Revenue Cloud, SAP CPQ, or similar platforms.
* Experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, diagnostics, or healthcare commercial operations.
* Knowledge of HCP/HCO master data, customer consent, field force effectiveness, promotional compliance, and commercial data governance.
* Experience with cloud platforms, data warehouses, business intelligence tools, and low-code/no-code automation platforms.
* Familiarity with AI governance, model evaluation, prompt engineering, agent monitoring, responsible AI practices, and enterprise controls.
* Consulting, systems integration, product management, enterprise architecture, or operating model design experience.
* Experience developing proposals, estimates, solution demonstrations, reusable assets, or market-facing points of view.
* Relevant Salesforce, Veeva, CPQ, cloud, data, architecture, or AI certifications.

**Success Measures**
Success in this role will be measured by:

* Adoption, usability, and sustained business value of implemented solutions.
* Reduction in manual processes, disconnected workflows, and operational friction.

title: Market Insights Manager
description:
**Description**
**Who is USP?**
The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high-quality medicines worldwide.
  
  
At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.
  
  
USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.
  
  
**Brief Job Overview**
This position is a global, nonsupervisory position in the Strategic Insights (SI) department within the Legal, Strategy and People division at the U.S. Pharmacopeia (USP). As part of the SI department, the Insights team performs a centralized market research function for USP – supporting all levels of the organization including the Executive Team.
  
  
The role functionally and administratively reports to India-based Sr. Insights Manager – Primary Research. The role is responsible for supporting organizational understanding of the USP’s customers and business environment and advocating for needed resources. This role manages complex, high level research projects to help decision-makers better understand stakeholders, customers, markets and trends through primary research techniques and consulting outreach. The position’s scope encompasses in-depth organizational knowledge of USP’s Public Health Programs, including official standards publications, reference standards, communications, pharmacopeial education, verification, advocacy, and other products and services to facilitate sound decision making.
  
  
**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**
As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence-based decision-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.
  
  
Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results-driven work environments.
  
  
The Market Insights Manager Primary Research has the following responsibilities:
  
  

* Autonomously manage global primary market research (qualitative and quantitative) of all levels of complexity, incorporating diverse stakeholder perspectives to ensure organizational alignment and buy-in. Strength in applying advanced statistical analyses and leveraging business intelligence to support strategic, tactical and operational initiatives as well as planning and implementation of new and potential USP products and programs is essential.
* Steward projects to generate actionable and meaningful insights. Develop research plans to meet business needs, consult with internal business partners, establish and manage schedules, monitor progress, and compellingly communicate the results
* Acquire and manage market research vendors to ensure quality work is provided on-time, on-budget, and that it is reported with a suitable degree of professionalism
* Proactively serve as a thought partner with USP leadership. Participate in corporate planning and new product development processes to identify opportunities, address needs, and support the development of business and marketing plans
* Proactively bring external perspectives and insight into business planning for the organization, accomplished through:
* Monitor trends in the pharmaceutical, healthcare, biotech, dietary supplement, food and other related industries to assess their implications for USP business lines
* Represents the Strategic Insights department with poise and professionalism
* Performs other related duties as required

**Who is USP Looking For?**
**Basic Qualifications**
The successful candidate will have a demonstrated understanding of our mission, commitment to excellence through inclusive and equitable behaviors and practices, ability to quickly build credibility with stakeholders, along with the following competencies and experience:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree required. Master’s degree preferred. Preferred majors in market research, marketing, science, business, or related social science discipline.
* 7 or more years of experience in applying Market Research to solve broad strategic business problems.
* Strong business writing skills – evidence of succinct, distilled reports and attention to detail through thoroughness and accuracy

Trust & Safety team members are tasked with identifying and taking on the biggest problems that challenge the safety and integrity of our products. They use technical know-how, excellent problem-solving skills, user insights, and proactive communication to protect users and our partners from abuse across Google products like Search, Maps, Gmail, and Google Ads. On this team, you're a big-picture thinker and strategic team-player with a passion for doing what’s right. You work globally and cross-functionally with Google engineers and product managers to identify and fight abuse and fraud cases at Google speed - with urgency. And you take pride in knowing that every day you are working hard to promote trust in Google and ensuring the highest levels of user safety.
  
  
Our team has the critical mission of protecting and respecting Google's users, ensuring online safety in both core and emerging areas. We are at the center of the company-wide charge to raise the bar on content, including coherent policies and scaled and effective enforcement. We have recently expanded beyond traditional product protections focusing on additional types of abuse: brand safety, controversial content, violent extremism, and political interference. We've advanced user protections, and demonstrated expertise across Google’s growing array of products and services.
  
  
In this role, you’ll lead a team, be a thought leader, an excellent operator and will collaborate cross-functionally. You will bring passion for abuse fighting, focus on putting the user first and lead a high performing team to deliver excellent business results. You will partner with key stakeholders to drive operational performance and lower abuse rates.

We seek highly motivated individuals with the dedication, integrity, and creative spirit needed to thrive in our organization.
  
  
Our CX Strategy & Digital Transformation team is building next-generation commercial, medical, and customer engagement capabilities powered by Salesforce, AI, Data Cloud, and advanced analytics. We are seeking a strategic and highly experienced architect who can design the future-state CRM and customer data ecosystem supporting scalable growth across Commercial, Medical Affairs, Market Access, Patient Services, and omnichannel engagement.
  
  
The Senior Manager, CRM Solution & Data Architect will define and govern the enterprise CRM, customer data, integration, and engagement architecture. This role will serve as the primary architecture leader across Salesforce, Data Cloud, customer master data, analytics, AI-enabled capabilities, and connected enterprise platforms.
  
  
The ideal candidate will combine deep Salesforce architecture expertise with strong data architecture, master data management, integration design, and pharmaceutical commercial process knowledge. The role will partner with business leaders, product owners, engineering teams, data teams, security, and external partners to deliver scalable, compliant, and business-aligned solutions.
  
  
**WORK SCHEDULE: This position requires full coverage of US Eastern Time business hours (8:00 AM – 5:00 PM ET) and is not a standard India daytime work schedule**
**Principal Responsibilities**
**CRM & Enterprise Solution Architecture**

* Define and own the end-to-end CRM architecture strategy supporting Commercial, Medical Affairs, Market Access, Patient Services, and omnichannel engagement.
* Establish future-state architecture roadmaps across Salesforce Sales Cloud, Life Sciences Cloud, Data Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, CRM Analytics, Marketing Cloud, and emerging AI capabilities.
* Translate business strategy and product roadmaps into scalable solution architectures, technical designs, and implementation guardrails.
* Develop and govern architecture standards, reusable design patterns, platform principles, and technology blueprints across the CRM ecosystem.
* Evaluate new technologies and vendor capabilities against enterprise architecture, security, data, and business priorities.

**Data Architecture & Customer 360 Strategy**

* Lead customer data architecture across HCP, HCO, KOL, patient, account, territory, consent, affiliation, and engagement data domains.
* Define Customer 360 architecture leveraging Salesforce Data Cloud, enterprise customer master platforms, and third-party data sources.

* Establish data governance, stewardship, metadata, lineage, quality, survivorship, matching, and identity-resolution standards.
* Drive master data management alignment across CRM, ERP, enterprise data platforms, IQVIA, and commercial applications.

**Integration & Platform Architecture**

* Architect integrations between Salesforce and Snowflake, IQVIA, customer master, ERP, data warehouse, marketing automation, patient services, sales enablement, and analytics platforms.
* Define API-led, middleware, batch, event-driven, and real-time integration patterns based on business and technical requirements.
* Ensure integration architecture meets scalability, resiliency, performance, monitoring, supportability, and security expectations.
* Guide delivery teams on platform interoperability, interface contracts, error handling, observability, and enterprise integration standards.

**AI, Analytics & Data Cloud Enablement**

* Partner with business and technology leaders to define AI-enabled CRM, field productivity, customer engagement, and decision-support use cases.
* Lead architecture for Salesforce Data Cloud, Agentforce, Einstein capabilities, predictive analytics, and customer intelligence initiatives.
* Ensure customer and engagement data is structured and governed to support segmentation, personalization, next best action, and advanced analytics.
* Collaborate with analytics and data engineering teams to establish trusted, reusable datasets and reporting architecture.

**Governance, Compliance & Security**

* Define architecture governance covering design reviews, standards compliance, technology decisions, nonfunctional requirements, and release readiness.
* Ensure CRM and data solutions align with applicable pharmaceutical, privacy, security, and records-management requirements, including HIPAA, GDPR, Sunshine Act, and FDA expectations.
* Establish security architecture standards for role-based access, classification, privacy, encryption, auditability, retention, and risk management.
* Lead architecture assessments for internal and vendor-delivered solutions, documenting decisions, risks, dependencies, and remediation actions.

**Leadership & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Provide thought leadership on CRM modernization, customer data strategy, AI adoption, and pharmaceutical engagement technologies.
* Oversee consulting partners and ensure internal team members participate throughout the design journey to build sustainable knowledge and ownership.

* Deep expertise in Salesforce Sales Cloud, Life Sciences Cloud, Veeva, Data Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, CRM Analytics, and related capabilities.

* Experience architecting enterprise integrations using APIs, middleware, event-driven architecture, batch processing, and cloud-native patterns.

* Data Analytics, AI/ML, chatbots, and virtual assistants
* Cloud solutions, DevOps, and CI/CD
* Legacy modernization and digital transformation
* Custom enterprise software and quality engineering

We are a lean, fast-moving team, and AI is one of our biggest growth areas. We are looking for an enterprise architect who can turn a client's business problem into a well-designed, production-grade AI solution.

**About the Role**

As our Enterprise AI Architect, you will own the technical design of AI products and solutions for our enterprise clients, from the first discovery conversation to production architecture. You will decide what to build, which models and patterns to use, how it integrates with the client's systems, and how it stays secure, reliable, and cost-effective at scale. This is a hands-on architecture role: you will define the blueprint, guide the delivery team, and stay close enough to the code to validate that what's built matches what was designed.

You will also work closely with our business development team as the technical voice in client conversations, so you should be comfortable explaining complex AI concepts to both engineers and executives.

**What You Will Own**

Client Problem → Discovery → Solution Architecture → Proof of Concept → Estimation and Proposal → Delivery Guidance → Production Readiness → Continuous Improvement

**Key Responsibilities**

*Solution Design and Architecture*

* Translate business problems into AI solution architectures, including GenAI/LLM applications, RAG systems, AI agents, predictive models, and intelligent automation
* Select the right approach for each problem: build vs. buy, open-source vs. proprietary models, fine-tuning vs. RAG vs. prompt engineering, and when AI is not the right answer
* Design end-to-end architectures covering data ingestion, vector stores, model serving, orchestration, APIs, integration with enterprise systems, and user-facing applications
* Create architecture documents, solution blueprints, and technical diagrams that delivery teams can build from

*Client and Pre-Sales Engagement*

* Join discovery workshops with CTOs, CIOs, and business leaders to understand objectives, constraints, and data readiness
* Support the business development team with technical proposals, SOW inputs, effort estimates, and architecture presentations
* Build and demo proofs of concept to validate feasibility and win client confidence
* Present trade-offs, risks, and timelines honestly, and manage client expectations on what AI can and cannot deliver

*Delivery Leadership*

* Provide technical direction to engineering, data, and DevOps teams during implementation
* Review designs and code for architectural integrity, scalability, and maintainability
* Define standards for LLMOps/MLOps: CI/CD for models, monitoring, versioning, evaluation, and rollback
* Mentor engineers and help build our internal AI capability

*Quality, Security, and Governance*

* Establish evaluation frameworks for AI quality: accuracy, hallucination rates, latency, cost per query, and bias
* Design for data privacy, security, access control, and compliance (e.g., GDPR, SOC 2, HIPAA where relevant)
* Apply responsible AI practices, including guardrails, human-in-the-loop design, and auditability
* Optimize for performance and cloud cost without compromising reliability

*Innovation and Thought Leadership*

* Track the fast-moving AI landscape (models, frameworks, tools, and best practices) and decide what is ready for enterprise use
* Build reusable accelerators, reference architectures, and templates that speed up future projects
* Contribute to case studies, technical content, and our AI service positioning

**Must-Have Requirements**

* 8–12 years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or ML, with at least 3 years in an architect or technical lead role
* Hands-on experience designing and delivering AI/ML solutions that reached production, with examples you can walk us through
* Strong practical experience with Generative AI: LLM integration, RAG pipelines, vector databases, prompt engineering, and agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)
* Solid understanding of ML fundamentals and when to use classical ML vs. LLM-based approaches
* Deep experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and its AI/ML services (e.g., Bedrock, SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI)
* Strong software architecture skills: microservices, APIs, event-driven design, data pipelines, and system integration
* Strong Python skills and the ability to review code and build prototypes
* Experience with MLOps/LLMOps: model deployment, monitoring, evaluation, and CI/CD
* Understanding of data architecture, including data lakes, warehouses, ETL/ELT, and data quality
* Knowledge of security, privacy, and governance requirements for enterprise AI
* Excellent communication skills: able to explain architecture to executives and engineers alike
* Experience working with international clients and distributed teams

**Good to Have**

* Experience in a services, consulting, or multi-client environment
* Pre-sales or solutioning experience, including proposals, estimates, and client presentations
* Experience fine-tuning or evaluating open-source models (Llama, Mistral, etc.) and deploying them on your own infrastructure
* Familiarity with tools such as MLflow, Kubeflow, Airflow, Docker, Kubernetes, and Terraform
* Exposure to legacy modernization or integrating AI into existing enterprise applications
* Cloud architecture certifications (AWS, Azure, or GCP) or AI/ML specializations
* Contributions to open-source projects, published content, or conference talks
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field

**This Role May Not Be a Fit If You…**

* Have worked only on research, notebooks, or proofs of concept that never reached production
* Have only used AI through no-code tools or API wrappers, without architectural depth
* Prefer a purely advisory role with no involvement in implementation
* Are not comfortable engaging directly with clients and business stakeholders
* Want a large, highly structured organization with a fully defined process

**How Success Will Be Measured**

* Quality and clarity of architectures and solution designs delivered
* Technical contribution to proposals won and client confidence in pre-sales
* Successful delivery of AI projects to production, on time and within scope
* Reliability, performance, and cost-efficiency of deployed AI solutions
* Reusable accelerators and reference architectures created
* Growth in the team's AI capability through mentoring and standards

**Compensation and Benefits**

* Fixed salary of ₹32–48 LPA, based on experience and depth of AI delivery
* Performance-linked bonus tied to project outcomes and pre-sales contribution
* Direct access to founders and leadership, with real influence on our AI strategy and service offerings
* The chance to shape architecture standards and build our AI practice from the ground up
* Exposure to enterprise clients and our US office
* Learning support for cloud and AI certifications
* Statutory benefits (PF, gratuity) and health insurance
* A growth path toward Head of AI / Principal Architect / Chief Technology Officer-track roles

**How to Apply**

Apply through LinkedIn or email your resume to hr@assentcode.tech with the subject line "Enterprise AI Architect". To help us evaluate quickly, please include a short description (or link) of one AI solution you architected that went to production: the business problem, your architecture choices, the stack, and the outcome.

Learn more about us: www.assentcode.tech

title: Sr Digital Product Manager
description:

 Bachelor’s degree and 12 years of Digital Product, Product Management, Product Leadership, Digital Transformation, Technology Strategy, or related experience
