title: Product Manager
description:
**About Global HealthX**




  





 Global HealthX is on a mission to reshape how people experience healthcare. We build products that
 



 touch real patients and providers, in a market that is early, enormous, and moving fast. We are past the"will this work" stage and squarely in the "how big can this get" stage which means whoever joins
 



 now gets to shape the product, the roadmap, and the culture while the story is still being written.
 



  





**About Healix Engage**




  





 Healix Engage is our patient and provider engagement platform — the layer that turns healthcare
 



 interactions into ongoing, meaningful relationships. It is a product with real users, real traction, and a
 



 roadmap far larger than the team currently chasing it. There is white space here that most PMs only
 



 dream about: core problems still to be solved, and the freedom to solve them well.
 



  





**The Role**




  





 We are looking for a Product Manager to own Healix Engage end to end. This is not a backloggrooming, ticket\-shuffling role. You will set direction, make the hard calls on what gets built and what does not, and be accountable for outcomes not just output. You will work shoulder to shoulder with engineering, design, and leadership, with unusual latitude to run experiments, kill bad ideas quickly, and double down on what is working.
 



 If you have been the PM who quietly does the strategic thinking while someone senior takes the
 



 meeting this is your chance to take the meeting.
 



  





**What You'll Do**




  




* Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Healix Engage, and translate it into a sequence of releases that compound.
* Talk to users constantly patients, providers, internal teams and turn what you hear into sharp product decisions.
* Define the problems worth solving, write crisp specs, and partner with engineering and design to ship fast without shipping sloppy.
* Use data to decide. Set the metrics that matter, instrument them, and let the numbers not opinions settle debates.
* Prioritize ruthlessly against limited time and resources the hallmark of a great PM at a growing company.
* Be the connective tissue across teams, keeping everyone aligned on the "why" and the "what's next."



  





**What We're Looking For**




  




* Roughly 3–5 years in product management, ideally including time taking a product from early to scaling (0→1 or 1→10 experience is a big plus).
* A track record of shipping products that moved real metrics you can point to specific outcomes you are proud of.
* Strong product intuition paired with genuine comfort in data; you can zoom from strategy to a Figma detail to a SQL query and back.
* Excellent judgment under ambiguity. You make good decisions with incomplete information and course\-correct quickly.
* Clear, persuasive communication you can align a room and write a spec that does not need a translator.
* A builder's temperament: high ownership, low ego, and a bias for action. You would rather ship, learn, and iterate than wait for perfect.



  





 Bonus: experience in healthcare, health\-tech, or another regulated, high\-trust domain.

title: (Agentic) Product Manager
description:
**About This Role**
 We are building an agentic banking platform for large enterprise banks. Multi\-modal AI converts business intent into autonomous agents that orchestrate processes, integrate data, and make intelligent decisions — turning weeks of manual work into hours.
   

  

 You will lead AI agents and intelligent automation — building capabilities that deploy autonomous agents to solve complex banking problems at enterprise scale. This is not a pillar\-specific role. You'll work across three interconnected pillars (Durable Processes, Data Connectors, AI Agents), collaborating with peer PMs to architect and ship agentic solutions end\-to\-end.
   

  

 You'll report directly to the Product Director and own the complete journey: from defining what agentic capabilities matter most, to shipping them, to measuring their impact. This role is for a PM who understands how AI agents fundamentally change enterprise automation, who can navigate technical and business complexity, and who ships with both ambition and rigor.
   

  

**What You'll Own**
 Strategic ownership
   

  

* Define the AI capability roadmap — which features move the needle, which delight customers, which drive competitive advantage
* Make the hard calls: what ships in Year 1, what comes after, what's out of scope
* Own the quality bar — "enterprise grade" means reliable, explainable, compliant, and safe. Set and enforce that standard.
* Shape how AI surfaces across the platform — consistency in UX, tone, and behavior across copilot, solution builder, and other capabilities


 Execution leadership
   

  

* Lead cross\-pillar alignment — work with peer PMs to define integration points and success metrics
* Conduct customer discovery: what AI capabilities matter most, what fears do they have about AI, what use cases are most valuable
* Make data\-driven decisions: usage patterns, LLM cost, inference latency, customer sentiment all inform roadmap
* Unblock ambiguity: when technical feasibility isn't clear (cost, latency, quality), you synthesize information and move forward decisively


 Partnership with platform PMs
   

  

* Collaborate with peer PMs who own the platform pillars
* Establish clear integration contracts: where AI surfaces in their UIs, how data flows from their features to your LLM calls, how they measure success


**We're Looking For**
**Experience Shipping One Or More Of The Following**
 AI\-native products or features that users love
   

  

* Enterprise software with AI capabilities built in (not tacked on)
* Products that required deep LLM integration and cost optimization
* Cross\-functional initiatives that span multiple teams or product areas

 Core capabilities

title: IT & Data PO D&A MDM Platform
description:
**Product Owner Master Data Workflow** 




  





**About the Role:** 




  





 Master data workflows are how product, customer, and vendor data is requested, enriched, validated, approved, and distributed across Danones global landscape spanning Orsoft (master data system of entry), SAP ECC / S/4HANA, and the surrounding integration layer across Customer, Vendor, Materials and Finance MD domains.
 



 As Product Owner for the Master Data Workflow, you deeply understand the needs of the requestors, data stewards, approvers, and downstream consumers who depend on these workflows, and you own the vision, roadmap, and backlog of the platform. You will Own workflow capabilities supporting Product, Customer, Vendor, and future master data domains across the enterprise . You are mandated by the organization and its stakeholders to turn that vision into a product that delivers maximum value to Danone and its business functions and you are accountable end\-to\-end for user satisfaction with the workflow product.
 



**You own the what and the why.** 
 You define outcomes, prioritize the backlog, and decide what gets built and in what order.
 



  





  





**Location \| Experience \| How to Apply:** 




**Location:** 
 Hyderabad
 



**Experience:** 
 9\-12 Years
 



**How to Apply:** 
 Interested candidates can also apply directly via the
 **Infosys Careers Page (https://career.infosys.com/jobdesc?jobReferenceCode\=INFSYS\-EXTERNAL\-254034\&rc\=0\)** 




 Global stakeholder exposure
 



 Opportunity to be part of a large\-scale transformation journey
 



 Good to have experience in consumer goods, manufacturing, retail, or related industry domains
 



  





**Technical Skills Required** 




  




* Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or a related field.
* 7\+ years in enterprise IT\&Data, including proven experience as a Product Owner / Product Manager (or equivalent) owning the vision, roadmap, and backlog of a technical or platform product.
* Strong command of agile product ownership: backlog management and prioritization, writing user stories and acceptance criteria, release planning, and working in Scrum / Kanban / hybrid (SAFe an advantage).
* Sufficient domain fluency in SAP master data (material / product, customer, vendor) and in master\-data workflow / BPM (e.g. Orsoft, SAP Business Workflow, SAP MDG) to prioritize credibly, shape requirements, and partner effectively with the technical Chapter — without needing to be the hands\-on design authority.
* Demonstrated ability to translate business and data\-governance needs into product outcomes and measurable value.
* Excellent stakeholder management across business and IT up to senior\-management level; able to align priorities and to say “no” constructively.
* Outcome\- and data\-driven decision\-making; comfortable prioritizing under constraints and ambiguity.
* Fluent English (written and spoken); effective in a global, multicultural, matrixed organization.



  





  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Product ownership of master\-data, workflow, or platform products in a large, matrixed enterprise.
* Familiarity with Orsoft\-based master data processes and with S/4HANA migration programs and their workflow implications — enough to prioritize and plan, not to configure.
* Understanding of data\-governance operating models (data owners, stewards, councils) and how workflows operationalize them.
* Awareness of process mining, workflow analytics, and automation (RPA, low\-code) as levers on the product roadmap.
* FMCG / CPG industry experience and its master\-data characteristics (innovation cycles, regulatory attributes, customer hierarchies).
* Working knowledge of agile / hybrid delivery (Scrum, SAFe) and ITSM (ITIL) as it relates to product operations.
* Familiarity with enterprise integration patterns, APIs, event\-driven architectures, and workflow orchestration across SAP and non\-SAP ecosystems



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Product Vision \& Strategy** 



* Define, communicate, and continuously evolve the vision and strategy for the Master Data Workflow, aligned to the MDM and IT\&Data strategy and to the needs of the business functions it serves.
* Translate business and data\-governance objectives into a clear product direction and measurable outcomes (e.g. cycle\-time, right\-first\-time quality, self\-service adoption).



**Backlog Management** 



* Own, maintain, and prioritize a single, transparent product backlog for the Workflow, spanning enhancement, project, and transformation demand.
* Make the prioritization calls — what is in, what is out, what waits — balancing value, risk, effort, and dependencies; define guardrails and functional scope for product extensions where the operating model requires them.



**Requirement Gathering \& Refinement** 



* Work closely with business process owners, data owners, and data stewards to gather, clarify, and refine requirements into well\-formed backlog items and user stories.
* Ensure data\-quality and governance needs are expressed as product requirements, in partnership with Data Governance and DQ teams.



**Release Planning \& Roadmapping** 



* Own the product roadmap and plan and prioritize releases with the squad and stakeholders.
* Manage the global roadmap and its communication — keeping stakeholders aligned on what is coming, when, and why.



**Plan \& Review** 



* Plan the work with the squad, then review and accept completed increments, demonstrating delivered value to stakeholders.
* Keep the backlog and product artefacts current for the applicable delivery framework (Scrum, Kanban, hybrid / waterfall).



**Dependency Management** 



* Identify and manage dependencies — across Orsoft, SAP ECC / S/4HANA, the integration layer (e.g. Tibco), and other products — that affect the platform’s success, coordinating and escalating through product and program governance as needed.



**Stakeholder Engagement** 



* Act as the primary liaison between the squad and stakeholders across Finance, Marketing, R\&I, and Supply Chain, ensuring needs, trade\-offs, and decisions are understood on both sides.
* Represent the product in product\-group, architecture, and program governance forums, and communicate value delivered to both technical and executive audiences.



**Acceptance Criteria Definition** 



* Define clear acceptance criteria so the team knows when a requirement is complete and ready for release, safeguarding quality and fitness\-for\-purpose from the user’s perspective.



**Continuous Improvement** 



* Actively seek feedback from stakeholders, squad members, and end\-users to identify improvement opportunities, and foster adherence to product and agile best practices.
* Use adoption, quality, and performance signals to drive simplification and continuous improvement of the workflow product.



**Workflow** 
**Governance** 



* Ensure workflow designs and approval processes align with Danone's Data Governance framework, stewardship model, segregation of duties, audit requirements, and compliance obligations.
* Partner with Data Governance teams to continuously improve stewardship experience and governance effectiveness.



**Adoption \& Change Management** 



* Drive adoption of workflow capabilities through stakeholder engagement, training needs identification, communications, and feedback management.
* Champion user experience improvements that increase compliance, efficiency, and self\-service.



**Automation \& Innovation** 



* Identify opportunities to simplify and automate workflow activities through AI, workflow intelligence, low\-code platforms, RPA, and business rules automation.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and their potential impact on workflow efficiency and user experience.



**Key Deliverables** 



* Product vision and strategy for the Master Data Workflow.
* Product roadmap and product OKRs.
* A relevant, up\-to\-date, and prioritized product backlog.
* User stories, acceptance criteria, and the deliverables required by the applicable framework (Scrum, Kanban, hybrid / waterfall).
* Release plans and roadmap communications to stakeholders.
* Defined and realized product value (adoption, cycle\-time, and quality outcomes).
* Extension guardrails and functional scope, where the product operating model requires them.



**Key Interactions** 




**Internal** 



* Product Analysts and squad members within scope.
* Chapter Lead and Chapter Manager (technical counterpart).
* Global business and function stakeholders — data owners and stewards across Finance, Marketing, R\&I, and Supply Chain.
* Product Group Lead and Product Lead; IT\&Data leadership.
* Peer Product Owners / Extension Product Owners; Business Partners.
* Program Leads / Deployment Project Managers.



**External** 



* Technology providers (Orsoft, SAP, integration vendors).

title: AI Ops Application Operations Lead
description:
**Role Overview**
 The AI Ops Application Operations Lead owns the production lifecycle of agentic coding applications, plugins, and skills across Zeta. The role helps teams move high\-value prototypes into production and keeps applications reliable, useful, governed, and measurable after launch.
   

  

 This role partners closely with application owners, AI Operations, IT, Security, and other technical teams. Its primary focus is production readiness, lifecycle and release management, feedback loops, and clear visibility into adoption, performance, and business impact.
   

  

 The ideal candidate combines application operations, technical program management, and product fluency. They do not need to be the primary developer for every application, but they must be comfortable working with AI\-assisted development tools, understanding application architecture, translating business needs into technical requirements, and coordinating work across stakeholders.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Production Readiness and Launch**
* Partner with owners of agenticly coded applications to assess whether an application is ready to move from prototype to production.
* Establish and manage a consistent production\-readiness process covering security, privacy, data access, architecture, user experience, support, monitoring, and documentation.
* Identify launch risks, dependencies, and gaps, and coordinate the work required to address them.
* Connect application owners with IT, Security, Data, Legal, and other teams involved in production approval and deployment.
* Develop launch plans, readiness checklists, support models, and ownership documentation for each application.
* Ensure applications have clear business objectives, target users, success measures, and accountable owners before launch.


**Application Operations and Lifecycle Management**
* Manage the ongoing operational health of production applications.
* Maintain a prioritized backlog of fixes, enhancements, and technical improvements based on direction from the application owner.
* Coordinate application updates, testing, release management, and communication to users.
* Help ensure applications remain compatible with changes to models, APIs, enterprise systems, data sources, and security requirements.
* Establish clear escalation paths for defects, incidents, access issues, and performance concerns.
* Maintain accurate documentation for application functionality, dependencies, ownership, and support procedures.


**Feedback, Adoption, and Continuous Improvement**
* Help application owners establish structured feedback loops with users.
* Collect and organize user feedback, feature requests, defects, and usage insights.
* Translate feedback into clear product requirements and backlog items.
* Support application owners in prioritizing improvements based on user value, business impact, risk, and effort.
* Coordinate user testing and validation before major releases.
* Identify common patterns across applications that could inform shared standards, reusable components, or broader AI Ops priorities.


**Measurement and Analytics**
* Develop and maintain dashboards that provide application owners with visibility into adoption, usage, reliability, performance, and business outcomes.
* Define appropriate metrics for each application, including active users, usage frequency, task completion, response quality, errors, latency, user satisfaction, and estimated time or cost savings.
* Monitor application health and surface risks, adoption gaps, and improvement opportunities.
* Partner with application owners to review performance regularly and agree on actions.
* Help determine whether applications should be expanded, redesigned, consolidated, or retired based on evidence.


**Governance, Standards, and Portfolio Management**
* Apply AI Ops standards for application development, production readiness, responsible AI, security, documentation, and measurement.
* Help create reusable templates, checklists, playbooks, and operating procedures for agentic coding applications.
* Support the development of a governed application portfolio and inventory.
* Ensure applications have clear ownership, approved data access, defined user groups, and appropriate controls.
* Promote consistency across applications while allowing teams to move quickly and iterate.


**Key Outcomes**
**Success In This Role Will Be Measured By**
* Increased percentage of high\-value prototypes successfully moved into production.
* Reduced time from prototype completion to production launch.
* Stronger production readiness and fewer post\-launch issues.
* Clear ownership and support models for every production application.
* Consistent visibility into application adoption, reliability, and business impact.
* Faster response to user feedback and application issues.
* Increased adoption and sustained usage of production applications.
* A well\-managed portfolio of applications aligned to business priorities and enterprise standards.


**Qualifications**
**Required**
* Experience in application operations, technical program management, product operations, product management, or a closely related role.
* Strong ability to coordinate work across business, product, engineering, IT, security, and data teams.
* Experience taking internal digital products, AI applications, or technology solutions from prototype through production launch.
* Ability to translate business requirements into clear technical and operational requirements.
* Strong backlog management, prioritization, documentation, and release management skills.
* Experience defining product metrics and building or managing performance dashboards.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Comfort working in a fast\-moving environment with evolving tools, standards, and priorities


**Preferred**
* Experience with AI\-assisted software development, low\-code tools, or agentic coding platforms.
* Familiarity with modern AI models, APIs, agents, workflow automation, and application architectures.
* Experience working with enterprise security, privacy, identity, access management, and software governance processes.
* Familiarity with analytics tools, application monitoring, user telemetry, and experimentation.
* Experience supporting internal enterprise applications or employee productivity tools.
* Working knowledge of software development practices, including testing, deployment, version control, and incident management.


**Core Capabilities**
* Application operations and lifecycle management
* Technical program management
* Stakeholder coordination
* Production readiness
* Backlog and release management
* User feedback, adoption, and continuous improvement
* Application analytics and measurement
* Risk and dependency management
* Technical fluency
* Clear communication and documentation


**Role Profile**
 This role is well suited for someone who enjoys turning early\-stage prototypes into dependable, scalable applications. They are comfortable operating between business and technology teams, creating structure where processes are still developing, and helping application owners make decisions based on user feedback and performance data.
   

  

 The successful candidate will be practical, organized, technically curious, and focused on measurable outcomes. They will know when to move quickly, when to slow down to address risk, and how to keep application owners and technical teams aligned throughout the application lifecycle.

This is a high\-impact role with significant exposure to business decision\-making and category ownership.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities

**Identify opportunities for portfolio expansion, backward integration, and downstream market development.**

 Business Development \& Commercial Excellence
   

  

* Drive customer acquisition and strategic account growth.
* Build long\-term relationships with key customers, suppliers, and channel partners.

* Work closely with sales teams to unlock new business opportunities and expand market share.


 Cross\-Functional Leadership
   

  

* Collaborate with sourcing, manufacturing, R\&D, supply chain, finance, and operations teams.
* Lead strategic projects involving multiple business functions.
* Ensure alignment between commercial objectives and operational execution.
* Drive organizational initiatives focused on scalability, efficiency, and growth.


 Founder’s Office \& Strategic Initiatives
   

  

* Partner directly with founders on critical strategic and operational initiatives.
* Support investment decisions, market entry strategies, and business expansion opportunities.
* Prepare executive presentations, business cases, and leadership dashboards.
* Drive special projects with end\-to\-end ownership and measurable outcomes.


 What We're Looking For
   

  

**Experience**
* 5\-10 years of experience in Strategy, Business Planning, Category Management, Corporate Strategy, Management Consulting, Specialty Chemicals, or Business Operations.
* Experience managing business performance, profitability, or P\&L is highly preferred.
* Prior exposure to specialty chemicals, industrial chemicals, pharmaceuticals, agrochemicals, or related sectors is advantageous.


 Business Acumen
   

  

* Strong understanding of business strategy, financial planning, and commercial operations.
* Proven ability to drive revenue growth and profitability.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities.


 Leadership Skills
   

  

* Ability to influence senior stakeholders and lead cross\-functional initiatives.

* Demonstrated ownership mindset and execution excellence.


 Entrepreneurial DNA
   

  

* Thrives in fast\-paced, high\-growth environments.
* Comfortable with ambiguity and capable of solving complex business problems.
* Passionate about building and scaling businesses from the ground up.

description:

*

+ Experience building microservices and distributed systems using REST, gRPC, event\-driven patterns, and asynchronous processing
+ Hands\-on expertise with relational and NoSQL databases (Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, Cosmos DB) and performance tuning
+ Strong understanding of state management, scalability, resiliency, and application security


**AI Driven Application Development**
* Proven expertise in AI‑driven application development, embedding intelligence directly into modern, cloud‑native applications.
* Extensive hands‑on experience using GitHub Copilot as a core engineering capability to accelerate solution design, coding, refactoring, testing, and documentation across delivery teams.
* Demonstrated ability to foster a Copilot‑assisted engineering culture (“vibe”) \- enabling rapid iteration, AI pair‑programming, explain‑as‑you‑build workflows, and high‑velocity delivery without compromising engineering quality.

+ Strong grasp of platform engineering principles, building paved‑road solutions and self‑service capabilities that balance speed, governance, and operational excellence.

+ Translate business outcomes into clear architecture, execution plans, and risk mitigation strategies

title: Sr. Delivery Consultant, Customer Experience, Professional Services
description:
**Description**
 AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small\- and mid\-market accounts to enterprise\-level customers including public sector.
   

  

 The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
   

  

 We are seeking a Senior Delivery Consultant specializing in Amazon Connect Customer Experience to join AWS Professional Services. In this role, you will design, build, and deliver complex customer experience solutions on Amazon Connect, serving as the technical authority for enterprise\-grade contact center transformations. You will spend \*\*80% of your time\*\* hands\-on — architecting and implementing CX solutions — while leading pre\-sales engagements, driving team capability development, and integrating AI\-native approaches into every engagement.
   

  

 This is a customer\-facing delivery leadership role that combines deep technical execution with strategic consulting, pre\-sales leadership, and practice development.
   

  

 As an experienced technology professional, you will be responsible for:
   

  

* Designing and implementing complex, scalable, and secure AWS solutions tailored to customer needs
* Providing technical guidance and troubleshooting support throughout project delivery
* Collaborating with stakeholders to gather requirements and propose effective migration strategies
* Acting as a trusted advisor to customers on industry trends and emerging technologies
* Sharing knowledge within the organization through mentoring, training, and creating reusable artifacts


 \#\# Required Qualifications
   

  

 \#\#\# Technical Expertise
   

  

* \*\*10\+ years\*\* of hands\-on experience designing and implementing Amazon Connect solutions (or equivalent enterprise contact center platforms with 3\+ years on Connect)
* \*\*Deep proficiency\*\* in Amazon Connect ecosystem: Contact Flows, Routing Profiles, Contact Lens, Amazon Q in Connect, Lex, Outbound Campaigns, Tasks, Cases, and Customer Profiles
* \*\*Strong software engineering skills\*\* — Python, TypeScript/Node.js, AWS CDK/CloudFormation, CI/CD pipelines, serverless architectures (Lambda, Step Functions, DynamoDB, SQS/SNS)
* \*\*AI/ML competency\*\* — practical experience implementing generative AI solutions using Amazon Bedrock, LLM\-based agents, prompt engineering, RAG architectures, and conversational AI (Lex, Q in Connect)
* \*\*Integration expertise\*\* — building production integrations with CRM/ITSM systems (Salesforce, ServiceNow, Zendesk), telephony (SIP/PSTN), and workforce management platforms
* \*\*Architecture at scale\*\* — designing multi\-region, multi\-tenant, highly available contact center architectures handling 10,000\+ concurrent contacts


 \#\#\# Consulting \& Leadership
   

  

* \*\*Pre\-sales experience\*\* — led or co\-led 5\+ customer proposals/SOWs including effort estimation, delivery planning, and technical presentations to senior stakeholders
* \*\*Delivery leadership\*\* — managed end\-to\-end delivery on engagements with 5\+ team members, navigating scope changes, customer escalations, and go\-live coordination
* \*\*Stakeholder management\*\* — demonstrated ability to build trusted advisor relationships with VP/C\-level customer stakeholders
* \*\*Mentoring track record\*\* — coached or mentored 3\+ junior consultants; contributed to team hiring decisions


 \#\#\# Certifications (Required or within 6 months of hire)
   

  

* AWS Solutions Architect – Professional
* AWS Certified AI Practitioner or ML Specialty
* Amazon Connect Specialty (or equivalent demonstrated expertise)


 \* \* \*
   

  

 \#\# Preferred Qualifications
   

  

* Experience with \*\*Amazon Connect Agent Workspace\*\*, \*\*Step\-by\-step Guides\*\*, and \*\*Connect APIs\*\* for custom CRM embedding
* Hands\-on with \*\*agentic AI frameworks\*\* — multi\-agent orchestration, MCP (Model Context Protocol), AgentCore, Strands SDK
* Knowledge of \*\*contact center operations\*\* — WFM, quality management, compliance recording, PCI\-DSS, HIPAA considerations
* Experience \*\*migrating legacy platforms\*\* (Genesys, Avaya, Cisco, NICE) to Amazon Connect
* Background in \*\*voice AI\*\* — real\-time STT/TTS, voice biometrics, IVR modernization, voicebot design
* Published \*\*thought leadership\*\* — blogs, conference talks, whitepapers, or reference architectures in the CX/contact center domain
* Familiarity with \*\*ProServe delivery mechanisms\*\* — PDLC, engagement management, CSAT frameworks, utilization tracking


 \* \* \*
   

  

 \#\# Working Model
   

  

* \*\*80% Delivery:\*\* Hands\-on customer engagements — designing, building, deploying Connect CX solutions
* \*\*10% Pre\-Sales:\*\* Discovery workshops, proposals, estimations, customer presentations
* \*\*10% Practice:\*\* Team mentoring, capability uplift, TFC contributions, product team collaboration


 \* \* \*
   

  

 \#\# About the Team
   

  

 AWS Professional Services works with enterprise customers to accelerate cloud adoption and realize transformational business outcomes. The Connect CX practice delivers contact center modernization, AI\-powered customer experience solutions, and omnichannel transformation programs for some of the world's largest organizations.
   

  

 We are builders who are obsessed with customer outcomes, thrive in ambiguity, and believe the best solutions come from deep technical expertise combined with genuine curiosity about customer problems.
   

  

 \* \* \*
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Solution Design \& Delivery (80%)


 Architect and deliver complex Amazon Connect implementations including multi\-channel (voice, chat, email, task) contact center solutions for enterprise customers

description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $100 billion in investment capital as of June 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world’s capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
   

  

 The D. E. Shaw group seeks a motivated and detail\-oriented professional to join its growing Middle Office function in Hyderabad, Bengaluru, or Gurugram, India. This team supports the lifecycle of the firm's global trading strategies and serves as a key link between the front office and operational teams. This project\-focused role offers the opportunity to lead middle office projects that strengthen the firm's ability to support a growing and increasingly complex book of investment strategies, while retaining hands\-on operational ownership. This position will initially be an individual contributor role, with the potential to assume people management responsibilities in the future based on business needs and the candidate's interest.
   

  

**WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY\-TO\-DAY:**
 In this role, you will lead and deliver middle office projects that strengthen the firm's ability to support a growing and increasingly complex book of investment strategies. You will act as a project manager across internal and external teams—scoping requirements, driving solutioning, coordinating testing, and owning sign\-off on product roadmaps. You will partner with trading desks, technology, operations, and vendors to convert operational pain points into durable solutions that reduce risk and manual effort. You will manually handle exceptions and edge cases that fall outside automated workflows, resolving them accurately and feeding insights back into process improvements. You will work across the full trade lifecycle and a range of hedge fund asset classes, designing corner cases and defining exception handling for post\-automation workflows. You will also build workflows, dashboards, and tooling that give the desk and management clear visibility into trading activity, operational health, and risk.
   

  

**WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR:**
 Basic Qualifications:
   

  

* A postgraduate degree and 5\+ years of relevant experience across the trade lifecycle, including time in or alongside middle office functions

* Demonstrated experience managing projects end\-to\-end as a project manager across internal and external teams, including scoping, testing, sign\-off, and stakeholder coordination
* A risk\-first mindset, with the judgment to anticipate corner cases and design exception handling for post\-automation workflows
* Exceptional communication and organizational skills, with the ability to tailor messaging to senior management, stakeholders, front office, and vendors
* The ability to design or contribute to dashboards, workflows, and analytics that surface operational insight


 Preferred Qualifications:
   

  

* Experience with automation and hands\-on familiarity with emerging GenAI and LLM tooling, with the ability to identify and apply these pragmatically within middle office workflows
* Program management–related academic qualifications (e.g., MBA, PMP)

 .

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
**About NationsBenefits:** 




 At NationsBenefits, we are leading the transformation of the insurance industry by developing innovative benefits management solutions. We focus on modernizing complex back\-office systems to create scalable, secure, and high\-performing platforms that streamline operations for our clients. As part of our strategic growth, we are focused on platform modernization — transitioning legacy systems to modern, cloud\-native architectures that support the scalability, reliability, and high performance of core backoffice functions in the insurance domain.
 



  





**About Role:** 




 We are seeking an experienced
 **Senior Product Manager** 
 to own and drive the strategic direction of our Nations Vision product ecosystem — a multi\-tool platform supporting hundreds of clients across the vision benefits landscape. The ideal candidate brings deep analytical rigor, unwavering attention to detail, and a relentless commitment to product quality and accuracy. This is a hands\-on leadership role requiring someone who can navigate complex, interconnected systems — fee schedules, provider networks, plan configurations, and claims processing — while maintaining the trust of hundreds of clients who depend on flawless execution.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




**Product Ownership \& Strategy** 




 • Own the end\-to\-end product roadmap for the Nations Vision platform, balancing client needs, business priorities, and technical constraints
 



 • Translate complex business requirements into clear, actionable product specifications.
 



  





**Core System Management:** 




**• Provider\-Facing Claims Portal:** 
 Drive continuous enhancement of the provider portal, delivering new features that improve speed and accuracy for end users
 



**• Fee Schedule Design \& Configuration:** 
 Oversee the accuracy, configuration, and maintainability of fee schedules across the platform; champion self\-service configuration tools that empower Operations teams
 



**• Provider Network Mapping:** 
 Manage the configuration and integrity of provider network data, ensuring accurate mapping across geographies and specialties
 



**• Plan Access Restrictions:** 
 Direct the setup and validation of plan\-level access rules, benefit tiers, and eligibility parameters
 



**• Claims Processing Engine:** 
 Partner with engineering to optimize claims adjudication logic, troubleshoot processing issues, and ensure accurate, timely claim outcomes.
 



  





**Quality \& Accuracy Focus:** 




 • Establish and monitor quality benchmarks across all product tools and workflows
 



 • Proactively identify data integrity issues, configuration errors, and process gaps before they impact clients
 



 • Drive continuous improvement initiatives to reduce errors, increase automation, and enhance system reliability
 



 • Conduct regular audits and root\-cause analyses, implementing preventive measures when issues arise.
 



  





**Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** 




 • Serve as the primary product liaison between engineering, operations, client services, and leadership
 



 • Communicate product updates, risks, and roadmap changes clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders
 



 • Partner with client\-facing teams to understand pain points and translate feedback into product enhancements
 



 • Collaborate with QA to define testing protocols that ensure system accuracy at scale.
 



  





**Client \& Stakeholder Management:** 




 • Support hundreds of client configurations, ensuring the platform scales without sacrificing accuracy.
 



 • Address escalations related to fee schedules, network mapping, or claims discrepancies with urgency and precision.
 



 • Gather and prioritize feedback from client\-facing teams to inform the product backlog.
 



  





**Required Qualifications** 




 • 5\+ years of product management experience, preferably in healthcare, benefits administration, or insurance technology.
 



 • Demonstrated experience managing complex, multi\-component systems or platforms.
 



 • Working knowledge of database systems, with ability to write moderately complex SQL queries.
 



 • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and make data driven decisions.
 



 • Exceptional attention to detail, particularly in high\-stakes, accuracy\-critical environments.
 



 • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for varied audiences.
 



 • Experience with claims processing systems, provider network data, or fee schedule management strongly preferred.
 



 • Proven track record managing products that serve a large, diverse client base.
 



 • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, or a related field (MBA a plus).

title: Digital Product Manager
description:
**Job Location**
 HYDERABAD OFFICE INDIA PSC PGH
   

  

**Job Description**
 P\&G was founded over 180 years ago as a simple soap and candle company. Today, we're the world’s largest consumer goods company and home to iconic, trusted brands that make life a little bit easier in small but meaningful ways. We've spanned three centuries thanks to three simple ideas: leadership, innovation and citizenship. The insight, innovation and passion of hardworking teams have helped us grow into a global company that is governed responsibly and ethically, that is open and visible, and that supports good causes and protects the environment. This is a place where you can be proud to work and do something that matters.
   

  

**Dedication from Us:** 
 You'll be at the core of breakthrough innovations, be given exciting assignments, lead initiatives, and take ownership and responsibility, in creative workspaces where new insights thrive. All the while, you'll receive outstanding training to help you become a leader in your field. It is not just about what you'll do, but how you'll feel: encouraged, valued, purposeful, challenged, heard, and inspired.
   

  

**What we Offer:** 
 Continuous mentorship – you will collaborate with peers and receive both formal training as well as day\-to\-day mentoring from your manager dynamic and encouraging work environment– employees are at the centre, we value every individual and support initiative, promoting agility and work/life balance.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We are looking for a Digital Product Manager to join our Digital Products team and build digital products and capabilities that solve meaningful business problems. This role is designed for a professional with prior technology experience who can connect business needs with technology solutions and translate strategy into products that deliver measurable outcomes.
   

  

 You will work at the intersection of business, technology, data, users, and AI. You will understand user and business needs, shape product strategy, prioritize opportunities, work closely with engineering and technology teams, and drive products from discovery through delivery, adoption, and continuous improvement.
   

  

**Position Responsibilities**
**Own Product Vision, Strategy \& Roadmap**
* Define product vision, objectives, roadmap, priorities, and success measures aligned to business outcomes.
* Understand user needs, business processes, pain points, and opportunities and translate them into clear product requirements and user stories.
* Own backlog prioritization, balancing business value, user experience, technical feasibility, risk, dependencies, and engineering capacity.
* Use data, user feedback, experimentation, and business signals to make informed product decisions.
* Identify opportunities to simplify processes and create scalable digital capabilities
* Build 0\-1 Products which are AI Native first.


**Drive Product Delivery**
* Lead cross\-functional product initiatives from discovery through development, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.
* Partner closely with engineering, data, architecture, design, security, and technology teams to translate product intent into scalable solutions.
* Understand technical constraints, architecture choices, APIs, data dependencies, and delivery trade\-offs sufficiently to make effective product decisions.
* Create clarity on requirements, priorities, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and expected outcomes.
* Track delivery progress, proactively address risks and blockers, and ensure commitments remain aligned to product priorities.


**Influence Stakeholders \& Drive Change**
* Build alignment among stakeholders with different priorities, perspectives, and levels of technical understanding.
* Influence without relying solely on formal authority and create commitment around priorities, decisions, and trade\-offs.
* Drive change management through stakeholder engagement, communication, training, adoption, and feedback loops.
* Anticipate resistance and create practical approaches to move users and stakeholders toward adoption.
* Act as a trusted partner and 'go\-to' person for the products and initiatives you own.


**Build Data\- and AI\-Enabled Products**
* Identify opportunities where data, analytics, AI, GenAI, automation, or digital technologies can improve business outcomes.
* Work with data and technology teams to ensure products are built on trusted, accessible, and appropriately governed information.
* Explore AI\-enabled experiences and workflows that help people access information, make better decisions, and reduce repetitive work.
* Ensure AI and automation capabilities are introduced with appropriate human oversight, controls, and accountability.


**Drive Adoption \& Value Realization**
* Define product KPIs, adoption metrics, user experience measures, and value metrics.
* Use product usage and business performance signals to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Develop stakeholder engagement and adoption plans for new capabilities.
* Create feedback mechanisms that continuously bring user and business insights back into product development.
* Ensure products deliver measurable value beyond initial launch.


**Partner with Technology \& External Teams**
* Collaborate with engineering, architecture, data, design, cybersecurity, IT, and vendor teams.
* Manage technology and business dependencies required to deliver product outcomes.
* Partner with vendors and external technology providers where required, ensuring clarity of outcomes, delivery expectations, and accountability.
* Contribute to solution design, testing, release planning, reliability, security, data quality, and long\-term sustainability.


**The Ideal Candidate**
* Has an MBA or prior hands\-on experience in technology, software, data, IT, digital engineering, or a related technical environment building AI native products.
* Has less than 3 years of post\-MBA experience / Relevant experience and is looking to build a career at the intersection of business, technology, and product management.
* Can combine business thinking with enough technical depth to engage credibly with engineers and technology teams.
* Is comfortable translating ambiguous business problems into structured product opportunities and clear requirements.
* Has strong influencing and stakeholder\-management skills and can create alignment without formal authority.
* Demonstrates the ability to drive adoption and change across diverse stakeholder groups.
* Is analytically strong and comfortable using data, KPIs, user feedback, and business signals to make decisions.
* Can communicate clearly with senior leaders, business users, engineers, data teams, designers, vendors, and other partners.
* Has strong ownership, bias for action, learning agility, and resilience in a fast\-moving environment.
* Is curious about emerging technologies, including AI, GenAI, automation, analytics, cloud, and modern digital platforms.


**Job Qualifications**
**Qualifications:**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, Analytics, or a related field.
* MBA or equivalent postgraduate management qualification from a recognized institution.
* Less than 3 years of professional experience post\-MBA.
* Prior professional experience in technology, software engineering, data, IT, digital, systems, or another technology\-focused role.
* Strong understanding of technology\-enabled business solutions and the software development lifecycle.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, influencing, structured problem\-solving, and collaboration skills.
* Ability to work effectively across business and technology teams and translate between the two.


**About Us**
**We produce globally recognized brands, and we grow the best business leaders in the industry. With a portfolio of trusted brands as diverse as ours, it is paramount our leaders can lead with courage the vast array of brands, categories, and functions. We serve consumers around the world with one of the strongest portfolios of trusted, quality, leadership brands, including Always®, Ariel®, Gillette®, Head \& Shoulders®, Herbal Essences®, Oral\-B®, Pampers®, Pantene®, Tampax® and more. Our community includes operations in approximately 70 countries worldwide.**
**Visit** 
**http://www.pg.com** 
**to know more.**
**We are an equal\-opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate against individuals based on race, color, gender, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, citizenship, disability, HIV/AIDS status, or any other legally protected factor.**
***At P\&G, the hiring journey is personalized every step of the way, thereby ensuring equal opportunities for all, with a strong foundation of Ethics \& Corporate Responsibility guiding everything we do.***
***All the available job opportunities are posted either on our website \- pgcareers.com, or on our official social media pages, for the convenience of prospective candidates, and do not require them to pay any kind of fees towards their application.”***

title: Lead Product Manager
description:
**Opentext \- The Information Company**
 OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to partner with the most highly regarded companies in the world, tackle complex issues, and contribute to projects that shape the future of digital transformation.
   

  

**AI\-First. Future\-Driven. Human\-Centered.**
 At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do—powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We're hiring talent that AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us.
   

  

 Your Impact
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced Product Manager to take end\-to\-end ownership of assigned capabilities within OpenText eDiscovery. In this role, you will define product vision and strategy, translate client and market needs into clear product direction, establish multi\-quarter roadmaps, and lead cross\-functional execution from discovery through release, adoption, measurement, and continuous improvement.
   

  

 You will operate at both strategic and execution levels—setting a compelling direction for assigned eDiscovery capabilities while providing the day\-to\-day Product Owner leadership required to deliver them. You will independently own meaningful components or capability areas within the broader eDiscovery product strategy, defining the problems to solve, desired client and business outcomes, investment priorities, dependencies, and delivery plans.
   

  

 You will work closely with Engineering, Architecture, UX, Product Management, Product Marketing, Sales, Professional Services, Support, Security, Compliance, and other stakeholders to deliver enterprise\-grade capabilities that create measurable client and business value.
   

  

 What the Role Offers
   

  

* Defining and communicating a clear, evidence\-based vision and strategy for assigned eDiscovery capabilities, aligned with broader product strategy and measurable client and business outcomes.
* Owning the complete product lifecycle, from problem discovery and investment framing through requirements, development, release, adoption, measurement, and continuous improvement.
* Building and maintaining multi\-quarter product roadmaps and making clear prioritization and investment trade\-offs based on client value, strategic alignment, market differentiation, risk, effort, and commercial impact.
* Translating product strategy into well\-defined epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, release plans, and a prioritized backlog that provides Engineering with clarity on both outcomes and intent.
* Leading cross\-functional alignment across Engineering, Architecture, UX, Product Management, Product Marketing, Sales, Professional Services, Support, Security, Compliance, and other teams.
* Identifying and actively managing cross\-team dependencies, establishing clear owners and decision points, removing ambiguity, and driving issues to resolution without waiting for escalation.
* Gathering and synthesizing insights from clients, field teams, usage data, technical stakeholders, market trends, and competitive analysis to validate problems, priorities, and product direction.
* Acting as the authoritative voice for assigned capabilities and communicating product direction, decisions, priorities, and outcomes clearly to delivery teams, stakeholders, clients, and senior leadership.
* Conducting product reviews, demonstrations, and stakeholder engagements as required to build alignment and product advocacy.
* Coordinating the inputs required for successful releases, including UX, security, compliance, accessibility, localization, enablement, documentation, and operational readiness.
* Measuring product outcomes after release, using qualitative and quantitative feedback to refine the roadmap, improve product practices, and continuously raise the quality of product decisions.
* Building strong relationships across globally distributed teams and influencing outcomes effectively in an environment where direct authority may be limited.


 What you need to Succeed
   

  

* Significant experience in software product management or product ownership, with demonstrated independent ownership of a product, platform area, or substantial end\-to\-end capability.
* Proven ability to define product vision and strategy, connect them to client and business needs, and translate them into actionable roadmaps and executable plans.
* Strong experience managing the complete product lifecycle, including discovery, requirements definition, prioritization, development, release planning, adoption, measurement, and iteration.
* Strong understanding of Agile and iterative software development methodologies, including backlog management, epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, release planning, and collaboration with Engineering teams.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex technical and product topics for varied audiences, including senior stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively across multiple teams and manage complex dependencies in a global software organization without direct authority.
* Strong prioritization and decision\-making skills, with the ability to make effective trade\-offs and drive progress through ambiguity and changing business or technical constraints.
* Highly self\-motivated and outcome\-oriented, with strong ownership, follow\-through, quality standards, and a continuous improvement mindset.
* Ability to work effectively with developers and architects, understand technical constraints, and participate meaningfully in architecture, security, compliance, and operational discussions.
* Experience gathering and synthesizing client, field, market, competitive, usage, and technical feedback into coherent product requirements and informed product decisions.
* Experience working with enterprise software, SaaS, cloud platforms, complex workflows, APIs, integrations, or platform capabilities.
* Strong stakeholder management and cross\-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to build trust and drive alignment across Product, Engineering, Sales, Services, Support, and other functions.
* Experience supporting product releases and go\-to\-market readiness, including demonstrations, enablement, documentation, positioning, or field engagement.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* Knowledge of eDiscovery, legal technology, analytics, information governance, compliance, security, or related enterprise software domains.
* Experience with enterprise SaaS or cloud\-based software products and globally distributed development organizations.
* Experience with APIs, integrations, platform capabilities, or complex enterprise workflows.
* Experience in product management for technically complex enterprise products or platforms.
* Familiarity with accessibility, security, privacy, localization, certification, compliance, and release\-governance requirements.
* Experience using product analytics, client feedback, market intelligence, or competitive analysis to inform product strategy and roadmap decisions.
* Experience working with global clients, enterprise customers, field organizations, or professional services teams.


 OpenText's efforts to build an inclusive work environment go beyond simply complying with applicable laws. Our Employment Equity and Diversity Policy provides direction on maintaining a working environment that is inclusive of everyone, regardless of culture, national origin, race, color, gender, gender identification, sexual orientation, family status, age, veteran status, disability, religion, or other basis protected by applicable laws.
   

  

 If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please contact us at hr@opentext.com. Our proactive approach fosters collaboration, innovation, and personal growth, enriching OpenText's vibrant workplace.

title: Product Owner
description:
At
 **Epiq** 
 , your work contributes to complex, global legal outcomes. You’ll join a values‑driven community where integrity guides decisions,
 **relentless service** 
 sets the bar, and we
 **thrive on big challenges** 
 together. We invest in your growth with enterprise‑wide learning and mobility. We celebrate who you are, and we respect life beyond work with flexibility that’s recognized externally. Enabled by modern platforms and AI,
 **you’ll do the most meaningful work of your career** 
 and see your impact at scale.
   

  

**Job Description:**
**Job Summary**
 As a Product Owner you are the primary link between stakeholders and delivery teams, balancing business priorities, customer expectations, operational realities, and technical feasibility. You will work closely with CTO’s org, Engineering Leadership, product management and cross\-function teams.
   

  

 The role calls for a highly motivated, independent thinker who is organized, detail\-oriented, adaptable, and effective at building relationships across diverse teams and stakeholder groups.
   

  

 Maximize product value by owning the definition, prioritization, and delivery of product capabilities — translating customer, business, operational, and regulatory needs into clear, actionable requirements and measurable outcomes.
   

  

**Essential Job Responsibilities**
**Product Vision, Strategy \& Roadmap**
* Define and communicate a product vision aligned with Epiq's strategic objectives and client needs.
* Create, maintain, and prioritize the product roadmap to deliver maximum business value.
* Partner with Product Management and Senior Product Owners to align delivery priorities with the broader product strategy.
* Define minimum viable products, experiments, and incremental delivery approaches that get value to business and customers early.


**Backlog Ownership \& Agile Delivery**
* Own, maintain, and continuously refine the product backlog, prioritizing on value, risk, dependencies, and technical feasibility.
* Translate business needs into epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional requirements. Lead backlog refinement and participate in sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, and release planning.
* Provide day\-to\-day requirement clarification and timely product decisions to engineering, QA, and UX, resolving impediments as they arise.


**Hands\-On AI Fluency \& Tooling**
* Use AI tools hands\-on in daily product work — requirement drafting, story refinement, discovery synthesis, research, meeting summarization, usage analysis — and maintain reusable prompt patterns for those workflows.
* Stay current on AI capabilities and emerging patterns, and translate that awareness into concrete product decisions.
* Build lightweight prototypes and clickable concepts using AI\-assisted and low\-code tools to validate ideas before committing engineering capacity.
* Identify and prioritize AI use cases on customer value, feasibility, data readiness, risk, and measurable impact, including where AI can remove manual effort from operational and client\-facing workflows.
* Define evaluation criteria for AI\-enabled features — accuracy, groundedness, latency, cost, confidence thresholds — with human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints and fallback paths for non\-deterministic output.
* Ensure AI usage meets privacy, security, client\-confidentiality, auditability, and responsible\-use requirements, and never treat unvalidated AI output as a final decision or deliverable.


**Stakeholder \& Customer Leadership**
* Serve as the voice of the customer and the liaison between business stakeholders, technical teams, operations, and clients.
* Gather and document business and customer requirements, and facilitate discovery workshops, demonstrations, and feedback sessions.
* Convert customer feedback, usage trends, and operational insight into actionable backlog changes.
* Communicate priorities, roadmap progress, delivery status, risks, and key decisions with clarity.
* Build trusted relationships and influence decisions across organizational levels, from delivery squads to senior leadership.


**Quality, Risk \& Continuous Improvement**
* Embed security, privacy, compliance, information governance, and operational readiness into the product lifecycle.
* Identify and communicate delivery risks, assumptions, dependencies, and constraints early.
* Define success metrics and track adoption, utilization, and business value to guide roadmap and investment decisions.
* Support product documentation, release communications, and enablement materials.
* 
* Validate delivered functionality, lead feature acceptance, and support UAT, release readiness, and deployment.


**Qualifications, Requirements \& Skills**
**Education**
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Advanced degree, or a product management certification (CSPO, PSPO, SAFe PO/PM, CSM, or equivalent).


**Experience**
* 7\+ years as a Product Owner, Product Manager, Business Analyst, Product Analyst role.
* Proven delivery in Agile or Scrum environments, owning enterprise software or SaaS backlogs.
* Demonstrated ability to elicit requirements and translate complex business needs into user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Hands\-on experience with backlog \& delivery\-management tools \- Azure DevOps (Preferred), Jira.
* Practical, day\-to\-day use of AI tools in product, analysis, or delivery work, with specific examples of how they changed your output or decisions.
* Strong stakeholder engagement across business and technology teams, with excellent written and verbal communication.
* Experience defining, launching, or scaling AI or machine\-learning\-enabled product features in production.
* Added Advantage \- Experience with document capture, classification, data extraction, or workflow automation technologies.
* Experience supporting global stakeholders and distributed development teams.
* Experience running structured pilots or proofs of concept with emerging technology vendors.


**Product Ownership**
* Backlog management and value\-driven prioritization
* Requirements elicitation, analysis, and functional documentation
* Roadmap planning and product lifecycle support
* Business process analysis and process improvement


**AI Adoption**
* Applied AI literacy: LLMs, prompt engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation, agentic and automation workflows
* AI\-assisted document classification, summarization, and intelligent data extraction
* Evaluation and quality criteria for non\-deterministic features, including human\-in\-the\-loop design
* Responsible AI: data privacy, security, confidentiality, auditability, and bias awareness
* AI\-assisted prototyping and low\-code or no\-code tooling
* Software development lifecycle knowledge; comfort with APIs, integrations, cloud applications, and enterprise architecture
* Data analysis and metrics interpretation; self\-sufficient with dashboards and queries


**Collaboration \& Personal Effectiveness**
* Stakeholder management and relationship building across varied personalities and communication styles
* Cross\-functional influence without authority
* Independent thinking, self\-motivation, ownership, and accountability
* Adaptability and comfort with changing direction in a fast\-paced environment
* Organization, attention to detail, and structured problem solving
* Customer\-first mindset and sound judgment under ambiguity
* Curiosity and continuous learning — particularly in a field moving as quickly as AI


**Domain Knowledge (Good to Have)**
* Experience in Legal Technology, eDiscovery, Compliance, Information Governance, Digital Forensics, Data Breach Response, Court Reporting, records or content management, or Professional Services.
* Document capture solutions, records management, Enterprise content management and workflow automation


**Success Measures**
 You may be assessed on the critical capabilities relevant to success in this role, including:
   

  

* Product vision development and strategic roadmap execution
* Timely delivery of prioritized product enhancements against a clear, well\-maintained backlog
* Requirements quality and solution delivery excellence
* Effective stakeholder communication, alignment, and cross\-functional influence
* High\-quality release execution and feature acceptance
* Adoption and utilization of delivered product capabilities
* Measurable business value realization and operational efficiency gains
* Demonstrated, practical application of AI tools and capabilities to improve product outcomes and team productivity
* Continuous improvement of product outcomes, processes, and user experience


**Competencies**
**Integrity –** 
 Behaves in an honest, fair, and ethical manner; shows consistency in words and actions; does what she/he commits to doing; respects the confidentiality of information or concerns shared by others; is honest and forthright with people; carries his/her fair share of the workload; takes responsibility for own mistakes.
   

  

**Client Focus –** 
 Takes action with the clients, both internal and external, and sees their needs as a primary focus; builds a sustaining collaborative and productive relationship with clients; seeks to understand client situations, issues, expectations, etc.; takes appropriate action to meet client needs and address concerns; implements or utilizes methods to monitor and evaluate client feedback.
   

  

**Results\-Driven** 
 – Sets stretch goals for personal and team accomplishment and works tenaciously to achieve those goals; acts with a sense of urgency; takes the initiative on actions; identifies what needs to be done and takes action before being asked; does more than what is normally required in a situation; establishes metrics to monitor progress and measure success; maintains focus by avoiding or overcoming roadblocks.
   

  

**Entrepreneurial Orientation** 
 – Proposes innovative business opportunities/ideas to customers and business partners; encourages and supports entrepreneurial behavior in others; demonstrates willingness to take calculated risks to achieve business goals.
   

  

**Decisiveness** 
 – Makes well\-informed, effective, and timely decisions even when data is limited, or solutions produce unpleasant consequences; perceives the impact and implications of decisions; can make tough decisions.
   

  

 Your specific salary will be determined based on several factors:
   

  

* Location\-based market rate for the role
* Your abilities in relation to the job specification
* Performance during screening and interview
* Pay parity with the wider team in the considered location


 Further details about the package will be provided during the initial screening call with the Talent Acquisition Team.

 Inspires action and alignment through clear communication, purposeful influence, and a compelling vision.

title: Program Leader, Tech Transformation (Mobility & Delivery + New Bets) - Field Operations
description:
**About The Role**
 This role sits within Field Operations and owns the conversion of manual, human\-intensive workflows across Mobility (Rides) and Delivery (Eats/Grocery) COE queues, as well as workflows supporting New Bets, into AI\-powered tools and automations. You will partner with Mobility, Delivery, and New Bets operations leaders, Product, and Engineering to design solutions where AI handles the bulk of processing across support, ops, and quality queues, freeing humans to focus on exceptions and higher\-judgment work. Given the breadth of this scope, the role requires the ability to move fluidly across multiple LOBs and quickly ramp up on unfamiliar or emerging business models.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Own identification, prioritization, and transformation of high\-volume, high\-friction workflows across Mobility, Delivery, and New Bets COE queues into AI\-first, largely automated processes
* Build fluency in current\-state workflows across each LOB \- volumes, TAT, quality, cost\-to\-serve, failure modes \- and build the case for automation, sequencing by impact and feasibility
* Partner with Mobility, Delivery, and New Bets operations leaders, Product, and Engineering to design solutions and the human\-in\-the\-loop review experience
* Drive delivery from pilot to scaled rollout across LOBs and geographies, adapting the approach to each business's maturity and volume profile
* Define and track metrics \- automation rate, accuracy, TAT, cost\-to\-serve, capacity impact \- per LOB, and report impact to Field Ops and LOB leadership
* Act as the connective tissue between LOB leadership, Product, Engineering, and Data Science, keeping the roadmap grounded in real operational needs across businesses
* Scan the internal/external AI landscape for opportunities applicable across Mobility, Delivery, and New Bets
* Build enablement and change\-management plans tailored to each LOB's frontline teams


**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree
* 8\+ years of experience in program management, operations strategy, consulting, or technology\-driven operations transformation, ideally across more than one business line
* Demonstrated experience partnering directly with Product and Engineering to scope, prioritize, and ship technical solutions
* Working understanding of how AI/ML and GenAI tools apply to high\-volume operational workflows across marketplace businesses, including where human review is still needed
* Strong analytical/quantitative skills \- sizing opportunities, defining success metrics, and measuring impact across multiple LOBs
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to translate operational pain points from different businesses into clear, buildable requirements
* Comfort managing multiple concurrent workstreams across different LOBs with a track record of shipping measurable outcomes


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience across ride\-hailing, delivery, or other on\-demand marketplace operations, or comfort ramping quickly on new/emerging business models (New Bets)
* Prior experience designing or launching human\-in\-the\-loop AI systems for support, dispatch, quality, or fraud\-adjacent operational queues
* Direct experience working with engineering on solution design \- PRDs/specs, data/API requirements, pilots, and iteration
* Familiarity with GenAI tooling (LLM APIs, agent frameworks, prompt engineering, RAG) sufficient for credible technical conversations
* Experience in a top\-tier strategy consulting firm, or in operations\-at\-scale/marketplace businesses
* Strong stakeholder management skills across multiple LOB leadership teams with differing priorities and maturity levels
* Bias for action and comfort with ambiguity, especially for New Bets where workflows and volumes are still evolving

 Job Category

 Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life.  Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

 We’re Salesforce, the Customer Company, inspiring the future of business with AI \+ Data \+ CRM. Leading with our core values, we help companies across every industry blaze new trails and connect with customers in a whole new way. And, we empower you to be a Trailblazer, too — driving your performance and career growth, charting new paths, and improving the state of the world. If you believe in business as the greatest platform for change and in companies doing well and doing good – you’ve come to the right place.
   

  

 Salesforce is transforming the way prospects, customers and Trailblazers interact with the company on the web. We are unifying the digital experience of online visitors across corporate brand websites and our Trailblazer ecosystem on a shared digital platform. The result will be dynamic and personalized based on a visitors role, industry, and location. It will also be a showcase of Salesforce products.
   

  

 Role Scope
   

  

 As a member of the Cloud Success Readiness team, you will be deeply invested in every aspect of the Agentforce and/or Data Cloud customer experience. You will work closely with Readiness Architects, Technology \& Product (T\&P) and our Customer Success Group (CSG) teams to ensure that we are delivering customer success to every customer at scale.
   

  

 Cloud Success Readiness improves customer Adoption and Product Quality by proactively addressing the most relevant customer needs, and by readying our stakeholders to deliver product innovation to our customers. As a Readiness Architect, you will be responsible for understanding the Agentforce and Data Cloud product portfolio, maintaining deep knowledge of product capabilities, and how they map to key customer use cases. You will leverage your product knowledge and technical expertise to surface product insights and recommendations, and document Agentforce and Data Cloud Product Feedback for the T\&P organization. You’ll work closely with Cloud Success teams, including Success Architects, Success Guides, Support Engineers, and Account Success stakeholders to scale your product expertise and knowledge of the product lifecycle to better enable their work with customers.
   

  

 We manage our work via Strategic Initiatives across the product lifecycle including new products and features, end\-of\-life retirements, and strategic programs such as migration or adoption efforts. We act as early adopters to bring architectural guidance, product expertise, innovation, and knowledge capital to our stakeholders in Customer Success and Technology \& Products.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will be comfortable collaborating within a larger team of subject matter experts and developing key stakeholder relationships across the organization to influence decision making.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Maintain deep understanding of Agentforce and Data Cloud products and roadmap and engage with T\&P and CSG stakeholders in the development of Agentforce and Data Cloud product feedback, roadmaps, strategic readiness plans, and customer adoption plays.
* Develop expertise for all new product and feature introductions, large\-scale migration efforts or product retirements. Document best practices and learnings from product interaction (e.g. pilots, pre\-launch discovery) to deliver to Cloud Success teams —including Success Architects, Success Guides, Support Engineers, and Account Success stakeholders— and deliver readiness for scale.
* Collaborate closely with your Readiness Architect team, leveraging your product, domain and business knowledge to create a holistic POV and strategic approach that supports the overall Agentforce and Data Cloud strategy and customer success, working with stakeholders across the organization.
* Maintain deep technical, functional and domain knowledge across all in\-market and new products. Practice continuous learning through first\-hand product experimentation and participation in Product\-driven betas, pilots and collaboration with SMEs in the Success Ecosystem.
* Identify, document, and track all recommended product enhancements reflecting inputs from customer, partner and internal stakeholders. Develop product requirements and deliver to Product Leadership for roadmap consideration.
* Provide product expertise to support the creation and rollout of adoption strategies to improve product adoption score and overall customer health.
* Participate in improving the CSS adoption score / customer health for Agentforce and Data Cloud.
* Work with other Readiness Success Architects across Cloud Success to continuously improve our operating model and share best practices.


****Experience****
* 8\+ years experience in individual contributor role in the SaaS industry.
* Hands\-on experience working with Agentforce and Data Cloud products, including deep understanding of current product suite and product capabilities that meet common customer use cases; understanding of competitor products and landscape a plus.
* Track record of collaborating within a team of subject matter experts who deliver against strategic business initiatives.
* Has held positions requiring interaction with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders at the across different functions. Understands and can translate customer use cases to technical and functional requirements.
* Salesforce Developer Experience a Requirement


****Skills \& Expertise****
* Strong Communication: Strong oral and written communication skills.
* Prioritization Agility: Approach work with a ‘beginner’s mind’ and shift focus and direction when needed to drive higher priority outcomes.
* Drive for Results: Can be counted on to exceed goals successfully; is constantly and consistently one of the top performers; very bottom\-line oriented; steadfastly pushes self and others for results.
