title: Transformation Officer
description:
**About Us**
 As a world leading provider of integrated solutions for the alternative investment industry, Alter Domus (meaning “The Other House” in Latin) is proud to be home to 90% of the top 30 asset managers in the private markets, and more than 6,000 professionals across 24 jurisdictions.
   

  

 With a deep understanding of what it takes to succeed in alternatives, we believe in being different in what we do, how we work, and most importantly in how we enable and develop our people. Invest yourself in the alternative, and join an organization where you progress on merit, where you can speak openly with whoever you are speaking to, and where you will be supported along whichever path you choose to take.
   

  

 Find out more about life at Alter Domus at careers.alterdomus.com
   

  

 The Transformation Officer is an intellectually curious, analytically driven role at the foundation of the Transformation Office. Working as a core member of a transformation program team, this individual supports the delivery of discrete workstreams by conducting structured business analysis, gathering and synthesising operational data, mapping processes, engaging with subject matter experts, and producing clear outputs that drive informed decision\-making and program progress.
   

  

 This is an ideal role for an early\-career professional with the mindset of a consultant — someone who is energised by problem\-solving, takes initiative to dig into the detail, and takes pride in producing high\-quality, rigorous work. The Transformation Officer will work closely alongside global process owners, operations teams, and lines of business, gaining broad exposure to the firm's operations and technology landscape while contributing meaningfully to real transformation outcomes from day one.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities**
**Analysis \& Research**
* Conduct structured current\-state analysis to understand existing processes, workflows, roles, and operational pain points, through interviews, workshops, and data review
* Gather, clean, and analyse quantitative and qualitative data to identify trends, inefficiencies, and opportunities for improvement
* Develop and maintain process maps, data models, and analytical frameworks that underpin workstream findings and recommendations
* Analyse interdependencies between people, process, technology, and governance elements of the operating model, under the guidance of the Senior Officer or Program Lead
* Proactively research best practices, benchmarks, and comparable approaches to inform solution design
* Contribute to the development of business cases, options papers, and other analytical outputs that inform senior decision\-making


**Stakeholder Engagement \& Requirements Gathering**
* Engage day\-to\-day with global process owners, operations teams, and lines of business to gather information, validate analysis, and support the change process
* Support the facilitation of workshops and interviews with stakeholders across functions to capture requirements, surface pain points, and gather input
* Assist in translating business needs into clear, structured requirements and user stories for technology and process workstreams
* Support change impact assessments and stakeholder mapping activities
* Build constructive working relationships with subject matter experts and operational counterparts across the business
* Communicate findings and workstream updates clearly and concisely, both verbally and in writing, in a manner appropriate to the audience


**Technology\-Enabled Transformation**
* Support work with Global Process Owners, Tech, Product, and Operations teams to understand technology solutions and their implications for the operating model
* Contribute to the definition of functional requirements and business logic for tech\-enabled tools, workflows, and automation opportunities
* Develop an active awareness of AI and agentic AI tools and their potential to create value within transformation workstreams, in line with Alter Domus's AI governance framework
* Assist in ensuring alignment between business processes and system capabilities, flagging gaps and inconsistencies for resolution


**Workstream Support \& Delivery**
* Support the end\-to\-end delivery of assigned workstreams, taking ownership of defined tasks and deliverables within the broader program plan
* Maintain up\-to\-date workstream documentation, including process maps, trackers, issue logs, and meeting notes
* Assist with data analysis, reporting, and insights to inform program governance and decision\-making
* Participate in testing, user acceptance, and validation activities to ensure solutions meet business needs
* Identify and escalate risks, blockers, and dependencies promptly, with an initial view on potential solutions
* Demonstrate a self\-starter attitude — proactively progressing work without waiting for direction, and consistently delivering to a high standard


**Change Management \& Documentation**
* Support the design and delivery of change activities, including communications, training materials, and readiness assessments
* Help identify change resistance and contribute to strategies that build engagement and adoption across impacted teams
* Produce clear, well\-structured documentation of current\-state and future\-state processes, including standard operating procedures (SOPs), playbooks, and knowledge assets to enable smooth transition to new ways of working
* Contribute to knowledge transfer activities and ensure workstream outputs are thoroughly recorded and accessible for BAU teams


**Essential**
**Skills \& Experience Required:**
* 3\-4 years of professional experience in management consulting, business analysis, operations, financial services, or a related analytical field; exceptional recent graduates will also be considered
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills — able to structure problems clearly, analyse data rigorously, and draw well\-reasoned conclusions
* High attention to detail with a commitment to producing accurate, high\-quality work
* Clear and effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present information in a structured and compelling way
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; ability to build clean models and well\-structured presentations
* A proactive, self\-starting mindset — intellectually curious, eager to learn, and comfortable taking initiative in ambiguous situations
* Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously in a fast\-paced environment
* High levels of personal drive, ownership, and accountability


**Desirable**
* Domain knowledge in one or more of the following:
+ Fund Administration (e.g., NAV production, investor reporting, transfer agency, custody operations, or related middle/back\-office processes)
+ Financial Services Technology (e.g., platforms, infrastructure, system implementations, or digital transformation)
+ AI Enablement (e.g., GenAI adoption, process automation, AI\-assisted workflows, or data\-driven transformation)

* Sound understanding of how regulated financial services entities operate, with some exposure to fund administration, private equity, alternative investments, or wealth management
* Exposure to regulatory change programmes or compliance\-driven transformation
* Experience with service design, customer journey mapping, or lean/six sigma methodologies
* Prior exposure to process improvement, project delivery, or transformation activity in any context (professional or academic)
* Familiarity with process mapping or collaboration tools (e.g., Visio, Lucidchart, Miro, Confluence, Jira)
* Familiarity with project management or change management frameworks (e.g., Agile, PRINCE2, Prosci, Kotter)
* Familiarity with technology concepts such as workflow automation, system integration, APIs, and cloud\-based platforms
* Business analysis certification (e.g., BCS, IIBA/CBAP) or Agile/Scrum certification (CSM, CSPO) a plus
* Undergraduate or postgraduate degree from a leading institution, ideally in Business, Economics, Finance, Engineering, or a field with role\-relevant transferable skills


**What We Offer**
 We are committed to supporting your development, advancing your career, and providing benefits that matter to you.
   

  

 Our industry\-leading Alter Domus Academy offers six learning zones for every stage of your career, with resources tailored to your ambitions and resources from LinkedIn Learning.
   

  

**Our Global Benefits Also Include**
* Support for professional accreditations
* Flexible arrangements, generous holidays, plus an additional day off for your birthday!
* Continuous mentoring along your career progression
* Active sports, events and social committees across our offices
* 24/7 support available from our Employee Assistance Program
* The opportunity to invest in our growth and success through our Employee Share Plan
* Plus additional local benefits depending on your location


 Alter Domus is an Equal Opportunity Employer: Equity Statement
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

title: Deputy Director - AI Solution and Platforms
description:
**Overview**
 The AI Solution Engineer is a delivery focused engineer who designs, builds, and operates production agentic AI applications, along with the platform services those applications run on. Working within the technical direction set by AI Solutions and Platforms leadership, the AI Solution Engineer translates solution architecture into production grade agents, retrieval pipelines, tool and system integrations, evaluation harnesses, and the guardrails and observability that keep those systems reliable once live.
   

  

 The AI Solution Engineer is a hands on practitioner who codes, integrates, tests, and iterates, owning feature level delivery across one or more solution or platform tracks while building a working understanding of the wider AI platform. The role works daily with modern AI engineering tooling, including agentic frameworks such as LangChain and LangGraph, the Model Context Protocol, and coding agents such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot and Codex. This is a technical builder first, with a growing architect mindset
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Responsibilities**
* Solution Architecture and Delivery: Architect, build and deploy production agentic AI applications for R\&D, taking them from problem definition and prototype through to production use by scientists and engineers.
* Hands On Engineering: Write production Python and own the difficult parts, including retrieval quality, tool and function design, multi agent orchestration, context management, structured outputs, latency and unit cost. Set the technical bar through design and code review.
* Agentic Framework Selection: Build with LangChain, LangGraph, MCP and agent to agent patterns. Select the appropriate model across Anthropic Claude, Azure OpenAI and Google model families, and recognise when a deterministic or classical machine learning approach is the correct answer.
* Evaluation and Quality: Establish evaluation as a delivery gate, covering golden datasets built with R\&D subject matter experts, automated evaluations in CI, regression and grounded Ness testing, red teaming, and human review in the loop. Take solutions from prototype into production and remain accountable for them once live.
* Platform Ownership: Own the shared AI platform for R\&D, including retrieval and vector infrastructure, agent runtime, prompt and model registry, MCP server and connector layer, guardrails, tracing and observability, cost attribution and rate management. Define reference architectures and reusable patterns so that downstream teams ship in weeks rather than quarters.
* MLOps and LLMOps: Embed CI/CD for models, prompts and agents, infrastructure as code, environment promotion, versioning, monitoring, incident response, model deprecation and migration.
* Enterprise Integration: Integrate AI solutions with the R\&D and enterprise estate, including PLM, LIMS, specification and document management systems, SAP, the Azure data platform and the enterprise Lakehouse.
* Security and Governance: Own security, privacy and governance for these systems in partnership with Cyber, Legal, Privacy and Responsible AI, covering access control, secrets management, handling of confidential formulation and specification data, and auditability. Contribute to AI governance standards for R\&D.
* People Leadership: Lead, coach and grow a team of AI and platform engineers. Develop technical depth in the team and build AI literacy across the wider R\&D community.
* Stakeholder Partnership: Partner with R\&D scientists, category and platform leaders to convert ambiguous scientific problems into scoped, valuable products, and to decline those that will not work. Manage delivery partners and vendors. Communicate credibly with a food scientist and a cloud architect in the same conversation, and with senior leadership on portfolio, risk and value.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Data Science or a related quantitative field. Masters preferred.
* 10 to 14 years in software, data or machine learning engineering, including at least 2 to 3 years building and running LLM and generative AI solutions in production.
* 2 or more years leading engineers, formally or as a senior technical lead, with evidence of having developed people.
* Strong hands\-on Python. Code quality will be assessed during the interview process.
* Deep practical experience with agentic AI, covering tool calling, planning, memory, multi agent and agent to agent patterns, retrieval augmented generation, structured output, guardrails and evaluation.
* Production experience with LangChain and LangGraph, or an equivalent framework such as LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, CrewAI, Pydantic AI or custom orchestration, with a clear view of the tradeoffs.
* Daily working use of AI coding agents such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex or Cursor, including agent configuration and custom tooling rather than inline completion alone.
* Solid understanding of LLM fundamentals, including context windows, embeddings, tokenization, fine tuning versus adapters versus prompting, and failure modes such as hallucination and prompt injection.
* Cloud and platform engineering experience. Azure preferred, covering Azure OpenAI or AI Foundry, AKS and Functions, or the equivalent on AWS or GCP. Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform or Bicep, CI/CD and API design.
* Data foundations, including SQL, Spark or Databricks, vector stores, and real experience working with messy unstructured technical documents.
* Prior delivery of technology for an R\&D, scientific or laboratory function in CPG, food and beverage, pharma, chemicals, flavors and fragrances, agriculture or materials science.
* Working familiarity with scientific and product data, including formulations and recipes, technical specifications, bills of materials, ingredient masters, sensory panel data, nutrition and claims data, and stability datasets.
* Experience with R\&D systems of record such as PLM, LIMS or ELN, and with specification and technical document management.
* Track record of taking agentic systems past pilot into sustained production use, with adoption and reliability data to evidence it.
* Experience building MCP servers and custom tool layers over enterprise APIs and internal systems.
* Retrieval engineering depth beyond baseline RAG, including hybrid and semantic search, reranking, chunking strategy for technical documents, and table and figure extraction.
* Databricks at production scale, including Unity Catalog, Delta and Lakehouse patterns.
* LLM cost engineering, including token accounting, caching, batching, routing across model tiers and chargeback to business units.
* Experience building internal developer platforms or shared services consumed by other engineering teams.
* Exposure to Responsible AI frameworks, AI model risk management, or EU AI Act readiness and comparable emerging regulation.
* Experience handling commercially sensitive or trade secret data, including how intellectual property is protected when third party models sit in the processing path.
* Experience in a global capability center delivering for global stakeholders across time zones, where the hub owned outcomes rather than executed tickets.
* Having hired, levelled and grown AI or platform engineers in the Indian market.
* A postgraduate qualification in Computer Science, Engineering or Data Science, or in a scientific discipline relevant to food, chemistry, materials or nutrition. Candidates who moved from science into engineering are of particular interest.
* Recognized AI engineering credentials, for example Anthropic's Claude Certified Developer Foundations or Claude Certified Architect exams, GitHub Copilot certification, or Microsoft, AWS or Google AI engineering certifications. Equivalent demonstrated experience is weighted equally.
* Open\-source contributions to agent or LLM tooling, conference talks, published papers or technical writing.

* Lead the design, development, and enhancement of SAP Commerce (Hybris) applications.

* Assess scope changes for technical impact, including architecture, integration, performance, security, testing, deployment, and supportability implications.
* Maintain current architecture and design documentation covering SAP Commerce customizations, integrations, extensions, deployment patterns, and operational dependencies.

**Stakeholder Partnership**
* Own the technical health of SAP Commerce business applications by monitoring stability, performance, maintainability, recurring issues, and improvement opportunities.
* Define and maintain an improvement roadmap aligned with business priorities, automation opportunities, platform optimization needs, and measurable value realization.
* Review business capability KPIs and application\-health trends monthly to identify improvement actions, risks, and technical priorities.

* Participate in client discussions, solution workshops, and strategic planning sessions to present technical recommendations, roadmap proposals, and modernization opportunities.


**Application Development \& Support**
* Manage SAP Commerce feature development, enhancements, integrations, and defect resolution from technical analysis through implementation, testing support, deployment, and stabilization.
* Support production environments, lead critical incident management, and drive root\-cause fixes that reduce recurring incidents and production defect leakage.
* Establish and maintain technical governance processes, documentation standards, operational controls, and audit\-ready evidence for SAP Commerce support\-and\-build engagements.
* Ensure technical governance standards are consistently applied across design, development, testing, release, and support activities.
* Review SLA, incident, defect, release, and performance trends to identify stability risks and continuous improvement actions.
* Improve mean time to restore service by strengthening incident response, triage, escalation, monitoring, and technical recovery practices.

**Team Leadership**
* Conduct regular code reviews across SAP Commerce customizations, extensions, integrations, and APIs to ensure adherence to SAP Commerce best practices, coding standards, security guidelines, performance expectations, and maintainability requirements.
* Build the team capability roadmap, including hiring support, onboarding, certification targets, knowledge\-sharing plans, mentoring, and succession planning for critical SAP Commerce skills.
* Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, continuous improvement, team engagement, and retention.
* Break approved demand into executable technical work, assign work across Senior Developers and Developers, and remove delivery blockers to maintain engineering flow.
* Support capacity planning across support, enhancement, defect resolution, and release work by providing realistic technical estimates and resource demand inputs.
* Monitor engineering productivity through sprint predictability, code review turnaround, build success rate, engineering utilization, and rework reduction.
* Coach Senior Developers and Developers through design walkthroughs, code reviews, pairing, troubleshooting, and structured technical knowledge\-sharing sessions.

* REST/SOAP Web Services
* Microservices Architecture
* Integration Patterns and Middleware

* Third\-Party Services
* CRM and Marketing Platforms
* Third\-Party Services

description:
**Company Overview**
 Arcesium is a global financial technology firm that solves complex data\-driven challenges faced by some of the world’s most sophisticated financial institutions. We constantly innovate our platform and capabilities to meet tomorrow’s challenges, anticipate the risks our clients encounter, and design advanced solutions to help our clients achieve transformational business outcomes.
   

  

 Financial technology is a high\-growth industry as change and innovation continue to disrupt the status\-quo and prompt major transformation. Arcesium is at a particularly interesting time in our own growth as we look to leverage our successfully established market position and expand operations in pursuit of strategic new business opportunities. We value intellectual curiosity, proactive ownership, and collaboration with colleagues, and we empower you to meaningfully contribute from day one and accelerate your professional development.
   

  

 We are looking for a passionate and technically adept Product Lead to join the Treasury group within the Product Management team. The Treasury product portfolio covers critical post\-trade functions including collateral management, margin calculation, portfolio financing, and securities borrowing and lending. This group works with technology teams throughout the process lifecycle to specify, develop, and implement Arcesium’s treasury modules.
   

  

 This role offers the opportunity to define and design the next generation of treasury products on a platform used by some of the most sophisticated hedge funds and institutional asset managers in the world, and to collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Own the product vision, roadmap, and execution for Arcesium’s treasury product modules, focusing on delivering robust, scalable solutions for collateral management, margin, portfolio financing, and securities borrow/lend workflows.
* Rapidly prototype product ideas and validate hypotheses using AI tools and vibe\-coding techniques—building functional prototypes hands\-on to accelerate discovery, test feasibility, and communicate product intent to engineering and stakeholders.
* Distill the vision into product roadmap and product/feature specifications through requirement gathering, solutioning, and business analysis in close partnership with clients and internal stakeholders.
* Collaborate closely with engineers and architects to translate product specifications into design and eventual product, ensuring core capabilities are effectively implemented and continuously improved.
* Rigorously and continuously evaluate the progress of products and features in flight by leveraging test cases and ensuring compliance with product specifications and the overall vision.
* Engage with both internal stakeholders and external users at client organizations to gather feedback, identify pain points, and prioritize impactful product improvements.
* Measure and analyze product usage data and user feedback to guide roadmap priorities and inform investment decisions.
* Conduct market research and competitive landscape analysis to stay ahead of industry trends in treasury and post\-trade technology.
* Articulate business cases, estimate timelines and budgets, and communicate with all stakeholders; prepare project plans, release notes, and other artifacts.
* Partner with product managers across other product groups on cross\-cutting programs and initiatives to provide comprehensive business solutions.


**What You’ll Need**
* 6\+ years of overall work experience, with a minimum of 2 years in product management preferably for financial technology products or platforms.
* Hands\-on experience using AI coding assistants and vibe\-coding / rapid\-prototyping approaches to build working product prototypes. You should be comfortable going from idea to interactive demo without waiting for engineering.
* Customer empathy and a deep understanding of client needs, preferably with experience working directly with hedge funds or institutional asset managers.
* Adept at balancing technical requirements with user and stakeholder needs, both internally and at enterprise client organizations.
* Experience working closely with engineering teams in an agile software development environment.
* Outstanding academic background and a passion to work in a high\-tech software development environment.
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills.
* Critical thinking and the ability to articulate standpoints and ideas and influence stakeholders.

description:

 As a Manager, you will be responsible for supervising and developing teams, managing client service accounts, and driving client engagement workstreams. Your role will involve strategic planning, mentoring junior staff, and maintaining accountability for project success. * Manage resource planning, allocation, capacity, utilization, workload, and delivery commitments across multiple Eloqua projects and workstreams.Identify skill gaps, support hiring and onboarding, and drive training, cross\-skilling, mentoring, and capability development within the team.


**Oracle Eloqua Technical Responsibilities**
* Lead the design and implementation of complex Eloqua Campaign Canvas and Program Canvas solutions.

* Email campaigns

* Contact fields
* Custom objects
* Campaign Canvas
* Program Canvas

* Review overall Eloqua platform usage and recommend improvements related to scalability, performance, usability, and operational efficiency.


**Integration and Data Management**
* Lead and govern integrations between Oracle Eloqua and CRM platforms such as Salesforce, Oracle Sales / Fusion CRM, and other enterprise applications.
* Strong understanding of campaign, contact, lead, opportunity, response, consent, and marketing\-preference data flows across integrated applications.
* Design and manage integrations between Eloqua and:
* Salesforce CRM
* Oracle Sales / Fusion CRM
* Event\-management platforms
* Webinar platforms

* Analytics platforms

**Leadership And Management Responsibilities**

* Build strong relationships across Marketing, Business Development, CRM, Technology, Operations, Data, Analytics, and other stakeholder groups.
* Support resource planning, project estimation, workload management, delivery forecasting, and prioritization.

* Drive continuous improvement across Eloqua implementation, campaign delivery, platform administration, integrations, and support processes.

**Required Skills**
* Strong hands\-on experience with Oracle Eloqua / Oracle Marketing Cloud.

* Strong understanding of marketing automation concepts including demand generation, campaign orchestration, lead nurturing, personalization, segmentation, lead management, and campaign analytics.

title: Supervisor, Applications Delivery

**Job Description**
 The person in this role is responsible for leading the design, delivery, implementation, and ongoing support of high\-quality application solutions. At lead/manager level, the role is accountable not only for technical execution, but also for delivery ownership, team coordination, stakeholder alignment, quality governance, operational stability, and continuous improvement across the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
   

  

 The person in this role works closely with business stakeholders, architects, project managers, vendors, and cross\-functional delivery teams to translate business priorities into scalable, secure, maintainable, and business\-aligned technology solutions. The role is expected to provide technical leadership, guide team members, manage risks and dependencies, and ensure successful delivery outcomes.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Delivery Leadership, Requirements Analysis \& Estimation**
* Lead requirement analysis discussions with business stakeholders, product owners, architects, and delivery teams.
* Translate business, functional, and non\-functional requirements into solution scope, technical approach, delivery plan, and implementation priorities.
* Own or review effort estimation, delivery planning, resource requirements, and execution timelines for assigned initiatives.
* Identify delivery risks, dependencies, assumptions, and constraints, and drive mitigation plans with stakeholders.
* Ensure requirement documents, user stories, solution notes, and technical specifications are complete, clear, and aligned with agreed scope.


**Solution Design**
* Provide technical leadership in converting enterprise architecture and business needs into detailed solution designs and implementation plans.
* Review and approve design artifacts, workflows, integration approaches, technical specifications, and solution documentation.
* Evaluate design alternatives and guide the team toward scalable, secure, high\-performing, maintainable, and cost\-effective solutions.
* Ensure solution designs comply with enterprise architecture standards, security requirements, data governance expectations, and engineering best practices.
* Lead technical discussions and design reviews with architects, vendors, project teams, and support teams.


**Application Development**
* Lead and guide application development, enhancement, configuration, integration, and maintenance activities.
* Review key technical deliverables to ensure quality, maintainability, performance, security, and alignment with agreed standards.
* Provide technical direction to developers and support team members, including code review guidance, design clarification, and issue resolution support.
* Drive reuse of components, utilities, frameworks, and automation capabilities to improve delivery efficiency and consistency.
* Balance hands\-on technical contribution with oversight of team delivery, ensuring work is completed on time and with expected quality.


**Testing \& Quality Assurance**

* You build an engineering team that can repeatedly deliver: Requirement → Design → Prototype → Validation → Production with faster development cycles, strong technical quality and reliable mass\-production performance

We’re proud to be expanding and reaching new heights in Hyderabad.
   

  

 Join us as we create something extraordinary together.
   

  

**Job Overview**
 LPL Financial is seeking a Data Product Analyst to support our Strategic Data Platforms, with a strong focus on how data is produced, shaped, governed, and delivered to downstream consumers across the firm.
   

  

 This role sits at the intersection of Product Management, Data Product Ownership, and Advanced Analysis, and is designed for a senior individual contributor who can bring rigor and clarity to complex, data‑centric platform initiatives.
   

  

 The Data Product Analyst focuses on data as a product—helping define data contracts, validate quality, assess downstream impact, and support data product and platform decisions.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is comfortable working across upstream systems of record, platform services, and downstream consumers, and excels at turning complex data flows into actionable insights and decisions.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Product Discovery \& Capability Support
   

  

* Support product discovery by helping translate business and platform needs into clear data‑centric problem statements.
* Contribute to roadmap planning by evaluating value, risk, and complexity across data initiatives.
* Help define outcomes and success measures for data platform capabilities (e.g., usability, reliability, adoption, quality).


 Advanced Data Analysis \& Problem Solving
   

  

* Perform hands‑on exploratory and diagnostic analysis across distributed data sources and platforms.
* Investigate data quality issues, lineage gaps, and semantic inconsistencies that affect downstream consumers.
* Conduct impact analysis for schema changes, new feeds, platform migrations, or system decommissions.
* Identify systemic issues in data flow, transformation, or consumption and recommend durable solutions.


 Data Product Ownership (Supporting / Platform‑Level)
   

  

* Support Data Product Owners by helping define:
* Data contracts, schemas, and semantic definitions
* Data quality rules, validation logic, and controls
* Usage expectations and downstream dependencies
* Maintain traceability between business intent, data products, and technical implementation.
* Partner with engineering, architecture, and data platform teams to support scalable, reusable distribution patterns.


 Agile Execution \& Delivery
   

  

* Contribute to Jira artifacts (features, stories, acceptance criteria) with strong data and platform context.
* Participate in backlog refinement, sprint planning, and demos to ensure work reflects validated platform and consumer needs.
* Support prioritization decisions by providing evidence‑based impact and dependency analysis.


 Stakeholder Communication \& Influence
   

  

* Act as an analytical partner to Product Managers, Platform Owners, Engineering, and downstream consumer teams.
* Communicate complex data flow and platform concepts in clear, decision‑ready narratives.
* Help align stakeholders across domains by grounding conversations in data realities and trade‑offs.


**What are we looking for?**
 We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast\-paced, team\-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates
 **pursue greatness** 
 ,
 **act with integrity** 
 , and are
 **driven to help our clients succeed** 
 . We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we
 **win together** 
 and
 **create and share joy** 
 in our work.
   

  

**Requirements**
* 5\+ years of experience in Product Analytics, Data Analysis, Data Product Ownership, or Platform‑oriented Product roles.
* Strong hands‑on experience with SQL (advanced querying, joins, performance awareness)
* Experience working with data platforms, distributed data systems, or integration layers.
* Experience adopting emerging AI‑enabled capabilities to improve the speed, depth, and effectiveness of data analysis
* Experience operating in Agile/Scrum environments with cross‑functional product and engineering teams.
* Proven ability to work across ambiguity and translate complex data ecosystems into actionable insights.
* Solid understanding of:
* Data modeling and semantic consistency
* Data quality, lineage, and governance concepts
* Pipelines, and event‑driven architectures (conceptual and analytical understanding)


**Preferences**
* What Success Looks Like
+ Data platform decisions are made with clear understanding of downstream impact and value.
+ Platform teams have strong analytical support when defining and evolving shared data capabilities.
+ Data quality and semantic issues are identified early, before they impact consumers.


**Core Competencies**
* Experience supporting advisor data platforms, or shared enterprise data services.

title: Senior Product Manager - GP & Client Experience (ADI)
description:
**About Us**
 As a world leading provider of integrated solutions for the alternative investment industry, Alter Domus (meaning “The Other House” in Latin) is proud to be home to 90% of the top 30 asset managers in the private markets, and more than 6,000 professionals across 24 jurisdictions.
   

  

 With a deep understanding of what it takes to succeed in alternatives, we believe in being different \- in what we do, in how we work and most importantly in how we enable and develop our people. Invest yourself in the alternative, and join an organization where you progress on merit, where you can speak openly with whoever you are speaking to, and where you will be supported along whichever path you choose to take.
   

  

 Find out more about life at Alter Domus at careers.alterdomus.com
   

  

 We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the
 **GP and client experience** 
 within ADI — the experiences our fund\-manager clients use to run and monitor their business: the client operations centre where they track the progress of their work, their dashboards and reporting, and the client portal. You will own the roadmap and the end\-to\-end product management for this stream. The first use cases go live in October 2026; your job is to build on them and
 **own the future roadmap** 
 that takes the GP experience to its full vision.
   

  

 You will translate the reality of fund administration — across private equity, private credit and real assets — into a clear, consolidated, self\-service experience, turning information that today lives in many places into a single, trustworthy view for clients. You will work hands\-on: authoring executable PRDs and building the first prototypes yourself, then partnering with engineering, design and client\-delivery teams to bring them to production.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities**
**Product strategy \& roadmap**
* Own the vision, strategy and roadmap for the GP \& client experience — including the future roadmap well beyond the first use cases — and converge the platform toward its full product vision.
* Prioritise a single backlog against client value, commercial impact and key\-client risk; make trade\-offs visible and take decisions at pace.


**The GP Experience**
* Own the client operations centre (where clients monitor the progress of their tasks), the client dashboards and reporting experience, and the client portal — defining the journeys, information design and self\-service capabilities.
* Define the single ‘one\-lens’ view across funds and asset classes — bringing valuations, capital calls and distributions, portfolio monitoring, and fund and investor reporting into one coherent client experience.


**Domain \& data**
* Understand how client\-facing information — valuations, cash flows, positions and reporting — is produced across the fund\-accounting, portfolio and reporting estate, and ensure it reaches clients as a single, trustworthy view.
* Work with data and platform teams to define what information the experience needs and where it is sourced, and manage the move from legacy portals so that no client is left behind.


**Building AI\-Native — How We Work**
* Author Executable PRDs (xPRDs) — structured context repositories that combine natural\-language intent, machine\-actionable specification, complete business and technical context, edge cases, success metrics and acceptance criteria, and embedded governance guardrails.
* Build the first functional prototype yourself during ideation and discovery, using AI tooling to validate desirability (product\-market fit with clients) and feasibility (with architects) in parallel — then hand a high\-fidelity, context\-rich prototype to engineering to curate and take to production quality.
* Own the non\-functional requirements — performance, availability, scalability, security and accessibility — from day one, treating them as first\-class product requirements rather than an afterthought.
* Work within an enhanced design\-thinking approach with governance embedded from day one — ethical AI and user rights, privacy, security, risk and compliance, and audit/traceability — alongside explicit attention to data readiness (maturity, availability and quality).


**Delivery \& cross\-functional**
* Act as product lead across the relevant delivery teams; partner with technology and architecture on delivery, and with client\-delivery and commercial teams on adoption and client engagement.


**Essential**
**SKILLS \& EXPERIENCE:**
* Proven senior product management experience delivering client\-facing B2B software, portals or data/reporting products with measurable customer and commercial impact.
* Demonstrated ability to work AI\-native — authoring structured, executable PRDs and building functional prototypes with AI tooling.
* Strong experience with dashboards, reporting and data\-visualisation products, and a sharp instinct for information design and self\-service experience.
* Excellent prioritisation, stakeholder\-management and communication skills, with the ability to create clarity from ambiguity.


**Desirable**
* Domain experience in fund administration, asset servicing or alternatives (private equity, private credit, real assets).
* Familiarity with the fund\-accounting, portfolio and reporting systems that produce client information (such as Investran, eFront, Yardi, Solvas and ReportPro).
* Experience in agile, multi\-team delivery and large product platforms.


**Personal Attributes**
* Outcome\-driven and client\-centric, keeping the client journey at the centre of every decision.
* Hands\-on and comfortable prototyping; happy to build, not just specify.
* Collaborative and influential across product, technology, design, operations and commercial teams.


**What We Offer**
 We are committed to supporting your development, advancing your career, and providing benefits that matter to you.
   

  

 Our industry\-leading Alter Domus Academy offers six learning zones for every stage of your career, with resources tailored to your ambitions and resources from LinkedIn Learning.

title: Associate Product Manager
description:
**Associate Product Manager \- Live Services** 




  





**About Us** 




 Liquidnitro Games is a game development company built to create, launch, and scale ambitious games for a global audience.
 



 Founded by industry veterans with deep experience across free\-to\-play, live services, and large\-scale game production agnostic of platforms, we bring together product thinking, design craft, engineering depth, art execution, data, and live operations under one roof.
 



 We build games from the ground up, take new ideas from 0 to 1, and work with select partners to strengthen, scale, and operate high\-quality game experiences. Our teams combine creative ownership with production discipline, helping projects move from early prototypes to validated products, and from launch to long\-term growth.
 



 At Liquidnitro, we are building the next generation of game teams, products, and tools from India for the global games industry.
 



  





**The Role** 




 We are looking for an
 **Associate Product Manager** 
 to join a team operating and growing a live game.
 



 This role sits at the intersection of players, product, data, design, and live operations. You will help understand how players engage with the game, identify opportunities to improve the experience, and work with cross\-functional teams to turn those insights into product changes, features, events, and experiments.
 



 You should be comfortable moving between data and gameplay, understanding both what the numbers are telling us and what is happening inside the game. The goal is not just to report performance, but to understand why players behave the way they do and what we should do next.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 



* Analyse player behaviour across retention, engagement, progression, monetization, and live events.
* Build a strong understanding of the game's core loop, progression systems, economy, content, and player segments.
* Identify product opportunities and translate them into clear hypotheses and recommendations.
* Work closely with Product Management, Game Design, Analytics, Production, Engineering, and other cross functional teams to improve the game.
* Support the design and evaluation of features, events, offers, progression changes, and monetization initiatives.
* Define success metrics for product changes and evaluate performance after launch.
* Design and analyse A/B tests and other experiments.
* Use cohort and segmentation analysis to understand differences in player behaviour.
* Investigate changes in KPIs and identify the underlying causes rather than stopping at surface\-level reporting.
* Review the performance of live events and features and recommend changes based on player behaviour and outcomes.
* Track competitive games, market trends, and relevant product mechanics.
* Contribute to product roadmap and live\-ops planning based on player needs, game performance, and business priorities.
* Communicate insights and recommendations clearly to both product and development teams.



  





**What We’re Looking For** 



* 1\-3 years of experience in product management – preferably in gaming or consumer related products.
* Strong analytical and structured problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work with data and convert analysis into actionable product decisions.
* Understanding of free\-to\-play game metrics such as retention, engagement, conversion, ARPDAU, and LTV.
* Strong interest in games and a good instinct for player experience.
* Ability to think in hypotheses, test assumptions, and measure outcomes.
* Comfortable working across multiple disciplines and communicating with both creative and technical teams.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* High attention to detail and curiosity about why systems and players behave the way they do.



  





**Good to Have** 



* Experience working on a live mobile or free\-to\-play game.
* Working knowledge of SQL and BI or analytics tools.
* Experience with A/B testing, cohort analysis, and player segmentation.
* Understanding of game economies, progression systems, rewards, and monetization.



  





**What Success Looks Like** 




 You are able to move beyond reporting that a metric changed and explain why it changed, which players were affected, what part of the game caused it, and what we should do next.
 



 Over time, you should develop enough understanding of the game and its players to independently identify product opportunities, build a case for them using data and player insight, and help drive them from hypothesis through implementation and measurement.

title: Entrepreneur in Residence - Product (Travel)
description:
**Why are we building Nuclei?**
 Before we started Nuclei, we listed down a few guiding principles. These were essentially our learning from previous startups/companies:
   

  

* Think big, think global, and not limit ourselves only to India.
* Build a company. We wanted to be sustainable from day 1 and build a profitable business. This does not mean that we compromise on growth, but we most definitely avoid unsustainable growth.
* Build for the long term, not flip it in a few years.
* And most importantly, we wanted to change the perception about India, from being a back\-office/outsourcing destination, to a product destination.


 All the above points came together to form Nuclei's vision — "To build a well respected global product company." At Nuclei, we are building innovative products that help enterprises increase customer engagement and build deeper relationships with their customers, by offering value\-added services like travel and gifting ecosystems.
   

  

**About This Role**
 As part of this vision, we're building a full travel ecosystem including Flights, Hotels, and Experiences, for one of the largest telecom operators in Europe, and expanding this proposition across multiple markets in Europe. This particular EIR seat sits within that travel team. You'll take ownership of category features and initiatives from first identifying the problem through to launch and iteration, working closely with the rest of the product, design, and engineering team.
   

  

**Please note: This is a remote job.**
**Who should apply?**
* Someone with 3 to 5 years of product building experience
* We're looking for product builders who can go 0→1 as well as 1→10 — building something new, and then scaling it through product\-led growth, journey optimization, and continuous iteration. It's not just build and forget.
* Prior experience in a startup would be preferred
* Founder or entrepreneurial experience is strongly preferred for this role — whether that's starting a company, being an early team member somewhere, or building a meaningful project of your own from scratch
* We have a strong preference for candidates with prior experience in travel, marketplace, or high\-volume consumer products


**Who are Product Builders?**
* Product Builders don't get hassled by chaos and constant change, they actually enjoy it and thrive in it. They understand that this is necessary for success.
* Product Builders work on building products from scratch (0 to 1\).
* Product Builders have a high bias for action.
* Product Builders think from first principles.


**What will you do?**
* Own category features and initiatives within our Flights, Hotels, and Experiences, product from problem definition through to launch and iteration.
* Translate customer problems and business inputs into clear requirements and prototypes. Scope and prioritize your own work based on customer and business impact.
* Work closely with the engineers, designers, and analysts who care deeply about their product. Should be able to quickly build rapport with them.
* Understand the tech that goes behind the product like data flow among systems, tech bottlenecks, and RCAs when things break.
* Analyze user behavior, funnel metrics, and feedback to identify opportunities for improvement, and drive product\-led growth initiatives \- journey optimization, activation, retention \- to keep pushing your category forward.
* Plan your features in smaller sprints while staying aware of the larger vision for the travel product and hold a high bar for quality. We're building a world\-class consumer product, so both the customer journey and the underlying tech need to be top\-notch.

title: GenAI Manager
description:
**About the Company** 




 QualiZeal, headquartered in Texas, USA, is a leading provider of AI\-powered Quality Engineering services worldwide. With a diverse portfolio of digital transformation services including Quality Engineering, Digital Engineering, Advisory and Transformation, and Emerging Technology Testing. QualiZeal empowers leading global organizations to achieve quality excellence and sustainable market leadership. Recognized for its industry\-leading growth rate since inception, QualiZeal has been named "The Fastest Growing Digital Quality Engineering Services Company in North America" at the 2022 Global Choice Awards and "Tech Startup of the Year" at the 2024 American Business Awards®. Trusted by over 70 global enterprises and employing more than 850 elite software quality engineers, QualiZeal is a fast\-paced, culture\-driven organization on a high\-growth trajectory.
 



  





 Recognitions:
 


* “The Fastest Growing Digital Quality Engineering Services Company in North America” (2022 Global Choice Awards).
* "Tech Startup of the Year" (2024 American Business Awards®).
* Great Place to Work Certified® (2023\-24, 2024\-25\).
* “Major Contender” in Quality Engineering by Everest Group (2023, 2024\).
* “Major Player” in Quality Engineering by NelsonHall (2024\).
* Notable provider in CAT Services Landscape Report by Forrester (Q4 2023\).
* Economic Times “Best Organization for Women” (2024\). 42% women workforce.
* Telangana Best Employer Brand Award (2024\).
* Industry\-leading Client and Employee Net Promoter Scores (NPS).
* Glassdoor Rating: 4\.2



  





**About the Role** 




  





 We are seeking an experienced GenAI Manager to lead end\-to\-end development and delivery of Generative AI products. This role bridges AI architecture, product development, and engineering execution. You will collaborate with AI Architects, Solution Architects, AI/ML Engineers, Prompt Engineers, and Full Stack Developers to build production\-ready, scalable AI applications.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 



* Lead full lifecycle of GenAI application development: ideation, architecture, development, testing, deployment, and optimization.
* Partner with AI Architects and Solution Architects to translate business requirements into scalable GenAI solutions.
* Define product roadmaps, sprint plans, milestones, and delivery timelines for GenAI initiatives.
* Oversee development of LLM\-powered applications including RAG systems, conversational AI, and AI agents.
* Drive agile delivery with iterative development cycles and rapid prototyping.
* Lead cross\-functional teams: AI/ML Engineers, Prompt Engineers, Full Stack Developers, DevOps/MLOps Engineers, and QA Engineers.
* Collaborate with AI Architects on system design, model selection, and integration patterns.
* Foster innovation, experimentation, and continuous learning in AI/ML technologies.
* Build and scale high\-performing AI development teams; drive hiring and capability development.
* Guide selection and implementation of LLMs, embedding models, and AI frameworks.
* Oversee prompt engineering strategies, RAG architectures, and vector database implementations.
* Manage AI/ML infrastructure: cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP), GPU resources, and model serving.
* Drive MLOps practices: CI/CD pipelines, model versioning, monitoring, and observability.
* Communicate project progress, risks, and outcomes to senior leadership.
* Translate complex AI/ML concepts into business\-focused language for executive audiences.
* Present product demos, technical architectures, and ROI analyses to stakeholders.



  





**Qualifications** 



* Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, AI/ML, Data Science, or related field.
* AI/ML or Product Management certifications are a plus.



  





**Required Skills** 



* 8\+ years in software development, AI/ML, or technology product management.
* 4\+ years leading AI/ML or GenAI development teams and programs.
* Proven track record delivering production\-grade AI applications.
* Strong understanding of LLMs (GPT, Claude, Llama), prompt engineering, RAG architectures, and AI agents.
* Proficiency in AI/ML platforms: LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face, OpenAI/Azure OpenAI APIs.
* Understanding of full stack development: Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, REST APIs, microservices.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP) and MLOps tooling.
* Excellent communication skills; ability to influence technical and business stakeholders.
* Strong product thinking with focus on user experience and business outcomes.
* Proven ability to build, mentor, and scale high\-performing technical teams.



  





**Preferred Skills** 



* Prior hands\-on experience as a software engineer, ML engineer, or data scientist.
* Experience building AI products in regulated industries (healthcare, finance).
* Knowledge of agentic AI systems and multi\-agent architectures.
* Experience with enterprise AI platforms (Azure AI, AWS SageMaker, Databricks).



  





**What This Role Offers** 



* Lead cutting\-edge GenAI product development with high visibility to senior leadership.
* Ownership of innovative AI products from inception to production.
* Work with talented AI architects, engineers, and domain experts.
* Continuous learning and growth in the rapidly evolving GenAI space.



  





**Equal Opportunity Statement** 




 QualiZeal is committed to diversity and inclusivity in the workplace. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds and experiences.

title: Product Management Specialist - SAP FICO
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
 Product Management Specialist \- SAP FICO
   

  

 Deloitte is seeking a Product Management Specialist to support Core Finance applications with a primary focus on SAP Record to Report processes. This role works across business and technology teams to help deliver stable, scalable, and efficient SAP Finance solutions. The ideal candidate brings hands\-on SAP FICO experience, strong understanding of finance operations, and the ability to support both ongoing operations and continuous improvement initiatives.
   

  

**Work you'll do**
 As a Product Management Specialist on the SAP Finance team, you will be responsible for:
   

  

* Supporting SAP Record to Report processes across Deloitte Core Finance applications, with a focus on SAP Financial Accounting (FI), Controlling (CO), and SAP S/4HANA Finance capabilities
* Analyzing business requirements and supporting functional design, configuration, testing, deployment, and post\-production support activities
* Supporting core finance activities including General Ledger, close processes, intercompany accounting, reconciliations, allocations, settlements, and profitability analysis
* Managing integration points between SAP FI/CO and connected systems such as Materials Management (MM), Sales and Distribution (SD), Human Resources/payroll, banking, tax, and external finance applications
* Driving operational improvements through incident resolution, root\-cause analysis, documentation, batch job support, controls, and adoption of new SAP Finance capabilities


**The team**
 Our SAP Finance team supports core finance applications that enable consistency, control, and operational efficiency across Deloitte’s finance environment. The team partners with business stakeholders, technology teams, and internal support functions to maintain critical Record to Report processes and deliver scalable SAP solutions. This is a collaborative environment where process standardization, service quality, and continuous improvement are central to success.
   

  

**Location: Hyderabad**
**Shift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM IST**
**Qualifications**
 Required:
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, Master of Computer Applications (MCA), or a related discipline
* 6–8 years of SAP FICO functional experience supporting Record to Report processes
* Experience configuring SAP Financial Accounting (FI) and Controlling (CO) based on business requirements
* Experience with SAP S/4HANA Finance and New General Ledger capabilities, including Parallel Ledger, parallel currencies, document splitting, and intercompany settings
* Experience with FI\-CO integration, including cost elements, cost centers, activity types, profit centers, internal orders, allocations, and settlements
* Experience supporting at least one end\-to\-end SAP FI or SAP S/4HANA Finance implementation, rollout, or major enhancement
* Experience supporting testing, defect analysis, transport coordination, deployment, and production support activities


 Preferred:
   

  

* Experience with Controlling\-Profitability Analysis (CO\-PA) and its integration with FI and CO processes
* Experience supporting month\-end, quarter\-end, and year\-end close activities in a shared\-services or global finance environment
* Experience supporting integration between SAP FI/CO and MM, SD, Human Resources/payroll, banking, tax, or external finance systems
* Experience with interfaces, data mapping, data conversion, reconciliation, and related documentation
* Experience creating functional specifications, configuration documentation, knowledge articles, or end\-user training materials
* Experience supporting adoption of new SAP Finance capabilities, including artificial intelligence\-enabled features


**Our purpose**
 Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
   

  

**Our people and culture**
 Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
   

  

**Professional development**
 At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state\-of\-the\-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
   

  

**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
 At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

title: Specialist Mfg 1
description:
**Job Summary**
 The Specialist, Manufacturing – AI\-Enabled Innovation (IVI) is an individual contributor within the Amgen India Capability Center (AIN), supporting the design, development, and deployment of digital and data\-enabled solutions across Amgen’s global manufacturing network. In the initial phase, this role supports manufacturing sites in the deployment of core capabilities, contributing to transition readiness, knowledge transfer, stabilization activities and adoption of new ways of working. In the steady state, this role operates within the Innovation Velocity Interface (IVI), contributing to the end\-to\-end lifecycle of innovation—from intake and requirements definition through MVP development and scaling. The Specialist brings deep domain expertise in specific manufacturing systems or processes (e.g., MES, finite scheduling, sensing, performance management) and acts as a bridge between manufacturing SMEs and technical development teams.
   

  

 This role is critical in ensuring that solutions are technically sound, compliant, and aligned to real manufacturing needs, while enabling scalable and reusable digital capabilities across the manufacturing network.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Transition \& Deployment Support (Startup Phase)
* Support deployment of Amgen’s Technology and Workforce Strategy (TWFS) manufacturing capabilities at sites, including MES standardization, documentation automation, and performance management solutions
* Participate in knowledge transfer (KT), onboarding, and stabilization activities to ensure successful transition to AIN\-supported capabilities
* Work with site SMEs to capture process knowledge, system requirements, and operational constraints
* Identify and escalate risks related to process gaps, system readiness, or compliance considerations
* Manufacturing Systems \& Process Expertise
* Provide deep subject matter expertise in one or more manufacturing domains, such as:
+ Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES / MBR design and lifecycle)
+ Finite scheduling and planning systems (e.g., PP/DS, S/4HANA)
+ Sensing, data integration, and digital control towers
+ Performance management and KPI frameworks

* Translate manufacturing processes into structured system and data requirements
* Define guardrails and design principles to guide solution development (e.g., what can be automated, standardized, or scaled)
* Support evaluation of system impacts, dependencies, and integration requirements
* Requirements Translation \& Solution Development Support
* Work closely with Sr Managers, Product Leads, and SMEs to translate business needs into detailed functional requirements
* Partner with technical teams (AI/Data, UX/UI, engineering) to ensure solutions are aligned to manufacturing realities and constraints
* Contribute to solution design, prototyping, and MVP development
* Validate that proposed solutions are fit\-for\-purpose, scalable, and aligned to enterprise standards
* GxP, Validation \& Compliance Alignment
* Assess whether solutions require GxP controls, validation, and documentation
* Ensure requirements incorporate data integrity, auditability, and regulatory expectations
* Partner with Quality and technical SMEs to ensure compliance\-by\-design in all solutions
* Support preparation of validation inputs and documentation requirements where applicable
* Innovation Lifecycle Execution (IVI Model)
* Support use cases through the IVI lifecycle: intake → evaluation → MVP → pilot → scale
* Contribute to business case inputs, including feasibility, constraints, and expected benefits
* Participate in testing, user validation, and deployment activities
* Support development of solutions designed for multi\-site reuse and standardization
* Stakeholder Collaboration \& Integration
* Collaborate with site SMEs, manufacturing leaders, and cross\-functional partners
* Act as a technical translator between manufacturing stakeholders and development teams
* Ensure clear communication of requirements, assumptions, and constraints
* Support structured engagement that balances speed of delivery with quality and compliance


**Basic Qualifications**
* Doctorate/Master's /Bachelor's degree and 8 \- 13 years of experience.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 4\+ years of experience in biopharmaceutical manufacturing, manufacturing systems, or related technical roles
* Demonstrated expertise in at least one domain:
* MES / electronic batch records (e.g., Körber PAS\-X or similar)
* Finite scheduling / planning systems (e.g., SAP PP/DS, S/4HANA)
* Manufacturing data systems, sensing, or digital dashboards
* Manufacturing performance management and KPI frameworks
* Strong understanding of GxP environments, validation concepts and data integrity principles
* Experience translating manufacturing processes into system or digital requirements
* Strong fluency in product management and modern delivery practices (roadmapping, prioritization, user\-centered design, adoption at scale).
* Ability to work effectively with technical teams (data engineers, developers, UX/UI) without being a coder
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills, with attention to detail and system\-level thinking
* Experience supporting system implementations, process improvements, or digital initiatives
* Effective communication and collaboration skills in a cross\-functional, global environment
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and contribute to fast\-paced, iterative delivery models


**Additional Information**
* Travel: as needed to support global stakeholder engagement (limited/periodic).
* Work Style: global collaboration across time zones; strong partnering across sites, functions, and technology teams.

title: Product Application Engineer - Debug
description:
**ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.**
 At AMD, we believe technology can change lives for the better. It can heal us, entertain us, and make us more connected, productive, and understanding of the world around us. And we’re looking for talent who feel the same: people who want to leave the planet better than they found it, those who don’t shy away from humanity’s challenges but are determined to help solve them.
   

  

 AMD is powering the next generation of supercomputing, high\-performance computing, cloud, and AI. Whether you’re designing next\-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or creating go\-to\-market plans, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward.
   

  

 THE ROLE
   

  

 The Technical Marketing Engineer for AMD\-AECG is an adaptable, self\-motivated individual who drives the Vivado and next\-generation tool product roadmap to best serve customer needs. This role is responsible for feature specification, planning, validation, documentation, early training materials, and key customer support. Technical Marketing works closely with Product Planning, R\&D, Applications Engineering, and top\-tier customers to improve the FPGA and Adaptive SoC design process and enable next\-generation designs and methodologies. The environment is fast\-moving, global, and focused on emerging technologies.
   

  

 THE PERSON
   

  

 The successful Technical Marketing Engineer plays a critical role in defining, planning, and supporting Programming File Generation and Hardware Debug in the Vivado Design Suite for AMD FPGA and Adaptive SoC products. This includes driving the programming file generation flow and the in\-system debug experience through Vivado Hardware Manager, Integrated Logic Analyzer (ILA), Virtual I/O (VIO), and readback/verification.
   

  

 This person understands customer needs and pain points across bring\-up and silicon debug, and helps define the next generation of the tool roadmap. title: Manager - Engineering
description:
**About ScienceLogic…**
 ScienceLogic is redefining IT operations for the modern enterprise. Our AIOps platform empowers organizations to achieve Autonomic IT — where systems are self\-healing, self\-optimizing, and seamlessly aligned with business outcomes. We help enterprises and service providers gain unified visibility across hybrid and multi\-cloud environments, automate workflows, and unlock performance at scale.
   

  

 We’re accelerating digital transformation through the power of automation, AI, and analytics — giving IT and business leaders the tools to deliver superior customer experiences, drive efficiency, and innovate with confidence.
   

  

**What We’re Looking For…**
 ScienceLogic is hiring an Engineering Manager for our PowerPack team based in our Hyderabad office. This role will manage a team of approximately 20 software engineers and SDETs responsible for the development, quality, and ongoing evolution of the PowerPack portfolio. You will report to the Director of Product Engineering (India) and will be a member of the India engineering leadership team. This is a people\-first leadership role with meaningful technical responsibility. We are looking for an experienced engineering leader who can build trust, develop future leaders, drive execution, and thoughtfully apply AI\-enabled practices to improve engineering outcomes.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing…**
 You’ll lead a team of approximately 20 engineers comprised of full\-time employees and, covering responsibilities across:
   

  

**People \& Growth**
* Conduct regular 1:1s with team members, providing coaching, feedback, and career development support.
* Hiring: run screening and calibration with recruiting partners, and own onboarding for new hires.
* Management of Contractors performance monitoring and support through contractor\-to\-FTE conversion process.
* Performance management and career development conversations that go beyond the annual review.
* Team health across the org: morale and psychological safety, not just velocity metrics.
* Conflict resolution and mediation to keep the team cohesive under pressure.


**Delivery \& Execution**
* Weekly alignment with your Product Owner on priorities, roadmap, and backlog, and with the leads you're developing as they take on more scope.
* Sprint execution accountability across both working groups, including capacity planning.
* Handling major or complex escalations, including regular syncs to work through what's outstanding.
* Tracking delivery metrics (velocity, uptime, bug counts, deployment frequency) and reporting progress, risk, and dependencies to stakeholders.


**Technical Leadership**
* Architecture and design review for pull requests, ensuring sound technical decisions across the team's work.
* Promoting engineering best practices: testing, code review, documentation, and CI/CD.
* Sponsoring and helping lead cross\-team technical initiatives, such as major platform migrations and release\-process automation.
* Running demo sessions and hands\-on skill\-building with the team on key technical areas.


**AI\-Enabled Engineering**
* Identify where AI creates real leverage in your team's engineering workflows, and act on it yourself, not just approve it from a distance.
* Work alongside engineers to design and deliver AI\-enabled solutions to real product and delivery problems.
* Build your team's capability to use AI as a working tool, including hands\-on training for engineers who are still building that muscle.


**Org Design**
* Today, the org runs flat: you manage all 20 engineers directly, organized across two informally\-led working groups.
* A key responsibility of this role is to identify and develop emerging leaders, establish a Team Lead layer, and evolve the organization into a more scalable team structure over time.


**Qualities you possess…**
* Experience:
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or an equivalent technical discipline
* 10\+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 3\-5 years leading engineering teams.
* Proven track record of delivering high\-impact software products, with the willingness to roll up your sleeves and work directly with engineers when needed.
* Experience managing engineering teams of this size directly, and a track record of developing individual engineers into first\-line leaders, even where that title doesn't formally exist yet.
* Self\-starter with the ability to operate effectively in ambiguous environments.
* Technical Competence:
* Strong understanding of modern software architecture and distributed systems.
* Proficiency in Python and REST APIs, with familiarity across other technology stacks.
* Proficiency in database technologies and event\-driven architecture.
* Deep understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC), CI/CD, and testing methodologies.
* Hands\-on, personal experience building or shipping at least one AI\-enabled feature: you were in the technical problem, contributing to design and trade\-offs, not sponsoring or approving someone else's work.
* Leadership \& Management:
* Exceptional leadership, coaching, and mentoring skills, with a visible track record of developing engineers with diverse experience levels and career aspirations.
* Demonstrated ability to build, motivate, and retain high\-performing engineering teams, with strong delivery instincts across sprint accountability, capacity planning, and cross\-team coordination.
* Strong critical thinking and problem\-solving abilities.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and negotiation skills with engineers, peers, and senior leadership.


**As a plus, you have...**
* Experience in a GCC, IDC, or other geographically distributed engineering environment.
* Product engineering background: ownership of outcomes, not just delivery of tasks.
* Familiarity with AIOps, monitoring, observability, or enterprise SaaS domains.
* Engineering background with hands\-on depth in Python, REST APIs, or cloud\-native development, enough that you're credible in architecture and design conversations, even though you won't be writing production code day to day in this role.
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum at scale, where ceremonies drive outcomes rather than checkbox rituals.
* Familiarity with JavaScript and frameworks like React.
* Exposure towards Spec Driven Development(AI\-DLC) and or TDD


*Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At ScienceLogic, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.*
*All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which you are applying.*
**About ScienceLogic**
 ScienceLogic is a leader in IT Operations Management, providing modern IT operations with actionable insights to resolve and predict problems faster in a digital, ephemeral world. Its solution sees everything across cloud and distributed architectures, contextualizes data through relationship mapping, and acts on this insight through integration and automation.
