**Position Summary**
**Job Description \- Strategy \& Transactions – Strategy (Senior Consultant)** 
**At Deloitte Strategy \& Transactions (S\&T), we don’t just advise \- we architect the future. Our team is uniquely positioned at the intersection of strategy and execution, empowering clients to tackle their most pressing challenges and unlock transformative growth.** 
**We work with C\-suite executives, Boards, and business leaders to answer the questions that matter most, from navigating complex M\&A and driving digital transformation, to reshaping operating models and unlocking new market opportunities. We are trusted advisors during our clients' most critical, high\-stakes moments.** 
**But we don’t stop at client impact, we are equally passionate about investing in our people. At S\&T, you’ll be part of a dynamic team culture that accelerates leadership development, fosters curiosity, and delivers hands\-on experience at the forefront of strategy and transactions. We design differentiated career paths that empower our talent to thrive.** 
**Our capabilities span the full lifecycle of transformation, from Enterprise and Growth Strategy to Enterprise Technology and Transformation Strategy, end\-to\-end M\&A, valuation and modeling, and performance improvement \& restructuring, to infrastructure \& real estate advisory and sustainability\-driven innovation.** 
**If you’re looking to work where bold thinking meets real\-world impact, and where your growth matters as much as your clients’, Strategy \& Transactions is your next move.**
**The Team**
 Our Strategy practice brings together several key capabilities that will allow us to architect integrated programs that transform our clients’ businesses, including Corporate \& Business Unit Strategy, Technology Strategy \& Insights, Enterprise Model Design, Enterprise Cloud Strategy and Business Transformation.
   

  

 Strategy professionals will serve as trusted advisors to our clients, working with them to make clear data\-driven choices about where to play and how to win, in order to drive growth and enterprise value.
   

  

 We are looking for Consultants for our Enterprise and Growth Strategy practice, with relevant experience in Insurance Industry.
   

  

**Work You Will Do**
 Deloitte’s ‘Strategy’ offering helps companies address the entire range of top management challenges including pursuing new growth opportunities, developing go\-to\-market strategies, channel strategies, and pricing strategies.
   

  

* Identify strategies for growth and value creation
* Develop appropriate business models, operating models, and capabilities to support their strategic vision
* Providing service excellence by identifying key client business issues, determining client needs by supplementing the standard assessment techniques and tools with innovative approaches, evaluating, and validating analysis and developing recommendations for the client in the context of the overall engagement
* Contribute to multiple work\-threads of large, complex engagements, with high\-quality deliverables
* Participate in the development and presentation of proposals for business development activities
* Maximize the ROI on technology investments and leverage technology trends to architect future business strategies


**Required Experience And Skills**
**Enterprise and Growth Strategy – FSI – Insurance**
**Strategy\-specific Experience:**
 Following experience would be required as a part of this job role:
   

  

* Insurance: Includes working with Life \& Annuities, Personal Lines, Commercial Insurance, Group, Specialty, Health, Reinsurance, Insurance Brokers sub\-sectors, etc. preferably US markets


**Enterprise and Growth Strategy Financial Services Industry Experience:**
* Hands\-on experience of working in Corporate Strategy or consulting firm catering to leading Insurance companies (minimum 2 years of experience)
* Enterprise and Growth Strategy consulting experience \- Corporate Strategy, Go\-to\-market (GTM) Strategy, Business Unit Growth Strategy, Roadmap Development, Business Model, Capability Assessment, Efficiency Plays, Cost Take\-out, Market Research / Assessment, Business Planning, Business \& Digital Transformation, Vendor Assessment, Operating Model Assessment, etc.) within Insurance Industry
* Ability to articulate leading business issues and trends within the Insurance industry. Interest and knowledge about the current trends in any one of its sectors (Life, Commercial, Personal, Specialty, Reinsurance etc.)
* Demonstrate ability to understand and analyze business issues and leverage technology to solve them
* Preferred experience of engaging in strategic issues with senior\-level clients including C\-Suite executives
* Exposure to working in non\-India geographies (preferably US) and / or interacting with global stakeholders
* Exposure around building dynamic Excel models and macros for market sizing, forecasting, and automation of repetitive analysis and reporting tasks
* Ability to craft structured generative research prompts and use tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude or MS Copilot in Excel/PowerPoint) to streamline research, create slides, synthesize interviews, or simulate models
* Experience in developing and deploying LLM tools to accelerate research, generate summaries, and support slide creation


**Core Consulting Skills**
* Clear and concise communication \- Conduct client interviews, participate in workshops / trainings and present recommendations; strong verbal and written skills are critical
* Good client presence – Interact and build relationships with clients and other team members
* Analytical thinking – Comfortable with managing large data sets, ability to perform detailed, quantitative analysis and research (primary and secondary), synthesize and present insights and recommendations from data through configurable dashboards; familiarity with Python, and Excel Macro scripting is nice to have
* Logical structuring \- Structured approach to problem solving and ability to perform root cause analysis of client problems
* Deadline\-oriented and quality focused – Support team in development of deliverables, manage specific work\-thread, develop plans for components of engagement, manage and mentor junior resources
* Collaboration \- Be able to work both independently and as part of a team with professionals at all levels. Be able to prioritize tasks, manage change in scope, work on multiple assignments, and raise concerns/questions where appropriate
* Ownership – Take ownership, manage and co\-ordinate activities and tasks assigned and drive to completion
* Network \- ability to chart one’s own career and build networks within the organization.


**\#FY27ReferralCampaign**
**Required Qualifications**
**For Consultants:**
* MBA or MS from a premier (Tier\-1\) school in India or abroad (not more than 6 years post MS / MBA)
* 4 to 5 years of relevant experience (post MS / MBA) in Insurance Industry
* Experience in consulting, or corporate strategy environment strongly preferred
* 3\+ years of industry experience with Insurance industry focus (preferably US clients)


**Our purpose**
 Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

 Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. Our state\-of\-the\-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
   

  

**Benefits To Help You Thrive**

Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
   

  

**Recruiting tips**

title: Product Manager - Agentic
description:
**About This Role** 



* We are building an agentic banking platform for large enterprise banks. Multi\-modal AI converts business intent into autonomous agents that orchestrate processes, integrate data, and make intelligent decisions — turning weeks of manual work into hours.
* You will lead AI agents and intelligent automation — building capabilities that deploy autonomous agents to solve complex banking problems at enterprise scale.
* This is not a pillar\-specific role. You'll work across three interconnected pillars (Durable Processes, Data Connectors, AI Agents), collaborating with peer PMs to architect and ship agentic solutions end\-to\-end.
* You'll report directly to the
 **Product Director** 
 and own the complete journey: from defining what agentic capabilities matter most, to shipping them, to measuring their impact.
* This role is for a PM who understands how AI agents fundamentally change enterprise automation, who can navigate technical and business complexity, and who ships with both ambition and rigor.



  





**What You'll Own** 




**Strategic ownership** 



* Define the AI capability roadmap — which features move the needle, which delight customers, which drive competitive advantage
* Make the hard calls: what ships in Year 1, what comes after, what's out of scope
* Own the quality bar — "enterprise grade" means reliable, explainable, compliant, and safe. Set and enforce that standard.
* Shape how AI surfaces across the platform — consistency in UX, tone, and behavior across copilot, solution builder, and other capabilities



  





**Execution leadership** 



* Lead cross\-pillar alignment — work with peer PMs to define integration points and success metrics
* Conduct customer discovery: what AI capabilities matter most, what fears do they have about AI, what use cases are most valuable
* Make data\-driven decisions: usage patterns, LLM cost, inference latency, customer sentiment all inform roadmap
* Unblock ambiguity: when technical feasibility isn't clear (cost, latency, quality), you synthesize information and move forward decisively



  





**Partnership with platform PMs** 



* Collaborate with peer PMs who own the platform pillars
* Establish clear integration contracts: where AI surfaces in their UIs, how data flows from their features to your LLM calls, how they measure success



  





**We're Looking For** 




**Experience shipping one or more of the following:** 




 AI\-native products or features that users love · Enterprise software with AI capabilities built in (not tacked on) · Products that required deep LLM integration and cost optimization · Cross\-functional initiatives that span multiple teams or product areas · Experiences that balance power with usability.
 



  





**Core capabilities** 



* AI fluency, not just enthusiasm – You understand LLM capabilities and limits. You know the difference between a prototype and a production system. You think about cost, latency, hallucination, and compliance from day one.
* Systems thinking across pillars – You see how an AI feature in one pillar impacts the others. You optimize for platform coherence, not local feature wins.
* Customer reality grounding – You spend time with users and understand their AI skepticism. You don't oversell; you deliver reliably.
* Quality obsession – You know that "enterprise grade" is non\-negotiable. Explainability, compliance, reliability, and safety are as important as feature velocity.
* Technical depth without being an engineer – You read research, understand prompt engineering tradeoffs, can discuss model selection and fine\-tuning. You think rigorously about technical problems.



  





**Nice to have** 



* Shipped copilot or AI\-assisted features in a production SaaS product
* Experience with LLM cost optimization, latency budgeting, or inference infrastructure
* Familiarity with enterprise workflow, process automation, or BPM domains
* Track record of shipping cross\-functional initiatives with competing stakeholders

title: Product Manager II
description:
At F5, we strive to bring a better digital world to life. Our teams empower organizations across the globe to create, secure, and run applications that enhance how we experience our evolving digital world. We are passionate about cybersecurity, from protecting consumers from fraud to enabling companies to focus on innovation.
   

  

 Everything we do centers around people. That means we obsess over how to make the lives of our customers, and their customers, better. And it means we prioritize a diverse F5 community where each individual can thrive.
   

  

 Job Description: Product Manager II
   

  

**Role Summary**
 F5 Digital is building the enterprise AI muscle that will power the next generation of intelligent, secure, and scalable internal platforms. We are seeking an AI Product Manager II to own our AI model ecosystem, token economy, and core agentic platform enablement.
   

  

 This role is responsible for the end\-to\-end management of our LLM stack, developer\-facing AI resources, and token economics. Beyond managing costs and access, this PM will actively support F5’s agentic transformation, building the tools, documentation, and developer experience that make it seamless for engineering teams to build secure and scalable AI agents.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is highly analytical, technically curious, and passionate about the rapidly evolving LLM and agentic software frameworks, combining product execution with a strong focus on developer enablement and platform economics.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
**Model Ecosystem Management**
* Own the lifecycle of AI models within F5, evaluating, onboarding, and managing access to the latest foundational models (e.g., Gemini, OpenAI, open\-source models).
* Partner with platform engineering to ensure seamless, secure, and observable model integration into our developer environments.
* Maintain a deep understanding of the evolving LLM landscape to guide internal development teams toward the right architectures and models.


**Agentic Transformation \& Developer Enablement**
* Serve as the product owner for developer\-facing tooling, SDKs, and APIs that facilitate agentic AI development.
* Support teams across F5 in transitioning from simple prompt\-engineering to complex, multi\-agent workflows and systems.
* Create and curate high\-quality developer resources, sample code, and onboarding paths to accelerate internal agent deployment.


**Token Economics \& Platform Efficiency**
* Own the enterprise token economy: track usage patterns, forecast capacity, and develop optimized pricing and chargeback models.
* Define and track key platform metrics, including model latency, token efficiency, usage anomalies, and cost\-per\-query.
* Partner with Finance and Cloud FinOps to manage and project enterprise AI spend while scaling capacity.


**Governance \& Responsible AI**
* Ensure model access and agent integrations adhere to strict corporate security, privacy, and data governance policies.
* Implement guardrails, logging patterns, and cost controls to reduce model risk and mitigate shadow AI across developer groups.


**Product Ownership \& Execution**
* Manage and prioritize the backlog for model hosting, API routing, token metrics, and developer enablement tools.
* Lead Agile sprints and collaborate closely with systems, platform, and security engineers.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
* 3\+ years of Product Management experience delivering developer platforms, APIs, SaaS, or technical infrastructure.
* Strong working knowledge of generative AI fundamentals (LLMs, API integrations, context windows, token consumption, and model routing).
* Familiarity with agentic concepts (e.g., tool\-calling, agent frameworks, MCP, orchestrators) and a desire to help developers build agents.
* Highly analytical with experience monitoring technical metrics, usage data, cloud spend, or subscription economics.
* Excellent technical communication skills, with the ability to build trust with engineering teams.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with developer platforms, technical documentation, or internal developer relations (DevRel).
* Understanding of cloud governance, FinOps, or managing usage costs for API platforms.
* Hands\-on experience with AI development orchestration tools (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex) or secure hosting platforms (Gemini, Azure AI, AWS Bedrock).


**What Success Looks Like**
* Maintain a streamlined, secure model\-onboarding pipeline that keeps F5 at the absolute forefront of AI technology.
* Build an intuitive developer experience that reduces the time\-to\-first\-agent for internal engineering teams.
* Establish a completely transparent, observable, and cost\-effective token\-tracking model.
* Mitigate security and cost risk by migrating developers away from unmanaged third\-party APIs to the secure, internal ecosystem.


**Why Join F5 Digital?**
 This is an opportunity to help shape F5’s enterprise AI foundation and build a platform that empowers every team to innovate responsibly with AI. You will work at the intersection of AI strategy, platform engineering, governance, and real\-world business impact—defining how F5 scales intelligent automation across the company.

title: Delivery Manager
description:
We are looking for an experienced
 **Delivery Manager – Engineering** 
 to lead end\-to\-end delivery across multiple software and product engineering initiatives.
 



 The role requires a strong combination of
 **engineering delivery leadership, people management, Agile execution, technical understanding, program management, and executive stakeholder management** 
 .
 



  





 The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of managing multiple engineering teams, delivering complex
 **SaaS, cloud, and product initiatives** 
 , improving engineering productivity, and ensuring predictable, high\-quality releases.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



  





 Engineering Delivery Leadership
 


* Own end\-to\-end delivery of multiple software/product engineering initiatives from planning through production release.
* Define delivery plans, milestones, timelines, dependencies, and success criteria.
* Ensure predictable and high\-quality delivery across multiple engineering teams.
* Identify delivery bottlenecks and proactively drive resolution.
* Ensure effective coordination between Engineering, Product, Architecture, QA, DevOps, and Business teams.
* Drive engineering delivery governance and establish consistent delivery processes.



  





 Agile \& Program Management
 


* Lead Agile/Scrum execution across multiple engineering teams.
* Drive sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand\-ups, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and release planning.
* Track delivery progress, risks, dependencies, issues, and mitigation plans.
* Ensure effective prioritization and capacity planning across teams.
* Establish appropriate governance and reporting mechanisms for engineering programs.
* Manage cross\-team dependencies and ensure timely resolution of blockers.



  





 People \& Engineering Leadership
 


* Lead, mentor, and develop multiple engineering teams and engineering managers/leads.
* Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, ownership, and continuous improvement.
* Support hiring, onboarding, performance management, succession planning, and career development.
* Identify skill gaps and work with leadership to build appropriate team capabilities.
* Ensure effective resource allocation and workforce planning across engineering initiatives.



  





 Engineering Excellence \& Productivity
 


* Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on engineering productivity and delivery efficiency.
* Establish and monitor engineering KPIs and delivery metrics.
* Track metrics such as:
* Sprint predictability
* Velocity
* Cycle time
* Release frequency
* Lead time
* Defect rates
* Production incidents
* Engineering productivity
* Identify trends and implement corrective actions to improve delivery performance.
* Promote engineering best practices, quality standards, automation, and operational excellence.



  





 Stakeholder \& Executive Management
 


* Partner closely with Product, Architecture, Engineering, QA, DevOps, and Business leadership.
* Provide executive\-level communication on delivery status, risks, dependencies, issues, and business outcomes.
* Present program health, delivery metrics, and improvement initiatives to senior leadership.
* Build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
* Proactively communicate delivery risks and establish mitigation strategies.



  





 SDLC, DevOps \& Quality
 


* Ensure adherence to SDLC, Agile, engineering quality, CI/CD, and DevOps practices.
* Work with engineering teams to improve release management and deployment processes.
* Ensure appropriate quality gates are established throughout the software development lifecycle.
* Partner with QA and DevOps teams to improve automation, release quality, and production stability.
* Drive continuous improvement in engineering processes and delivery standards.



  





 Primary Skills – Must Have
 


* **12\+ years** 
 of experience in Software Engineering / IT.
* **5\+ years** 
 in Delivery Manager, Engineering Manager, Program Manager, or Senior Technical Project Manager roles.
* Strong experience managing
 **multiple engineering teams** 
 .
* Proven experience delivering complex
 **SaaS / Product / Cloud\-based solutions** 
 .
* Strong knowledge of
 **Agile/Scrum and SDLC** 
 .
* Strong program/project planning and execution experience.
* Excellent
 **stakeholder and executive management** 
 skills.
* Strong experience in risk, issue, dependency, and change management.
* Strong people leadership and team\-building capabilities.
* Experience managing engineering capacity and resource planning.
* Strong understanding of engineering delivery metrics and continuous improvement.
* Experience with
 **Jira, Confluence** 
 , and other Agile delivery tools.



  





 Technical Exposure
 



  





 The candidate should have a strong understanding of modern software engineering and cloud technologies, including:

 AWS / Azure

* **CI/CD**
* **DevOps**
* **Kubernetes / Containers**
* **Databases**
* **Distributed Systems**
* **Software Architecture**

 Hands\-on coding is

 .

 .

 .

 .

title: Sr Product Manager – Orchestration, Shipment Technologies
description:
**Description**
 Amazon’s Ship Tech (STS) team is responsible for key technology that enables planning, orchestration, and execution of transportation service to deliver billions of packages to Amazon.com customer globally. Our goal is to ensure the best delivery experience for customers across all geographies through a highly scalable, adaptive, and autonomous transportation network.
   

  

 We are looking for a product leader to own and drive our technical roadmap for key systems and capabilities that enable Customer Delivery Experience and Cost to Serve Reductions. They will own critical Amazon services that leverage real\-time insights and predictive supply chain data across our entire network to drive automation, efficiency, and visibility. These services allow us to identify problems that could impact on\-time delivery, take proactive actions to mitigate network and package level problems, and keep customers informed on what is happening.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is capable of breaking down and solving complex problems, and has a strong will to get things done! You will work on real world problems on a global scale. You own your products end\-to\-end and influence the direction of our product and technology which impacts hundreds\-of\-millions of customers around the world. You are a hands\-on, pragmatic problem solver that easily balances trade\-offs between competing interests. You thrive in a fast\-moving team environment where you are able to juggle complex dependencies and requirements while producing optimal solutions.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will have successfully built 0\-to\-1 products in the logistics and transportation space. You are able to synthesize a variety of technologies and capabilities, and translate them into products that solve specific pain\-points. You are analytical and data driven, and are laser focused on measuring and improving the success of products you own. You will own the business model, P\&L, feature development, product roadmap, customer segmentation and pricing, and demand generation. You will drive product development across multiple cross\-functional teams.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Serve as the subject matter expert in transportation visibility and intelligence, leveraging your deep domain knowledge to identify market trends, customer pain points, and opportunities for product enhancement
   

  

 Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including engineering, design, and customer success, to translate business requirements into technical specifications and drive the successful implementation of new product features and enhancements
   

  

 Develop a comprehensive product roadmap that aligns with the company's overall strategic objectives and effectively communicates it to stakeholders
   

  

 Continuously gather and analyze customer feedback, market intelligence, and industry insights to inform product decisions and ensure the delivery of high\-value solutions
   

  

 Champion a customer\-centric design approach, working closely with Operational, Business, and UX team to optimize the user experience and drive product adoption
   

  

 Manage the product lifecycle, from ideation to launch, ensuring that milestones are met, risks are mitigated, and the product is delivered on time and within budget
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders
* Experience overseeing roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience in using statistical analysis to identify issues or opportunities for improvement
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience as a product manager or owner


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights
* 5\+ years of supply chain operations and logistics experience
* 5\+ years of transportation and supply chain experience
* 2\+ years experience with customer delivery experience
